tei:titleStmt.tei:title: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs rtsa gsum bsnyen sgrub cho ga phyogs bsdus grub gnyis padmo'i skyed tshal gyi them byang 'god pa la/ka)thog mar ra
o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs rtsa gsum bsnyen sgrub cho ga phyogs bsdus grub gnyis padmo'i skyed tshal gyi them byang 'god pa la/ka)thog mar ra

tei:div.tei:p: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i ring lugs rtsa gsum bsnyen sgrub cho ga phyogs bsdus grub gnyis padmo'i skyed tshal gyi them byang 'god pa la/ ka) thog mar rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan/ 37

1-76 kha) bsam lhun gsol 'debs/ 77-81 ga) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ spyi dril gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i las byang chog khrigs ye shes sprin phung*/ 82-210 nga) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bsam lhun dril sgrub gsol 'debs dngos grub snying po/ 211-212 ca) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bsam lhun dril sgrub snying po'i bcud bsdus/ 213-233 cha) bla ma padma khrag 'thung las: phrin las bzhi sgrub kyi brgyud 'debs/ 234-239 ja) bla drag po padma khrag 'thung las: gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar gyi las byang*/ 240-269 nya) bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po las/ dbang sdud zhags sgrub kyi las byang khrigs su bsdebs pa yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po/ 270-324 ta) bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po las/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying po rab gsal/ 324-326 tha) 'khor 'das zil gnon gsol 'debs bsdus pa padma'i myu gu/ 327-328 da) thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ longs sku ltar sgrub kyi 'don khrigs su bsdebs pa padma'i phreng ba mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ 329-345 na) bka' brgyad phrin las bsdus pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung*/ 346-347 pa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi rgyun khyer snying po'i don bsdus/ 348-379 pha) bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las/ phrin las go cha 'bar ba me yi 'khor lo bklag chog tu bkod pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal/ 380-495 ba) rdo rje phur pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ 496-497 ma) bla med yang phur gwa'u dmar nag las: las byang phrin las rgyun khyer yid bzhin nor bu/ 499-522 tsa) 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dug ri me 'bar nag po khro bo kun 'dus kyi ngan sngags zhag sgrub chog bsgrigs/ 523-568 tsha) 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi bsnyen sgrub sogs nyer mkho'i phrin las snying po gsal byed/

569-577 (i u rta mgrin 'dir 'dzud dgos) dza) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ gcod yul gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung*/ 578-592 wa) gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i 'ja' lus mkha' spyod sgrub thabs bklag chog tu bkod pa bde chen gsang lam/ 593-621 zha) bdud 'dul drag mo'i brgyud 'debs bsdus pa/ 622-622 za) ye shes mkha' 'gro khro gnyer gtum mo rtsa ba gsum dril gyi cha lag /gdong lnga'i gsang sgrub gnam lcags ur mo'i phrin las bklag chog tu bkod pa gnas gsum ḍākki'i bka' rgya ma/ 623-647 'a) seng gdong ma'i srung zlog rgyun khyer/ 648-649 ya) rlung zhags mkha' 'gro'i gsol 'debs bde chen dpal bskyed/ 650-651 ra) mkha' 'gro'i las byang bde chen dpa' mo'i rol rtsed/ 652-679 la) rlung zhags sgrub pa'i bsnyen dmigs/ 680-681 sha) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi las byang 'ja' lus srog sgrub ngag 'don chu babs su bkod pa/ 682-726 sa) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi bskang ba 'chi med dpal gyi ljon pa/ 727-729 ha) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las/ spros med rgyun khyer snying po dril ba/ 729-739 a) tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi/ bsnyen yig padma'i do shal/ 740-746 i) rta mgrin gsol 'debs/ 747-747 u) rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub 'don khrigs su bkod pa rngam pa'i rta skad/ 747-764 e) rtsa gsum spyi la 'jug pa'i me mchod phrin las bzhi ldan don gnyis dpal ster/ 765-786 o) lo gsum bsnyen sgrub mtshams kyi khog dbub mkhyen brtse'i dgongs rgyan sgeg mo'i me long*/ 787-816 oṃ) e wam̐ sgrub sde zung gi lo gsum mtshams kyi bca' yig ma nor lam ston/ 817-833 bcas re zhig rdzogs so/ rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bkam̐' gtem̐r srim̐ zhum̐ ru/

/em̐ waṃm̐ dpem̐ skrunam̐ kham̐ng nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog / ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga'i grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyis skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // ༈ dpe cha'i bzo bkod dang par zhus sogs ni o rgyan gsang sngags dang karma longs spyod zung gis bgyis pa'o// // ༈ rdzogs pa chen po 'khor 'das yongs grol las/ rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi cho ga'i 'don khrigs blo dman 'jug bde zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ rigs kun khyab bdag bla ma rje/ /dbyer med rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /dngos po kun gyis rab btud nas/ /de sgrub cho ga'i 'don khrigs spel/ 'dir rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi cho ga nyams su len pa la gsum/ sbyor ba sta gon gyi rim pa dang*/ dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub kyi chog khrigs/ zur du cho ga'i yan lag gzhan du bshad pa'o/ dang po ni/ sku rten bris 'bur gang rung bkram pa'i mdun du/ stegs bu kheb can gyi steng du ras bris sam/ 'bru tshom lha grangs bkod pa'i steng du bla gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa rgyan spros can nam rtsa gsum spyi gtor gang rung*/ bum pa bcud ldan mgul chings can/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka /mdun du chad brtan/ bskul/ gter srung ma gza' dam gsum/ phyi mchod sna bdun sngon 'gro/ tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor bsags la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs sogs spyi ltar song nas/ brgyud pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ e ma hoḥ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /chos sku kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ /sna tshogs ma 'gags sprul pa'i pho brang nas/ /longs sku rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs/

/rnga yab padma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /pad 'byung yab yum sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /ke ri gsang ba mchog gi pho brang nas/ /ḍākki mtsho rgyal sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas mchog yang rdzong shel gyi sgrub phug nas/ /dpal chen sangs rgyas ye shes la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab rgya sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i pho brang nas/ /karma las 'brel rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /chos bdag brgyud 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /spyi gtsug nyi zla padma'i gdan steng nas/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang lus rtsa khams dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod gnas mchog nas/ /dam chos 'khor 'das yongs grol la gsol ba 'debs/ /mthu ldan dgra bgegs tshar gcod gnas mchog nas/ /bka' srung gter bdag rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol btab bden pa'i mthu byin gyis/ /bdag sogs skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs kun/ /'khrul med phyag rdzogs dgongs pa'i btsan sa zin/ /rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sa lam yongs bgrod nas/ /kun bzang klong du 'ub chud sangs rgyas shog / gnyis pa la'ang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum/ sngon 'gro la'ang dgu las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba la/ skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa sad par byas la/ na mo: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun 'phags pa'i tshogs: chos longs sprul gsum gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ sems can pha ma rigs drug 'khrul 'khor rnams: sdug bsngal kun bral bde ldan mchog reg pa'i: ma nor byang chub sa lam la 'god phyir:

zung 'jug bde chen mchog tu sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i dge ba rnams/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral gyur cig /bde dang bral bar ma gyur cig /btang snyoms chen por gnas gyur cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams 'od zhu rang la thim par gyur: ces brjod/ dkar gtor sngon du song nas bzhi pa bgegs gtor la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ om̐ sarba bighnān a karṣa ya dzaḥ rten la dgug /om̐ sarba bighnān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥ?ghṛ hna daṃ ba liṃ dye swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngo/ hūm̐: bdag ni khro rgyal 'bar ba dbang gi sku: ye shes gsang gsum mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: byang chub dngos grub bsgrub la bar gcod bgegs: mchod sbyin khyer la so sor rang gnas gshegs: om̐ badzra kro dha hya ghṛ wa gnod byed sarba u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las mi shigs rdo rje'i sku: ye shes las grub sra mkhregs pha lam ltar: mi shigs 'khor lo me ri mtshon cha'i gur: phyi nang sprul pa'i khro bos mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra tsakra rakṣa hūm̐: drug pa mchod pa byin rlob ni/ hūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul spyan gzigs lha mi'i tshogs:

dpag med nam mkha'i khyon khengs kun bzang sprin: gzung 'dzin 'khri ba'i bag chags kun sbyangs nas: bla med bde gshegs mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ badzra arghaṃ?shabda āḥhūm̐: bdun pa thun min nang gsang gi mchod rlob ni/ hūm̐: thabs shes bde stong bhandha rab 'khyil dbus: byang sems dkar dmar bde chen bdud rtsi'i sprin: sbyor sgrol sman raka ting 'dzin tshogs gtor 'di: sbyangs spel bsgyur pa'i ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ sarba a haṃ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta pū dza khā hi: brgyad pa byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'og min lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas/ /kun bzang chos sku'i lha tshogs byin phob cig /ma 'gags dbyings rig zang thal pho brang nas/ /longs sku rdor sems lha tshogs byin phob cig /ma bcos sku lnga rang byung pho brang nas/ /sprul sku dga' rab rdo rjes byin phob cig /gang 'dul thugs rje mngon shar pho brang nas/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba kun 'dus byin phob cig /rnga yab padma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /rje btsun pad 'byung yab yum byin phob cig /mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas mchog nas/ /ḍākki ye shes mtsho rgyal byin phob cig /bod yul dben gnas so so'i sgrub gnas nas/ /rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lngas byin phob cig /zab rgya sgo 'phar gter gyi pho brang nas/ /karma las 'brel rtsal gyis byin phob cig /dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /chos bdag rgyud 'dzin rnams kyis byin phob cig /spyi gtsug nyi zla padma'i gdan steng nas/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla mas byin phob cig /rang lus rtsa khams dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs byin phob cig /gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod gnas mchog nas/ /dam chos 'khor 'das yongs grol byin phob cig /mthu ldan dgra bgegs tshar gcod gnas mchog nas/ /bka' srung gter bdag rnams kyis byin phob cig

/las bzhi dam tshig gnyan po'i pho brang nas/ /yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i lha tshogs byin phob cig /chos sku'i byin 'bebs thugs rje sha ra ra/ /longs sku'i byin 'bebs bkrag mdangs ta la la/ /sprul sku'i byin 'bebs bag dro me re re/ /rig 'dzin byin 'bebs thugs rje spungs se spung*/ /dkyil 'khor byin 'bebs dpal 'bar lams se lam/ /gnas 'dir byin chen phob la dbang chen bskur/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dza/ a be sha ya a āḥ dgu pa brda sgo dbye zhing phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: sku gsum byin phob dbang bskur dngos grub stsol: ye shes sgo phyes 'khrul pa'i sgo bcad nas: dkyil 'khor mchod cing phyag 'tshal mi btang bsgrub: snang stong lha skur rtogs kyang sdig bshags bgyid: om̐ badzra tsitta hūm̐ sa twa āḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang bcu gcig las/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐: kun bzang rgyal ba ye sangs rgyas: āḥ 'gags med longs sku rang rtsal rdzogs: om̐: sgyu ma'i zung 'jug gsal snang dag: hrīḥ gnyis bsdus snang srid kun la khyab: om̐ ma hā shū n+ya ta dzñā na dharma hūm̐: gnyis pa rten dang rten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: nam mkha' rlung me sa chu las: dbang chen ri rab rdo rje'i gzhi: me ri dur khrod phyi nang rdzogs: 'khor lo pad nyi zla gdan dbus: ye shes sprul pa'i gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang : chos 'khor 'dod snam rtsig pa dang : pha gu drwa phyed rin chen brgyan: mda' yab pu shu bang rim ldan: ka gdung bla bre 'phan gdugs tshang : dbus su rin chen sna lnga'i tog: sgo rdzogs mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs tshang : phyi dang nang med zang thal klong : 'ja' 'od ye shes lnga ldan gtibs: de nang rma bya seng glang rta: khyung chen sde lnga'i khri 'phang du: zla ba'i lte bar yi ge hūm̐:

gnas 'gyur rdo rje padmar gyur: de nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: rang nyid longs sku rdo rje sems: dkar gsal zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan 'bar: dbu skra smug 'bol spyi bor brgyan: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rigs bdag mthing : phyag gnyis snang stong rdor dril brten: sku lus 'od stong spyan ras gzigs: che mchog zhi khro rigs brgya rdzogs: ye shes na bza' cod pan 'phur: phyed skyil bde stong ting 'dzin ngang : gnas lnga rigs lnga'i longs spyod rdzogs: rtsa sgor rta mgrin dbyug tho dmar: gsang bar dbyings phyug bde bar sbyor: sngon mo lang tsho mnyen lcug ldem: zil chags yab la spyan gzigs mdzes: skra grol ratna'i cod pan 'phur: phyag gnyis mgul 'khyud gri thod 'dzin: spyan stong khengs pa'i 'ja' gur dbus: yum chen brgya rtsa bye ba stong : rgyan drug ga shal chas rdzogs mdzes: zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril: rdo rje padma mnyam sbyor bas: bde ba bskul zhing mi rtog 'char: zung 'jug gzi brjid cher rgyas bsgom: gnas lngar rigs lnga'i lha mo mdzes: phyogs bzhi ke'u ri yab yum brgyad: rang rtags phyag rgyas brgyan zhing 'gying : mtshams bzhir skyong ma mkha' 'gro bzhi: gri thod rgyan ldan 'gying stabs bzhugs: phyi rim thub pa rigs drug ni: 'gro drug skyabs mchis tshul du gsal: sgo bzhir stag seng khyung 'brug bzhi: rang rtags rgyan ldan rol stabs bsgom: de ltar dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha: dran snang chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: 'od zer dpag yas sprin 'tshubs bzhin: thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phro 'du las: skad cig gnas nas spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badzra sa twa buddha dzñā na sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

gsum pa dbang bskur ba ni/ dbang lha rigs lnga 'og min zhing nas byon: khrus bstsal sgrib dag dbu rgyan cod pan thob: byin rlabs dbang bskur dngos grub mchog thob nas: zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lha ru byin gyis rlobs: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐: kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bzhi pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: rnam dag chos sku g.yo med spros bral las: sna tshogs longs sku rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: gnyis bsdus sprul pa 'gro don yid snang phyir: kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lnga pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: rang bzhin dbyings la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang : sna tshogs thabs kyis sems can mun sel ba: kun tu snang ba rdo rje dkyil 'khor lha: dbyer med brtan par bzhugs shing chos 'khor bskor: badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: drug pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: drug pa khyab brdal kun gzhi brda yi chos: kun 'dus yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bag chags 'dag bya'i phyir: yul 'dzin ngo bo dag la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pu ho: bdun pa phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos ma: zhal zas sil snyan gzugs sgra dri ro reg: glu ma gar ma sgeg mo phreng 'dzin sogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul: om̐ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐: brgyad pa yid sprul gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum rab 'byams ri rab gling khams nas: rgyal srid rin chen bkra shis rtags brgyad rdzas: phyi nang spyan gzigs kun tshang mchod pa'i sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul: om̐ badzra rā ni ta saṃ pra ra ni ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: dgu pa nang gsang gi mchod pa ni/

hūm̐: rang byung snod yangs mchog tu bskyil ba yi: dkar dmar byang sems pañtsa kun sbyar nas: sman raka gtor tshogs sbyor sgrol mchod pa 'di: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul: om̐ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta pū dza āḥhūm̐: sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ khyab bdag bla ma kun tu bzang po mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab rdo rje la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen shrī singha dang*/ /padma thod phreng mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ /rtsa gsum gling pa thugs mchog rdo rje la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /mi 'jigs rdo rje snyan grags rgya mtsho dang*/ /gsang sngags bstan rgyal tshe dbang 'dus pa rtsal/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /bka' bab lung bstan mkhyen rab grags pa'i zhabs/ /rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma thams cad la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /rigs bdag rdor sems dam pa rigs brgya dang*/ /yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol/ /chos skyong srung ma dam can rgya mtsho dang*/ /nor lha gter bdag yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag /sman mchod 'bul lo phrin las rnam bzhi stsol/ kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hoḥ bdud rtsi'i thig le gnas gsum du bkod cing lce thog tu myong la/ badzra a mṛ ta siddhi mmepra yatstsha/ bcu pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: kun bzang klong nas zhi dang khro gar sprul: 'gro don yid snang dbyer med rdo rje sems: kun 'dus yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dug lnga rnam dag rigs lnga longs spyod rdzogs: 'byung lnga rnam dag yum lnga so sor gsal: yab yum sku la zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs:

rtsa khams 'khor lo'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: kau rī tsau ri la sogs dbang phyug ging : sgo ba sgo ma sprul sku thub pa drug: mtshams dang laṅka la sogs 'gro 'dul gyi: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bcu gcig pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis/ dmigs bsal sgrub pa'i skabs dang bdag 'jug gnas 'dren sogs skabs khyad par can dang 'brel na dzap khang dbye ba ni/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ gis dbye ba las bsnyen rkyang skabs mi dgos/ dang po bsnyen dmigs ni/ bdag gi snying gar 'od lnga'i klong*/ /zla steng rang 'dra'i ye shes pa'i/ /thugs kar rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐/ /dkar gsal sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ /'od 'phros 'phags mchod byin rlabs bsdus/ /sems can sgrib sbyangs bde chen bkod/ /tshur 'dus sngags phreng nyid la zhugs/ bsnyen pa ni/ om̐ gu ru buddha dzñā na badzra sa twa hūm̐: zhes dang yig brgya ci nus bzlas/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyi nyams len dang bsnyen rkyang kho na'i skabs 'dir dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod dang bcas rjes kyi bya ba nongs bshags bsdu rim bsngo smon bkra shis sogs kyis mtha' dbyung bar mdzad pa yin no/ gnyis pa sgrub pa'i skabs bsnyen pa'i mgor dzap khang dbye la bsnyen pa khyug tsam song rjes bdag mdun dus gcig tu gsal btab la/ dmigs pa ni/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ yig la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi rdor sems yab yum lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i thugs brgyud bskul te de rnams kyi mdun bskyed dwangs ma'i thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros phyogs bcu dus bzhi bde gshegs sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas bdag mdun gyi lha rnams la thim pas gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mched lcam rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag bshags/

dam can chos skyong dregs pa can rnams dbang du bsdus/ phrin las rnam bzhi 'bad med du bsgrubs/ yang 'od zer rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas so so'i las dang rgyu mthun gyi rnam smin sdug bsngal sdig ltung nyams chag thams cad lhag med du sbyangs nas phyi nang snod bcud thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par gyur par bsams la/ om̐ gu ru buddha dzñā na badzra sa twa hūm̐: mthar yi ge brgya pa ci mang bzla'o/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams dang mchod bstod bya/ gsum pa cho ga'i yan lag bshad pa la gsum/ rang don tshogs bsags dang bdag 'jug gzhan don gnas lung ngo*/ dang po la gsum/ phyag 'tshal bshags pa/ bskang ba'o/ dang po tshogs zhing gsal gdab cing phyag 'tshal ba ni/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad rang mdun nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drang ba ni/ e ma hoḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi kun gyi bdag nyid che: bla ma rdor sems zhi khro yongs rdzogs dgongs: 'dir gshegs nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: nyams chag na rag sbyang phyir phyag mchod bzhes: hoḥ bdag lus phung po bsdus bya sgyu ma yi: shes sgrib bag chags ma lus sbyang slad du: rtsa khams zhing khams lha ru mos byas nas: rtse gcig gdung ba drag pos phyag 'tshal lo: bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: skye med chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: ci yang sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mngon par byang chub sku la phyag 'tshal lo: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: che mchog khro bo'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jam dpal sku yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: padma gsung gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: yang dag thugs kyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: phur pa phrin las lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bla ma rig 'dzin lha la phyag 'tshal lo:

ma mo rbod gtong lha la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha la phyag 'tshal lo: dmod pa drag sngags lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bka' sdod sgo ma'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: dam can rgya mtsho'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: kun bzang klong nas zhi dang khro gar sprul: 'gro don yid snang dbyer med rdo rje sems: kun 'dus yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: kun bzang yab yum thugs rje sprul pa ni: rdor sems spyan ma la sogs rigs lnga dang : sems dpa' sems ma yab yum bcu drug bcas: thub drug sgo ba yab yum brgyad la sogs: zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: che mchog la sogs khrag 'thung yab yum dang : kau rī siṃ ha phra men brgyad rnams sogs: sgo ba yab yum dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: khrag 'thung lnga bcu brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: ka dag dbyings rig sku la phyag 'tshal lo: zang thal khyab bdag sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'od gsal bde chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo: ci yang sa le'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mngon par byang chub sku la phyag 'tshal lo: rang rig rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: 'khor 'das ye shes chen por phyag 'tshal lo: snang srid sangs rgyas zhing la phyag 'tshal lo: snod bcud gdod ma'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sgra grags gsung dbyangs drug cur phyag 'tshal lo: gang shar gnas lugs de la phyag 'tshal lo: nyag gcig thig le chen por phyag 'tshal lo: de ltar rab gus gdung bas phyag byas mthus: bskal pa thog ma med nas da lta'i bar: bdag sogs nyams chag sdig ltung ci bsags pa: lhag med byang nas rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sar: mngon rdzogs bla med byang chub thob par shog: gnyis pa la/ bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ tshig dbang dang sbrel ba'i bshags tshan bzhi las/ thog mar bshags yul gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid sgyu lus snang stong spyi bo'i steng : rig pa skye med dung mdog rdo rje sems:

thabs shes phyag rgya bsnol zhing snyems ma 'khyud: skyil krung thugs kyi hūm̐ mthar yig brgyas bskor: sngags phreng 'khor zhing 'od zhu bdag la thim: bdud rtsis lus khengs bag chags g.ya' bral bsgom: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs? ma yengs brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na/ mtshams med lnga yi sdig pa 'dag /dang po bum dbang bskyed rim dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig nyams chag bshags pa ni/ om̐: kṛ ya rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sgor zhugs nas: bdag lus gzhal yas khang du gnas pa yis: gnas lnga phung lnga rigs lnga yab yum ste: bskyed pa lha sku phyag rgya ma gsal zhing : gsal brtan dag gsum tshad du ma rdzogs nas: phung khams snod bcud lha ru rgyas ma thebs: rdzogs pa lus rtsa sprul sku ma rtogs nas: rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro tha mal 'dzin: rdo rje lus kyi ngo sprod ma rtogs nas: 'da' ka 'od kyi gong bu gdeng ma thob: yo ga'i bsgom don tshul bzhin ma rtogs nas: bskyed pa'i tshe na zhal phyag ma gsal zhing : rdzogs pa'i tshe na ting 'dzin ngo ma sprod: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs don dang mi ldan pas: bum dbang dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: tshogs mchod dus su ser sna'i zhen pas bcings: bskang bshags dus su bzlas brjod grangs nyung sogs: tshod yod chog shes le lo'i dbang gyur pa: bla med 'od gsal de bzhin ngang gis bshags: dug lnga ye grol ye shes lnga ru bshags: dug gsum sku gsum mnyam nyid ngang du bshags: rnam rtog tshogs drug mi rtog dbyings su bshags: kun rtog ma rig ka dag ngang du bshags: phung khams rnam dag rigs lnga rgyal bar bshags: khams lnga rnam dag yum mchog rigs lngar bshags: 'byung lnga rnam dag lha mo lnga ru bshags: sgo dgu 'dzin rtog theg dgu'i ngang du bshags: rnam shes tshogs brgyad sems dpa' brgyad du bshags: skye mched bcu gnyis lha mo rnams la bshags: rigs drug 'khrul 'khor thub pa drug la bshags:

rtag chad mu bzhi sgo ma bzhi ru bshags: 'khrul 'dzin sna tshogs dkyil 'khor lha ru bshags: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: gnyis pa gsang dbang dang 'brel ba'i bshags pa ni/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo bla ma he ru kaḥ rdo rje sems dpa' nyams chag sbyong ba'i lha: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro byang sems tshogs: rigs lnga zhi khro'i lha tshogs thams cad dang : srung ma dam can tshogs bcas dgongs su gsol: bdag cag thog med dus nas da lta'i bar: ma rig sgrib pas tshor dang ma tshor gyis: sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag dang : mi dge mtshams med nyon mongs brgyad khri'i nongs: sdig pa mi dge bgyis dang bgyid du stsal: yi rang byas shing rkyen gyur thams cad bshags: u pa'i man ngag gsang ba'i sgor zhugs nas: lus gnad tshogs drug lhug bzhag mi shes shing : phung khams lha skur ma rtogs rtsa khams sgrib: ngag gnad gzung 'dzin stong pa'i tshig la chags: ngag rlung sngags su ma dag srog rtsol sgrib: yid rlung dhū tir 'ching ba'i tshad ma phebs: gtum mo'i bde drod lus la ma shar ba: a nu'i mtha' bral gnas lugs don ma rtogs: gsang dbang dam tshig phog pa mthol lo bshags: mdor na so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi: sdom pa dam tshig nyams chag ci mchis kun: gnong 'gyod nongs pas mthol bshags phyin chad sdom: dag tshangs sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: gsum pa ni sher dbang dang 'brel ba'i bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i rig ma dgongs su gsol: dga' bzhi'i gnas gter rdo rje pho nya mo: thabs ldan las kyi phyag rgyar byin ma brlabs: snang stong yab yum zung 'jug mi shes shing : dbyings rig yab yum phyi nang ris su phyes: gsal stong yab yum ngang rgyun ma bsrings nas: bde stong ro la chags pas ting 'dzin bsgribs: dga' bzhi bcu drug bde stong nyams ma myong : dbab ldog 'dren dkram gnad du ma khel zhing :

zag med lhan skyes ma mthong bdud rtsi nyams: sbyor ba'i tshe na bde stong dbye gsal dka': sgrol ba'i tshe na snying rje'i bag chags zhan: 'khrul gzugs rmongs pas mu stegs spyod par shor: ma hā bde ba chen po'i don ma rtogs: sher dbang dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: bzhi pa tshig dbang dang 'brel ba'i don bshags ni/ hoḥ ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas dgongs su gsol: a ti yo ga'i mtha' bral don bzung nas: lta ba gtad med rgya yan mi shes shing : bsgom pa brdal khyab 'od gsal ma rtogs nas: spyod pa mtshan ma'i bag chags snang ba bsgrubs: 'bras bu gsum gyis so sor ris su phyes: dbyings rig dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: ka dag klong la gzhal med ma rtogs shing : zang thal rig pa'i tshogs drug 'gyu ba bgag: sems kyi rang bzhin stong nyid ma rtogs nas: rnam shes rlung la mtshan ma'i lta ba 'dzin: khregs chod dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: gzhi ni 'od gsal rang ngo ma mthong zhing : sems nyid chos skur ma rtogs thig le nyams: lam ni snang bzhi zad sar ma phyin zhing : khregs chod thod rgal nyams snang tshad ma phebs: 'bras bu yang dag mngon byang ma chub cing : a ti'i lta ba klong du ma gyur pa: tshig dbang dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: lta ba ye sangs rgyas pa'i klong du bshags: sgom pa mi dmigs rgya yan klong du bshags: spyod pa gang shar ro snyom klong du bshags: gzhi ni 'od gsal ma bcos klong du bshags: lam ni zang thal 'gags med klong du bshags: 'bras bu 'khor gsum yongs dag de bzhin bshags: bshags dang bshags bya stong nyid klong du bshags: a ti klong chen lta ba'i bshags pa yis: ye grol gdod ma'i dgongs pa la gnas shog:

ces mi dmigs lta ba'i ngang nas bshags: spro na bde gshegs spyi bshags bya ba ni/ om̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas: rdo rje dam can ma lus dgongs su gsol: dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin byang chub go 'phang du: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje bsgrub pa'i phyir: yi dam lha dang rdo rje slob dpon dang : gsang ba'i dam tshig grangs su mnos pa la: dam bcas bka' las 'da' bar mi bgyi ste: las dang skal bas dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang : phrag dog la sogs shor nas nongs bgyis pa: rdo rje slob dpon bstan pa'i sgron me la: snying nas smad cing dam tshig nyams pa dang : dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje spun rnams la: ngan sems log par lta ba la sogs pa'i: sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: yi dam lha yi phyag rgya ma gsal zhing : sngags kyi bsnyen pa grangs las chad pa dang : dus drug las kyi mchod pa khyad par du: bsnyen sgrub bskang ba'i cho ga ma bgyis te: bka' ltar ma lcogs gzhung bzhin rngo ma thogs: gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: rdo rje slob dpon byams pa'i sku drin gyis: snyan khung brgyud nas sems kyi dkyil du bzhag: thugs kyi man ngag byin pas dam tshig 'dres: gsang mtshams 'das nas 'chol bar smras la sogs: thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: chos rnams mnyam pa nyid du ma rtogs te: yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: le lo snyoms las gnyid kyi dbang gyur te: bsnyen sgrub dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: lus ngag yid kyi bsrung bya 'das pa yis: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa bshags: rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: yo byad 'byor tshogs chung ba mthol lo bshags: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du: mngon rtogs spong len bgyis pa mthol lo bshags:

mkha' 'gro sde bzhi rnams kyi spyan lam du: khas blangs dam bcas nyams pa mthol lo bshags: chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: gtor ma lo zlar 'gyangs pa mthol lo bshags: dus gsum pha ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: drin lan lan gyis ma lon mthol lo bshags: mched dang lcam dral rnams kyi spyan lam du: dam tshig brtse gdung chung ba mthol lo bshags: 'gro drug sems can rnams kyi spyan lam du: snying rje phan sems chung ba mthol lo bshags: so sor thar pa rnams kyi sdom pa dang : byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa dang : rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig la sogs pa: 'gal zhing nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags: mi 'chab mi sbed slan chad sdom par bgyi: dus gsum byas pa'i sdig sgrib mthol bshags na: tshangs par mdzad nas sku gsung thugs la sogs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: zhes sogs yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing bshags pa bya'o/ gsum pa skong ba la bdun/ dang po thun mong phyi yi nyer spyod dang 'dod yon lnga yi bskang ba ni/ skong rdzas rnams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu? byin gyis brlabs shing mkha' khyab tu spel/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na: yan lag brgyad ldan gtsang ma'i chab: gtsang mar spos ldan zhabs bsil mtsho: dkar dmar me tog mdangs bcud ldan: spos mchog ngad ldan bdug pa'i sprin: nyi zla mar me 'od lnga 'tsher: gser mdog 'dag chal dri yi chab: 'bru sman sbyar ba'i zhal zas brjid: rnga dung sil snyan rol mo ldir: dkar mdzes me long padma 'dzin: ser mdzes ting ting pi waṃ rdung : mthing mdzes dung chos rnga yab 'dzin: dmar mdzes dri mchog zhal zas stob: ljang mdzes pañtsa li ka thogs: mthing mdzes chos 'byung spyan mdzes bsnams: thams cad gar gyi stangs stabs bsgyur: dngos 'byor mchod sprin brgya rtsa brgyad: yid sprul 'khor 'das kun 'gengs 'dis:

rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs dam bskang : bskangs nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: ngan song sdig ltung lhag med sbyangs: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa yis: 'bras bu sku gsum lhun grub shog: om̐ badzra sa twa sarba pañtsa ku la arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe dharma dhā tu pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: gnyis pa bdud rtsi sman gyi skong ba ni/ hūm̐: phung po lnga yi bhandha ru: rtsa rlung thig le'i bdud rtsis gtams: chos nyid don gyi ye shes rgyun: mtshon byed rtags kyi a mṛ tas: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing rtog sgrib dag: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: gsum pa chags bral rakta'i skong ba ni/ hūm̐: 'khor lo lnga yi bhandha ru: nyon mongs rtog tshogs bsgral ba'i khrag: rang grol gshis kyi dmar chen po: snang ba brda yi rakta 'dis: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing rtog sgrib dag: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā rakta khā hi: bzhi pa rmad byung gtor ma'i skong ba ni/ āḥ 'byung 'dus las kyi gtor gzhong du: sha khrag drod dbugs gtor ma bshams: dwangs ma lnga ldan longs spyod che: 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i bha lingtas: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing rtog sgrib dag: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā bha lingta khā hi: lnga pa snang gsal mar me'i skong ba ni/ hoḥ sgron me drug gi kong bu ru: phung lnga rnam dag sdong bu btsugs: rang byung ye shes mar me sbar: 'od gsal snang bzhi'i mchod sprin 'dis: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing rtog sgrib dag:

bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā dzñā na dī paṃ pra tītstsha swā hā: mar me'i smon lam ni: hūm̐: bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: snying po byang chub lam la zhugs pa yis: 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi ltung zhing : chags sdang gcong rong gnas su mi skye dang : log lta dmyal ba'i zangs khar rbab mi 'gril: 'khon 'dzin gcan gzan gdug pa'i skad mi thos: nyon mongs mtshon rtse gdug pa'i zer mi phog: dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' drin che ba dang : srog gis sbrel ba'i mched dang lcam dral dang : gsum pa'i dbang gis sbrel ba'i rig ma gsum: skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du: mi 'bral rtse gcig 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: sa bcu khyad par rim gyis bgrod par shog: nam zhig tshe 'phos lus brjes dus byung nas: 'khor ba'i g.yang sar lan gcig ltung srid kyang : snang ba'i sgo 'byed zhun mar mdangs gsal 'dis: rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon cing : kun tu 'od kyi sa la rgyud sbyangs nas: padma chen po'i sa la lhun gyis grub: rdo rje 'dzin dang bde ba chen po'i sa: 'khor lo tshogs chen sa la gshegs pa'i tshe: sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis mdun bsus shig: yi dam lha yis rgyab nas srog rten cig: byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mtha' skyor cig: mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis sna drongs shig: ma tshogs dbang mo rnams kyis rjes skyongs shig: ye shes bla ma'i sa la rgyud sbyangs nas: lcang lo can gyi sa la phyin pa'i tshe: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas nas kyang : rdo rje khro rgyal khyod kyi zhal mthong nas: rig 'dzin rnams dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang : bla med sku gsung thugs su 'grub par shog: drug pa dag 'gyur lha'i skong ba ni/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso bo kun tu bzang : sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi mes thugs dam bskang : ma dag phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga:

ye nas rigs lnga yab yum thugs dam bskang : khams dang skye mched rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: sems dpa' sems ma bcu drug thugs dam bskang : rnam shes tshogs brgyad rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: sgo ba yab yum brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : nyon mongs rigs drug rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: bcom ldan thub pa drug gi thugs dam bskang : bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs rang rtsal ni: khams drug yab yum bcu gnyis thugs dam bskang : dbang po rnam shes tshogs brgyad gnas gyur pa'i: gnas kyi kau rī ma brgyad thugs dam bskang : 'dod yon brgyad kyi rang bzhin gnas gyur pa'i: yul gyi phra men brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : rtag chad mu bzhi rang bzhin gnas gyur pa'i: ye shes sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : bag chags dbang gis las lus 'khor ba las: spor byed chen mo brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las thogs med sgrub: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang : rakta dmar gyi arghaṃ dang : rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang : rnal 'byor tshogs kyi longs spyod dang : snang gsal zhun chen mar me dang : sha chen gsur gyi dud pa dang : thod pa ltag sprod rnga sgra dang : rkang chen dung gi gling bu dang : thun mong mchod pa sna tshogs kyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bdun pa ting 'dzin rtogs pa'i skong ba ni/ hūm̐: dngos po chos nyid yangs pa'i klong du bskang : snang ba ye shes chen po'i klong du bskang : gsal ba shes rab 'bar ba'i klong du bskang : sdug bsngal ka dag chos nyid klong du bskang : kun rdzob don dam skye med klong du bskang : hūm̐: bskang du med de skye med klong du bskang : mchod du med de gnyis med rol pas mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug chen por sbyor: bsgral du med de mnyam nyid dbyings su bsgral:

ye sbyor ye sgrol chen po'i thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: de ltar skong bshags zab mo 'di yang 'bad na mtshams med lnga yi sdig kyang nges par byang nas mchog thun mong dngos grub tshegs med par myur du thob pa'o/ rang don du bdag 'jug bya ba la/ dkyil 'khor dbang rdzas mchod rdzas sogs ma tshang ba med pa gzhung bzhin 'du bya la/ gzhung gi gsol 'debs skyabs sems nas bzung bdag bskyed mchod bstod bar song nas dzap khang dbye zhing*/ bdag mdun dbyer med kyi bskyed bzlas bya/ de nas rnam bum dang las bum bsgrubs nas mchod bstod 'od zhu bcas kyi mthar gsol kha nas bshags skong tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ de nas dngos gzhi ni/ ji ltar dam pa sogs? las bum chus khrus byas la/ spro na bgegs gtor spyi ltar dang bsdu na hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ gu gul bdug badzra rakṣa rakṣa sa srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms/ sa gzhi spos chu?maṇḍal phul/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po laḥ byang chub ma thob bar du ni: skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi: sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: 'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed do: sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir: gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod: don dam spros bral byang chub sems: rang byung mtha' bral gsal stong bsgom: zhes lan gsum skyabs sems tshogs bsags dkyus gcig tu grub par byas te/ kyaiḥ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yi: dkyil 'khor smin pa'i dbang mchog dag: skal ldan bu la gnang bar stsol:

phyin chad bskyed rdzogs rgyud la gnas: zhes gsol ba btab cing dam bca'/ de nas ye shes pa dbab pa ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ t swa bhā w rang nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gsal ba'i snying gar ye shes sems dpa' rdor sems yab yum rjes su chags pa'i sbyor bas snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad dpal rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du spyan drangs te snying ga nas sib sib thim par mos la 'bebs rdzas dang rol mo'i sgra sbyar zhing*/ oṃ gu ru buddha dzñā na badzra sa twa dzñā na a be sha ya a aḥ ra ra ra ra tsā la ya tsā la ya hūm̐ āḥhaḥdzhaiṃ/ oṃ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brtan par bya'o/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang bar badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bar mos la/ hūm̐: chos sku bum pa'i lto ba ru: rdor sems zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: skal ldan bu yi spyi bor bskur: bskyed rim sku yi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru buddha dzñā na badzra sa twa hūm̐: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de ltar bum pa'i dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gnas skabs lus lhar bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthar thug snod bcud kyasi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bdag nyid bcom ldan dpal rdo rje sems pa'i sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs par yin no/ bhandha bde ba chen po'i pho brang du bla ma yab yum sbyor ba'i dkar dmar byang sems bhandhar 'khyil ba'i bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag la/

hūm̐: thabs shes bhandha mtshan ldan 'di: bdud rtsi sngags phreng gsung dbyangs rdzogs: skal ldan bu yi mgrin par bskur: bzlas brjod sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru buddha dzñā na badzra sa twa hūm̐: wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes bdud rtsi myangs pas rtsa thams cad bdud rtsis gang*/ dug gsum gyi rnam rtog 'gags/ bde ba'i ye shes skyes par bsam/ des gsung gi dbang thob ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gnas skabs ngag sngags kyi 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthar thug sgra skad thams cad grags stong 'gag med bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems pa'i gsung mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ shes rab ye shes ni/ bde stong dbyer med mtshon byed me long sindhū ra'i thig le snying gar byugs pas gzugs dang lang tsho rdzogs pa'i shes rab ma snyems ma'i ngo bo pang du 'khod par bsams la/ hūm̐/ 'di bsten sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bla med byang chub mchog gi lam/ /skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas/ /dga' bzhi ye shes rgyas par shog /karma mu dra dzñā na siddhi hūm̐/ zhes 'du shes sum ldan gyis rig ma dang mnyam par sbyar bas dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas lhan skyes kyi bde ba brtan par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa atmā kau3 haṃ/

zhes brjod cing 'khyud rgya bya/ de ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas/ thugs kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gnas skabs su lam pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthar thug 'khor 'das kyi rtog tshogs thams cad bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ de nas tshig gi dbang ni/ rang byung ye shes gsal la mi rtog pa'i mtshon byed shel rdo bstan la/ hūm̐: shel rdo chos dbyings dkyil 'khor te: bde stong yan lag ngo sprod rdzogs: skal ldan bu yi snying gar bskur: yongs rdzogs ka dag dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru buddha dzñā na badzra sa twa hūm̐: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ltar dbang bzhi pa bskur bas sgo gsum cha mnyam gyis bsags pa'i bag chags dri ma dag lam khregs chod thod rgal bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ maṇḍal phul/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na: slob mar bzung nas spyad du gsol: bsod nams? bdag 'jug rgyas par mi spro na/ dbang bskur gnas 'dren rab gnas sogs la 'brel ba'i tshe rig me dor ba tsam gyis chog par gsungs pa ltar na/ om̐ badzra sa ma ya om̐/ āḥbadzra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swā badzra sa ma ya swā/ hā badzra sa ma ya hā/ zhes me tog phul bas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams gnyis su med par bsam zhing*/ om̐/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig /om̐ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ om̐ badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ om̐ badzra sa ma ya ho/ zhes dngos grub bskul zhing bstim mo/ gnang ba zhu ba ni/

thal mo sbyar bas btud de/ om̐/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi slob mar 'jug par 'tshal/ zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ dbang bskur gyi tshe bdag 'jug rgyas par blangs kyang gnang ba zhu ba 'di ni nges par bya dgos so/ gsum pa gzhan don gnas lung gi cho ga 'og tu shes par bya'o/ ༈ rtsa ba'i gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ thog mar tshogs bya ba ni/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gis byin gyis brlabs: hūm̐: bdag nyid rdor sems thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge 'phros: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ las me rlung chus: dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor bdud rtsir bsgyur: hūm̐: phyi snod 'jig rten tshogs gzhong du: nang bcud sems can tshogs su bsgyur: 'khor 'das gnyis med mchod pa'i rdzas: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: om̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdor sems yab yum la: zhi ba sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyis bskor: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar dpyangs cod pan sna tshogs pu ru ru: rin chen snyan cha rgyan gdub khro lo lo: zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan dga' bro ya la la: glu len gar byed bro rdung khrigs se khrig: brda 'gros mnyen lcug 'khril ldem khyugs se khyug: bde stong nyams dbyangs sna tshogs lhangs se lhang : bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od phung kyi li li: byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus rtsal sha ra ra: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen myur du phob: tshogs mchod rdzas la bcud chen sna tshogs phob: dkyil 'khor rdzas la gzi brjid bkrag mdangs skyed: gnas khang 'di la 'od phung 'ja' gur 'khyil: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mor nyams rtogs spel:

rten 'brel phun tshogs dga' ston bskyed du gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ de nas tshogs mchod ni: hūm̐: bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes tshogs kyis mchod: sku lnga lhun grub bde chen ngang du bzhes: gnyis med bde stong mchod pas dgyes gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: de nas tshogs kyi skong ba ni: hūm̐: mchod sprin lha mo nam mkha'i gar bsgyur ma: sna tshogs dbang po tshim byed mchod 'dzin tshogs: bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i bhandha ru: byang sems bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsis bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i bhandha ru: shes rab skye med gsang ba'i rdzas kyis bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i bhandha ru: gsal stong gnyis med sbyor ba'i mchod pas bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i bhandha ru: dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag gtor mas bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo'i bhandha ru: nyon mongs rtsa mdud grol ba'i raktas bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: phung po 'byung lnga dag pa'i bhandha ru: dbang po rnam lnga mchod rdzas bcud kyis bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig:

hūm̐: rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa'i bhandha ru: ma 'gags lhun grub rang byung rdzas kyis bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: hūm̐: ye shes lnga ldan lhun grub bhandha ru: dug lnga rnam dag sku lnga rdzas kyis bkang : bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: dam tshig sor chud nyams chag bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib bag chags thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib ma lus bral gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs pa'i phrin las mdzod: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma rdor sems zhi ba dbyings kyi lha: thugs rje lcags kyus brtse bas dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig bag med dbang gyur pas: phyi nang 'khrul pa'i blo rtog ci mchis pa: dkyil 'khor lha la mthol bshags bzod par gsol: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ buddha sa twa hūm̐: om̐ badzra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ ratna sa twa hūm̐: om̐ padma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ karma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: sogs yi ge brgya pa bzlas lhag chad bkang : de nas tha ma bsgral ba ni: na mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya sngags dang ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bden pas gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad tshogs tha ma 'di dang gnyis su med par khug cig: om̐ badzra aṅku sha dza dgra bo nṛ tri mā ra ya dza dzaḥ lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug byas la: hūm̐: nga ni rig pa he ru kaḥ ro gcig lta ba khros pa'i sku: phyag g.yas thabs kyi rdo rje gsor: g.yon pas shes rab phur bu bsgril: ma rig gnyis 'dzin dgra bo rnams: snying rje'i phur bu 'debs shing bsgral: ka dag mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas shog: om̐ badzra dharma kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsgral lo: de nas gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma rdor sems zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams:

chos nyid klong yangs dgyes pa'i zhal phyes shig: dug lnga ma rig bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rang grol bde ba chen por dgyes gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na la khā hi: tshogs 'bum gsog thabs ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin rdo rje 'khrul med thugs ka nas: 'od 'phros sbyangs nas tshogs rdzas bdud rtsir gyur: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor zhing khams rab 'byams lha: byin gyis brlab phyir tshogs la gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha la zhal zas tshogs mchod 'bul: phyi nang spyan gzigs mchod pas thugs dam bskang : ru tra bsgral ba bzhes so nyes skyon bshags: gzigs mdzes rol cig dngos grub a la la: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra khā hi: ga ṇa shuddhe hoḥ siddhi a la la hoḥ bsdu na/ oṃ badzra sa twa āḥs pa ri wā ra bhya ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta khā hi/ yang bsags chog /de nas tshogs la rol/ lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: dpal gyi dam bzhag lhag sdud ma: bhandha'i skyogs thogs dur khrod nyul: mi sdug gzugs 'chang rngam pa'i tshogs: lhag ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: om̐ utstshiṣṭa khā hi: thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: thugs rjes sems can 'dul slad du: ye shes rol pa'i rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: deng sang thugs dam tha tshig bskul: om̐ ma hā gu ru dzñā na hoḥ chad mdo ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar bskal tha ma dus gsum la: kun bzang rdor sems padma yab yum gyis: dkyil 'khor zhal phyes dregs pas khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig phrin las mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐ bha lingta khā hi: brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ bod khams skyong ba'i ma sring bdud sman tshogs: gzugs mdzes gar sgyur glu len drod nyul ma: stag tshang mchims phur dbang rtags khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la gsang sngags mel tshe mdzod: ma ma hring hring phaiṃ phaiṃ dza bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi:

rta bro ni/ hūm̐: gtor gzhong 'og tu gnod byed dam sri khug: zhi khro'i bro brdungs dam sri thal bar brlag: nam yang mi ldang rdo rjes rgyas gdab bo: rnam rtog mtshan ma'i ru tra tshar chod cig: om̐ āḥnan hūm̐ nan satwaṃ bha ya nan dzñā na hoḥ de nas dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub gnas lugs lta ba'i ngang : ka dag dbyings rig 'od gsal snying po can: nam yang bstan pa'i rgyal sa zin pa yi: 'dod rgu'i ye shes dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: om̐ sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: rjes chog la drug /dang po gtang rag mchod bstod ni/ om̐ badzra sa twa pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe?shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta khā hi: hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: kun bzang klong nas zhi dang khro gar sprul: 'gro don yid snang dbyer med rdo rje sems: kun 'dus yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bstod par 'os p sogs kyis bstod/ gnyis pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la: 'gal zhing cho ga lhag chad phud nyams sogs: las ngan bag chags skyon can ma dag sogs: rig pa rdor sems dkyil 'khor lha la bshags: om̐ badzra sa twa ?yig brgya brjod la brtan bzhugs bya/ gsum pa bsdu rim ni/ hūm̐: gzugs rnams snang stong sgra rnams grags stong ngang : yid rnams dran stong bskyed rdzogs sgyu ma'i klong : dkyil 'khor mi dmigs hūm̐ dang na dā yal: ma bcos lhun grub chos dbyings ngang la gnas: a a āḥ sa gsal snang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bsdus la/ om̐ gu ru buddha dzñā na badzra sa twa hūm̐: gis slar ldang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rakṣa maṃ/ bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ ma rig 'khrul 'khor rigs drug sems can rnams: phan bde'i byang chub lam mchog bgrod pa'i phyir: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dge ba bsod nams tshogs:

sa bcu byang chub go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo: lnga pa smon lam ni/ na mo: 'khor gsum yongs dag rdor sems zhi khro yi: dkyil 'khor byang chub dam pa 'di bsgrubs pas: mtha' yas ma gyur 'gro kun sdug bsngal gyi: rgya mtshor bsgral nas sangs rgyas thob par shog: drug pa bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: skyabs gsum ngo bo dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha: zhi khro rigs brgya'i bka' srung gter bdag gis: bar chad sel zhing chos bdag spel ba'i yul: bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: ces bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab bo/ ༈ gsum pa gzhan don gnas lung gi cho ga la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor sogs sngar bshad pa ltar byas pa'i mdun/ mtshan byang dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i khar bzhag /'og tu dgos pa'i chas bye til yungs dkar sbyong chas/ me long khrus gzhong las bum zas bsngo mar me sogs 'du bya/ gnyis pa cho ga dngos la/ dang po brgyud 'debs nas brtsam dngos gzhi'i cho ga las byang bzlas pa yan song nas/ 'dir las sbyor gyi bzlas pa bya bar spro na/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dang thugs rje'i 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas/ ngan song rnams sbyangs/ bdag gzhan dmigs yul gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing du bsgral bar gyur/ yi ge brgya pa'i sham bu'i mthar/ om̐ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma tha ma tha sarba tirya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces btags pa bzlas pas/ gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yang snying yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba nyams chag dang rtog sgrib thams cad sbyong bar byed pa 'di bzlas pas rnal 'byor pa rtog sgrib can/ nyams chag can/ gsog 'jog can/

bag chags ngan pa can khyed rnams kyi nyams chag bskangs te ngan song du ltung ba'i las kyi sgrib pa las thar bar 'gyur ro/ tshe 'di la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras kyi dam pa dgongs nas bsrung zhing skyob par mdzad la/ shi 'phos nas kyang bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras kyi thu bor 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o/ zhes gnang ba byin par bsam/ dbang dang gnas 'dren sogs las gzhan sbrel tshe gzhung ltar bum chog bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ gzungs thag la 'khril te bum pa'i nang du song*/ lha yab yum gyi thugs rgyud bskul 'od zer spro bsdu don gnyis mdzad sku'i cha thams cad nas byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la rtsa bsnyen bzla/ las bum gong du ma song na 'dir bya/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod song nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul bas lha 'od du zhu ba'i bum chu bdud rtsir bsam mo/ gnyis pa tshe 'das gnas lung gi cho ga la bcu gcig /dang po rten bskyed pa ni/ mtshan byang las bum chus bran la/ om̐ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri sarba dra byāṃ shwa dha ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan la ming byang nṛ las

chaiga'i gzugs kyi rnam pa ji lta bur gyur bar bsams la/ gnyis pa rnam shes dgug pa ni/ lcags kyu'i rgya dang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer gyis rnam shes bkug par bsams shing*/ na mo rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par sbyong ba la dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi? bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum rigs drug gi gnas gang du gnas kyang skad cig gis rten 'dir mchis par gyur cig om̐ badzra a karṣa ya dzaḥ lan gsum gyis rnam shes dang*/ sarba pā paṃ a na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas sdig pa bkug nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rnam shes āḥdakar po'i rnam par rten la bstim/ gsum pa bgegs sbyong ba ni/ gtor ma rten la bskor zhing*/ om̐ sarba bighnān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo zhes nas ghṛhṇa daṃ bha liṃ dye swā hā/ zhes sogs lan gsum gyis zhi ba ting lo dang changs bus bskor zhing hūm̐ bzhi pa lan gsum gyi drag por sbyong ba dang*/ na mo rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ ngan 'gro thams cad rnam par sbyong ba la dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi? bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa chaiga'i gson gyi dus su tshe srog la bar du gcod pa gshin gyi dus su sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la dpag tshad dang rgyang grags su ma gnas par song zhig /gal te mi 'gro na ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/

zhes brjod cing phyed mas sbyongs la gu gul bdug yungs dkar gyis brab drag sngags bzla zhing*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badzra kro dha dzwa la maṇḍa la phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ ha la ha la ha la hūm̐/ rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas pas gtor ma rgyang ring du dor te drag po'i sbyong ba'o/ bzhi pa sdig pa sbyong ba ni/ rten gyi mdun du til dang me chu bshams/ tshe 'das chaiga'i sdig sgrib thams cad kaṃ nag po'i rnam pa sna bug nas thon sna sgor sdig pa'i rnam par gyur te til la thim par bsams shing*/ til g.yas g.yon gyis mer bsregs chur dor la/ om̐ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ sdig pa thams cad ye shes kyi me chus sbyangs par bsam/ de nas sgrib sbyong gi sngags bzlas pa'i bye ma dang yungs dkar brab cing yig brgya dang*/ om̐ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma tha ma tha sarba tirya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sogs dang ngan song sbyong ba'i sngags mang du bzlas mthar/ tshe 'das kyis bskal pa stong nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyong dka' ba om̐ pā paṃ badzra bi shwa bhi shuddhe ye swā hā/ sdig sgrib thams cad nyi mas ba mo bzhus pa bzhin dag par bsam mo/ lnga pa khrus bya ba ni/ thog mar dkyil 'khor sogs rten gyi gzugs brnyan shar ba'i me long la khrus gsol zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sku khrus gsol/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la/ /nyon mongs dri ma mi mnga' yang*/ /tshe 'das sgo gsum sgrib bral phyir/ /gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo/ om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ kā ya bi shwa dha ni swā hā/ zhes sku phyis/ khrus chus slar blugs pa'i bum pas ming byang ngam rten la bkru zhing*/

hūm̐: bum pa chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni ye shes lnga yi ngang : tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol bas: dug lnga'i sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: yig brgya'i mthar tshe 'das chaiga'i shes bya'i sgrib pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ bag chags kyi sgrib pa dang*/ las kyi sgrib pa dang*/ kun nas bslangs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig: om̐ sarba pā paṃ shwa dha na ye swā hā/ gzhan yang*/ 'di ni phyin drug rang bzhin chu: nyon mongs dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: phar phyin chu yis legs bkrus pas: nyon drug dri ma dag gyur cig: ces dang yig brgya'i mthar: tshe 'das shes bya'i sgrib? sogs dang gong ltar brjod cing bkrus pas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis nyon mongs pa'i thal ba'ang sbyangs par bsam/ drug pa skyabs 'gror 'jug pa ni/ tshe 'das dkyil 'khor sa la phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'debs par bsams la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: kun bzang klong yangs zhi dang khro gar sprul: 'gro don yid snang dbyer med rdo rje sems: kun 'dus rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: dug lnga gnas dag rigs lnga longs spyod rdzogs: 'byung lnga gnas dag yum lnga so sor gsal: yab yum spyan la zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: rtsa khams 'khor lo'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: kau rī tsau ri la sogs dbyings phyug ging : sgo ba sgo ma sprul sku thub pa drug: mtshams dang laṅka la sogs 'gro 'dul gyi: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ sogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ bdun pa dbang bskur ba ni/ tshe 'das skad cig gis dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te thim par gyur/ snying po'i mthar/

badzra a be sha ya a āḥ btags pa brjod la rol mo sgrog tiṣṭha badzra sa brtan par bya/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: chos sku'i bum pa stong gsal 'di: rdor sems zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: khyod kyi gnas gsum bzhag pa yis: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya wākka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bum pa gnas gsum reg cing bum chu 'dod yon nang du blug /brgyad pa zas gtad pa ni/ tshe 'das rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur zhes bskyed pa'i mdun du bza' btung sna tshogs bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las lha rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin las grub pa'i 'dod yon gyi dngos po gzugs mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod kyi 'khor los sprin chen po gyur: na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bhyo? sngags rgyas byin brlabs la/ phyogs dus kun na gzugs sgra dri ro reg /reg bya khyad par dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob khyod la 'bul/ /zag med dga' bdes rtag tu tshim par shog om̐ gu ru buddha dzñā na badzra sa twa pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bsngos/ dgu pa 'khor bar ma chags par gdams pa ni/ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: rigs drug gnas na bde ba med: sdug bsngal las la ma chags par: ma yengs rtse gcig dran pas zungs: bcu pa lam ston gyis gnas spar ba ni/ hūm̐: tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: rnam shes rlung gi rta pho la: rig pa gsal ba'i mi bos bzung : dbu ma chos dbyings lam la gshegs: klong yangs 'og min zhing khams su: bcom ldan rdor sems yab yum bzhugs: dbyer med de yi sras nyid du: rlung gi shugs la sems kyi rtsal: rig pa dri med āḥdakar de: zang thal skar mda' chad pa ltar: phaṭ sgra drag po'i brtul zhugs kyis: ldog med rdor sems thugs kar thim:

hika: drag po gsum gyis spar/ zhes rnam shes āḥthung gi rnam pa spyi bo nas thon 'og min zhing du song nas rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar thim par bsam mo/ bcu gcig pa mtshan byang sreg pa ni/ nub tha ma'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi me zer byung bas tshe 'das kyi phung khams skye mched 'khor ba'i chos thams cad dmigs med ka dag gi dbyings su sbyangs par bsams la me sbar zhing*/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings kyi thabs khung du/ /bdag 'dzin phung po'i bud shing la/ /shes rab ye shes me sbar te/ /tshe 'das nyon mongs bag chags bsreg /'di ni skye 'gag smon pa dang*/ /gnas med mtshan ma med pa'i me/ /'di ni rang byung ye shes me/ /bdag 'dzin mtshan ma'i rtog pa bsreg /don la bsreg bya sreg byed kun/ /bya rtsol med par ye sangs rgyas/ /'bad med lhun grub chos kyi sku/ /rang byung ye shes der snang ngo*/ yig brgya'i mthar/ agne dzñā na dzwa la raṃ/ zhes zag bcas kyi phung po zag med du bsgyur bar bya'o/ thal ba sātstsha gdab/ bsngo ba smon lam ji ltar 'os pas mtshams sbyar ro/ de nas tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma phyin chad mthar chags su btang bas grub par bya'o/ zhes rdzogs pa chen po 'khor 'das yongs grol las/ rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan gyi cho ga'i 'don khrigs blo dman 'jug bde zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ lam 'dir mos pa mi phyed dge ba can rang slob rdo bla au ḍī ya na'i mtshan 'dzin nas/ sngar gyi dzñā na shrī bha dra'i chog khrigs zhib mor bzhugs kyang phal cher tshan thor du gyur pa dang 'ga' zhig rjes 'jug rnams kyis/ rang 'dod bzhin gsar btsud mdzad pas rtsa ba'i sa bcad 'khrugs shing lta mi bde bar gyur pa dang*/ gzhan yang du ma zlos skyon can sogs bdag 'dra'i blo dman rnams kyis nyams su len par mi bde bas/ tshul 'dir bsnyen sgrub kyi 'jug pa bde phyir kha gsal zhing nar 'gros su bklag chog bgyis na/

ma 'ongs par sgrub sde rnams dang grong chog pa su la'ang phan thogs par 'dug pas/ cis kyang de bzhin bsgrigs rogs zhes nan bskul ngor lung zin chos kyi bdag po arya dhwa dza'i skyes mthar 'bod pa'i gdol spyod pa/ gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis gter gzhung rtsa ba'i tshig rkang dang dzñā na shrī bha dra'i bsgrigs chags la gzhi bcol/ rigs mthun gzhan nas kyang kha 'gengs dgos pa sab la mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po srid 'dir bltams par mdzad pa'i gnas mchog /lumbī ni'i tshal dang gu ru padmas gangs can gdul bya bdag gir bzhes pa'i thugs bskyed gnang ba'i yul/ mchod sdong chen po bya rung kha shor sogs khyad du 'phags pa'i gnas mchog du mas brgyan pa'i bal yul chos ldan gyi khab chen po'i char/ sgrub gnas kyi rgyal po yang le shod gnam lcags sgrub sder rab byung bcu bdun pa chu mo lug gi lor/ cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can du brtsams par bgyis skabs/ yi ge pa ni bskul ba pos bgyis la de bzhin zhu dag gi mthun 'gyur 'brong smyon mkhyen rab zla shar gyis mdzad pas/ 'di la dge ba'i cha mchis na ma rgan gyi gtsos pa'i 'brel thogs sems can rnams mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du skye ba'i rgyu ru smon zhing nor 'khrul mchis na/ rtsa gsum lha la mthol zhing bshags kyi bzod par mdzad du gsol lo// // ༈ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las: gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub bzhugs so: e ma hoḥ nub phyogs bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su: snang mtha'i sprul pa 'dzam bu gling du byon: o rgyan dha na ko sha'i mtsho las 'khrungs: ind+ra bhū tis rgyal srid mnga' gsol mdzad: za hor rgyal po'i bstan pa chos la btsud: 'gro ba'i mgon po o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

rgyal srid spangs nas dur khrod gnas brgyad byon: ta na ga ṇa'i sbyor sgrol spyod pa mdzad: rgya gar mu stegs dmag tshogs dam la btags: manda ra sogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad: rgya gar thams cad rin chen gter gyis bkang : rig 'dzin gtso bo o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs rje'i dgongs pas bod la gzigs pa'i tshe: bal bod mtshams su lha srin dam la btags: mkhan slob chos gsum bod la nyi ma shar: bsam yas la sogs mtha' 'dul yang 'dul grub: mdo sngags gnyis kyi chos kyi sgron me sbar: thugs rje'i bdag nyid o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bsam yas mchims phur bde 'dus sgrub chen mdzad: rje 'bangs rgya mtshor chos kyi bka' chen phab: sku tshab nyer lnga bod kyi don la bzhag: dgongs brda nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i shog ser la: ye shes lnga ldan tshom bu'i tshul du zug: kha byang yang byang lung byang rgya chen bsdams: dus gsum kun mkhyen o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: khra 'brug rtsa gsum bka' 'dus zhal phyes tshe: manda ra ba mkha' spyod gnas nas byon: dkyil 'khor byin 'bebs bkra shis mtha' rten mdzad: 'gro don mthar phyin o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs sras lnga dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga la: zhal gdams don tshan ma 'ongs lung bstan bzhag: 'dzam gling khams kun rin chen gter gyis bkang : lho nub gdong dmar srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: thugs rjes bod kyi sems can don la gzigs: grub thob rgyal po o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

skal ldan las can gsol ba btab pa'i tshe: nangs re dgong re bod kyi don la byon: yar mar tshes bcu'i dus su dngos su byon: rig 'dzin rnams kyi zhal mjal lung bstan gnang : gnas chen dus bzang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad: gtan gyi skyabs mchog o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gter la dbang sgyur smin grol dkyil 'khor gyi: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i tshe: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs: byin 'bebs dbang bskur bkra shis rab gnas mdzad: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung bar the tshom med: byin rlabs kun 'dus o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar: rigs dang dkyil 'khor lhag pa'i lhar gyur zhing : bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bdag gyur nas: phrin las 'gro 'dren dpal du 'byung gyur cig: om̐ gu ru badzra yo gi ni siddhi pha la hūm̐: zhes gsol 'debs 'di o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas bsam yas mchims phu nas gdan drangs pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// //

bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ spyi dril gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i las byang chog khrigs ye shes sprin phung bzhugs so// // rtsa gsum bde gshegs kun 'dus lha la 'dud/ de la rtsa gsum kun 'dus kyi rgyab chos gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i lha tshogs spyi dril gyi las byang chog khrigs su bsdeb pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o/ dang po ni/ gzhung las/ thog mar 'jug pa'i chos la rnam pa drug: dang po skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa dang : bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod mchod pa byin rlabs so: dang po byin dbab skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: gdod nas rnam dag sangs rgyas chos kyi sku: brgyad khri bzhi stong dam chos longs spyod rdzogs: gang 'dul der ston dge 'dun sprul pa'i sku: dkon mchog sku gsum dbyer med o rgyan rje: gsol 'debs skyabs gsol brtse chen thugs rjes gzigs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa bla ma'i sku: che mchog yi dam 'dus pa bla ma'i gsung : mkha' 'gro bde chen 'dus pa bla ma'i thugs: nor lha 'dus pa bla ma'i yon tan gter: chos skyong 'dus pa bla ma'i phrin las rtsal: rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru rin po che: gsol 'debs skyabs gsol brtse chen thugs rjes gzigs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mthong grol sku yi gzi brjid 'od du 'bar: phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs thams cad sprin ltar gtibs: thos grol gsung gi sgra dbyangs theg chen mdzod: sna tshogs 'gro 'dul chos sgra 'brug stong ldir: tshor grol thugs kyi dgongs pa ris med gsal: rtsol med rang byung ye shes lhang gis ston: dran pa tsam gyis mthu dpung byin rlabs bskyed: tshad med thugs rje mnga' ba'i gu ru rje: gsol 'debs skyabs gsol brtse chen thugs rjes gzigs:

bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bdag sogs khams gsum rigs drug sems can kun: 'di phyi'i re ltos skyid sdug khyed shes pas: brtse chen thugs rjes nam yang mi gtong zhing : smin grol dbang dang dngos grub dus 'dir stsol: rig grol sku las ye shes 'od dpung 'bar: las nyon rtog sgrib gzhob dud thu lu lu: myong grol thugs rje'i byin rlabs char rgyun gyis: dbang bzhi'i don rgyud nyams rtogs ya la la: btags grol zab don tshig brgyud man ngag rnams: chos dang rang rgyud 'dres par byin gyis rlobs: tshe 'dir rang rig chos sku mngon gyur nas: longs spyod sprul sku'i 'gro don mthar phyin shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs ma hā gu ru dgongs su gsol: bdag gi pha khyed snying nas sgrub lags na: sku yi phyag rgya lus la rdzogs pa dang : gsung gi nus rtsal ngag la smin nas su: thugs kyi ye shes dgaungs pa mngon gyur nas: mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i pha ma rnams: gang la gang 'dul phrin las rnam pa bzhis: byang chub mchog tu 'god par sems bskyed nas: gu ru yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs rje yis: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni/ hūm̐: ma hā gu ru bde chen chos kyi rje: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med ci bgyis pa: kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin chen po ltar: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtsho rnams: o rgyan gu ru 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bdag gzhan 'gro drug lus ngag yid gsum gyis: tshe rabs thogs med dus nas da lta'i bar:

mi dge sdig pa'i las rnams ci bgyis pa: rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i spyan sngar bshags: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba sras bcas kyi: dpag med dge ba'i tshogs gnyis gter chen 'di: yon tan dpag yas lhun 'byams yongs mnga' bar: bdag cag gus pas rjes su yi rang ngo : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru'i byin rlabs thugs rje rgya mtsho yis: 'gro drug mang por so so'i sgra skad du: dri med gsung gi bdud rtsi bla med kyis: chos kyi 'khor lo rtag par bskor du gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru 'chi med rdo rje'i sku: ma gyur 'gro ba thugs rjes skyong ba'i phyir: ji srid 'jig rten 'khor ba ma stongs bar: thugs rje mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bla ma bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas la: phyag 'tshal mchod sogs dge tshogs ci mchis pa: 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: dmigs med mtha' bral chos dbyings chen por bsngo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bzhi pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: gzi byin 'od stong zer ma phyogs bcur 'phros: de yi shugs las bgegs rnams snying rjes bkug: gtor ma len phyir lhag med gnas 'dir mchis: lan gsum/ oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dzaḥdzaḥ bgegs tshogs 'byung po a karṣa ya dza dzaḥ de nas kha phyir bstan la/ hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang 'byung po log 'dren tshogs: deng phan khyed rnams byang chub lam dgod phyir: yid mthun 'dod yon mchod sbyin 'di khyer la: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du bde bar dengs: ci ste mi 'gro gdug pa'i sems 'chang na: bdag nyid dbang chen drag sngags phyung rdeg gis: khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag:

de bas rang rang gnas su phyir dengs shig: oṃ badzra kro dha hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bgegs gtor btang la thun brdeg cing : hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: bdag nyid dpal chen thugs khros nas: khro bo spros pas nam mkha' gang : khro mo spros pas sa gzhi gang : sras mchog khro chung bar snang gang : me yi bya khyung phyogs bcur 'khrigs: drwa mig lcags sdig glog ltar 'khyug: 'khor yug mtshon char thog ltar 'bebs: bgegs tshogs thal ba'i rdul du brlag: de bas bka' las ma 'da' zhig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a hūm̐: badzra hūm̐: raksha hūm̐: yaksha hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya gnod byed bgegs tshogs thams cad tshindha tshindha bhandha bhandha ha na ha na pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha da ha da ha hu lu hu lu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: lnga pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: nga nyid gdod nas rab khros he ru kaḥ ka dag thugs las rdol ba'i shes rab mtshon: rno dbal lhun grub drag rtsal 'gengs pa'i tshogs: bar med khyab ste skar ltar rab 'khrugs pa: srung mtshams med par dum bu gcig pa ni: e yi mkha' ltar khyab pa'i gur khang gyur: oṃ badzra dharma dzñā na tsakra e kham̐ ram̐ dzwa la rakṣa ye swā hā: drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes mchod gzhi khyab par bsang chu gtor zhing*/ phyi mchod la dmigs te/ hūm̐: rig pa'i gru 'dzin khyon ltar yangs pa'i dbus: phyi mchod lha mo me tog bdug spos ma: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo dang : gzugs mdzes lang ling gar ma yid 'ong rigs: lta na sdug cing tshul bzang mchod thogs tshogs:

grangs med sprul pas rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: lan gsum bdud rtsi la dmigs te/ hūm̐: bhandha mtshan ldan lcang lo 'khyil ba'i nang : sha lnga rdzas lnga pañtsa a mṛ ta: dri lnga 'bru bcud chang dang dza gad phud: sman mchod dug lnga sel ba'i ye shes mdangs: dkar mngar kha dang ro skyur zhun gyi rigs: sna tshogs tshang 'di rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ lan gsum rakta la dmigs te/ hūm̐: bum ril bhandha dum gcig zlum po'i dbus: bzang mo'i mkha' yi mu kha sgra gcan gyi: 'khor lo khyab 'jug myur 'gros rab bskul nas: 'bar ba'i rlung las rgyu ba'i byams chen po: chags med dmar chen gzi 'od 'khyil ba'i tshogs: mtsho ltar 'khrugs pa rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ lan gsum gtor ma la dmigs te/ hūm̐: thams cad rin chen las grub nyi zla'i snod: rgya che srid pa'i khyon ltar 'thug pa'i dbus: snod gzugs bsdus pa'i bcud mchog bha lingta: lhun mtho dbyings la bsnyegs pa'i rgyan mdzes btsugs: mdangs ldan bcud mchog rgyas pa'i zer stong 'khyugs: kun tshang 'tshogs 'di rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis spel/ gnyis pa/ dngos gzhi dngos la sgrub gzhi dam tshig dkyil 'khor bskyed: bsgrub don ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren bstim: sgrub thabs mchod bstod dzapa ྄bzlas mdo don gsum: zhes pas thog mar dam tshig dkyil 'khor bskyed pa la lnga las/ dang po sku gsum ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐: zab zhi spros bral gdod nas chos kyi dbyings: bya rtsol skye 'gag bral ba ka nas dag: dmigs med mkha' ltar khyab pa'i klong chen po:

gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru dharma dhā tu āḥ hūm̐: chos dbyings ngang las rtsol bral thugs rje'i 'od: mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin phyogs ris med par brdal: phrin las shugs la rdzogs pa'i nus stobs can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru dzñā na sa twa hūm̐: hūm̐: thams cad snying po byang chub sems kyi gzhi: kun byed brda ston ye shes rdo rje hūm̐: 'gro don thugs rjes skyob mdzad sprul pa'i sku: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru badzra tsitta hūm̐: gnyis pa klong lnga'i dgongs pa gsal gdab pa/ hūm̐: dbyings kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings stong pa'i mkha': thabs kyis bskyed pa snod bcud srid pa'i gzhi: klong lnga'i dgongs pa ye shes rdo rje'i rtsal: dbyings kyi thig ler rdzogs pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru dzñā na pañtsa e: gsum pa gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub zhing gi bkod pa'i khyon: rin chen 'od lnga 'bar ba'i sa gzhi ni: phyogs dang phyogs bral nam mkha'i pha mthar brdal: thig le thig phran lug rgyud zer dpung 'khrigs: rdo rje'i 'od las rin chen gzhal med khang : dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi la rtsig rim lnga: nang du sku gsum thod pa tshar gsum brtsegs: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs 'dod snam 'khor: pha gu drwa phyed mda' yab shar bu sogs: zhi rgyas dbang drag brda rtags rdzu 'phrul gyis: phyi nang rgyan rdzogs snang stong 'od skur 'thibs: chos dbyings dur khrod rdo rwa me gur 'bar: bde chen zhing bkod rdzogs pa'i thugs rje can:

gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru ratna maṇḍal hūm̐: bzhi pa dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: pho brang gzhal yas dbus kyi lte ba la: rin chen zur brgyad seṅge glang chen rta: rma bya shang shang gis btegs nor bu'i khrir: dar zab 'bol brtsegs padma nyi zla'i steng : 'khor yug rin chen padma'i phreng bas bskor: dbus su hūm̐ las ma hā gu ru rje: snang srid zil gnon dmar smug khro 'dzum sgeg: 'dab ldan dar gyi snyan zhu gsang gos dkar: dar dmar chos gos mthing nag phod chen gsol: smug nag ber phyam snyan rgyan mgul rgyan mdzes: rdo rje bhandha tshe bum kha ṭwāṃ brten: zhabs gnyis swag lham rgyal po rol pa'i stabs: 'gying bag brjid ldan nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi: tsha zer 'khrigs pas phyogs bcu'i zhing kun khyab: thugs kyi ngo bo bla ma rdo rje 'chang : mthing gsal rang 'od yum 'khril longs spyod rdzogs: rdo rje dril 'dzin 'od lnga'i klong du gsal: gsang sngags don brgyud rdzogs pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: dbu gtsug 'ja' 'od tshom bu 'bar ba'i klong : shrī singha dmar smug cang dril bsil: dbang mo zung 'jug rnal 'byor spyod pa'i chas: dga' rab rdo rje dkar gsal he ru kaḥ rdo rje thod 'dzin rnal 'byor ma dang sbyor: rdo rje sems dpa' rigs lnga yab yum dang : thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung drang por bzhugs: dgongs brda brgyud pa'i rig 'dzin bla ma rnams: snang stong sku yi phyag rgya 'od stong 'bar: dbang bzhi chu bo gcig bsdus thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:
