ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de yi phyi rim phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhir: shar phyogs padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: nyon mongs rang grol rigs drug sdug bsngal skyob: rig 'dzin 'dus pa bde chen rgyal po'i sku: dmar smug khro 'dzum mtsho rgyal dkar mo sbyor: rdor dril bsnol stabs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor: rnam smin rig 'dzin mdangs lnga gsang ye sbyor: sa gnas rig 'dzin nyi zla bde chen dkar: phyag rgya rig 'dzin ser gsal mthing 'od sngo: tshe dbang rig 'dzin rdo rje rnal 'byor dmar: lhun grub rig 'dzin las kyi dbang mo ljang : 'khril sbyor gri thod ḍā ru bhandha bsnams: gtso bo'i chas rdzogs ye shes rang 'od 'bar: sdug bsngal bde chen mchog sbyor thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: lho phyogs padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: tshogs drug rang grol bag chags dbyings su sbyor: thugs kyi bdag nyid buddha he ru kaḥ mthing gsal rdo rje bhandha longs spyod rdzogs: rol stabs lha lcam dmar mo 'khril sbyor rol: sku yi bdag nyid badzra thod phreng dkar: yon tan bdag nyid ratna thod phreng ser: gsung gi bdag nyid padma thod phreng dmar: phrin las bdag nyid karma thod phreng ljang : rigs kyi phyag mtshan bhandha yum dang rol: dus gsum kun mkhyen 'gro drug lam sna 'dren: 'khrul snang rang sar grol ba'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: nub phyogs padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'byung lnga rang grol dpa' bo gyad kyi sku: mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul sku'i cha lugs can: chos gos gsum ldan pad zhwa rtse rnon gsol: sa gnon rdo rje mnyam bzhag bhandha bsnams:

bde stong kha ṭwāṃ ye shes rol pa'i 'khor: mā kī dkar mo sangs rgyas spyan ma ser: gos dkar dmar mo dam tshig sgrol ma ljang : 'khor lo rin chen padma rgya gram g.yas: g.yon rnams dril 'dzin lha mo'i chas kun rdzogs: phyed skyil 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin gsal 'tsher 'bar: dbyings rig dbyer med sbyor ba'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: byang phyogs padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'pho ltung 'jigs skrag rang grol zab lam ston: rdo rje rnal 'byor dmar gsal cung zad khro: rus rgyan zangs gri bhan dmar brkyang bskum gar: rjes chags gzhan snang dbang sdud phag zhal ngur: bde chen kha ṭwāṃ dkur brten gar dgu'i nyams: mkha' spyod sa spyod bde spyod zab spyod kyi: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang mdog: gtso mo'i chas rdzogs zhi rgyas chags dang khro: las bzhi phrin las dbu ma'i chos sgo 'byed: bde chen dag zhing 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: hūm̐: phyogs mtshams nam mkhar sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha: dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs tshom bur 'khrigs: rin chen zur brgyad padma nyi zla'i steng : sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad las bzhi'i gar: ma 'dres mtshan rdzogs phyogs mtshams 'gro ba 'dul: mtshams brgyad rdo rje rin chen padma las: ḍākki sde bzhi zhi rgyas dbang drag gi: bde spyod gar ldan ye shes rang 'od 'bar: rdo rje bdud 'dul ma dang zhi ba mtsho: rdo rje phra men mtsho gling mkha' 'gro rnams: las mdog phyag mtshan gri thod kha ṭwāṃ gaḥ rigs kyi ḍākki 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dgyes bskang thugs dam bskul: thabs dang shes rab phrin las du ma yis:

'gro don stobs chen mdzad pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de yi phyi rim 'ja' zer mu khyud kyi: sna tshogs pad 'khor 'od lnga'i drwa ba mdzes: shar du dug lnga'i nad sel sman gyi bla: log 'dren bdud dpung 'joms mdzad seṅge'i sgra: mthing nag rab khros dpa' bo dpa' ba'i chas: nyon mongs rtsad gcod phag mo dmar mo 'khril: rdo rje dril 'dzin gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: pad nyi'i gdan steng ye shes me dpung 'bar: dbu gtsug drang srong sman bla baiḍūr mdog: mnyam bzhag mchog sbyin lhung bzed a ru ra: stong gsum 'byung ba'i bcud sdud mgyogs ma bzhi: tshe 'phrang bar chad sel ba'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: lho phyogs dbul phongs gdung sel 'dod rgu'i rje: padma rgyal po dmar smug sgeg pa'i gzugs: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs: g.yas gsum rdo rje rgyal mtshan lcags kyu dang : g.yon gsum thod pa ne'u le padma bsnams: longs spyod rab rdzogs dbang mo zung 'jug 'khril: rin chen padma nyi zla'i gzi brjid 'bar: gsang yum manda ra dang mtsho rgyal ma: gling bzhir dbang sgyur mgyogs ma sde bzhi'i tshogs: dgos 'dod re ba skong ba'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: nub tu bdud bzhi g.yul las rgyal ba'i stobs: gzhom bral gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i sku: mthing nag rab khros dur khrod chas kun rdzogs: rdo rje'i go ldan gnam lcags bu yug 'tshubs: phyag g.yas rgya gram g.yon pas thog rgod 'bebs: drag rtsal stobs ldan spyi bor bya khyung lding :

rdo rje'i gdan la dor stabs srid gsum gnon: rnam rgyal mi g.yo stobs chen dbyug sngon rgyal: rang rtags phyag mtshan rgyan rdzogs me dpung klong : rdo rje'i go cha rdzogs pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: byang du phung byed bdud dgra gzhaum pa'i rgyal: shāntiṃ garbha bdud 'joms nag po'i sku: srid gsum srog bdag dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs: rdo rje'i rwa rtser gnam lcags 'khor lo bskor: lcags sdig kha nas phur bu char du 'bebs: sku smad dbal gsham mu stegs snying la gzir: lha dang gshin rje ma bdud rgyal po btsan: gnod sbyin klu gnyan gza' bdud dmu rje sogs: 'jig rten dregs pa'i sde dpon yongs kyis bskor: pha rol dmag dpung bzlog pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: shar lhor bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i mgon: bde gshegs kun 'dus padma thod phreng dmar: rgyal po'i cha lugs rdo rje mkha' la gdengs: g.yon pa mnyam bzhag bhandha bdud rtsis gtams: gru mor kha ṭwāṃ brten mdzad 'gying bag can: zhabs gnyis rol stabs bzod dka'i gzi byin 'bar: snang srid zil gnon bde stong gsang ba'i yum: gar ging dpa' bo ḍākki'i tshogs dang bcas: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: lho nub zab gter sgo 'byed phyag rgya rdzogs: dbang drag khro rgyal badzra lo ha he: dmar nag am gtsigs rdo rje phur bu gdengs: thod skam dbu rgyan dbu skra khams nag gtibs: stag sham rus rgyan mgo phreng wang long 'khrol: stag mo grus ma'i steng na ya 'dor 'gyings:

rigs bdag padma thod phreng yab yum dang : phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro sde bzhi bde spyod gar: bka' dang gter srung dbang sdud gus pas 'dud: zab gsang gter la spyod pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: nub byang snang srid dbang sdud he ru kaḥ brtul zhugs ngar ldan dmar ser khro 'dzum nyams: nyi ma 'od zer nyi zer bhandha bsnams: stag sham rus rgyan phyag zhabs gdu bu 'khrol: phyed skyil rol stabs 'od zer spyan ma 'khril: yab yum gnyis med ye shes gzi byin 'bar: padma nyi zla'i gdan la bde stong rol: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar: zab gter sbas gnas dga' bzhi'i gsang sgo 'byed: thogs med rten 'brel mnga' ba'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: byang shar ma rungs bdud tshogs mthar byed che: dregs pa zil gnon gtum drag he ru kaḥ smug nag am gtsigs bdud 'dul sngags pa'i chas: dug sbrul sku rags gnam lcags phur bu bsnams: phyag g.yas rtse gsum g.yon pas seng phur 'dril: pad nyi baṃ steng zil gnon stangs stabs gar: khrag 'thung mngon spyod lha srin sde brgyad 'dul: khro chen sde bzhi gtum rngam bzhad gshe 'bar: phyag mtshan bzhi ldan stobs bcu'i rtsal chen 'byin: log 'dren rgol ba tshar gcod thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: hūm̐: gru chad bar khyams khor yug gnas yul gyi: dpa' bo ḍākki ging chen sgo skyong sde: bar snang lha klu gnod sbyin mi'i rig 'dzin: rgya bod mkhas grub bka' brgyud bla ma rnams: thugs rje'i sprin gtibs byin rlabs char rgyun 'bebs:

'dod snam mchod sprin lha mos gar stabs bsgyur: nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang ba yi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dgyes par bskang : mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong zhing bstan pa srung : dbang mo nyer brgyad mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis: ma bdun sring bzhi ging chen bco brgyad dang : 'bar ma brgyad dang sa bdag sum cu gnyis: pho nya sum brgya drug cu laṅka'i tshogs: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang : phyi rgyud gtsang ris mgon po bdun cu lnga: bka' dang bstan skyong phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub: 'khor 'das dbyer med dkyil 'khor gcig gi ngang : khams gsum yongs su sgrol ba'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐:

lnga pa gnas gsum rgyas gdab cing snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ hūm̐: de ltar bskyed pa'i dam tshig 'khor lo yi: spyi bor zla ba mgrin par padma dmar: thugs kar nyi steng oṃ dkar āḥdamar po: hūm̐ mthing las 'phros 'od zer dpag med pas: rang bzhin chos dbyings rnga yab dpal ri nas: rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren snying nas gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gnyis pa sgrub don ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drang ba la gnyis las dang po ni/ snyan pa'i dbyangs dang gdung ba'i shugs kyis/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig padma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgongs shig phyogs bcu'i dus gsum bde gshegs rnams: rje btsun chen po padma thod phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: chos sku skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : sprul bsgyur gzugs kyis 'gro don mdzad pa'i phyir: rtse gcig phur tshugs dad pas gsol ba 'debs: thugs rje'i dbyings nas bzhengs te skur bskyod 'tshal: byin rlabs mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams: g.yel ba med par dus 'dir stsal du gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs rje'i stobs kyis mdzad pa'i phrin las shugs: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mthu stobs rtsal 'bar zhing : 'gyur med sku ni lta bas chog mi shes: gar gyi stangs stabs brda 'gros lam se lam: 'gag med gsung gi sgra dbyangs nus pa ldan: hūm̐ dang phaṭ kyi 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: 'khrul med thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su khyab: brtse chen thugs kyi byin rlabs thibs se thib: rnam 'gyur yon tan du ma brjod las 'das: yid bzhin 'bad med dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: 'gro 'dul phrin las gar yang thogs pa med: zhi rgyas dbang drag cig car sha ra ra: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che:

bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru 'dus pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: rnam 'gyur cha lugs cir yang ston byed cing : nyi zla'i 'od 'phro gzi byin ya la la: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha khra la la: dri zhim spos kyi ngad pa chi li li: sgra dbyangs rol mo mang po ti ri ri: dpa' bos hūm̐ sgra bro rdung 'u ru ru: dpa' mos glu len gar stabs khrigs se khrig: ging chen pho nyas bshugs pa kyu ru ru: zhi tshogs mdangs ldan gar sgyur shigs se shig: 'ja' dang 'od kyi gur khang thibs se thib: khro tshogs rngam brjid 'cham stabs lams se lam: drag sngags gnam lcags thog ser sha ra ra: dam can chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: myur mgyogs me rlung glog dmar tshubs se tshub: nor lha gter bdag sgeg bzhad ya la la: dgos 'byung longs spyod bu yug chi li li: sde brgyad bshan pa'i tshogs ni rubs se rub: mda' mdung mtshon cha'i rno dbal zengs se zeng : mtha' sdud pho nya'i tshogs ni nyi li li: dug rlangs nad kyi rlung dmar 'u ru ru: kun kyang 'bar ba'i cha lugs rngam pa'i sku: bdud 'dul dpal gyi rta bro chems se chem: nad gdon sdig sgrib rkyen tshogs sangs se sangs: thugs rje'i stobs bskyed nus pa'i rtsal phyungs la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar phob: dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'di la byin chen phob: rnal 'byor sgrub mchog bu la byin gyis rlobs: phyi nang gsang dbang ma lus bskur du gsol: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che: pho brang chen po 'di la brtan par bzhugs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mthu chen khyed kyi mthu rtsal nus pa phyungs: rtags dang mtshan ma ma lus bstan du gsol: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i thugs dam dus la bab: ma g.yel bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:

rang bzhin gnas nas skur bzhengs 'dir gshegs la: dbang chen khyod kyis bdag la dbang mchog stsol: byin chen khyod kyis bdag la byin phob cig: bla ma'i sku las ye shes gzi brjid che: rnal 'byor lus la bde ba bskyed du gsol: yi dam gsung gi byin rlabs nus pa ldan: sgrub pa mthar phyin dngos grub stsal du gsol: mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi dgongs pa klong du gyur: ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol: bdag sogs byang chub snying po ma thob par: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad 'dul ba dang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal: ha ri ni sa badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes spyan drangs pas/ mngon rtogs ltar byon par bsams la/ gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: ting 'dzin cho 'phrul ye shes rol pa'i zhing : pho brang rang bzhin dam pa rgya re che: rin chen rgyu lnga'i khri mchog dpangs re mtho: padma nyi zla'i gdan mdzes 'od re gsal: phyi nang stong gsal gzhal yas nyams re dga': 'ja' tshon spel legs bkod pa dwangs re spro: sgom pa'i lha tshogs bkrag mdangs gzi byin 'bar: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: gnyis med 'gro ba'i don du sku bzhugs 'tshal: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che: bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub ma rnyed bar: thugs rje rtse gcig breng breng bdag la dgongs: sgrib dag ye shes chos sku 'char ba dang : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba tiṣṭha lhan: gsum pa sgrub thabs phyag 'tshal mchod bstod dzap bzlas bcas don tshan dgu las/ dang po mos gus phyag mchod ni/ e ma hoḥ dus gsum skye 'gag med pa chos kyi sku: bde chen 'du 'bral med pa longs spyod rdzogs: 'gag med ci yang ston pa sprul pa'i sku:

sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku: 'gag med gsung dbyangs thos grol dam pa'i gsung : mkhyen brtse ye shes mnyam nyid rig pa'i thugs: sku gsung thugs ldan padmar phyag 'tshal lo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: log 'dren bdud bzhi bcom pa sangs rgyas dngos: chos sgo kun la thogs med dam pa'i chos: mdo sngags zung 'jug skur ston dge 'dun sde: mchog gsum kun 'dus padmar phyag 'tshal lo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zhi ba'i las mdzad nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs: rgyas pa'i las mdzad tshe dpal ye shes bskyed: dbang gi las mdzad rang snang dge la sbyor: drag po'i las mdzad gzung 'dzin kun rtog bsgral: mchog thun lhun grub rang byung ye shes ston: phrin las rdzogs pa'i rje la phyag 'tshal lo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gang la gang 'dul tshad med thugs rje'i rtsal: thabs shes dbyer med rnam bzhi'i 'khor los bsgyur: ye shes las grub bka' sdod pho nya'i tshul: chos nyid rnam dag lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ gnyis pa thun mong spyi yi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho na: dri bral yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon tshogs: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can la 'bul: arghaṃ dhe wi badzra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can nyon mongs pa'i: tshad gdung bsil ldan zhi gnas bde thob shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho na:

dkar ser dmar ljang mthing gsal me tog tshogs: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can la 'bul: puṣpe dhe wi badzra pū dza hūm̐: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can nga rgyal gyi: gzugs ngan skyon bral mtshan dpe thob par shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho na: dri bsung zhing khams kun khyab bdug pa'i sprin: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can la 'bul: dhū pe dhe wi badzra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'daibs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can ma lus kyi: khong khro dag nas tshul khrims mchog thob shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho na: phyi nang snod bcud ye shes gsal ba'i sgron: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can la 'bul: ā lo kai dhe wi badzra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'daibs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can gti mug gi: mun sangs ye shes 'od gsal mchog thob shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho nas: 'jam legs 'o ma'i rgya mtsho spos kyi chu: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can 'bul: gandhe dhe wi badzra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can gzung 'dzin gyi: dri spangs mi rtog ye shes don rtogs shog:

bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho na: ro brgya'i bcud ldan lha yi zhal zas sogs: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can la 'bul: nai wi dye dhe wi badzra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can 'dod chags kyi: ser sna dag nas ting 'dzin ros tshim shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho na: zhing khams bkod mdzes lha yi 'byor pas gtams: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can la 'bul: maṇḍal dhe wi badzra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can lus ngan gyi: rgyu spangs zhing khams rnam dag thob par shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho nas: sgra snyan glu dbyangs rol mo ji snyed pa: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can la 'bul: shabda dhe wi badzra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'daibs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can zhe sdang gi: dri dag snyan grags chos sgra sgrog par shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: gsum pa bla med phyi yi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: snod kyi 'byung ba las skyes yangs shing mdzes: bcud kyi lha klus rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i sku: phyi nang mchod rdzas stangs stabs bskrun pa'i gzugs: che ba'i yon tan rgyas mdzad 'dod yon gyi: lha mos yongs gang rdo rje gzugs ma'i tshogs:

rigs 'dus o rgyan gu ru'i lha tshogs la: spyan gyi mchod pa 'bul lo gnyis med bzhes: rū pa dhe wi badzra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can thams cad la: 'gyur med rdo rje sku yi dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: reg med rang bzhin lhun grub 'byung ba'i sgra: reg bcas glu dbyangs snyan tshig skye 'gro'i sgra: zung 'jug rnga yab dung ting 'bud dkrol brdungs: gaṇḍi chos tshig don rdzogs 'dod yon gyi: lha mos yongs gang rdo rje sgra ma'i tshogs: rigs 'dus o rgyan gu ru'i lha tshogs la: snyan gyi mchod pa 'bul lo gnyis med bzhes: shabda dhe wi badzra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can thams cad la: gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: lhan cig skyes dang a gar du ru kaḥ dam rdzas tshim byed bdug pa spos kyi dri: dwangs byed rgyas pa rang bzhin sman gyi dri: snang srid yongs gang rdo rje dri ma'i tshogs: rigs 'dus o rgyan gu ru'i lha tshogs la: shangs kyi mchod pa 'bul lo gnyis med bzhes: gandhe dhe wi badzra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can thams cad la: dngos grub kun 'byung yon tan dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: kha mngar skyur rtsub rang bzhin 'byung ba'i ro: btso bsregs rjen sogs thabs kyis sbyor ba'i ro: sha lnga dam rdzas lnga sogs lha'i bdud rtsi: rtsa brgyad stong ldan mthu stobs byin rlabs ro: snang srid yongs gang rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs: rigs 'dus o rgyan gu ru'i lha tshogs la: ljags kyi mchod pa 'bul lo gnyis med bzhes: rā sa dhe wi badzra pū dza hoḥ

gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can thams cad la: thogs med phrin las mthar phyin dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: phyi yi reg bya lha yi dar zab gos: nang gi lha klu mi mo mtshan ldan dang : thabs shes sbyor ba bde ba myong reg gi: bde chen ye shes gsang ba bla na med: smra bsam brjod bral shes rab rig ma'i tshogs: rigs 'dus o rgyan gu ru'i lha tshogs la: sku yi mchod pa 'bul lo gnyis med bzhes: sparshe dhe wi badzra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can thams cad la: mkhyen brtse ye shes thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'bru tshig don dang man ngag zung du bsdebs: gsal dang go 'byed snying po sdud pa sogs: shes bya'i dbang po tshim byed rgyal ba'i bka': phyag rgya gsum ldan chos kyi rdo rje ma: mkha' klong rnam dag chos nyid rol pa'i tshogs: rigs 'dus o rgyan gu ru'i lha tshogs la: chos kyi mchod pa 'bul lo gnyis med bzhes: dharma dhe wi badzra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can thams cad la: sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐:

bzhi pa nang mchod sman raka gtor gsum las/ dang po 'chi med bdud rtsi'i sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i rdzas: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong dang sbyar ba'i sman: rigs lnga ye shes lnga rdzogs bsgrub pa'i rdzas: 'gro drug sdug bsngal 'joms pa'i ye shes rtsi: dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus mchod pa'i sprin: rā sa ya na'i rdzas mchog khyad par can: rig 'dzin 'dus pa bla ma'i zhal du 'bul: sarba pañtsa tsitta su ra hūm̐: bskyed rdzogs dbyer med dgongs rgyud dag par sbyor: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: che mchog 'dus pa yi dam lha la 'bul: sarba pañtsa tsitta su ra hūm̐: dam tshig nyams skong sngags kyi dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen 'dus pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: sarba pañtsa tsitta su ra hūm̐: rten 'brel phyogs med 'char ba'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: yon tan 'dus pa nor lha gter bdag mchod: sarba pañtsa tsitta su ra hūm̐: 'dod rgu 'bad med 'byung ba'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: phrin las 'dus pa chos skyong gter srung mchod: sarba pañtsa tsitta su ra hūm̐: myur mgyogs thogs med las kyi dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rig rtsal 'dus pa snang srid dkyil 'khor mchod: sarba pañtsa tsitta su ra hūm̐: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs pa'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha rnams mnyam sbyor ba'i: byang sems bdud rtsi ma lus pa: char rgyun lta bur babs pa nyid: bdag nyid tsitta'i snying dbus thim: ye shes sems dpa'i skur gyur nas: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ bo dhi tsitta a mṛ ta badzra ā yu ṣe a be sha ya siddhi hūm̐:

zhes bdud rtsi myang zhing*/ gnyis pa rakta'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bhandha yangs pa mkha' klong rdzogs pa'i nang : mu la rakta srid pa bskyed pa'i khrag: añdza rakta bde chen sbyor ba'i khrag: du na rakta rgyud drug bsgral ba'i khrag: gu na rakta 'byung ba srid pa'i khrag: ma hā rakta thugs rje chags pa'i mdangs: 'khor ba'i rgyu bsgral khams gsum dbang sdud rdzas: bde mchog bde spyod rakta'i mchod pa 'di: bde gshegs 'dus pa gu ru'i thugs dam bskang : ma hā rakta dzñā na pū dza hoḥ thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: yi dam bder 'dus zhi khro'i thugs dam bskang : ma hā rakta dzñā na pū dza hoḥ thun mong grub pa rnam brgyad dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa dbyings phyug thugs dam bskang : ma hā rakta dzñā na pū dza hoḥ skye 'gro chos la 'god pa'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: chos skyong 'dus pa dam can thugs dam bskang : ma hā rakta dzñā na pū dza hoḥ bstan srung drag sngags mthu yi dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nor lha 'dus pa gnod sbyin thugs dam bskang : ma hā rakta dzñā na pū dza hoḥ che btsan 'gran zla bral ba'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: gsum pa dam rdzas gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: srid pa bcud kyi skye 'gro gtor mar sbyar: dpal gyi gtor ma brjid ldan 'gyings pa 'di: ri rab lhun po bas kyang dpangs re mtho: ma mo'i gtor ma padmas bskor ba 'di: gling bzhi gling phran bas kyang bkod re legs: dkar gyi thig btab dmar gyi gur phub pa: gser gyi ri bdun bas kyang brjid re che:

rakta dmar gyis gtor ma bran pa 'di: rgya mtsho'i 'jings rnams bas kyang gting re zab: bdud rtsi sman gyis gtor ma bran pa 'di: lha yi zhal zas bas kyang ro re bda': dkar rtsi dmar rtsi sha chen dri chen dang : dri chus byugs pa'i rdzas de rnam pa lnga: seṅge glang chen rta dang ba glang dang : mchog chen mi la sogs te rnam pa lnga: ma hā māṃ sa la sogs sha sna stong : ma hā rakta la sogs khrag sna stong : ma hā tsitta la sogs snying sna stong : go ro tsa na la sogs klad pa stong : ba su ta dang nang rol rnam pa lnga: shing tog lo tog 'bru sna sman sna dang : rtsi dang rtsa rgyud rtsi chen go snyod dang : sga dang lan tshwa spod kyi bye brag dang : ri sgog klung sgog sha mong sna tshogs dang : bza' dang bca' ba btung ba la sogs pa: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa sna tshogs pa: thogs med blo yis yongs su kun bsdus nas: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs te: bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i ba liṃ chen po 'di: bla ma rig 'dzin thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma hā bha lingta pū dza bhuñdza hoḥ tshe gcig 'od skur grol ba'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma hā bha lingta pū dza bhuñdza hoḥ rtag brtan 'gyur med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma hā bha lingta pū dza bhuñdza hoḥ brtul zhugs rdzu 'phrul thogs med dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dam can srung ma'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma hā bha lingta pū dza bhuñdza hoḥ lha 'dre mi gsum 'dul ba'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mchod par 'os pa'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma hā bha lingta pū dza bhuñdza hoḥ

tshogs gnyis 'bras bu mthar phyin dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'khor 'das gnyis su med par thugs dam bskang : ma hā bha lingta pū dza bhuñdza hoḥ dgongs klong chabs cig grol ba'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: lnga pa gsang ba bla med kyi mchod pa sbyor sgrol rnam pa gnyis las/ dang po bde chen sbyor ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: kun tu bzang mo shes rab dbyings kyi yum: dmigs med snying rjes sems can yongs la snyoms: thabs mchog bde chen 'khor 'das dbyings su dag: 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams thugs dam bskul ba'i phyir: thabs dang shes rab gnyis med mchod pa'i rgyan: a ho ma hā su kha sa ma ya satwaṃ: āḥdang hūm̐ las rdo rje padma'i dal: pra be sha ya phaṭ kyis gsang sgo phyes: su ra satwaṃ gyis bde ba'i rdo rje bskul: sa ma ho yis dgyes pa chen por gnang : ra ho rā ga ya mis mnyam sbyor te: dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med lhun grub kyi: mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul: dzñā na ma hā su kha pū dza hūm̐: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nam mkhas gar khyab chos dbyings yum gyi mkha': snod kyi 'jig rten rab 'byams gzhal yas khang : gsal snang rtog med sems can kun gyi sems: kun gzhi a la yid ni hūm̐ gi ngang : 'khor 'das gnyis med yab yum thabs shes bsnol: āḥhūm̐ sems gsum 'dres pa'i kun tu bzang : 'gro kun bde gshegs rgyal ba'i sras su gyur: dgyes mchod bde ba chen po bzhes su gsol: dzñā na ma hā su kha pū dza hoḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bde ba chen po dag la gang gnas pa: rtogs pa chen po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: khams gsum las 'das byang chub rin po che: stor ba btsal bas rnyed par ga la 'gyur: thig le chen por chud par gnas pa la:

ye shes snying po 'di las gzhan med do: 'khor ba mya ngan 'das la skye 'chi med: bde ba chen po'i ngang la mnyam par rol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bde ba'i rtsi la rol kyang gnyis med bde: srid pa'i 'dod pa shin tu rnam dag pas: mi srid chos kyi dbyings su rnam sbyar nas: rigs 'dus gu ru'i dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir: rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa la: dam rdzas mchog gi mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: chos nyid lhun grub dag pa'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha pū dza pra tītstsha hoḥ gnyis pa ru tra bsgral mchod ni/ hūm̐: srid gsum rnam dag chos dbyings brub khung du: gzung 'dzin las rlung dug lnga'i dbang gyur pas: rigs drug 'khrul pa'i mun khung 'khyams pa kun: tshad med 'od gsal snying pos yongs bzung ste: brtse chen byams pas mnyam nyid dbyings su 'ching : dga' chen g.yo bas kun snang rtog pa dag: btang snyoms khyab brdal nyon mongs tshor ba gzhom: rang byung ye shes gnyis 'dzin bdud dang phrol: rig 'dzin dpa' stobs gyad kyi phur bu yis: thugs rje rtse gcig bdag 'dzin ru tra'i dpung : mnyam rdzogs dbyings su sgrol cig kī la ya: las dang bag chags 'khrul pa'i sa bon rnams: shes rab rno mtshon 'bar bas rdul du rlog: lhun grub snod yangs 'od gsal dwangs mar bskyil: dbyings nas skur bzhengs zhi khro rab 'byams lha: ngang gis khros nas ye shes 'bar ba'i zhal: srid gsum rnam par rol pa'i hoṃ yangs par: bstab bo bde chen 'gyur med dbyings su stims: ma rig gti mug bsgral ba'i mchod pa che: chos dbyings ye shes lha tshogs zhal du bstab: ha la pañtsa dzñā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: sangs rgyas bstan dgra rnam snang dbyings su ā: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

zhe ldang lha bdud bsgral ba'i mchod pa che: me long ye shes lha tshogs zhal du bstab: ha la pañtsa dzñā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bla ma'i sku dgra rdor sems dbyings su āḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nga rgyal phung bdud bsgral ba'i mchod pa che: mnyam nyid ye shes lha tshogs zhal du bstab: ha la pañtsa dzñā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: rnal 'byor sgos dgra rin 'byung dbyings su phaṭḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nyon mongs 'dod chags bdud dpung bsgral mchod 'di: sor rtog ye shes lha tshogs zhal du bstab: ha la pañtsa dzñā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: mched lcam zur dgra snang mtha'i dbyings su phaṭḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: phrag dog 'chi bdag bdud dpung bsgral mchod 'di: bya grub ye shes lha tshogs zhal du bstab: ha la pañtsa dzñā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: yon bdag rkyen dgra don grub dbyings su phaṭḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dug lnga yongs su bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di: klong gyur ye shes lha tshogs zhal du bstab: ha la pañtsa dzñā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: rgyal khams phung 'dre rdor 'chang dbyings su phaṭḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rnam shes tshogs brgyad bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di: 'da' ka ye shes ging chen zhal du bstab: ha la pañtsa dzñā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: mtha' dmag 'byung po kun bzang klong du phaṭḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: brgyad khri bzhi stong nyon mongs bsgral mchod 'di: dbyings sgrol ye shes lha tshogs zhal du bstab: ha la pañtsa dzñā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs:

lan chags 'byung po ka dag klong du phaṭḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bsgral bya sgrol byed 'dzin pa'i 'du 'phro rnams: mtha' grol gnyis med ye shes klong du bstims: smon lam log pa'i bdud rigs de bzhin nyid: rgyu zad rkyen zad chos skur grol bar shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ma traṃ ru tra mā ra ya pū dza hoḥ drug pa gling bzhi'i gar mchod ni/ hūm̐: thugs rje ye shes rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: phung khams skye mched ye nas rgyal ba'i sku: yab yum gnyis med ye nas lhun gyis grub: stangs stabs phyag rgya thams cad glu dang gar: rnam rol phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: mu tra gīrti nīrti pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: seṅge'i 'gying gar gsang ba rdo rje'i gar: padma'i 'dzum gar bde spyod dbu ma'i mdangs: las kyi 'jol gar dbang sgyur rgya gram rgya: rin chen bsgyur gar drug ldan 'dzin pa'i stangs: stag mo'i 'gyur stangs buddha dbyings kyi gar: khro bo'i 'gying gar g.yas su shigs se shig: khro mo'i bzhad gar g.yon du ya la la: thabs shes zung 'jug mchog thun dngos grub gar: rnal rol phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: mu tra gīrti nīrti pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dang po'i dam tshig nam mkha' gar gyis gang : bar gyi dam tshig sa gzhi gar gyis gang : da lta dam tshig gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur: bde chen gar mkhan tshul du sangs rgyas shing : gsang chen nges pa'i mchog ston e ma hoḥ rnam grol phyag rgya phyi nang mchod pa 'bul: mu tra gīrti nīrti pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

g.yas kyis se gol gtog pa ta la hoḥ g.yon gyis se gol bsgyur ba sham pa rgya: thabs shes ta la sham pa rtse sprad nas: sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya'i gar bsgyur bas: snang srid thams cad phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor du: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad sprin bzhin gtibs: rnam rol phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ ma hā shū n+ya ta dzñā na pri sha su ka ta na hūm̐: bdun pa de bzhin nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas dag pa'i rang bzhin byang chub sems: skye shi las 'das bya rtsol kun dang bral: dge sdig brjod med kun gzhi yid las 'das: lta med lta ba'i rgyal po'i mchod pa 'bul: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rtog med spros bral gzhi grol rang lugs su: yengs su med de bde gsal mi rtog ngang : bde sdug las dang bag chags rgyu 'bras zad: g.yo med sgom pa'i rgyal po'i mchod pa 'bul: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: tshogs drug zhen med phyogs ris med par bde: gnyis med rang bzhin lhun grub rol pa'i rtsal: dug lnga rang grol snod bcud dngos po stong : mnyam nyid spyod pa'i rgyal po'i mchod pa 'bul: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: brjod bral gshis la dngos med bsgom du med: byas chos blos btang byar med blo las 'das: snang sems 'dzin bral dmigs med dbyings su thim: yongs rdzogs 'bras bu rgyal po'i mchod pa 'bul: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gzhi la 'pho 'gyur med pa rnal ma'i ngang : phung khams yul med ming bral 'od lnga'i sbubs:

snang srid rnam dag a ti rdzogs pa che: rang byung kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'i mchog: dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa ngang gis 'bul: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sarba dharma dhā tu dzñā na badzra āḥ

brgyad pa bstod pa ni/ gu ru'i yon tan rjes dran zhing : rtse gcig rjes su 'jug pa'i blos: khyed shes blo bkal gdung dbyangs kyis: hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen lhun grub bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sku ni mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i sku: gsung ni mi 'gag mnyam nyid rig pa'i gsung : thugs ni mi g.yo smra bsam brjod las 'das: sku gsung thugs ldan padma rgyal la bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'gro ba'i don du rang byung 'od dpag med: bkra shis yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i sku: 'jig rten dbang bsgyur padma rgyal po'i sras: snang srid zil gnon rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bskyed pa med pa rgya mtsho'i klong las 'khrungs: skye shi rgyun chad gzhom med rdo rje'i sku: rig rtsal dbang thob 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong : bde gshegs kun 'dus sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stobs bcu'i rtsal gyis log 'dren zil gyis gnon: drag sngags dgongs pas lha srin sde brgyad 'dul: dbyings ye dbyer med ma sring bran du bkol: 'khor lo'i mnga' bdag mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje'i rtsal: ma 'ongs sangs rgyas rnams kyi smon lam mthu: da lta'i sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes dpal: dus gsum sangs rgyas sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mkhyen pa'i yon tan ye shes tshad las 'das: sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya cig car 'gyed: gang 'dul theg pas gdul bya thar lam 'dren:

bstan pa'i bdag nyid mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: phyi ltar phar phyin drug ldan sprul pa'i chas: nang ltar sngags mchog sngags bdag 'khor los bsgyur: gsang ba bla med kun bzang rdo rje 'chang : zung 'jug sprul bsgyur 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: brjod med spros bral kun bzang snang mtha' yas: bde chen rigs lnga longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi rje: dga' rab rdo rje ye shes klong dgu'i gar: dgongs brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gsang ba'i bdag po rig 'dzin rdo rje chos: gsang sngags bka' bab skal ldan rgyal po dzaḥ yang dag mchog brnyes 'gro ba'i don du brtson: rig 'dzin brda brgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rgyud sde kun la dbang sgyur las kyi dbang : sgrub sde brgyad kyi don rtogs mkhas pa brgyad: theg pa'i don la dbang sgyur chos kyi rje: gtad rgya lung bstan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: che chung bzhi rdzogs bde chen 'dus pa'i sku: sku gcig sku lnga mtshan brgyad bye ba brgyad: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kun la dbang bsgyur zhing : rlabs chen gdul bya skyong la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'khor bar ma chags skyon bral padma 'byung : yon tan rab rdzogs padma sam bha wa: shes bya kun mkhyen blo ldan mchog sred rtsal: khams gsum srid gsum dbang sdud padma rgyal: lhun grub rig 'dzin rnam bzhir phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma rig mun sel 'gro 'dul nyi ma 'od: log 'dren bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms shākya seng :

log lta ru tra rdul brlags seṅge'i sgra: dregs pa lha srin kun 'dul gro bo lod: dgra bgegs tshar gcod rnam bzhir phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rdo rje mkha' 'gros mi 'gyur bdud sde 'joms: rin chen mkha' 'gros re skong bcud char 'bebs: padma mkha' 'gros rjes chags gzhan snang sdud: las kyi mkha' 'gros bar gcod gdug pa 'dul: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro sde bzhir phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bstan pa'i brgyud 'dzin dgra bgegs bdud 'dul ma: rnal 'byor 'khor skyong byin rlabs zhi ba mtsho: sngags kyi las mdzad mtsho gling ḍākki ma: las kyi bka' sdod thogs med phra men ma: dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: padma thod phreng sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos: ji srid nam mkha'i 'khor lo ma zhig bar: de srid 'gro don phrin las rgyun mi 'chad: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes stobs 'chang ba: 'khor 'das spyi dpal mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: ye shes rang gsal 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku: ka dag klong nas lhun grub thugs rje che: ma 'gags rang gsal zhi khro'i bkod pa rdzogs: 'khrul pa'i snang tshul rang mdangs 'od skur sbyangs: dran rig rang grol bde chen rgyal po'i sku: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dbyings kyi dpal ldan thugs rje bkod pas brgyan: chos nyid gsal rdzogs 'gyur med yon tan ston: tshogs drug rang grol 'gag med thar lam ston: spang thob bral ba'i 'bras bu chos skur rdzogs: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

bde chen klong du 'khor 'das 'ub chud kyang : gnas skabs 'byung bzhi las rlung 'phen sdud kyi: zag bcas sgyu lus 'jigs tshogs ya nga'i 'phrang : 'byung lnga rang grol ye shes 'od skur rdzogs: mtsho skyes rdo rje dpa' bo gyad kyi lha: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma ye grol las rab rdzogs: 'byung ba rnam dag dby-ings phyug mkha' 'gro lnga: las rlung bag chags sor sdud mkha' spyod spar: dbu ma'i sgo 'byed lhun grub sku lnga'i klong : dbyer med mnyam par rol mdzad rnal 'byor ma: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: sku lnga ye shes lnga yi rang mdangs las: thugs rje mtha' yas zhi khro'i bkod pa rdzogs: gcig tu ma nges cho 'phrul sna tshogs gar: gang la ci 'dul rol pa'i tshul du ston: du ma ro gcig dgongs klong yangs pa'i mkhar: 'du 'bral med pa'i don gyis phyag 'tshal bstod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dug gsum nad 'joms drang srong sman gyi rgyal: bdud bzhi'i bar chad sel mdzad seṅge'i sgra: 'byung lnga dbang sdud ye shes pho nya'i klong : zung 'jug bde chen mchog sbyor sman gyi bla: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ye shes stobs kyis snod bcud rgud pa sel: thugs rje'i dbang gis rtsol med dgos 'dod 'byung : nus mthu rtsal gyis khams gsum dbang du sdud: 'dod rgu'i srid rje mkha' 'gro nor gyi lha: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: brgyud pa kun la dbang sgyur mthu stobs bdag: ye shes bdun ldan rdo rje'i go cha can:

'byung lnga ye shes 'khor los rgyas 'debs pa: log 'dren ldang med rnam gnon gur gyi lha: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stobs ldan nag po mngon spyod dmod pa'i chas: drag sngags thal 'byin rdo rje pha lam sku: sde brgyad g.yul 'gyed phas kyi rgol ba 'joms: bstan dgra bgegs dpung tshar gcod kī la ya: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: chos nyid zhi las thugs rje 'bar ba'i shugs: srid pa dpyi gnon ye shes dgongs pa yis: stong gsum rngam drag ging chen pho nyas 'gengs: 'dre rgod mi min 'tshe ba pha mthar bskrad: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes gzi byin gyi: klong lnga'i rang bzhin srid pa rgya yis 'debs: snod bcud go 'byed mkhyen brtse phrin las rdzogs: zab rgya mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod gter sgo 'byed: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dgongs pa klong yangs 'od gsal snying rje'i ngang : rnam 'gyur brtul zhugs spyod pa ma tshogs sdud: srid pa bran bkol lha 'dre mi gsum 'dul: sbas gnas sgo 'byed 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stobs bcu'i dbyings las 'gying rtsal khros pa'i gar: snang srid dbang sdud bdud 'dul sngags pa'i chas: tshad med rnam bzhi'i phyag rgyas dgra rgol 'joms: bdud bzhi'i dpung bcom dregs pa zil gnon lha: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: tshe rabs las dang smon lam shugs kyis 'brel: dbang lung man ngag brgyud dang nyams chag skong :

theg pa 'dzin 'chang rig 'dzin slob dpon sogs: sgrub pa bka' brgyad zhi khro yi dam lha: gnas yul zhi skyong dpa' bo ḍākki'i tshogs: chos dbyings ye shes rol pa chen po'i lha: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rngam gshe dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ging chen dang : 'gugs 'ching sdom myos las mdzad sgo ma bzhi: bde chen bcud 'dzin mchod sprin lha mo 'bum: bka' nyan las byed gzugs sku dregs pa'i tshul: pho nya bka' sdod dam can srung ma'i tshogs: thams cad chos dbyings chen por brdal khyab pas: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: shes rab dbyings las thugs rje thabs kyi skur: rtsol med rang shar phyogs bcu'i zhing kun gyi: rgyal ba rab 'byams dkyil 'khor ma lus rdzogs: gnyis med rang snang gsal stong ye shes lha: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: zhes bstod cing gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ dgu pa dzapa ྄la dang po dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: chos sku khyab brdal zhing khams nas: gdod ma'i mgon po snang mtha' yas: gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi 'od klong nas: longs sku 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: pad ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: o rgyan chen po rje 'bangs rnams: gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐:

'gro 'dul thugs rje'i pho brang nas/ /rig 'dzin o rgyan rtsa gsum gling*/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: bsam yas mchims phu'i sgrub gnas nas/ /rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje yang*/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: rtswa nang gsang ba'i dga' tshal nas/ /'o dbyings gnyis med bde chen rgyal/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: gnas bzhi padma chos gling nas/ /karma bhi dhwa dha ra yang*/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: sbas yul rin spungs pho brang nas/ /o rgyan gnyis med 'gro 'dul gling*/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: gang 'dul der ston gzhal yas nas/ /chos bdag rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: bde chen mchog gi 'khor lo nas/ /bka' drin sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: snang stong thig le'i mkha' klong nas/ /yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha/

gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: rtsa khams dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /yi dam ḍākki'i lha tshogs rnams/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: dam tshig gnyan gyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ gnyis pa dzap dngos la gsum/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ kye kye bla ma rin po che: sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pu: mgon med bdag la thugs rjes zungs: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che: re zhing ltos pa'i gnyen gcig pu: bdag la re sa gzhan na med: sdug bsngal 'di las drang du gsol: rje btsun padma thod phreng rtsal: khyed la bdag nyid bran du 'bul: skyid sdug re ltos khyed shes pas: bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsol: bla ma sangs rgyas phrin las mdzad: bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa: 'dren pa'i bla mar bdag gyur cig:

ces gsol ba snying nas gdab: de nas dzap dgongs gsal gdab pa ni/ de yang gsang 'dus las/ snang srid gzhal yas bla ma lha/ /thams cad phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor che/ /dper na chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar/ /snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa srog bzung nas/ spyi bo'i bla ma la sems rtse gcig pas mos gus gdung shugs drag pos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: zhes gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bzla'o/ gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs gnad dang sbyar te/ bla ma yab yum sku yi gnas bzhi nas/ /'od zer byung ba bdag gi gnas bzhir thim/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje yis/ /byin gyis brlabs nas dbang bzhi thob par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar bla ma rang la thim pas/ rang nyid thod phreng rtsal gyi sku yi gsal snang dang nga rgyal la sems rtse gcig pas kyang bzla ste/ sha med 'od kyi gzugs can ni/ /padma 'byung gnas sku ru bsgom/ zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa ste sgrub pa'i tshul lo/ gsum pa las sbyor ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis rigs bzhi'i thod phreng bskul bas de las rang 'dra'i sprul pa mkha' khyab tu spros pas phrin las rnam bzhi gang 'dod bsgrubs par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsitta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: de nas bsnyen sgrub las sbyor rnams sgrub yig bzhin dzap dgongs gsal btab la bzla'o/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams lan gsum gsum bzlas/ bcu pa dzap bstod dngos grub blang ba ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe ḍākki nī sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ? sogs shabda pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: mnyam nyid chos sku'i rang bzhin ni: kun bzang zag pa med par bde: sems can don la de bzhin gshegs:

thugs rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'gag med yan lag drug cu'i gsung : grags stong snying po'i rang bzhin can: 'gro rnams bdud rtsis tshim mdzad pa'i: rang byung gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: rtsol med rang byung chos kyi dbyings: ma skyes 'jigs med rdo rje'i sku: blang dor med par chos dbyings ngang : 'gyur med thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos dbyings rol pa chen po las: rtsal dang rol pa mi dmigs kyang : nam mkha' mdzod kyi cho 'phrul gyis: yon tan re skong phyag 'tshal bstod: rang bzhin ci yang ma nges te: dkyil 'khor chen po'i cha bzung nas: rtog med rtog pa ngang gis 'dul: phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha dang rig 'dzin drang srong dgongs: 'dir bzhugs rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams: smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs shing : bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis las gzhung bsrangs: las dang thugs rje mthun pa yi: zhi rgyas dbang drag yid bzhin gter: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi hūm̐ ā: zhes ting 'dzin ye shes kyi dbang blang ngo*/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa bcu drug las/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs tshogs mchod 'bul: zhes pas zhing lpags sam gcan gzan shun lpags steng*/ sha chang bza' btung la sogs pa/ ci 'byor bsod nams tshogs su bshams/ dang po bsang ba la ni gsum/ thog mar byin rlabs rdzas kyis bsang*/ rdo rjes bdud rtsi blangs te gtor/ de nas nus ldan sngags kyis bsang*/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsang : sarba bi shuddhe ye swā hā: de nas mos ldan ting 'dzin bsang : tshogs gtor 'bru gsum gcig pa las: lnga ldan 'od zer dpag med 'phros: longs spyod 'bag btsog dag par bsam: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa sbyang ba la yang gsum/ tshogs kyi bdag po ting 'dzin ni: bla ma rigs 'dus yab yum sku: gnyis med sbyor ba'i mkha' dbyings su: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: 'phros dngos 'dzin gyi:

rnam par rtog pa bsregs gtor sbyangs: de nas bskal pa gsum gyis sbyangs: hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: chos kun sgyu mar rig pas na: rig pa'i yi ge ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: 'phros pas 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs: ram̐ las me byung dngos 'dzin bsregs: yam̐ las rlung byung bag chags bsregs: kham̐ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: ram̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kham̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ sam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ de nas chos nyid dag pas sbyangs/ thal mo khog stong phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ lan bdun brjod pas gnyis bsdus kyi chos kun gzhi bral stong nyid ngang*/ gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa la gsum/ thog mar snod bcud byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: snod kyi 'jig rten ma lus 'byung ba lnga: ye nas rnam dag dbyings phyug yum lnga'i mkha': bsam 'das ris med gzhal yas chen por rtogs: ma hā gu ru chos nyid klong chen ngang : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: khams gsum 'gro drug phung khams skye mched rnams: ye nas dus gsum bde gshegs 'khor dang bcas: snang mtha' ris med rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid: gu ru'i mkhyen brtse ma 'gags phyogs med gsal: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de nas rnal 'byor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: 'dus shing 'tshogs pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo rnams: ye nas rnam dag rtsa gsum thod phreng rtsal: 'khor 'das gnyis med ye shes lhun gyis grub: gu ru'i dgongs klong bde stong dbyer med ngang : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de nas longs spyod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: snod kyi 'jig rten rnam dag tshogs gzhong du: bcud kyi 'gro drug dam rdzas tshogs su bshams: tshogs brgyad dbang po lang tsho'i dpal gyis brgyan: gnyis med rgyal ba'i thugs dam dgyes skong rdzas: lha yi me tog rin chen 'dod yon tshogs:

mi yi gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i rigs: gshin rje'i sha chen sna tshogs ji snyed pa: srin po'i thod rus klad pa 'bru mar tshogs: gnod sbyin nor bu'i rig byed dza gad bcud: ma mo'i sha khrag snum can sna tshogs dang : nam mkha' lding gi shing thog dri bcud tshogs: drang srong sman sna shing gi lha mo yi: rtsi bcud bdud rtsi me tog sna tshogs rigs: dud 'gro'i gzugs brnyan ngo mtshar dkar gsum tshogs: klu yi snying po sa bdag 'bru sna tshogs: snod bcud 'dod yon longs spyod ma lus pa: rgya che gting zab srid pa'i ltos dang mnyam: kun bzang mchod sprin gnyis med bdud rtsir gyur: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: swa ratna hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ: zhes brjod lag pa thal mo sbyar te gtug /bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ phud mchod bsgral bstab bskang bshags rol/ ces pas dang po phud mchod pa la gsum/ thog mar snod bcud rdzas kyis mchod/ gnyis med rol pa chen po'i ngang*/ hūm̐: bla med tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di: rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams la mchod pa 'bul: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis grub pa dang : rgyal mtshan 'phan gdugs bla bre lhab lhub dang : bdug spos dri zhim me tog sil mar bkram: bdud rtsi sman dang snang gsal sgron me bcas: lha dang mi yi rol mo sna tshogs dang : glu dbyangs dril bu sgra snyan tshigs bcad dang : bza' btung ro mchog bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga: rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun la sogs pa: mtshan mchog yid 'ong btsun mo sna tshogs sgeg: thabs ldan rol pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: bsod nams tshogs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pū dza sarba sa ma ye swā hā: de nas 'khor gsum yang dag mchod pa ni/

hūm̐: bla med tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir: ma chags pa la chags pa med: chags pa la yang chags pa med: bdag med rtogs na mya ngan 'das: zag med dbyings la ye shes rol: rgyal srid dang ni rang gi lus: bu dang chung ma 'khor dang g.yog: nor gyi dbyig dang sbas pa'i gter: rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang : glang chen ne'u le shang shang dang : 'khor 'das rab 'byams mchod pa 'bul: ma lus dgyes pas bzhes mdzod la: 'khor ba'i khri mun stongs par mdzod: mnyam med gu ru rin po che: gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs: byin rlabs thugs rje'i klong nas stsol: ci bsam 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: tri ma dha la sa pa ri wā ra shuddhe sa ma ye swā hā: de nas kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bde bar gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das: rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes che: srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun: kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol: bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'di: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro: 'dod yon longs spyod mkho dgur ldan: nam mkha'i mtha' klas gter chen 'di: rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dmyal sogs sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod: gu ru'i thugs rje'i dgongs pa'i klong : khams gsum 'khor ba gnyis su med: lhun grub rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ badzra ātma ko3 haṃ utga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: gnyis pa skye shi med par bsgral zhing bstab/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i brub khung thar med nang : nṛ tri las skyes dgra bgegs nyam thag pa: lcags sgrog gis bcings srog gcod bshan pas bzung : mya ngan ngu 'bod 'o dod lhang lhang bsam: bden pa brdar zhing gzugs la dbab pa ni/ na moḥ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun bden pa dang : dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: drang srong rig 'dzin grub thob brgyud par bcas: sa dang lam gnas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs:

bstan srung dam can chos skyong srung ma dang : gnas dang dur khrod zhing skyong mkha' 'gro sogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mthu stobs nus rtsal dang : sngags 'chang bdag gi sngags dang phyag rgya dang : ting 'dzin byin rlabs lhag bsam rnam dag pas: bka' dang bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs kyis: sangs rgyas bstan dgra rgyal khams yongs la 'tshe: sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i log 'dren bdud: thugs rje'i dpyang thag chad pa'i gdul bya rnams: bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa gang yin pa: stong gsum srid pa'i 'dzin khyon gar gnas kyang : snying nas zungs shig rdo rje lcags kyu ma: khug cig badzra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ ske nas chings shig rdo rje zhags pa ma: lus ngag non cig ratna pā sha hūm̐: yan lag sdoms shig rdo rje lcags sgrog ma: 'byung bzhi dkrugs shig padma pho ṭa baṃ: myos par gyis shig rdo rje dril bu ma: zungs shig gtor cig karma ghaṇḍe hoḥ skyabs dang phrold cig rdo rje phra men ma: phyes shig badzra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ las byed pho nya'i dmag tshogs mthu ma chung : dbang med las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas phul: 'jigs rung 'chi bdag mun pas mdun nas bsus: srid pa mtha' sdud stong khams rdul phran shigs: 'byung ba dgra gshed 'khrugs pa'i 'ur sgra bcas: gzugs la phob cig a be sha ya āḥ ru tra nṛ tri sha truṃ tsitta nan: zhes bkug phur pa thogs la/ ham̐'u: che mchog padma thod phreng rtsal: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs: g.yon pas phur bus dgra snying gzir: gnod byed pho mo rdul du rlog: hūm̐: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan khyod: dang po zhe sdang pha yi khams: bar du 'dod chags ma yi khams: tha ma za 'dre'i lto bar chags: dug lnga las kyi 'bras bu smin: las ngan de dang ma phral na: rigs drug ngan song rgyun du 'khor: khyod kyi bla ma nga yin no: rnam shes bdag 'dzin phung po la: shes rab snying po'i phur pa 'debs: las ngan bag chags gzhob tu bsreg:

snang mched 'od gsal rang ngo sprod: mtshan 'dzin phung po de yal nas: khyod kyang rgyal ba'i sras su skyes: kun bzang sa la gnas par gyur: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsgral dkyil 'khor lha tshogs chos dbyings drag po'i sku ru gsal/ hūm̐: skye med dbyings las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs zhi dang khro: rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma lus 'khor dang bcas: khams gsum sgrol byed rngam pa'i dgyes zhal phyes: dug gsum dbyings sdud hu lu'i rngam sgrar bcas: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phung khams bag chags rnams: 'khor ba'i lam lnga dgag phyir zhal du bstab: gnyis med chos kyi dbyings su rnam par rol: khro rgyal tshogs rnams rngam pa'i tshul gyis rol: khro mo'i tshogs rnams chem chem hrug hrug rol: pho nya'i tshogs rnams gtad len tshul gyis rol: ma mo'i tshogs rnams rdul du brlag cing rol: phra men tshogs rnams lhag med rnam par rol: bstan srung tshogs rnams sgrol la rngam par rol: theg chen bstan la sdang zhing dmod pa dang : gsang sngags sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i bdud: las ngan dam sri ma lus zhal du bstab: zhe sdang rus pa gti mug sha chen ri: 'dod chags khrag mtsho nga rgyal klad khrag 'khyil: phrag dog nang khrol mchod pa bla na med: dug lnga bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: mi 'gyur sku lnga'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī dharma pā la sarba sa ma ya ma hā maṃ sa rakta keṃ ni ri ti tsitta ba su ta go ro tsa na sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: gnyis su med par bstab bo/ gsum pa rang bzhin rnam dag bskang zhing bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: phyogs lhung bral ba'i lta ba dang : the tshom med pa'i spyod pa dang : yengs ba med pa'i ting 'dzin dang :

lhag chad med pa'i cho ga yis: rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : tshogs gtor bdud rtsi rakta dang : dza gad mar me gsur chen sprin: rkang gling thod rnga rol mo'i tshogs: sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin rnam dag pas: mthun pa'i dam rdzas ma lus pa: snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bde ba'i gar: tshul bzhin ma nor bsgrubs pa yi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: ye nas ka dag sangs rgyas phyir: snang ba mtha' yas thugs dam bskang : ma 'gags longs sku'i rtsal ston phyir: rdor sems rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : spyod yul sku yi gar bsgyur phyir: dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : dgongs gsang theg mchog srol 'dzin phyir: shrī singha'i thugs dam bskang : bka' bab don brgyud yongs 'dzin phyir: rdo rje thod phreng thugs dam bskang : phyogs mtshams thugs rje rol pa'i phyir: sgyu 'phrul mtshan brgyad thugs dam bskang : gnyis med phrin las lhun grub phyir: dbyings phyug ma tshogs thugs dam bskang : kun gzhi ka nas dag pa'i phyir: bde chen rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : tshogs drug lhug par grol ba'i phyir: dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs dam bskang : 'byung gzugs mtshan ma rnam dag phyir: dpa' bo gyad kyi thugs dam bskang : skad cig mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas phyir: rdo rje rnal 'byor thugs dam bskang : 'khor ba'i gcong nad 'byin pa'i phyir: 'chi med sman bla'i thugs dam bskang : khams gsum 'khor los bsgyur ba'i phyir: padma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams gzhom pa'i phyir: rdo rje gur gyi thugs dam bskang : zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir: stobs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : 'jigs brgyad mi mthun bskyab pa'i phyir: snang srid zil gnon thugs dam bskang : zab dgu'i gter la mnga' bsgyur phyir: stag zhon khro rgyal thugs dam bskang : dbang bsgyur brtul zhugs spyod pa'i phyir:

nyi ma 'od zer thugs dam bskang : drag sngags dmod pa mthar byed phyir: dregs pa zil gnon thugs dam bskang : gsang sngags dkyil 'khor kun rdzogs phyir: zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang : snang srid ma lus dgyes pa'i phyir: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : bka' dang bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir: dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : khams gsum 'khor ba 'dag pa'i phyir: ye shes gsal rdzogs dkyil 'khor gyi: lha dang gnyis med thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hoḥ bdag gis bla med snying po'i sgor zhugs nas: sku yi dam tshig bkur 'os slob dpon mchod: gsung gi dam tshig bsnyen sgrub yi dam lha: thugs kyi dam tshig sbyor sgrol gsang ba bcu: tshul bzhin ma bsgrub rtsa ba'i dam las 'gal: nyes ltung sgrib par gyur pa ci mchis bshags: shes bya lnga dang mi spangs dwang du blang : bsgrub dang spyad bya'i dam tshig nyi shu lnga: yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: khyad par nyer gcig rgyun gyi dam tshig bzhi: gal mdo nges pa'i dam tshig gsum la sogs: bsrung mtshams ma shes gzhung dang 'gal ba rnams: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan la bshags: lhun grub ye shes rang gsal dkyil 'khor du: byang zhing dag nas tshangs pa mchog gi don: mnyam nyid bsrung mtshams bral ba'i dngos grub stsol:

zhes yig brgya bzla/ bzhi pa tshogs la rol pa ni/ rdo rje rgyan bro pho mo yis: rnal 'byor pho mo thams cad la: thabs shes rdzas rnams bsnol la stob: kye ho dgongs shig rnal 'byor pa: gsang chen theg par bde ba yis: bde ba chen po bsgrub bya'i phyir: 'dzin med rang grol chen por rol: ga ṇa tsakra siddhi hoḥ lan gdab pa ni/ hoḥ rgyal ba'i spyod yul thabs kyi lam: gnyis med bde chen rang bzhin mchog: rnam dag tshogs kyi longs spyod 'di: chos nyid ngang du rol par bya: man tra siddhi a la la hoḥ zhes brjod gar gyi phyag rgyas blangs/ 'chi med bdud rtsi chen po ltar: phung khams skye mched rgyal ba'i dal: gnyis med bde chen rol pas tshim: nang ltar shes rab ting 'dzin tshogs: rang byung yongs su rdzogs par rol: gsang ba chos nyid lta dgongs tshogs: dbyer med kun grol rol gar spyod: lnga pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: dang po phud kyis mchod pa ni: bla ma rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i rtags: bar du bskang zhing bshags pa ni: yi dam mkha' 'gro mthun pa'i rdzas: tha ma 'gugs shing bsgral ba ni: chos skyong dam can rbad pa'i rten: dbyer med tshogs la rol pa ni: nor lha gter bdag dngos grub bdag: kun nas lhag ma sdud pa ni: laṅka gnas nyul dgyes par mchod: dkyil 'khor mtha' la bzhag pa ni: bka' bzhin bstan pa bsrung bar bcol: lhag ma kha chus bran pa ni: 'da' ka dam tshig gcig par ston: hūm̐: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs bstan srung ni: mtshan mo sgra sgrogs ma mo bye ba 'bum: srod la rab rgyu cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston: smag rum gseb nas mi sdug skad ngan 'don: la las rgyan mdzes spras nas mkha' la lding : la las sder chags bzhon nas sa gzhi nyul: la las gcer mo dur khrod bam ro khur: la las g.yang gzhi gyon nas bhandha thogs: la las nang rol 'dren zhing rgyu ma za:

la las srod 'phros drod nyul lam lam 'gyu: don la thams cad rnal 'byor ma sring ste: bye brag so so'i snang ngor sgyu ma'i gar: mi bzad gar sgyur bstan pa'i bya ra'i tshogs: bka' yi las byed phra men 'khor bcas kyis: 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: rgyud srung sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs ma g.yel zhing : ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad nas: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma tri hriṃ hriṃ mu kha le sa ma ya maṇḍal pā la bha lingta kha kha khā hi: drug pa tshogs kyi bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: lta spyod phrin las man ngag thabs mkhas pa: tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen 'di phul bas: bdag cag 'dir 'dus rnal 'byor pho mo dang : pha ma rigs drug khams gsum sems can rnams: tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis gnas dag nas: nad gdon sdig sgrib sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: tshe dpal ye shes bde legs phun tshogs shing : log 'dren gdul bya dbang 'dus chos la 'khod: dgra bgegs rnam par 'tshe ba rdul du rlog: dgongs pa'i ting 'dzin mkhyen brtse'i phrin las rdol: kun bzang go 'phang da lta mngon gyur nas: padma thod phreng rlabs chen phrin las sgo: mngon rdzogs phyam gcig 'gro ba sgrol bar shog: ces smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab bo/ bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ mos gus gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis su/ hūm̐: ma g.yel bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bzhengs shig chos dbyings bden chen klong nas bzhengs: bskul lo 'gro ba'i don du thugs dam bskul: mdzod cig rnam bzhi'i phrin las thogs med mdzod: thugs rje phrin las mdzad pa bsam mi khyab: bye ba phrag brgya sprul sku'i zhing khams su: o rgyan sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya'i tshogs: gang la gang 'dul gdul bya'i re ba bskang : dgongs spyod dag pa ye shes thams cad bskul:

khyad par bdag cag bod kyi sems can rnams: las ngan 'bras bu sdug bsngal mtsho kha rdol: skyabs med mgon med yi chad 'di 'dra la: thugs rje ma g.yel mkhyen brtse'i mthu dpung bskyed: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: las dang rgyu 'bras rnam smin dbang btsan na: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa mchog: thugs rjes yal yol btang snyoms dbang gyur na: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdul bya gang la mdzad: bdag cag rjes 'jug khyed kyis mi skyong na: padma'i thugs bskyed dam bcas ci la dgongs: nad mug mtshon gyis 'gro ba bzod dka' na: drag rtsal mthu stobs nus pa gang la bskyed: phung byed bdud kyis 'jig rten dbang bsgyur na: shugs sgrol mngon spyod dmod pa'i phrin las gang : byang chub sgrub la bar chad dbang btsan na: mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam tshig g.yel lam ci: brtse chen thugs rje skyed cig mthu ma chung : gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dbyings nas bskyod: bla ma rig 'dzin byin 'od thibs se thib: nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin ya la la: zab gsang bde chen chos sgra 'u ru ru: mkhyen brtse nus pas bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs: yi dam lha tshogs rngam brjid ya la la: hūm̐ dang phaṭ kyi gad rgyangs di ri ri: tsha zer me 'od tshwa tshwa si li li: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo gar sgyur tshogs: glu dbyangs rol mo mang po 'u ru ru: ging chen chos skyong las byed sha ra ra: me rlung mtshon cha bu yug tshubs se tshub: bstan dgra dam nyams phye mar nyi li li: kun kyang thugs rje'i sku la phrin las gar: gnyis med sprul pa'i 'od zer stong khams gang : bdag sogs khams gsum rigs drug sems can gyi: nad gdon sdig sgrib rkyen tshogs gzhob tu sregs:

tshe dpal lus stobs ting 'dzin ye shes skyed: srid pa'i che btsan dregs pa dbang du sdus: ma dag log lta'i snang ba chos la sgyur: tshe gcig byang chub sgrub pa'i bdud tshogs thul: dkar po dge ba'i chos srid lang tsho spel: rgyal khams phung 'dre dme 'khrug mtshon bskal g.yo: ma rungs bdud kyi sde tshogs cham la phob: theg chen bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: zhes pas thugs dam bskul zhing 'dod pa'i don ji srid grub par dmigs te nges blo brtan par bskyed/ brgyad pa tha tshig chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min dga' ldan chos dbyings pho brang du: bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru kas: dam la btags pa'i kau sing mkha' 'gro ging : dbang phyug ma sring 'bar ma pho nya'i tshogs: dam tshig bzhin du 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: bdag ni 'od gsal snying po'i srol brgyud 'dzin: khyed rnams dpal gyi bka' sdod dam tshig can: de phyir chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: de 'og 'dzam gling dur khrod brgyad kyi gnas: dpal chen khrag 'thung brgyad kyi skur bstan nas: dam la btags pa'i zhing skyong bka' srung tshogs: dam tshig bzhin du 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: bdag ni bskyed rdzogs las bzhi'i phrin las 'chang : khyed rnams dpal gyi bka' sdod dam tshig can: de phyir chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: de 'og bal yul yang le shod kyi gnas:

khrag 'thung rdo rje srin po'i skur bstan nas: dam la btags pa'i ma mo bcu gnyis dang : gtsang ris mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga'i tshogs: dam tshig bzhin du 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: bdag ni drag sngags stobs 'dus phrin las 'chang : khyed rnams dpal gyi bka' sdod dam tshig can: de phyir chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: de 'og bod yul bsam yas has po ri: yaksha me phreng rtsal gyi skur bzhengs nas: dam la btags pa srid pa'i lha dgu dang : dge bsnyen nyer gcig mgur lha brtan ma'i tshogs: snang srid lha srin dregs pa che dgu rnams: dam tshig bzhin du 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: bdag ni slob dpon dgongs srol 'dzin pa'i gdung : khyed cag srid pa'i lha dgu g.yar dam can: de phyir chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: da lta lho nub o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling : zangs mdog dpal rir srin rgyal skur bzhengs nas: dam la btags pa'i srin tshogs gdon gyi rigs: dam tshig bzhin du 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: bdag ni padma thod phreng phrin las skyong : khyed cag srid pa'i 'byung po tha tshig can: de phyir chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: snga phyi bar gsum tha tshig bka' bsgos pa'i: o rgyan rgya gar bal bod rgya nag sogs: srid pa'i lha srin dregs pa che dgu yis: padma thod phreng mtshan tsam 'dzin pa yang : g.yo med gus pa'i sems kyis spyi bo'i gtsug:

blang zhing bkur bar bya zhes rang dam bcas: tha tshig ma g.yel 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: bdag ni slob dpon padma'i gdung gsob pa: khyed cag srid pa'i lha 'dre g.yar dam can: de phyir chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: nga ni rig 'dzin rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gzi byin bskyed: chos nyid mi 'gyur bden tshig padma'i bka': nga yi bka' las su yang 'da' ma byed: gal te bka' dang dam las 'das gyur na: yaksha me dbal rdo rje srin po'i sku: stobs ldan nag po 'jigs byed kī la ya: srid gsum shugs sgrol las mkhan dmod pa'i dbal: gnam lcags rdo rjes sde brgyad lus srog 'joms: lcags sdig khros pas dam nyams snying khrag 'thung : gzir 'debs phur bus khams gsum dus gcig sgrol: stong khams sgrol zhing 'tshubs pa'i las byed de: nyam thag 'o dod 'bod pa gdon mi za: de bas bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di longs la: gangs can bod yul sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: mtha' bzhi'i dmag bzlog dme 'khrug mtshon bskal thul: sad ser btsa' than mi phyug dal yams dang : sri keg byed zor than ltas ngan dgu zlog: dus su char phob lo phyugs srid rnams spel: gtsug lag dben gnas chos 'khor gnyan po skyongs: bshad sgrub mdo sde sngags sde rgyas par spel: 'jig rten bde skyid legs dgu phun tshogs shing : kun kyang chos la spyod pa'i phrin las mdzod: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sarba sa ma ya hūm̐: bha lingta khā hi: zhes bsgo/ las rnams thogs med bsgrubs par bsam/ dgu pa bshal chus brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i bka' nyan pa: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma:

dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong : gangs dkar sha med rdo rje kun tu bzang : 'brog chen 'khor 'dus rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso: gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje g.yu bun ma: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum: gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang : rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong : btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig ma: mo btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil: g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje si le ma: ma sring bod skyong chen mo bcu gnyis kyi: so so'i bran g.yog yang g.yog 'khor dang bcas: lhab lhub mdzes pa'i na bza' sku la gsol: sna tshogs rgyan cha mang po khro lo lo: g.yer kha sil snyan rol mo si li li: glu len bro rdung gar rtsed khyugs se khyug: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas pa'i bya ra mdzod: oṃ pra mo li tsa tur yaksha li tsa tur ma tri li tsa tur ra ya sarba i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: bcu pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: grub thob rgya mtshos bro brdungs pas: ye shes lnga ru lhun gyis grub: mu kha chos 'byung khri rkang du: rdo rje mchu yis bro brdungs pas: rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgyun lam gcod: las mtha' rnam bzhi'i dal dbus su: so so'i phrin las bro brdungs pas: zhi rgyas dbang drag lhun gyis grub: hūm̐: bro yang ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang ye shes chen po'i glu: gar yang phyag rgya drug gi gar: gdangs yang ma 'gags rig pa'i sgra: de ltar brda dang rten 'brel gyis: sna tshogs las kun lhun gyis grub: oṃ nan: ā nan: hūm̐ nan: sgab 'dre 'byung po thams cad satwaṃ bha ya nan: bcu gcig pa dngos grub blang ba la gsum las/ dang po dzap bzlas pa ni/ dngos grub sdud pa'i sngags 'di las sbyor kun la btags zhes pas/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsitta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ ba su siddhi na na kha dhi ā yu puṇye sarba bsdus bsdus pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes bzlas/ gnyis pa dgongs pa bskul zhing tshe dgug pa ni/ mda' dar g.yab cing*/ hūm̐: mkha' mnyam tshe bdag 'od dpag med: chos dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu siddhi dzaḥ puṇye dzñā na shrī bhrūm̐: hūm̐: lhun grub rigs lnga rdo rje sems: sku lnga dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu siddhi dzaḥ puṇye dzñā na shrī bhrūm̐: hūm̐: rigs 'dus padma thod phreng rtsal: thugs rje ye shes dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu siddhi dzaḥ puṇye dzñā na shrī bhrūm̐: hūm̐: dbyings phyug bde chen mtsho rgyal ma: dbang sgyur stobs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu siddhi dzaḥ puṇye dzñā na shrī bhrūm̐: hūm̐: mtshan brgyad rig 'dzin rje 'bangs tshogs: rmad byung sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu siddhi dzaḥ puṇye dzñā na shrī bhrūm̐: hūm̐: dngos grub kun stsol yi dam lha: thugs rje rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la:

'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu siddhi dzaḥ puṇye dzñā na shrī bhrūm̐: hūm̐: bka' sdod mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams: dam tshig gnyan po'i dkyil 'khor du: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu siddhi dzaḥ puṇye dzñā na shrī bhrūm̐: hūm̐: bskul lo rig 'dzin snying nas bskul: skyed cig thugs dam dbyings nas skyed: bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: tshe dang ye shes char chen phob: phyi snod 'byung ba'i tshe bkrag mdangs: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: sgrub rdzas ye shes bdud rtsir bskyil: bkrag dang gzi mdangs ya la la: rig rtsal ye shes stobs skyed la: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par stsol:

zhes bskul tshe 'dzab bzlas pas bskul/ 'khor 'das tshe dpal bcud 'khyil bsgom/ gsum pa dbang blang ba ni/ sgrub rdzas bdag nyid dngos su mos par bskyed/ rtse gcig gsol btab dngos grub stsol bar dmigs/ hūm̐: bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba'i: 'jig rten dbang bsgyur padma rgyal po ni: rigs ni za hor rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs: o rgyan yul du sgro 'dogs ma lus bcad: bsil ba tshal du dngos grub sna tshogs brnyes: wā rā ṇa sīr chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: rgya gar yul du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad: 'jig rten khams kyi gdug pa thams cad btul: bod yul dbus su rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs: kha ba can du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad: lho nub mtshams su 'gro ba'i don du dgongs: sku tshab lung bstan gsung tshab gter du sbas: lho nub mtshams su 'gro ba'i don la dgongs: skal ldan rnams la zab gsang brda chos ston: zangs mdog dpal rir rig 'dzin gtso 'khor bzhugs: rnga yab gling du srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: 'jig rten 'khor ba ma stongs de srid bar: mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje spyan gcig po: sku gsum dbyer med che mchog he ru kaḥ mnyam med bla ma mchog khyod dus 'dir dran: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che: thugs rjes khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: khyad par bdag sogs bod kyi rje 'bangs rnams: rtse gcig pha khyod yon tan dran pa yis: mo gus gdung bas 'bod pa cang gsan nam: brtse chen thugs rje skyed cig mthu ma chung : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sku lnga rigs 'dus gu ru zil gnon la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus zhu: skye shi bral ba'i bde chen rgyal po la: lta ba'i gzhi rtsa chod pa'i dngos grub zhu: ka dag mngon rdzogs dpa' bo gyad kyi skur: g.yo med dgongs pa rang gsal dngos grub zhu: tshogs drug zhen bral dus gsum mkhyen pa la:
