spyod pa blang dor bral ba'i dngos grub zhu: 'byung lnga rang grol rdo rje rnal 'byor mar: blo bral chos zad 'bras bu'i dngos grub zhu: 'chi med mgon po 'phags mchog sman gyi blar: tshe ring nad med bde skyid dngos grub zhu: 'dod rgu'i srid rje padma rgyal po la: dgos 'byung lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub zhu: gsang sngags rig sngags khyab bdag gur gyi lhar: log 'dren bdud bzhi tshar gcod dngos grub zhu: drag sngags rtsal 'byin stobs ldan kī la yar: shugs sgrol phrin las mthar phyin dngos grub zhu: bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa brgyad skyob zil gnon lhar: skye 'gro bde la 'god pa'i dngos grub zhu: snang srid dbang bsgyur stag zhon yi dam lhar: chos ltar phyogs med thob pa'i dngos grub zhu: lha 'dre mi gsum 'dul mdzad nyi ma 'od: bzang ngan 'brel tshad don ldan dngos grub zhu: tshad med bzhi ldan dregs pa zil gnon lhar: dmod pa'i las kun gdung mchog dngos grub zhu: bla ma rig 'dzin zhi khro rab 'byams lhar: mngon spyod rdzu 'phrul thogs med dngos grub zhu: gnas yul skyong zhing dpa' bo ḍākki la: rten 'brel phyogs med 'char ba'i dngos grub zhu: bka' nyan las byed chos skyong srung ma la: las bzhi thogs med 'grub pa'i dngos grub zhu: ye shes las grub dkyil 'khor thams cad la: snang srid chos skur 'char ba'i dngos grub zhu: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: mos pas gsol ba snying nas btab pa'i mod: bde gshegs sgyu 'phrul dgongs pa gcig tu dril: sku yi gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum du 'char: gsung gi gdangs sgra 'brug stong ldir ba'i che: thugs kyi dgongs pa nam mkha'i glog bas myur: yon tan gdul bya'i rol pa ma 'dres gsal: phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam ris med brdal: 'gyur med rdo rje sku yi dngos grub stsol:

nad gdon sdig sgrib rkyen ngan bral ba'i tshe: mi 'gyur g.yung drung lta bur lhun grub nas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: 'gag med rdo rje gsung gi dngos grub stsol: ngag gi sgrib dag brgyad khri bzhi stong sgo: gdul bya so so'i skad du chos ston pas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ 'khrul med rdo rje thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: yid kyi sgrib dag chos nyid bde ba che: dus gsum bstan pa'i bdag por lhun grub nas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: yon tan rdo rje gzi brjid dngos grub stsol: shes bya'i sgrib dag sangs rgyas thugs rje rdzogs: 'khor 'das lhun 'byams zad med gter mnga' ba: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru gu na a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐: phrin las rdo rje mthu stobs dngos grub stsol: rtog sgrib dag nas thabs shes dngos grub stsol: dgongs pas rgyas thebs gdul bya mthar phyin nas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hoḥ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor sngags bzlas dbang rnams blang*/ dngos grub rdzas la rings pa'i tshul gyis rol/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe ḍākki nī sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ sogs shabda pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen lhun grub bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: bstod par 'os p bcu gnyis pa bzod gsol ni/ oṃ: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin zhal phye nas: sgrub rdzas mchod pa gzhung bzhin bshams lags na: bla ma rtsa gsum thugs dang ci 'gal ba:

ye shes spyan ldan rnams la bzod par gsol: sgom pa yun thung yi dam lha ma gsal: bsnyen sgrub ma them dngos grub mthu ma brnyes: sri zhu dad chung bla ma mched la brnyas: tshogs dang phud nyams mkha' 'gro'i thugs dang 'gal: dam rdzas ma tshang srung ma'i thugs dang 'gal: le lo snyoms las gnyid chags rmongs pa yis: bskang lhag ma lcogs cho ga chad lhag dang : 'gal 'khrul nyams chag nongs pa ci mchis pa: gzhi med rtsa bral ngang du mthol lo bshags: ye bsrungs chos nyid klong du bzod par gsol: bdag la bsrung mtshams bral ba'i dbyings gnas su: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: dbyangs gsal dang yig brgya bzla'o/ bcu gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ mi dmigs ka dag ngo bo dbyings rig gi: kun gsal rol pa'i cho 'phrul zhi khro'i lha: lhan skyes ye shes gnyug ma'i sbubs su bsdu: bde gsal mi rtog gnas lugs ngo bor āḥ a a āḥ bcu bzhi pa dge ba bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ gdod nas lhun grub chos dbyings ngo bo yang : de don ma rtogs rmongs khyu'i sems can rigs: a 'thas zhen pa'i 'gog lam gsal bya'i phyir: kun rig don gnyis rtogs phyir dge tshogs bsngo: bco lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ bla med bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dal bzung nas: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: ma 'ongs 'di nas rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing : pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su mngon par shog: bcu drug pa bkra shis ni/ oṃ: chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: gnas lugs rgyal sa 'dzin pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis drug pa rdo rje 'chang : thugs rje phyogs bcur khyab pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin padma 'byung : 'gro kun smin grol 'god pa'i bkra shis shog: snyan brgyud bkra shis mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: zab rgya mkha' ltar brtan pa'i bkra shis shog: smon lam bkra shis buddha dzñā na ba:

lung bstan dus las mi 'da' bkra shis shog: gter gnas bkra shis mchims phu'i ke'u tshang du: byin chags yun ring brtan pa'i bkra shis shog: zab chos bkra shis zil gnon rig 'dzin 'dus: mkha' ltar mtha' yas kun khyab bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis sngags bdag ral gcig ma: phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i bkra shis shog: nyin yang bkra shis mtshan yang bkra shis shog: nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis bde legs shog: ces dang bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i bkra shis bcas gzhung bzhin bya'o/ de ltar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs bskyed rdzogs lam 'khyer gyis rnal 'byor bklag chog tu bkod pa ye shes sprin gyi phung po zhes pa 'di yang rang nyid rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa rnams kyis tshes bcu'i dus mchod kyi slad du gter gzhung las rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rgyas pa dkyil 'khor bcu gsum gyi dgongs pa ji bzhin gtan la phab ste/ bder 'dus rtsa ba'i phrin las ni/ 'bring po dkyil 'khor lnga pa'i las byang nas kyang mi 'gal bar brgyan te/ dbus 'gyur sa yi thig le khams gsum bde ldan dpal 'khyil du skyid grong smyon pas bkod pa dge bar gyur cig /de ltar thugs sgrub bsam lhun chog khrigs rig 'dzin chen po thugs mchog rdo rje'i mdzad par bsnyen sgrub skabs gzhung dang man ngag gis dgongs pa ltar bya'o zhes gzhan du zhal 'phang par mdzad la/ dzap dgongs bla ma gsang 'dus las bzhag par mdzad 'dug pa dang gzhung 'di gtso bo gsol 'debs ltar du sgrub pa yin pa sogs rgyu mtshan dang sbrel na bla ma gsang 'dus kyis bsnyen sgrub las kyi dgongs pa dang ches 'byor bas na/ 'dir yang gsang 'dus bsnyen sgrub kyi dgongs pa bzhin kha 'gengs zhus pa po ni gu hya'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// // bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bsam lhun dril sgrub gsol 'debs dngos grub snying po bzhugs so//

e ma ho/ gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku 'od ma'i 'gyur/ /longs spyod yongs rdzogs rgyal sras snying rje'i gter/ /gang 'dul der ston sprul sku padma 'byung*/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa bar bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'byung lnga rnam dag o rgyan bde chen rgyal/ /'khrul snang rang grol o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen/ /'byung ba'i 'jigs skyob o rgyan dpa' bo gyad/ /dbyings rig mnyam sbyor rdo rje rnal 'byor lha/ /dug lnga rang grol lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dbul phongs gdung sel o rgyan nor gyi lha/ /dug lnga'i nad 'joms o rgyan sman lha dang*/ /pha rol bdud rgol 'joms mdzad rdo rje'i gur/ /bdud bzhi mthar byed o rgyan phyag rgya gyad/ /phrin las thogs med lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /hor sog g.yul bzlog dregs pa zil gnon rtsal/ /lam 'phrang 'jigs skyob gu ru nyi ma 'od/ /zab gter sgo 'byed o rgyan yi dam lha/ /bar chad sgrol mdzad dpa' bo ging la sogs/ /gang 'dul der ston lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sku lnga mtshan brgyad rnam 'phrul bcu gsum sogs/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor zhi dang khro bo'i sprin/ /sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bdag nyid can/ /gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas skabs 'gal rkyen bar chad dbyings su zhi/ /don gnyis 'bad med bsam don chos bzhin grub/ /mthar thug rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing khams su/ /rang rig pad 'byung dbyer med sangs rgyas shog /ces pa'ang nyer mkho'i ched du rang slob au ḍī'i mtshan can gyis bskul ngor gnam lcags bstan 'dzin pas sbyar ba'o// // bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bsam lhun dril sgrub snying po'i bcud bsdus zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru dhe ba ḍākki nī ye/ gu ru'i thugs sgrub rgya mtsho'i bcud phul rmad/ /bde gshegs gcig la dkyil 'khor kun 'dus pa/ /rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos sde bsam lhun ma'i/ /dkyil 'khor dril sgrub snying bsdus 'dir gsal bya/ de'ang thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi man ngag sgrub thabs bcu gsum dang bcas phyogs bsdus/ spyi dril gsol 'debs ye shes sprin phung bsnyen sgrub dang sgrub chen sogs nyams len la 'jug pa'i skabs rgyas par mi lcogs na/ thun bzhi dang spros med kyi skabs don bsdus nas nyams su lain par 'dod pa la/ thog mar sbyor ba'i chos spyi mthun ltar byas la/ dang po sngon 'gro la skyabs sems ni/ skyabs yul gsal gdab la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur/ na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed du: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad gus drag po yis: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje'i ye shes bskul: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o: lan gsum/ gnyis pa tshogs gsog pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ dkar gtor spyi mthun/ gsum pa bgegs gtor ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba bhū ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ sa bkug / sarba bighnān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ ghṛhna daṃ ba liṃ dya swā hā/

hrīḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa'i bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad gu gul bdug rol mo 'tsham rngam bya'o/ bzhi pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: sku las sprul pa'i khro bos nam mkha' gang : gsung las sprul pa'i khro mos sa gzhi gang : thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog bar snang gang : gnyis med sprul pas 'khor yug khyon kun khengs: phyi nang bar med ye shes me dpung 'khrigs: glags lta'i bdud bgegs dam sri tshar chod cig: badzra rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā: lnga pa byin 'bebs ni/ hūm̐: 'og min bkod pa rab rdzogs lhun grub zhing : lnga ldan zang thal 'gyu ba'i pho brang nas: rigs 'dus rgyal ba rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: 'du 'bral med par thugs rje'i shugs mtshon nas: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: mchog thun 'bad med lhug par deng stsol shog: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ mthar me tog bkram brdung dang bcas byin chen dbab/ drug pa mchod pa byin rlob ni/

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: phyi mchod bcu drug nang mchod sman raka gtor: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med bde ba'i rgyun: zag med ye shes chen po'i dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta bha lingta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā su kha dharma dhā tu āḥhūm̐: zhes rim bzhin sbyang ngo*/ sngon 'gro spyi'-i rim pa'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: dang po ci yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid du: brtse ba'i snying rje chen por shar: de las 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying por gsal: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ e ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: oṃ bhrūm̐ dzñā na maṇḍal tsakra hūm̐: gnyis pa gzhal yas khang dang lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'og min lhun grub rin chen gzhal med khang*/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nang rgyan kun rdzogs/ /dur khrod rdo rwa me ri srung gur brjid/ /pho brang lte bar rin chen zur brgyad dang*/ /rigs lnga'i khri 'phangs padma nyi zla'i steng : dbus su hūm̐ las ma hā gu ru rje: snang srid zil gnon dmar smug khro 'dzum sgeg: 'dab ldan dar gyi snyan zhu gsang gos dkar: dar dmar chos gos mthing nag phod chen gsol: smug nag ber phyam snyan rgyan mgul rgyan mdzes: rdo rje bhandha tshe bum kha ṭwāṃ brten: zhabs gnyis swag lham rgyal po rol pa'i stabs: 'gying bag brjid ldan gzi 'od phyogs bcur khyab: dbu gtsug kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab sogs/ /dgongs brda snyan brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma rnams/ /snang stong sku yi phyag rgya 'od stong 'bar/ /o rgyan snang mtha' bde gshegs rigs lnga sogs/ /dbus phyogs chos sku'i tshom bu 'ja' tshon bkra/ /de yi phyi rim phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhir/

/gnas pa'i padma nyi zla'i lte ba ru/ /'byung lnga dag pa o rgyan bde chen rgyal/ /tshogs drug lhug bzhag o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen/ /'chi 'pho 'jigs skrag rang grol dpa' bo gyad/ /mkha' spyod zab lam ston mdzad rnal 'byor ma/ /rang rang cha lugs rigs kyi tshom bu rdzogs/ /de yi phyi rim 'ja' zer mu khyud kyis/ /gtams pa'i 'dab brgyad 'od lnga'i drwa ba mdzes/ /phyogs bzhir dug lnga'i nad sel sman gyi lha/ /dbul phongs gdung sel o rgyan nor lha dang*/ /pha rol rgol 'joms gtum chen rdo rje'i gur/ /hor sog dmag bzlog phung byed bdud dgra gzhaum/ /shar lhor dregs pa zil gnon thod phreng rtsal/ /lho nub zab gter sgo 'byed yi dam lha/ /nub byang sbas gnas sgo 'byed nyi ma 'od/ /byang shar dregs pa zil gnon he ru kaḥ /rang rang phyag mtshan rigs kyi tshom bu bcas/ /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs mkha' la 'ja' ltar gsal/ /phyogs mtshams nam mkhar sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha: dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs tshom bur 'khrigs: rin chen zur brgyad padma nyi zla'i steng : sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad las bzhi'i gar: /mtshams brgyad ma mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro sogs/ /rigs kyi ḍākki 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas: gru chad bar khyams khor yug gnas yul gyi: dpa' bo ḍākki ging chen sgo skyong sde: bar snang lha klu gnod sbyin mi'i rig 'dzin: rgya bod mkhas grub bka' brgyud bla ma rnams: thugs rje'i sprin gtibs byin rlabs char rgyun 'bebs: 'dod snam mchod sprin lha mos gar stabs bsgyur: nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang ba yi: /phyi 'khor dbang phyug ging lang 'bar ma dang*/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bka' dang bstan skyong sogs/ /'khor 'das dbyer med dkyil 'khor gcig gi ngang*/ /nyi ma dang ni 'od zer ji bzhin du/ /snang la rang bzhin ma grub gsal bar bsgom/ /de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis:

'og min zhing dang rnga yab dpal ri nas: pad 'byung rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams: gsang ba'i pho brang gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ gsum pa spyan drangs shing byin dbab pa ni/ dri bzang gi spos gtong zhing rol mo gling bu'i dbyangs snyan dang bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐: bzhi pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: dbyings la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang : nyi zla padma'i gdan gyi steng : gu ru bka' 'dus lha tshogs rnams: 'gro ba'i don la dgongs te bzhugs: bdag cag sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyis: phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi: gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: om̐ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos dang : mar me dri chab zhal zas sogs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'bul: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dang : dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog sogs: sbyor sgrol gsang ba kho na nyid: tshogs mchod dza gad chang la sogs: gzhan yang spyan gzigs du mar bcas: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha la 'bul: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ha ri ni sa badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pū dza hoḥ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pū dza hoḥ

sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta gu hya sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na king ni ri ti bha lingta pū dza hoḥ.āḥ drug pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen lhun grub bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chu bo bzhi rdzogs bde chen 'dus pa'i sku: sku gcig sku lnga mtshan brgyad bye ba brgyad: rnam 'phrul bcu gnyis 'khor lo'i sprin bkod cing*/ /rlabs chen gdul bya skyong la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: theg pa 'dzin 'chang rig 'dzin bla ma dang : sgrub pa bka' brgyad zhi khro yi dam lha: gnas yul zhing skyong dpa' bo ḍākki'i tshogs: chos dbyings ye shes rol pa chen po'i lha: shes rab dbyings las thugs rje thabs kyi skur: rtsol med rang shar phyogs bcu'i zhing kun gyi: rgyal ba rab 'byams dkyil 'khor ma lus rdzogs: gnyis med rang snang gsal stong ye shes lha: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dgu pa dzapa ྄la dang po gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub tshar gcig dang*/ dzapa ྄bskul ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshogs: ye shes dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud bskul la: 'gro ba'i don phyir phrin las gter chen gyi: dgongs pa klong yangs byin rlabs shugs 'byung bas: sgrub la smin grol gdams pa zab mo mchog: 'bad med myur ba nyid la stsal du gsol: bsnyen dmigs gsal gdab pa ni / thugs kar don gyi ye shes sems/ /rig stong rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang*/ kha sbyor bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs/ /mi shigs thig ler hūm̐ gi mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od zer spro bsdu yis/ /don gnyis phrin las lhun gyis grub/ /rig stong ka dag ngang du blta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: zhes bsnyen pa dang*/

sgrub pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ las sbyor ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsitta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams lan gsum gsum bzla zhing stong tshig phul/ ༈ de nas tshogs 'bul bar spro na/ rang lugs gsol ka rnams grub nas/ na raka bshags pa'am bsdu na brjod med don bshags la sman raka gtor ma'i skong bsdus tsam sbyar ba dang*/ rang lugs rig 'dzin srog sgrub gtor bsngo'i byin rlabs nas spyan 'dren bar sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ dang po tshogs sbyang spel ba ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum gyis sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo? lan gsum gyis spel/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ lhun grub rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho nas/ /bla ma bder 'dus sku gsum lha tshogs rnams/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /rnga yab padma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /mtshan brgyad rnam 'phrul bcu gsum 'khor tshogs bcas/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /sna tshogs gang 'dul der ston pho brang nas/ /o rgyan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /gnas 'dir gshegs la dbang bskur byin chen phob/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ gu ru de wa ḍākki nī badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos skyong nor gyi bdag: gter bdag gnyan po skyong la sogs: rig 'dzin bder 'dus dkyil 'khor la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: phyi snod srid gsum yangs pa sogs 'phro skyong zhing*/ bzhi pa skong ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod mdzes pa'i lha mo sna tshogs dang :

nang mchod sha lnga bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: gsang mchod bde stong chags med ye shes rdzas: sman gtor rakta sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: spyan gzigs dkor cha yid 'ong mnyes pa'i rten: rol mo sgra snyan gdangs dbyangs dgyes pa'i glu: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'dis: bla ma rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshogs: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing bar chad sel gyur nas: mchog thun 'bad med lhun grub stsal du gsol: lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag dkyil 'khor zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas: bag med dbang gyur dam 'gal ci mchis pa: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: yig brgya bzla/ drug pa bsgral bstab ni/ dgra bgegs nṛ tri sha truṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ hūm̐: shes bya lta ba gyad kyi phur pa yis: nga bdag srid pa'i ru tra bsgral gtubs nas: sha khrag klad rus phung por spungs pa 'di: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta la khā raṃ khā hi: zhes bsgral zhing bstab bo/ tshogs la rol/ bdun pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: bka' yi las byed phra men 'khor bcas kyis: 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: rgyud srung sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs mi g.yel zhing : rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta khā hi/ brgyad pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig rgyal ba thugs dam can: rtsa gsum bder 'dus lha tshogs mthu ma chung : sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na: mthu chen khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: bar chod rtsom pa'i log 'dren rdul du rlog:

oṃ gu ru dhai wa ḍākki nī sa ma ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: dgu pa tha tshig bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa la: bka' 'dus snying po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i spyan snga ru: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : bstan srung phrin las bsgrub pa khas blangs bzhin: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub mchog stsol bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: oṃ sarba dharma pā la i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: bcu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i bka' nyan pa: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: so so'i bran g.yog yang g.yog 'khor bcas kyis: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mel tshe mdzod: oṃ ma ma hring hring bha lingta kha kha khā hi: bcu gcig rta bro ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du: rtsa gsum 'dus pas bro brdungs pas: rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgyun lam chod: ye shes lnga ru lhun gyis grub: de ltar brda dang rten 'brel gyi: sna tshogs las kun lhun grub shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: satwaṃ bha ya nan: bcu gnyis pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs ngo bo lhun grub ka dag la: bder 'dus rig 'dzin rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe chos zas nor gos dang snyan grags stobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus rnams: skad cig nyid la deng 'dir thob gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na sarba siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes dbang blangs/ gsum pa rjes chog la drug /dang po mchod bstod ni/ oṃ gu ru dāe wa ḍākki nī sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ sogs/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos sku'i rang bzhin mtha' bral ye shes klong :

longs sku'i mtshan nyid sna tshogs 'dzin bral la: sprul sku ji snyed 'gro ba'i mgon mchog che: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha la bstod par bgyi: gnyis pa nongs bshags ni/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying brtan bzhugs bya/ gsum pa bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ badzra kā wa tsi rakṣa haṃ/ bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas lhun grub chos dbyings ngo bo yang : de don ma rtogs rmongs khyu'i sems can rigs: a 'thas zhan pa'i 'gog lam bsal bya'i phyir: kun rig don gnyis rtogs phyir dge tshogs bsngo: lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ bla med bder 'dus rgyal ba'i dal bzung nas: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: ma 'ongs 'di nas rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing : pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'tshogs par shog: drug pa bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: rje btsun padma badzra zhes: bde chen yum mchog manda ra: pad 'byung yab yum bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis dang bsngo smon rgyas bsdus ci rigs brjod par bya'o/ de ltar thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus man ngag sgrub thabs bcu gsum dang bcas phyogs bsdus/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rjes phyogs bsgrigs spyi dril gsol 'debs bsam lhun ma rgyas pa sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral bar bzhugs kyang*/ 'di nyid rgyas drag pas spros med bsnyen sgrub thun bzhi sogs la sbyar ba'i skabs su mi bde zhing*/ rtsa ba gcig dril ni cung bsdus che bas bsam lhun dkyil 'khor bcu gsum chig dril nyams len la sbyar dka' bar ma zad/ skabs 'gar dus mchod dang rgyun bkol ngag 'don tshogs 'bum bsags pa bcas rang gzhan dgos mkhor gal che bar sems te/ gter gzhung dgongs pa gzhir bzhag cing kha 'gengs dgos pa rnams kyang rang gzhung las blangs te/ 'phri snon cung zad bcas bal yul yang le shod gnam lcags sgom sder/

rab byung 17pa'i me khyi'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 15nyin gnam lcags pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis/ 'phral mar bris pas nor ba mchis na rtsa gsum lhar 'chags shing dge bas rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //

bla ma padma khrag 'thung las: phrin las bzhi sgrub kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so: rje btsun thod phreng rigs 'dus lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang zab mo gsang ba ye shes kyi rgyud nas legs par 'byung ba'i bla ma phrin las lnga ltar sgrub pa la sngon du 'gro ba'i skyabs yul theg pa rin po che nyer len bgyid pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor spros bcas dang spros med go rim ci ltar 'dug kyang dgos pa'i cha lag khrigs bsdebs su brgyud rim brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'bad pa ni: thog mar rnam snang chos dang ldan zhing phan sems bla med dam pa'i dge bas rab tu bskul zhing dam bca'i gzer gsum 'chug med du gnas pa'i ngang la 'di ltar gdab pa'o: na mo: mdun gyi nam mkhar chos dbyings skye med ngang : ma bcos stong nyid e yi 'phro 'du las: rang byung lhun grub 'od kyi gzhal yas khang : phyi nang gzhal 'das bkod pa rab rgyas pa'i: 'ja' tshon dpung bzhin khyon kyang yangs pa'i dbus: dri med gdod ma'i mtsho dkyil pad sdong rtser: chags med skyon bral 'od skur sprul pa'i lha: rje btsun chen po padma thod phreng rtsal: dkar dmar mdangs ldan dri med gzi 'bar ba: mtshan dpe'i sku la rgyan kun rab rdzogs pa'i: phyag mtshan la sogs cha shas ma nyams par: dpa' la rab tu bzhad cing bzhugs pa yi: 'khor yug rab tu bskor ba'i skyabs yul lha: skar 'tshogs grangs bzhin chu zla'i snang ngor ltar: ma 'dres gsal bzhin gsol ba 'di ltar du: sku gsum bla ma bsgrub par dam bca'o: e ma hoḥ ka dag bde ba chen po'i klong yangs nas: chos sku 'od mi 'gyur la gsol ba 'debs: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma 'gags ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang nas: longs sku spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs: cir snang sgyu ma rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: rnga yab padma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: sprul sku o rgyan rje la gsol ba 'debs:

skye 'chi 'khrul 'dzin zhig par byin gyis rlobs: zab lam bde chen gsang ba'i pho brang nas: dbyings phyug manda ra bar gsol ba 'debs: snyan brgyud klong du grol bar byin gyis rlobs: shes rab ye shes mchog gi pho brang nas: mtsho rgyal rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs: brda bzhi mngon du grol bar byin gyis rlobs: sku gsum don ston brgyud pa'i pho brang nas: 'phags mchog rigs gsum mgon por gsol ba 'debs: tshig don rgyud la 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen dbang drag 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: dmar nag me phreng sku la gsol ba 'debs: bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad 'dul bar byin gyis rlobs: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub pho brang nas: drag po rigs bzhi'i lha la gsol ba 'debs: las bzhi lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sprul pa rnam bzhi 'gyed pa'i pho brang nas: phrin las der ston lha la gsol ba 'debs: dus min 'chi ba 'joms par byin gyis rlobs: gzhan yang pho brang gnas yul ma lus nas: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la gsol ba 'debs: mchog thun 'bras bu 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: rje btsun chen po o rgyan rin po che: zol med bdag gis re ltos nyid las med: sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dam pas thugs rjes zungs: byin gyis rlobs shig gsol ba snying nas 'debs: sku yi dbang bskur bskyed rim lha yi sku: sprul sku'i 'gro don nus par byin gyis rlobs: gsung gi dbang bskur zung 'jug sngags kyi sgra: longs sku'i rang rtsal rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs: thugs kyi dbang bskur rdzogs rim ka nas dag: chos sku'i rgyal sa zin par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen ye shes dbang drag 'dus pa'i lha: 'di nas brtsams te zag med rdo rje'i sku: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor bsgrub par dam bca' nas: mi 'da' mi 'gyur bla med ye grol ngang : rang dbyings a ti'i rgyal sa zin gyur cig:

om̐ gu ru dzñā na padma dha ra sarba siddhi hrīḥ zhes gsol ba btab pas mdun gyi nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'od zer sku dang lug gu rgyud kyi rnam pas za 'og snal ma brgyud cing mthud pa lta bur 'ub kyis bsdus nas rang la thim pas rang lus ye shes chen po'i skur grol nas: lhan skyes kyi dga' ba nyams su myong zhing : bde gsal mi rtog pa'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur te: rang bzhin lhun grub rol pa'i ting 'dzin la gnas pa'i ngang la ci 'tshams su bzhag go: zhes pa'i gnad ni sku gsum bla ma'i rol rtsed: nyams len rgyun gyi thig le rang dbyings gcig tu rdzogs pa'i man ngag bla ma rtsa gsum gyi sngon 'gro 'khyer bde la rab tu nges so: sa ma ya: rang dbyings khyon las dpag par dka' ba'i dpyid: 'jo ldan ku mu da yi phreng ba spel: gzi 'bar brgyud pa'i lam bzang 'dren mchog bzhag: ma 'ongs las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas ma sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // bla drag po padma khrag 'thung las: gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar gyi las byang bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: gsang sgrub zab mo rdo rje me 'bar bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: drag po sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: dur khrod dam mam rang byung phug: shing gcig drung ngam dben pa'i gnas: bkra shis rgyud dang mthun pa'i yul: dmar smug sa la stegs bu bya: dkyil 'khor las rim gzhung bzhin gdab: yang na ras bris 'bru tshom steng : dbus su bhandha mtshan ldan nang :

drag po'i sman rdzas rnams kyang blugs: dar dmar kha bcad dar nag gdugs: bum pa cha tshang tsa ka li: sman gtor rakta phyi nang mchod: spyan gzigs la sogs tshang bar bshams: rang nyid drag po'i ting 'dzin ngang : dang po dkar gtor spyi mthun bsngo: de nas bgegs gtor bsang sbyangs bya: gsum pa rdzas mchod byin gyis brlab: 'byung ba rim brtsegs lha bskyed bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po skyabs 'gro ni: na mo: dbyings rig dbyer med rtsa ba gsum: ye nas mchog gsum sku gsum bdag: phyi nang mi dmigs zang thal sku: 'bad rtsol bral bar skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed ni: hoḥ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong : ma rtogs sems can rgyud drug rnams: rnam thar byang chub lam 'god phyir: blo 'das de bzhin sems bskyed do: de nas bgegs 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa yi: 'gugs pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed: sgrub la mi dbang log 'dren bgegs: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir mchis: oṃ badzra ṭakki rā dza ya: gnod byed 'byung po dza dzaḥ bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal khrag 'thung rol: 'byung po bka' las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma khyer la rang gnas dengs: 'tshe na drag sngags me char 'bebs: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya rbad bhyoḥ thums shig gtor myog rbad raṃ dzwa la ya phaṭḥ de nas srung 'khor ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las srung ba'i gur: rdo rje lcags sdig bya khyung 'phros: gri gug kha ṭwāṃ me ri'i gur: sra mkhregs pha lam rang bzhin gyur: oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa: tri pā paṃ tsakra rakṣa: khrom̐ ga ru ṭa tsakra rakṣa: ka ra ti ka tsakra rakṣa: tri shū la tsakra rakṣa: ram̐ dzwa la tsakra rakṣa: e swa bhā tsakra rakṣa: zhes srung 'khor drag po bsgom: mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod sna tshogs sprin chen g.yo: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dmar:

gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med rdzas: srub skyed rgya chen spel bar gyur: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha ling ta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ sarba a haṃ dzñā na pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs: sman raka phyar zhing dkrug: de nas bum pa dang sman rdzas rnams la: hūm̐: bum pa gzhal yas bdud rtsi lha: bhandha'i snod du rdzas sman gtams: phyi nang spyan gzigs sna tshogs rnams: bskyed spel mtshan ldan rab tu sbyangs: om̐ bhrūm̐ dhe wa bhai ṣa dzyai ye bhi shwa om̐ āḥhūm̐: byin 'bebs ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam ḍākki chos skyong rnams: mi mngon dag pa mkha' spyod klong nas bzhengs: sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor 'di la byin chen phob: dbang bzhi mchog thun stsol bar mdzad du gsol: oṃ ma hā gu ru ḍākki dzñā na sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ brda sgo brda phyag dam bca' ni: hūm̐: ma rig blang dor 'thib sgo bcad: rang rig lha zhal 'char sgo phyes: brda phyag 'tshal zhing mchod bshags bstod: ma 'grub bar du srog ltar bzung : om̐ bhrūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ badzra tsitta hūm̐: de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing brdal: āḥ zang thal ngang la rol rtsal rdzogs: om̐ kun rgyu sa bon phyag mtshan gyur: hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: de nas 'byung rim brtsegs shing gzhal yas khang dang lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: e las nam mkha' yam̐ rgya gram: ram̐ las me ri kham̐ rakta: sum̐ las sa gzhi keṃ ri rab: bhrūm̐ las rang byung bhandha'i mkhar: rmang gzhi rdo rje rgya gram nag: gru bzhi sgo bzhi sna lnga'i rtsig: lha klu sde brgyad gza' rgyu skar:

ka gdung gral lcam thog steng phub: dmar nag 'dod snam pha gu ser: drwa ba rus rgyan thod tshal 'phyangs: rlung gis sham bu lda ldi bskyod: mda' yab bhandha skam rlon spel: g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan tsitta'i tog: rta babs bya khyung seng 'brug ngar: chos 'khor hūm̐ sgra tog gis mdzes: phyi rol dur khrod rdo rwa mtshon: me ri khyung dang lcags sdig gur: srid pa'i rlung yang mi thar bsgom: nang du dmar nag rakta'i mtshor: mi rta bam ro lhu dum 'khril: dur khrod rgyan 'phyang du ma bres: dbus su zla gam dmar smug klong : chos 'byung mthing nag bam gyi steng : gnam lcags rdo rje hūm̐ sgra can: me ri tshwa tshwa si li li: dran rdzogs padma he ru kaḥ khro rgyal drag po thod phreng rtsal: dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar 'khrugs: khro gtum spyan rtsa glog ltar 'gyu: dbu rgyan bya khyung rigs lnga rdzogs: g.yas gsum gri gug rdo rje me: g.yon gsum thod khrag lcags sdig sbrul: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog brgyangs: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal chas brgyan: zhabs bzhi khro bo rol pa'i stabs: bya khyung mthing nag me gshog brdzis: gsang ba khro mo gri thod mthing : 'khyud cing yab yum me dpung klong : lha srin sde brgyad 'dul bar bskyed: hūm̐: phyi rol gnam lcags rtsibs brgyad steng : shar du sgrol ging mthing nag rngam: g.yas gsum spu gri chu gri me: g.yon gsum thod phreng snying dang sdig: dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu rdzogs: me yi bya khyung dmar nag zhon: hūm̐: lho ru gtum ging sngo nag khro: g.yas gsum tsitta me chu gri: g.yon gsum kha ṭwāṃ lcags sdig me: dur khrod dpal chas rab tu rdzogs: 'joms byed bya khyung kham nag zhon: hūm̐: nub tu khro ging dmar nag gtum: g.yas gsum ral gri gri gug thod: g.yon gsum 'khor lo spu gri sdig: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal dang ldan:

srog gzan bya khyung ser nag zhon: hūm̐: byang du las ging ljang nag 'bar: g.yas gsum 'khor lo rdo rje gri: g.yon gsum tri shul lcags sdig khyung : dur khrod chas ldan khro la brjid: gtor byed bya khyung ljang nag zhon: hūm̐: yum chen ging gi khro mo bzhi: rang mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: gri thod 'dzin cing mgul nas 'khyud: kun kyang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: 'jigs byed bskal pa'i me ri 'bar: dbu rgyan bya khyung rigs lnga rdzogs: thams cad gtso bo'i chas dang mthun: mtshams bzhir yab yum sprul pa'i khyung : dkar ser dmar ljang mthing la rngam: bswe mig zangs rwa lcags kyi mchu: me gshog rlabs kyis dpag tshad g.yo: dam sri 'dre rgod gnyen por bsgom: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi sgo yi las byed ma: shar du ma mo sdig pa'i gdong : lho ru ma mo chu srin gdong : nub tu ma mo phag gdong ma: byang du ma mo khyung gdong ma: bzhi ka gcer bu mi bzad pa: gos su mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: phyag na gri gug bhan dmar dkrugs: thams cad lcags sdig mgo dgu zhon: dus 'khrug lo nyes mu ge dang : nad rims dal yams 'joms par gsal: hūm̐: gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul tshogs: khyung dang lcags sdig phag rgod 'gyed: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: gsal snang chu zla'i klong ltar bsgom: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas khrag 'thung khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs spyan drangs par gyur: spyan 'dren pa ni: gri sha'am sha chen gang rung gis gsur btang zhing rol mo drag tu bya: hūm̐: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas: khrag 'thung khro rgyal yab yum dang : las kyi ma mo sprul khyung rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren myur du byon: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal bsen dam sri 'dre rgod dang : 'byung po sa bdag klu yi khrir:

gdug pa 'dul ba'i rngam stabs kyis: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: om̐ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: mi bzad skur ston khrag 'thung pa: 'jigs byed bla ma drag po yi: phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: brkyang bskum gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod gar dang spyan gzigs dang : nang mchod sman gtor rakta dang : gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta khā hi: om̐ ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta king ni ri ti kha kha khā hi: bdud rtsi lag mchod byed na skabs 'dir sbyar/ de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma drag po he ru kaḥ stobs 'dus padma khrag 'thung rgyal: sku mdog dmar nag srid gsum 'dul: zhal gsum khro zhing pho rgyud sngangs: spyan dgu sdang mig mo rgyud sdud: snyan nas 'brug sgra stong khams g.yo: shangs nas rlung dmar 'byung po gtor: khro bcu mche gtsigs dgra sha za: ljags dmar 'dre rgod snying khrag rngub: khyung gi dbu rgyan snang srid 'dul: sbrul bcings ral bsigs srid rtse 'gugs: phyag drug mtshon cha dgra la 'debs: sgro gshog bar snang me 'od 'khrugs: dur khrod chas brgyad dregs pa 'dul: dpal chas ma tshogs dbang du sdus: zhabs bzhi dor thabs stong gsum gnon: srid pa'i khyung brdzis rgyal 'gong bsgral: yum chen gsang ba khro mo mthing : zhal gdangs khro gtum ma rungs brgyal: gri gug skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod: bhan dmar 'byung po'i klad khrag rol: dur khrod chas ldan phar phyin rdzogs: yab 'khril sprul pa'i khro tshogs bskul: yab yum bskal pa'i me ri'i dbus: bzhugs shing tshwa tshwas stong khams khyab: dus ngan 'byung po 'dul byed pa: 'jigs byed khro rgyal yab yum sku:

snang srid 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: khro chen mi bzad 'jigs pa'i ging : las kyi dpa' bo chen po bzhi: zhal gsum gdangs shing rgyal 'gong 'dul: spyan dgu bgrad pas klu gnyan sngangs: dbu rgyan bya khyung sa bdag 'joms: sgro gshog nad rims dal yams gzhom: g.yas gsum mtshon char dgra la 'bebs: g.yon gsum mtshon gyis dam sri bkums: dpal chas dus 'khrug 'dre rgod 'dul: zhabs bzhi khyung brdzis klu srin 'joms: rang mdog khro mo rigs bzhi rngam: gri thod 'dzin cing dug lnga gzhom: yab 'khril rang 'dra'i khro chung 'gyed: sku la me lce ya la la: yab yum ging chen tshogs la bstod: hūm̐: sprul pa'i bya khyung ga ru ḍaḥ bswe mig tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: zangs rwa dmar po rngam la rno: me gshog stong khams 'u ru ru: lcags sder klu 'dzin khyugs se khyug: gnam lcags rkan dgra thags se thag: dam sri 'byung po'i snying khrag 'thung : sprul pa'i bya khyung bzhi la bstod: hūm̐: sdig pa chu srin phag dang khyung : gdong can sha za khro mo bzhi: zangs kyi gri gug lhabs se lhab: rakta'i khrag 'thung kyu ru ru: mi lpags g.yang gzhi shams se sham: gcer mo skra dmar sa la gzhol: lcags sdig 'dur ldang khyugs se khyug: me char tshwa tshwa spungs se spung : sprul pa'i bya khyung phag dang sdig: 'byung po'i srog len myu ru ru: dkyil 'khor phyi nang gsang ba'i lhar: sgo gsum 'dun pas rab tu bstod: thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i mtha': nad mtshon 'byung po 'dre rgod dang : dam sri rgyal 'gong kha dar bas: khro rgyal mngon spyod dus la bab: phyi yi dgra 'dre 'byung po thul: nang gi dug lnga'i bar chad sol: gsang ba'i skag rkyen dgra la phob: nad mtshon dal yams rtsad nas chod: las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang nyid che mchog padma drag po gsal ba'i thugs kar gser gyi mchod rten gyi dbus bum pa'i gzhal yas su padma nyi zla'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' phyag rdor mthing nag /rdo rje sdigs mdzub can/ de yi thugs kar dmar ser thig le'i steng du ting 'dzin sems dpa' snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs kar hūm̐ gi mthar rtsa ba'i sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor bar dmigs la sngags bzla bar bya'o/ slar yang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ zhing khams rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba sras bcas mchod byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur 'dus gzi brjid lhag par rgyas shing ma dag pa'i khams rnams su cig car du khyab/ khams gsum gyi dregs byed ma lus dbang du bsdus shing log rtog rnams zil gyis mnan/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can tshar bcad/ 'gro ba'i las sgrib mtha' dag bcom nas yi dam lha yi go 'phang la bkod/ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos nyid kyi rol par sad par bsams la bzlas pa bya'o/ yang lha tshogs thams cad kyis zhal dang sngags las kyang rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba'am gnam lcags kyi thog rgod drag tu lhung ba ltar srid gsum thams cad yom yom shig shig tu 'gul zhing ldeg pa dang*/ 'od zer dmar nag 'bar zhing rab tu 'khrugs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig tu gnas par byas la bzla bar bya'o/ zhes pa'ang gnam lcags gu hya'i ming gis 'phral mkho la dmigs te bris pa'o// // dang po rtsa sngags ni: om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa padma he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ las sngags ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ.āḥhūm̐: ging bzhi'i sngags ni: om̐ badzra tsakra kro ta tsaṇḍa ghṛ wa tsa tur kro ti shwa ri hūm̐ bhyoḥ khyung lnga yi sngags ni: om̐ khrom̐ ga ru ṭa pañtsa hūm̐ phaṭ: khro mo sha za bzhi la: om̐ ma mo mu khā le kro ti tsa tur baṃ ru lu ru lu bhyoḥ phag sdig khyung la: om̐ wā ra hī pa paṃ khroṃ ṭa ya bhyoḥ

zhes rtsa sngags las sngags sham bu sngags rgod ni: nyi ma bdun phrag rim bzhin bzlas: rgyal bsen ar gtad sham bu ni: om̐ she la du ging rā dza nan tsitta thum bhyoḥ srin mo la: om̐ raksha kā li ya ma nan: tsitta shag 'gas hu lu bhyo bhyoḥ 'dre rgod 'byung po la: om̐ a mu ka bhū ta mā ra ya dzi ni rbad bhyoḥ dam sri la: om̐ ya ma ye ru ṭa mā ra ya nan bhyoḥ gdon spyi la: om̐ trag thur shag rbad duntsa mā ra ya a mu ka tri sha rbad bhyoḥ trag thum: zhes bzlas 'go nad srung na nad 'joms par bu'i sngags bzla zhing sgrub pa 'dis byas kyang rung : yang sngags so sor kha bsgyur sham bu gang dgos bya: gzhung la rtsa sngags dang las sngags sgrub pas chog: sngags so so'i bzlas pa bya zhing rdzas kyi ril bus srung ba byas na thub nges so: dmigs pa gang 'os sngags dang bstun: hūm̐ sgrub ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: snang srid thams cad drag po e yi klong : snod bcud gzugs snang yi dam lha yi sku: 'byin 'jug rlung rnams rang bzhin snying po'i sngags: khams kyi rang mdangs khro bo rol pa'i rtsal: gnas lugs ma bcos skye med yi ge hūm̐: rang rig ngo bo che mchog drag po rtsal: padma khrag 'thung gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: bla ma rdo rje thod phreng sku mdog mthing : zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing drag tu khros: rdo rje gri gug ral gri g.yas su thogs: bhan dmar thong shol lcags sdig g.yon na bsnams: rdo rje sgro gdeng dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs: rdo rje phag mo zangs mdog gri thod 'dzin: brkyang bskum ye shes gar gyis pang du 'khyud: 'bar ba'i zer ldan me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'jigs byed drag po'i sku yi char:

spyi bor snang mtha' rigs kyi bdag: steng du sprul pa'i bya khyung rngam: dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje 'jigs: mgrin par dbang chen rta mgrin gshe: thugs kar phyag na rdo rje gtum: lte bar rdo rje gzhon nu 'bar: gsang bar yaksha khro bo brjid: phyag g.yas badzra kī la ya: phyag g.yon ratna kī la ya: zhabs g.yas padma kī la ya: zhabs g.yon karma kī la ya: gsang ba yum gyi gnas lnga ru: bde chen mkha' 'gro sde bzhis gar: gzhon nu rgyan rdzogs cha lugs 'chang : drag po yab yum phyogs bzhi ru: 'jigs byed ging chen yab yum bzhi: sgrol ging gtum ging khro ging dang : las ging bcas pa yab yum brgyad: mtshams su sprul pa yang sprul bcas: gzhan yang sgo skyong la sogs pa: dbang drag rdo rje srin po yi: sku gsung thugs kyi gzi brjid rnams: stobs bcu 'gyed phyir sprul pa'i lha: srid gsum mngon spyod las kyis sdud: stong gsum sde brgyad dam la btags: gling khams kun la 'gran zla bral: sku las khro chung tshwa tshwa 'phro: me ri'i 'bar mched wa la la: 'byung po mi dang mi min sogs: bgegs dang dam sri ma lus kun: drag po'i stobs kyis tshar bcad gyur: rang bzhin hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes sgra sgrogs shing snang srid thams cad res 'ga' khro bo khro mo res 'ga' hūm̐ kha dog lnga ldan snang srid kyi khyon thams cad khengs par bsgom/ skabs su rang bzhin 'ub kyis bdag la bsdu ba mi dmigs gsal stong ka dag ngang la bsgom: spyi 'gror: rang nyid khro rgyal padma khrag 'thung gi thugs ka nas: me yi bya khyung dug gi phag rgod lcags kyi sdig pa rdo rje'i ser ba rnams snod bcud khengs par 'phros pas rgyal 'gong dam sri 'byung po gnod byed ma rungs pa klu dang sa bdag rnams gzhob kyis bsregs hab hab ljib ljib tu zos nas lhag ma med par

bsams: tshur 'dus pas srung ba'i gur du gyur nas bskal pa'i rlung yang bgrod mi nus par bsgom: de ltar rang nyid thun mtshams rdzogs par bsgrub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas tshogs bya ba ni: chu gtsang gi bran zhing : hūm̐: gdod nas chos dbyings ngo bo nyid: rang byung snying po'i 'od zer gyis: rgyu 'byung yi ge sbyong byed 'phros: gtsang btsog bzang ngan ka nas dag: om̐ dharma ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ shuddhe hoḥ hūm̐: bdag nyid khro bo'i thugs ka nas: byin rlabs yi ge 'bru gsum 'phros: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis sbyangs spel bsgyur: tshogs rdzas nam mkha' mdzod du gyur: om̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥ de nas tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni: rol mo dbyangs dang bcas nas: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: rje btsun thod phreng yab yum la: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas: drag po khrag 'thung yab yum la: ging dang khro mo sha zas bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bka' dang dam tshig pho brang nas: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho la: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs thibs se thib: khro bo'i lha tshogs ya la la: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: dur khrod pho brang tshogs khang la: gshegs shing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: mos pa'i skal ldan smin par mdzod: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: che mchog dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod: skye med chos dbyings ngang du bzhes: deng 'dir mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha khā hi: bar pa bskang ba ni: hūm̐: phyi nang spyan gzigs sna tshogs mchod sprin 'dis: bla ma thod phreng yab yum dang :

drag po'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bshags pa ni: hūm̐: ma rig rmongs pa'i 'khrul gzugs bdag: grangs med bsags pa'i sdig sgrib tshogs: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: om̐ badzra sa twa hūm̐: tha ma bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden pa'i mthus: gnod byed 'byung po glags lta'i rigs: myur du tha ma'i ling gar khug: pho nyas bzung zhing byad du chugs: om̐ badzra aṃ ku sha ya ru tra mā ra ya dza dza nan: phur bu thogs nas: hūm̐: khrag 'thung thugs las sprul pa'i sras: las mdzad badzra kī la ya: nam mkha'i mthongs nas thog babs ltar: ru tra'i snying la kī la ya: om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bhighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ru tra trag raksha mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: khrag 'thung lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: dam nyams ru tra bsgral ba yi: dug lnga'i sha khrag mchod pa 'bul: skye med ngang du dgyes par rol: lhag med ye shes dbyings su hoḥ de nas tshogs la rol ba ni: hoḥ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos sogs/ lhag ma ni: hoḥ dpal gyi pho nya bye ba 'bum: gnas nyul dur khrod tshogs khang 'grim: gsang sngags grogs kyi mel tshe ma: lhag ma bzhes la phrin las mdzod: om̐ bhakṣa li si ta ma hā bha lingta khā hi: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams: mi mngon chos dbyings klong nas bzhengs: drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: rig 'dzin bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: dam las 'gal ba'i dgra bgegs la: bka' yi chad pa drag po phob: dmag 'khrug zhi ba'i dus la bab: mtshon bskal nyams pa'i dus la bab: nad yams bzlog pa'i dus la bab: rgyal bsen 'dul ba'i dus la bab: klu srin 'joms pa'i dus la bab: 'dre rgod bsgral ba'i dus la bab: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'tshe: thad nas langs pa'i dgra bgegs 'di: myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod:

om̐ he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ bhyo bhyo 'byung po gnod byed thams cad zlog zlog: gtor zor 'phen na zor thogs te: hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: de ring dam nyams dgra la 'phen: lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpung bskyed: nyams pa'i dgra bo cham la phob: gtor zor dbal kha sha ra ra: drag sngags tshwa tshwa si li li: pho nyas srog len khyugs se khyug: nam gyi phar ma tshur phyed la: dgra srog dmar po chod la shog: zor sna las byed shan pas drongs: dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: om̐ ya ma du na du bhyoḥ thun tsa thun tsa bhyoḥ rbad du shag du bhyoḥ trig thum gzer thum bhyoḥ mā ra ya bhyoḥ zhes gtor ma me dpung ngam mtshon char bsgyur la dgra bo'i phyogs su 'phang : de nas chad mdo ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe me ri 'bar ba ru: bla ma thod phreng drag po dang : mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes gnyis: rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor phyes: steng 'og lha srin khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: de 'og ti sgro'i tshogs khang du: rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas dang : mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis: khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ma sring gnas nyul khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: o rgyan gter bdag gling pa yis: ti sgro'i tshogs khang chen mo nas: gsang rgya zab gter bton pa'i tshe: las kyi ma mos khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: yang gsang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di: phyogs bcur spel ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ kro ta kro ti ḍā ka ḍākki ma mo ru lu bhyoḥ i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan ldan sil snyan sgra: brda gar glu dbyangs khyugs se khyug: mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le ma hā bha lingta khā hi:

de nas gtor gzhong 'og tu dam sri bkug: rta bro ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: stong gsum chem chem khro bo'i bro: mnan mnan ma sring mkha' 'gro'i bro: nam yang ma ldang las kyi bro: sgab 'dre dam sri 'dul zhing shig: om̐ nan ā nan hūm̐ nan mā ra ya nan: zhes rta bro bya: de nas gtor snod kha yar bzed la me tog 'thor: dngos grub len pa ni: hūm̐: zab dbyings bla med gsang ba'i mchog: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyis: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i skal ldan la: mi 'gyur sku yi dbang bzhi stsol: 'gags med gsung gi dbang bzhi stsol: spros bral thugs kyi dbang bzhi stsol: phrin las bzhi ldan dbang bzhi stsol: 'chi med tshe dang mi zad nor: snyan grags mnga' thang chos dang srid: phun tshogs 'dod rgu deng 'dir stsol: om̐ dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirmā kā ya: swa bhā kā ya wākka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes dbang bzhi blangs shing dngos grub rol: dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: gsang 'dus rang byung dpal chen pho brang lha: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas 'khor bsdu yum la bsdu: yum yab hūm̐ thim hūm̐ yang mi dmigs klong : ka dag rang byung rang shar klong du hoḥ a āḥ zhes mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bsdu: rjes bsngo ba ni: hoḥ dmigs med rgya yan chos nyid rgyu yi bsngo: rang shar rol rtsal ma 'gags lam gyi bsngo: sna tshogs spros bral ka dag 'bras bu'i bsngo: kun gzhi skye med 'khor 'das gzhi gcig bsngo: de nas smon lam bya ba ni: hoḥ bdag blo ye nas dbyings rig sgrib pa bral: gnyis 'dzin ma rig 'khrul pa'i rmongs gzugs rnams: dran rtog chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: tshe rabs pad 'byung yab yum 'bral med shog: bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: ka dag lhun grub rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis 'chi med tshe yi lha: gnas lugs rang rtsal mngon pa'i bkra shis shog:

sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin padma 'byung : tshe rabs gtan gyi bla mar bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i bkra shis mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang : gsang rgyud gdams pas rgyud smin bkra shis shog: sa ma ya: e ma kho bo bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i snyan brgyud zab rgya can: yang gsang sgrub pa rdo rje me 'bar bzhag: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: chos pa rnams kyang chos gzugs rtags tsam 'dzin: nyams len snying rus smyug ma'i sdong po 'dra: yi dam mi sgrub rgyal 'gong the'u rang bsgrub: de yi rkyen la stongs khams ru trar skye: yi dam mi dgyes ri rab logs la gzigs: steng 'og 'khrugs shing nad mtshon char pa g.yo: chos rgyal bris pa'i ri mo shul rjes smra: ma 'ongs de dus 'gro mang skyob pa yi: yang zab snying thig zab chos bka' rgya can: bla ma drag po sgrub pa'i las tshogs 'di: gzhan las khyad 'phags yid bzhin nor bu'i chos: tshig nyung don che myur zab snying gi cha: yang gsang 'di 'dra gzhan la sbas pa med: mtshan skar mang yang nyin mo'i skar ma gcig: me tog mang yang u dumba ra gcig: sems can mang yang sa bcu'i sangs rgyas gcig: sgrub skor mang yang snying gi thig le gcig: zab rgya mang yang gnad kyi gzer bu gcig: de phyir mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod ma gtogs par: yang zab gcig dril 'di 'dra shin tu dkon: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed ri mor gzugs: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: padma gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i tshogs khang-i atsha rgya: las kyi ma sring mkha' 'gros rgya 'di srungs: dam nyams bdud rigs lag tu ma shor cig: dus drug ma yengs bya ra lhang lhang gyis: sa ma ya:

gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo padma gter bdag gling pas me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i tshogs khang nas/ gsang gter du bgyis nas lo drug bar gsang rgyas bsdams/ slar glang lor padma sbas tshal nam mkha' 'brug grags su sangs rgyas lhums zhugs kyi zla tshes la shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po las/ dbang sdud zhags sgrub kyi las byang khrigs su bsdebs pa yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po bzhugs so/ khams gsum 'di na dbang che ba'i/ /dbang phyug ma hā dhe wa yang*/ /dbang med bran du bkol byas pa'i/ /dbang sdud rgyal po de la 'dud/ de'ang bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po'i dbang sdud nor bu zhags pa'i sgrub thabs 'don khrigs su bsdeb pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gter gzhung las/ bsod nams rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor dbang gi dal: rab rdul 'bring thang tha ma 'bru tshom ni: lha grangs ci ltar lag len bzhin du bkod: mnga' thang rgyas pa'i longs spyod dkor cha dang : phun tshogs 'byor ldan can gyi zas nor dang : sa sna chu sna shing sna 'dzoms tshad dang : sman sna 'bru sna dar sna rin chen rnams: legs par bsags shing dkyil 'khor mtha' bzhir bskor: mchod rdzas gzhung bzhin gang 'os dkor cha bsham: dbus su thod pa mtshan ldan kha sbyor nang : bsod nams nor rdzas dbang sdud 'khor lo bzhag: g.yas su dzam gtor g.yon du bum rdzas gtams: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ dkyil 'khor rang dang zhal sprod du bkod pa'i gong du stegs mtho ba'i khar/ rab mtshan ldan thod pa kha sbyor rin chen 'bru sman gyi bkang ba'i dbus sku 'khor tshad ldan gzhung bzhin bris pa dang*/ ma 'dzoms na gter bum mam gong gtor bkod pa'i g.yas g.yon du sman raka bza' btung sogs g.yang rdzas dang dkor cha ci 'byor bsham/ de'i cung dma' ba'i sar chad brtan bskul gtor gter bdag dge bsnyen zhi drag gis mtshon chos srung gi gtor ma tshogs mchod yo byad nyer spyod bcas dngos gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar bshams la/

g.yang skyabs dang 'brel na bse rag bkar yas dang g.yang gtor g.yang chang pho chas gri mtshon mo chas rgyan gos mda' dar phye mar sogs ma tshang ba med par 'du bya/ de nas dngos gzhi nyams su len tshul yang*/ gzhung las/ dam por mtshams bcad smra bas mi chod par: gzhi bdag gtor ma bsngo zhing phrin las bcol: bgegs gtor bsngo zhing dbul sri bkar yas bya: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nang du byi dor legs par byas nas/ bde ba'i stan la 'khod/ mtshams dam por bcad de thog mar/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas gnas gzhi bdag po la gtor ma bsngo zhing sgrub la bar chad dang phrag dog spongs la phrin las sgrubs zhes bcol/ bgegs gtor bsngo zhing dbul sri bkar yas bya la drag po kā la yaksha'i mtshams gcod srung 'khor bsgom tshul sogs spros par mos na zur 'gebs ltar shes par bya la rgyun du ni dkyus ltar byas pas chog go /de nas ji ltar bya tshul yang*/ de nyid las/ sku gsum tshul ldan ngang nas bag lhod nas: ting 'dzin rnam gsum gsal btab 'dzin med ngang : sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa rnams: slob dpon bka' bzhin 'khrul med brtson par bya: zhes pa ltar/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs skyes rabs gsol 'debs sogs rang lugs gsol 'debs dkyus ltar grub nas las gzhung gi brgyud 'debs ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings lhun grub spros pa'i mtha' bral yang*/ /'gro ba'i don du snying po'i rtsal phyung nas/ /ma gyur 'dren pa'i ngo bo snang mtha' yas/ /bdag la dngos grub rnam gnyis deng 'dir stsol/ /byin rlabs dbang dang nus pas bdag la skyongs/ /rang bzhin snying rje 'gags med rmad du byung*/ /'phags mchog phyag na padmo spyan ras gzigs/ /'bad med 'dun pa'i gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas lugs mngon du 'gyur bar bdag skyongs la/ /thugs rje'i rlabs phreng sgyu ma'i gar sgyur bzhin/

/skye dgu rnams la bsod nams char chen g.yo/ /gtan gyi skyabs mgon o rgyan chos kyi rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'di phyi dge legs stsol/ /skad gnyis smra mchog buddha dzñā na dang*/ /sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so chos nyid mngon gyur nas/ /rang rig bla mar 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro kun dge legs 'byin mdzad dzambha la/ /dbul ba'i phongs sel padma rgyal po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so sgrub rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'dod rgus nyer len khyab par g.yo ba yis/ /rab 'khyil shin tu 'khrugs pa'i gnas kyi bdag /zla 'dzin gnyis dang klu yi dbang mo la/ /mos blos bskul nas dwang bas gsol ba 'debs/ /'di phyi kun tu tshogs gnyis mthar phyin nas/ /bsod nams go 'phang mchog la gzhol bar shog / ces gsol ba btab bo/ dang po sngon 'gro la/ tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od kyis mdun gyi nam mkhar o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa sad par bsam la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dal: yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi dkyil 'khor lhar: bsod nams spel zhing bsgrub phyir skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ ma gyur 'gro ba gzhan don du/ /o rgyan nor lha'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /deng 'dir bdag gis bsgrubs nas su/ /dbul phongs sel bar sems bskyed do/ gsum pa tshogs bsags pa ni/ hūm̐/ yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi mchog /padma rgyal po'i lha tshogs rnams/ /lhun grub bde chen dbyings nas gshegs/ /bsam 'phel 'khor lo'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dbang phyug bdun ldan phyag 'tshal lo/ /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang*/ /rin chen sna tshogs mu khyud bcas/ /zhing dang bcas pa'i nye zhing du/ /ma tshogs med cing 'tshogs pa dang*/

/phyi nang spyan gzigs mchod pa rnams/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i tshogs la 'bul/ /gus pas btud cing dwang ba yis/ /mi dge'i las lam gang gyur bshags/ /rgyal ba mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs/ /rtag par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /ci srid byang chub dge ba'i tshogs/ /de srid ma gyur 'gro la bsngo/ /dam pas smon lam deng 'grub shog / mthar dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim zhing rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ dkar gtor sngon du 'gro bas/ bzhi pa bgegs gtor byin rlob pa la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid khro rgyal thugs ka nas: phyogs mtshams 'gugs bsgral mtshon 'phros pas: tshe bsod longs spyod mnga' thang la: gnod byed yi dwags bgegs rigs kun: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir khug: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa kā la gnod byed mā ra ya khug dza dzaḥ zhes 'gugs la bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: gnod byed bgegs rigs lan chags rnams: 'dod yon glud gtor 'di bzhes la: phyi rol dpag tshad bcu ru dengs: dam tshig 'gal na rdul du rlog: hūm̐ kro ta kā la tsaṇḍa bhū ta gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐: thod phreng drag po khro rgyal gyis: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad rnams: mtshams bcad khro bo'i gur gyur nas: 'jigs med rdo rje'i bhrūm̐ du gyur: oṃ āḥbadzra rakṣa tsakra bhrūm̐: drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: ye shes dkyil 'khor longs spyod 'phel ba'i dal: kun tshang mchod pa phyi nang sgrub rdzas rnams: zad med longs spyod nam mkha'i mtha' rgyas bzhin: dgos 'dod 'bad med mchog tu 'grub gyur cig: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye

sogs āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ bdun pa rten rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum bya: oṃ ratna mu la dha mañdza ye swā hā: zhes pas byin brlab par bya: oṃ gu ru padma rā dza hri ha ho phaiṃ phaiṃ sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā: oṃ swa bhā wa sogs? stong pa'i ngang las gzhi e las nam mkha': yam̐ rlung gi rgya gram: ram̐ me yi tsakra: kham̐ chu yi dkyil 'khor: bhrūm̐ rin chen pho brang : hri ma a ho zhes pas: rang byung lhun grub kyi pho brang : phyi nang gi bkod pa rgyan yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ste: srid pa gsum g.yo nus pa'i mdangs chags pa khams gsum gyi nor sna dkor cha sogs lta bas chog mi shes pa'i blo las 'das pa ma tshang ba med pa tshang zhing yid du 'ong ba: pho brang gi nang thams cad yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po dgos 'dod sna tshogs 'grub pa bsam pas brjod du mi lang pas rab tu gang ba 'di nyid rje btsun ma hā gu ru padma rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor dang khyad par nor bdag dzambha lha bka' dang gter gyi srung ma rnams mnyes pa'i rdzas: bsgrub pa'i rdzas: bskang ba'i rdzas: mchod pa'i rdzas: rten pa'i rdzas: phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub pa'i rdzas phun sum tshogs pa dang nam mkha' bar snang 'khor yug mu mtha' snang bas bzung dang ma bzung 'byams klas pa'i rang bzhin thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur: oṃ sarba ga na e ma la shrī pa ri wā ra ratna pha la ma ṇi dha ra ma la puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: brgyad pa byin 'bebs pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings ngo bo ka dag klong dkyil nas: dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po yis: ma rig dbyings su dag pa'i byin phob cig: snang stong mkha' la sgrib pa'i g.ya' bral ba: bgres rgud bral ba rdo rje sems dpa' yis: zhe sdang rnyog ma bral ba'i byin phob cig: khyab brdal ngang la ci yang lhun gyis grub:

tshogs gnyis yid kyi gter las rin chen 'byung : nga rgyal mtshan ma zhig pa'i byin phob cig: ma 'dres chu zla'i byad bzhin so sor snang : ci yang sgyu mar rtogs pa'i snang mtha' yas: 'dod sred chags pas grol ba'i byin phob cig: 'khor 'das dmigs su ma mchis rtsod bral ba: bdag 'dzin snying po zhig pa'i don yod grub: phrag dog rlung dmar gzhom pa'i byin phob cig: ting 'dzin yan lag brgyad ldan snyoms par 'jug: nges pa'i lam ston drug pa'i rnam par snang : gti mug tshogs bcom ye shes byin phob cig: shes rab dbyings dang rnam gzigs snying po'i spyan: mthu stobs 'chang mdzad sku gsum rdo rje'i thugs: sgo gsum tha mal zhig pa'i byin phob cig: nyag gcig thig le rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: rig stong grangs med 'od sku'i rnam rol can: ma skyes gsal rdzogs ye shes byin phob cig: byin chen phob la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: rje btsun mgon po snang mtha' spyan ras gzigs: mtsho skyes rdo rje padma rgyal po yis: dkyil 'khor g.yang rten rdzas la byin phob cig: tshe yi dbang mo lha lcam manda ra: chos sku yum chen jo mo mtsho rgyal mas: zas nor snyan grags 'phel ba'i byin phob cig: gtsug na nor bu'i gdengs ka klu yi rgyal: dgos 'dod mchod sbyin klu mo nor skyong mas: phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'tshub pa'i byin phob cig: shar phyogs 'gugs byed lha mo lcags kyu ma: yul 'khor srung gi tshe bsod mnga' thang rnams: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob bcud stims shig: lho phyogs dbang sdud ma mo zhags pa ma: 'phags skyes po yi dpal 'byor snyan grags srid: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob bcud stims shig: nub phyogs tshe 'phel lha mo lcags sgrog mas: spyan mi bzang gi 'byor rgyas rgyan gos tshogs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob bcud stims shig: byang phyogs g.yul las rab rgyal dril bu mas:

rnam thos sras kyi phywa g.yang 'dod rgu'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob bcud stims shig: rnam rgyal khang bzang dgos 'dod bum pa ru: tshangs pa'i 'byor ldan tshogs pa'i bcud chags nas: dgos 'dod 'bad rtsol mi dgos lhun grub stsol: phywa g.yang 'dod rgu dpal 'byor byin phob cig: hūm̐: ye sngon lta bur bstan pa mtho ba dang : gser ri'i lhun ltar bsod nams rgyun chags nas: rtsi shing grangs ltar 'dod rgu lhun gyis grub: rol mtsho'i klong ltar g.yang zhag khad kyis 'khyil: khu rlangs gtibs bzhin phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'tshub: dbyar gyi pho nya'i snyan grags 'brug ltar sgrogs: dngos grub 'gugs pa'i byin rlabs glog bzhin myur: 'bad rtsol mi dgos thugs rjes char bzhin 'bebs: dam sri tshar gcod nus pa thog ltar 'bebs: de ltar byin rlabs shugs 'byin bsgrubs pa'i lha: deng 'dir byin rlabs dbang bskur bstsal nas su: sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzod: oṃ gu ru padma rā dza sarba pa shaṃ puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ma ṇi bha dra bai ru pakṣā ra tsa hring hring ma ma thun thun sarba dza dzaḥ maṅga la shrī ya a dhiṣṭha ye swā hā: zhes rol mo dang bcas byin 'bebs bya/ dgu pa dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐: pad 'byung sku gsum dbang sdud skur ston pa: bsod nams longs spyod 'phel ba'i dal bzung nas: nam yang mi shigs tsitta dag tu bsgrub: ting 'dzin rnam gsum brda rtags bsten bgyid do: oṃ badzra tsitta nan sa ma ya ho hūm̐: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bcu las/ dang po dkyil 'khor lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ hrī mā: kun khyab ye shes dbyings kyi ngang : rang byung 'byung lnga bsnol brtsegs thabs: de dbus bhrūm̐ gyur gzhal yas khang : rin chen las grub rgyas pa'i dbyibs: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs: phyi nang rtsig rim chos tog tshang : de nang dgos 'byung rin chen khrir:

padma 'byung gnas dbang sdud dmar: zhal gsum phyag drug sgeg cing sbom: gsus pa che zhing gsus khyim 'khyil: dbu skra rin chen rgyan ldan brjid: g.yas g.yon rdo rje bhandha bsnams: bar gnyis rgyal mtshan ne'u le mdzes: mtha' gnyis lcags kyu padmas sdud: rin chen rgyan ldan dpa' zhing brjid: brkyang bskum rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs: g.yas su lha lcam sgeg mo dmar: ratna'i rgyan 'phyangs dbang sdud tshul: phyag gnyis ne'u le lcags kyu bsnams: dal 'gying 'gros kyi tshul du gnas: g.yon du mtsho rgyal lang tsho dkar: bde chen 'khyil zhing rgyan ldan mdzes: phyag gnyis rdo rje padma bsnams: zhabs gnyis dbang sdud brda 'gros tshul: gnyis ka gcer mo mnyen lcug ma: zung 'jug bde chen ldan par bsgom: phyogs bzhir dbang sdud mkha' 'gro bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang rgyan ldan gar: phyogs bzhir mtshon pa'i phyag mtshan ni: rang rtags ne'u le lcags kyu bsnams: mdun du klu mo nor skyong ma: na chung mdzes ma'i cha lugs can: khog stod mi la khog smad sbrul: sbrul mgo gsum gdengs nor bus brgyan: g.yas g.yon nor bu zhags pa bsnams: rin chen 'dod 'byin tshul gyis bskyed: gzhan yang nor skyong dbang sdud ma: phyi nang sprin 'khrigs snang bzhin bsgom: bdag nyid gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: skad cig nyid la spyan drangs gyur: badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

gnyis pa spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐: gter 'byung yid bzhin pho brang nas: padma rgyal po dbang sdud rtsal: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor: nor bdag 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: dgos 'dod lhun grub ratna'i khrir: dbang sdud padma yab yum 'khor: dngos grub kun 'byung brten pa'i phyir: 'dzum bag 'gying brjid tshul gyis bzhugs: oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: bdag gzhan dbul phongs skyon bsal phyir: gu ru nor lha'i dkyil 'khor la: bsod nams bskyed phyir phyag 'tshal bstod: oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba la gsum/ dang po thun mong snod bcud maṇḍal gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ spro na maṇḍal rgyas pa'ang bya/ bsdu na/ trām̐/ gling bzhi gling phran bkod pa'i tshom bu la/ /lha ma'i nor rdzas yo byad rgyan gyis phyugs/ /snang srid 'di ru ci srid tshogs pa 'di/ /phyi nang mnyes mchod dgyes pa'i 'dod rgu'i tshogs/ /pad 'byung nor lha rgyas phyir mchod pa 'bul/ ratna maṇḍal hūm̐/ gnyis pa thun min rgyal srid sna bdun dang bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'khor lo nor bu glang po rta mchog mdzes: btsun mo blon po dmag dpon rin po che: rin chen gdugs dang bum pa dpal be'u rgyan: 'khor lo padma gser nya chos dung sgra: rgyal mtshan dang ni bkra shis rdzas rtags bcas/ /pad 'byung nor lha rgyas phyir mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ sapta ma hā ratna aṣṭa maṅga la badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐: gsum pa khyad par bla med kyi mchod phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul 'dod yon mchod sprin dang*/ /bla med nang mchod sman gtor rakta'i rgyun/

/gsang mchod sbyor sgrol de bzhin kho na nyid/ /kun 'byung ratna'i rdzas su byin brlabs nas: dbang sdud padma 'byung gnas nor lha mo: 'dod rgu mchod sbyin dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe dharma pū dza hoḥ lā sye mā lye gīrti nīrti swa ra swa tī waṃ se pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta la khā hi: ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta ma hā ta na ga ṇa sarba pū dza khā hi: drug pa brda bstod ni/ hūm̐: kun 'byung longs spyod bdag po 'dod rgu'i rje: bde stong mchog gsum rang byung ngang nyid las: ral pa'i cod pan rin chen brgyan pa ni: dgos 'dod nor bu char bzhin 'bebs pa'i brda: zhi 'dzum rgyan dang ga shal 'phyang ba ni: zab cing spros bral dngos grub 'byung ba'i brda: zhal gsum dmar zhing dkar la rgyas pa ni: sku gsum thugs rjes 'gro kun skyob pa'i brda: g.yas g.yon rdo rje bhandha bsnams pa ni: rdo rje'i sku brnyes rtogs med don ldan brda: bar gnyis rgyal mtshan ne'u le bsnams pa ni: dam chos rgyas phyir dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i brda: mtha' gnyis lcags kyu padma bsnams pa ni: gzhan snang 'gugs shing padma dbang sdud brda: sgeg cing gsus khyim che la 'gying ba ni: khams gsum zil gnon longs spyod 'byung ba'i brda: thung la sbom zhing rgyan kun rdzogs pa ni: pad 'byung mkha' 'gro nor lhar mtshon pa'i brda: zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs su dpa' ba ni: ma rungs log 'dren zil gyis gnon pa'i brda: ratna'i khrir bzhugs gzi brjid ldan pa ni: pad 'byung rjes 'jug 'dzam gling khyab pa'i brda: brda rtags rgyan rdzogs dbang sdud rgyal por bstod: g.yas su lha lcam 'jo sgeg dmar ba ni:

tshe la dbang zhing rig 'dzin 'du ba'i brda: ratna rgyan 'phyangs mdzes par gzigs pa ni: pad 'byung brda rtags thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i brda: phyag gnyis ne'u le lcags kyu bsnams pa ni: khams gsum dbang sdud dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i brda: dal zhing 'gros kyi tshul du gnas pa ni: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gtso mo'i brda: g.yon du mtsho rgyal lang tsho dkar ba ni: gsang sngags bstan rgyas dam chos 'phel ba'i brda: bde chen 'khyil zhing rgyan ldan mdzes pa ni: dug lnga ma spangs 'gro don lhun grub brda: phyag gnyis rdo rje padma bsnams pa ni: thabs shes lam spyod bde stong mtshon pa'i brda: zhabs gnyis dbang sdud tshul gyis brda 'gros ni: gzhan snang dbang sdud dug lnga zil gnon brda: gnyis ka gcer mo mnyen lcug ldan pa ni: rtsa rlung dbang sdud chags lam grol ba'i brda: zung 'jug bde chen rab tu rgyas pa ni: 'gro ba'i yid snang dbang sdud zil gnon brda: gsang ba bde stong rig ma'i tshogs la bstod: phyogs bzhir dbang sdud mkha' 'gro 'gyed pa ni: phrin las bzhi ldan dngos grub 'byung ba'i brda: phyag g.yas rang rtags lcags kyus mtshan pa ni: pho nya sgo ma'i sgo gsum 'gugs stim brda: g.yon na nor skyug ne'u le bsnams pa ni: bsod nams longs spyod char rgyun myur 'bebs brda: bzhi ka gar stabs mkha' la bsgyur ba ni: rdzu 'phrul drwa bas gang 'dul ston pa'i brda: phrin las bzhi ldan mkha' 'gro rigs bzhir bstod: mdun du klu mo nor skyong mdzes pa ni: klu g.yang dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs pa'i brda: na chung mdzes ma'i cha lugs 'chang ba ni: zab gter bka' srung khyad par mdzad pa'i brda: khog stod mi mo mdzes 'dzum chags pa ni: 'gro ba'i yid snang gang 'dod ster ba'i brda: sbrul mjug rgya mtsho'i gling du 'khyil ba ni: chos dbyings bde drod rig mar brdzu ba'i brda: sbrul mgo gdengs ka nor bus brgyan pa ni:

sgrub la grogs mdzad bar chad sel ba'i brda: phyag gnyis zhags pa nor bu 'dzin pa ni: zab chos mthar phyin kun snang khyab pa'i brda: rin chen gling bzhugs rtse gcig gus pa ni: sa 'og dbang bsgyur sgrub mchog skyong ba'i brda: rol mchog bcud 'dzin klu mo mdzes la bstod: phyi nang mkha' 'gro zhing skyong phra men ma: 'dod rgu mchog sbyin ḍākki nor lha'i tshogs: sku gsum dag pa'i klong yangs bde ba'i ngang : 'khor 'das chos nyid grol bar phyag 'tshal bstod: dbang sdud padma rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod: las kyi rig ma gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: klu mo nor skyong sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyi nang mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs la bstod: bdun pa bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang nyid padma rgyal po gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ yig dmar po padma rā ga'i mdangs can gyi ha khog tu hrīḥyis mtshan pa gsal ba'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor la 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing dang lho nub padma 'od sogs zhing khams mu med par 'phros pas phyogs dus rgyal ba rnams la dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ byin rlabs 'od dmar gyi rnam pa tshur bsdus bdag la thim pas rang dang sgrub rdzas la thim pas mchog thun grub gnyis zad mi shes pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor grub par mos bzhin pa'i ngang nas rtsa ba'i snying po 'bum phrag gsum bzlas par bya'o/ bzlas lugs ni/ yid bzlas dang*/ rlung bzlas/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa sogs ci nus bya zhing dub na ngag bzlas bya'o/ oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes rtsa sngags dang*/ brgyad pa sgrub pa'i sngags phreng dbang sdud yid bzhin zhags pa ni/ de nas sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ni/ gzhung las/ zil gyis gnon na rang nyid ni:

dbang sdud rgyal po zil gnon tshul du bsgom: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs srog sngags phreng las 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rgyal ba mchod 'gro ba'i las sgrib sbyangs/ snang grags rigs gsum gu ru padma rgyal po'i lha sngags ye shes kyi rol pa 'byams klas par gyur/ oṃ ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa nā ga ni: pha la ṇi sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: dgu pa de ltar mtshan ma mngon nas las la sbyor ba'i tshe/ thugs srog sngags phreng las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can grangs med pa 'phros pas/ 'jig rten 'das pa dang ma 'das pa'i lha pho rgyud mo rgyud dang*/ khyad par du 'jig rten skyong ba'i dregs byed mthu bo che rnams dang*/ tshe bsod mnga' thang phywa g.yang la dbang 'byor ba'i lha klu gnod sbyin sogs skye 'gro mthong thos dran reg rnams rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus nas ci bsgo ba'i phrin las thogs med du bsgrubs par mos bzhin las sngags gong gi phyed cha 'khyol bar bzla'o/ oṃ ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa nā ga ni: pha la ṇi sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ṇi baṃ dza siddhi ma ma ṇi pa shaṃ hriṃ dza thun thun siddhi dzaḥ nor sgrub dbang sdud dmar po'i sngags phreng 'di/ las rim sngags zhag bdun bzlas pa gal che/ gzhan yang khyad par gyi las sbyor dag sbyar bar 'dod na gzhung chen mo la blta bar bya'o/ bcu pa 'grub rtags rdzogs nas dbang bzhi blangs gsungs pas dngos grub len pa ni/ hūm̐: padma rgyal po dbang sdud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: thugs dam rgyud bskul bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: byin rlabs bcud bsdus dbang bzhi mchog tu bskur: 'chi med tshe dang 'dzad med nor gyi mdzod: snyan grags mnga' thang chos gos srid la sogs: yid la gang smon skal ldan bdag la stsol: 'dzam gling 'jig rten khams gsum dbang sdud la:

'dzad med 'dzam gling longs spyod kun thob shog: rtsa sngags la/ oṃ kā ya siddhi dzaḥhūm̐: wākka siddhi baṃ hoḥ tsitta siddhi ho dzaḥ sa ma ya siddhi dza dzaḥ zhes dbang dang dngos grub rol te/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying bcas dang*/ rjes chog la dang po mchod bstod bya ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ 'dod 'byung yid bzhin dbang gis rab skyud pa/ /o rgyan pad 'byung dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /phyi nang gsang gsum dpag yas mchod sprin 'bul/ /bsam 'phel dpal 'byor sbyin la bdag bstod do/ gnyis pa bshags pa ni/ oṃ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang : gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni: ma rig 'khrul pa ci mchis pa: de kun mgon por bzod par gsol: zhes lhag chad bkang zhing yig brgya brjod/ ye shes pa brtan par bya/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ ye shes ngang las dgongs pa zang thal gyis: dkyil 'khor hūm̐ bsdu hūm̐ yang gsal stong ngang : sku bzhi ma bcos spros bral stong pa yis: ka dag dbyings rig shar grol a la bzhag: a a āḥ bzhi pa bsngo ba bya ba ni/ hoḥ bsngo byed rgyal po ye rig shes pa'i rgyu: bsngo yul rang gsal gnas lugs smra bo che: bsngo ba kun 'byung 'khor 'das phyogs ris bral: de dag rig pas bsal bzhag dran shes bsngo: lnga pa smon lam bya ba ni/ hoḥ srid par bsdus pa'i mtha' yas sems can rnams: dbul phongs pre ta'i 'ching ba rab grol nas: don gnyis bsod nams 'bras bu tshogs rdzogs nas: mthar thug gu ru'i go 'phang myur thob shog: drug pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla ma yi dam mchog: zil gnon padma dbang sdud rgyal po rtsal: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho klu mo gter gyi bdag: phyi nang rtsa gsum lha yi bkra shis shog: zhes sogs bsngo ba smon lam ci rigs kyis rgyas btab bo/ de dag gi stod las las rim gi chog khrigs le tshan no/ de nas tshogs mchod bya bar spro na/

thog mar las byang gzhung bsrangs la gsol 'debs nas brtsam bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod yan sngon du song nas/ skabs 'dir rang lugs chos skyong spyi dang khyad par gter srung dge bsnyen zhi drag gi gsol mchod rnams grub pa dang*/ na rag bshags skong mar me'i smon lam bar 'don/ khyad par gtor bsngos rig 'dzin srog sgrub tshig lhug yan grub mtshams 'dir tshogs la 'jug par bya ba yin no/ de la tshogs mchod bya ba'i rim pa ni/ dang po tshogs bsang sbyang chu gtsang gis bran la: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rang nyid padma rgyal po yi: thugs las byin rlabs yi ge 'phros: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bag chags sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: ro mchog 'dod yon sna tshogs gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra na sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub pho brang nas: snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon po la: mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas stong gis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ma 'gags dbyings rig pho brang nas: longs sku thugs rje 'phags mchog la: zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: stobs bcu gzi byin pho brang nas: rig 'dzin sprul sku pad 'byung la: bka' bab grub thob tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: kun 'byung yid bzhin pho brang nas: dbang sdud padma rgyal po la: 'dod sbyin mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dag pa bde chen pho brang nas: lha lcam gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro la: ma sring bye ba 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: me rlung 'tshub ma'i pho brang nas: legs ldan zhing skyong mgon po la: dam can gter bdag 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gaṅgā yid 'ong dal mtsho'i dbus:
