klu mo gzi ldan nor skyong la: dbang sdud skyong ma 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug: dgos 'dod char 'bebs si li li: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid ta la la: dri zhim spos dud chi li li: gnas 'dir byin chen myur du phob: dkyil 'khor rdzas la bkrag mdangs bskyed: bkram pa'i mchod par bcud chen phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas tshogs mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dbang sdud yab yum mgyogs ma bcas: dam can gter bdag chos skyong la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas skal ldan bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: de nas bskang ba bya ba'i rim pa ni/ tshogs dang mchod rdzas sna tshogs bsham: phyi nang spyan gzigs longs spyod dang : dkor cha rin chen 'bru sman tshogs: phun sum tshogs par bshams nas su: bskang ba'i rim pa 'di ltar bya:

hūm̐: lhun grub bde chen 'khyil ba'i pho brang nas: padma rgyal po nor bdag dkyil 'khor lha: dbang sdud ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sna tshogs rin chen pad zla'i khri la bzhugs: ro mchog lnga ldan 'dod yon phud kyi mchod: thugs dam bskangs shing dgos 'dod rab sbyin nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: mdzes pa'i spyan gzigs dar mtshon sprin ltar gtibs: rin chen sna tshogs 'bru sman bcal du bkram: dkar mngar phud kyi mchod pa mtsho ltar bskyil: rta glang ma he g.yag lug ra yi gzugs: spyan gzigs bla med yid 'ong mchod pa yis: gu ru padma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : lha lcam gsang ye gnyis kyi thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud mgyogs ma rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : nor skyong klu mo gzi ldan thugs dam bskang : gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: gar mo lang ling me tog phreng ba thogs: sgeg mo mdzes ldan dri zhim sgrom bu 'dzin: dmar mo dgyes bzhes snang gsal sgron me 'dzin: ljang mo 'jo sgeg bzhad 'dras dung chos bsnams: klu mo mnyen lcug zhal zas rgya mtsho 'khyil: 'khril ldem brda 'gros rol mo sna tshogs thogs: mchod sprin lha mo yid 'ong gar sgyur gyis: gu ru padma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : lha lcam gsang ye gnyis kyi thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud mgyogs ma rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : nor skyong klu mo gzi ldan thugs dam bskang : gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa mtsho ltar 'khyil: mu la rakta dbyings kyi rang byung khrag:

ba liṃ gtor ma brjid ldan ri ltar spungs: sbyor sgrol sna tshogs spyod pa'i bye brag gis: gu ru padma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : lha lcam gsang ye gnyis kyi thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud mgyogs ma rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : nor skyong klu mo gzi ldan thugs dam bskang : gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: zla rgyas zho dang zla phrom mar gyi phrom: 'bras rgun bu ram ka ra sbrang rtsi chang : phye mar 'brang rgyas longs spyod sna tshogs dang : gser dngul zangs dang mu tig baiḍūrya: nor bu rta mchog glang po dmag dpon dang : btsun mo blon po 'khor lo rin po che: gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dpal be'u bum pa zlum: gser nya padma chos dung g.yas su 'khyil: g.yang gi dga' 'khyil sna tshogs bsnams pa 'dis: gu ru padma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : lha lcam gsang ye gnyis kyi thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud mgyogs ma rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : nor skyong klu mo gzi ldan thugs dam bskang : gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan dang : sa le 'bri dang shel sgong lug: ga ṇa tshogs kyi longs spyod dang : bdud rtsi tshe yi a mṛ ta: māṃ sa sna tshogs sha sna'i mchog: ri sgog rlung sgog sha mong dang : co le nyo le nyi khri dang : rgun 'brum sna tshogs shing gi thog: ma tshang med pa'i mchod rdzas kyis: padma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : lha lcam ḍākki'i thugs dam bskang : gsang ye mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : klu mo nor skyong thugs dam bskang : klu yi dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang :

dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bskang ba skye med ngang du bskang : mchod pa gnyis med rol pas mchod: sbyor ba zung 'jug dga' bzhi sbyor: sgrol ba dug lnga dbyings su bsgral: bshags pa ye grol chen por bshags: thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: bskang ba bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod spyan gzigs 'dod yon sna lnga'i gter: nang mchod rdzas mchog bla med mchod pa'i sprin: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol sna tshogs dbang po 'dis: dbang sdud padma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro gnyis kyi thugs dam bskang : 'od ldan klu mo nor skyong thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : gter srung dge bsnyen chen po'i thugs dam bskang : phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing dgyes pa rab bskyed nas: sgrub la 'dod rgu yid bzhin char ltar phob: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hoḥ rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig bag med dbang gyur nas: bskyed rdzogs ma gsal mchod pa lo zlar 'das: dam rdzas ma tshang rgyu chung phud lhag shor: lhag ma phri zhing ser sna'i 'dod sred bcings: ma rig rmongs pa'i rkyen dbang ci mchis pa: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha la bshags: byang zhing dag ste mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: bshags pa bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: phyi nang dam tshig 'gal zhing nyams pa dang : bsnyen sgrub bskang bshags mchod rdzas chad cing lhag: bag med dam 'gal le lo ci mchis pa: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod 'bul bskang zhing bshags: nyams grib dag nas tshangs pa stsal du gsol: oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐:

zhes yig brgya bzlas: lhag chad bkang : de nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: mdun du hom yangs lcags khang gru gsum nang : nṛ tri las skyes dgra bgegs 'byung po dang : god bdag dbul sri mngon sum gsal bar gyur: hūm̐: na moḥ mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: khyad par bka' gter chos skyong bden pa'i mthus: gnod byed 'byung po bar chad rtsom pa'i rigs: rang dbang med par tshogs ling 'di la khug: bskrad cing bsdams nas bsgral gtub phye mar thongs: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ gnod byed 'byung po a karṣa ya dzaḥ de nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: ye shes thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo'i rgyal: sras mchog las byed badzra ku mā ra: phyag gnyis srid pa'i ri rab phur bu bsgril: byad ma gdug pa'i snying du kī la ya: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dam sri mā ra ya trig nan: gzir nan: mā ra ya rbad rbad: de nas gtub cing 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbang sdud rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: dug lnga dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rngam yangs zhal du bzhes shing mgrin par drongs: bde stong chos nyid rang byung lto bar bskyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi: zhes bdud rtsi bran zhing 'bul: g.yang skyabs bya na skabs 'dir sbyar srol yod pas de bzhin du bya/ de nas dga' ston tshogs la rol ba ni: hoḥ chos dbyings ngang la 'khor 'das gcig: dgag sgrub spang blang re dogs bral: bram ze khyi phag ji bzhin du: ro snyom lta ba'i tshogs la rol: dngos grub sna tshogs 'di la 'byung : a la la ste e ma hoḥ zhes pad kor phyag rgya dang bcas te blangs nas rol: de nas lhag ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i tshogs: lhag sdud ging dang ma mo sman: gnas nyul zhing skyong phra men ma: gos su mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon:

phyag na skyogs bzang bhandha thogs: dam tshig can gyi tshogs khang 'grim: la la mkha' 'gro'i gar bsgyur gzugs: la la bud med rgan mo'i gzugs: la la sha za srin mo'i gzugs: la la dur khrod 'dre mo'i gzugs: sprul pa sna tshogs ma nges kyang : don la gnas nyul dus mtshan ma: rnal 'byor kun gyi drod tshad nyul: dur khrod tshogs khang mtha' la gnas: dngos grub kun gyi sa mtshams 'dzin: legs gnyis kun gyi stangs 'dzin ma: dam tshig can la bu bzhin skyong : ma mo gnas nyul tshogs len 'bum: bka' yi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra dam nyams zas su zo: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs phye mar thongs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma mo rakmo ting ting shag shag dza bha lingta kha kha khā hi: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas: dbang sdud rgyal po rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal: gsang ba las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: mthu rtsal thugs rjes gzi byin deng 'dir skyed: da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo 'dul dka'i tshe: sems can bsod nams dman zhing bar chad sdang : yi dwags bgegs rigs 'byung po mi min gyis: mnga' thang longs spyod phywa la dgra sdang bas: mthu chen khyed kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: phyi yi bar chad rkyen ngan dbyings su sol: nang gi thig le rtsa rlung nyams pa gsos: gsang ba chos srid rang sems dbang du sdus: stong gsum phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: dbang sdud pho nya 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: mnga' thang snyan grags spel pa'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo rig 'dzin thugs rje can: sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor skal ldan bdag cag la: 'dod rgu zad med rin chen char ltar phob: thugs dam bskul lo bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki nī sa ma ya ma hā bha lingta kha kha khā hi:

gsol kha mthar dbyung*/ de nas chad mdo bya ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min bkod pa rab rdzogs su: thog ma'i mgon po snang ba mtha' yas kyis: 'od gsal snying po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbyings kyi ma sring khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og dur khrod ma la dga' tshal dang : dbang sdud chen po padma rgyal po yis: dngos grub kun 'byung dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: nor skyong pho nyas khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bsam yas mchims phu'i gnas mchog tu: rig 'dzin chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis: dbang sdud zhags pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: gnyer gtad srung mas khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: mdo smad rong gi dge bsnyen pho brang nas: rig 'dzin chen po rtsa gsum gling pa yis: zab gsang brda yi shog ser bton pa'i tshe: gter srung pho nyas khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bca' bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: chad mdo'i tha tshig 'di la gnas pa yi: srung ma dam can gter bdag pho nya rnams: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phywa g.yang dpal 'byor 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ kro ta kro ti ya kro ta bha sa ki si bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod skyong brtan ma ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: sha za sman mo yang 'khor bye ba 'bum: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rin chen mdzes rgyan g.yer kha si li li: glu len nyams dga' bshugs glu kyu ru ru: dgyes pa'i gad mo 'dzum mdangs ya la la: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la:

zab gter gnyan gyi mel tshe rogs dan mdzod: sgrub la ma yengs bstan pa bu bzhin skyongs: bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma mo mu kha le ting ting shag shag kha kha khā hi: de nas rta bro bya ba ni: hūm̐: dbang chen rngam pa'i bro ra ru: khro rgyal stobs kyi bro brdungs pas: dgra sri dam nyams thal bar brlag: gtum mo rdo rje'i bro ra ru: khro mo 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas: bgegs srin 'byung po tshar yang bcad: las mkhan 'tshogs pa'i bro ra ru: gter srung dam can bro brdungs pas: god 'dre dbul sri thal bar brlag: chem chem khro rgyal rol pa'i bro: rdungs shig stobs bcu'i rtsal gyi 'gros: nam yang dam sri ma ldang cig: oṃ āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nanaḥ dam sri mā ra ya rbad ching nan nan: de nas gtor gzhong kha yar bzed la me tog 'thor zhing*/ rten 'brel gang rigs kyi mchod pa yang bya: skabs su dngos grub 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: zab dbyings dkyil 'khor lhun grub pho brang nas: chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs: sprul sku rig 'dzin 'chi med padma 'byung : dbang sdud rgyal po nor bdag dzambha la: mgyogs ma mkha' 'gro rlung gi zhags pa can: phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus kun: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor la: tshe chos zas nor longs spyod phywa dang g.yang : snyan grags chos dang mnga' thang 'dod rgu'i tshogs: mchog dang thun mong yid la 'dod pa'i rigs: 'bad med yid bzhin nor bu char bzhin phob: myur du skal ldan rig 'dzin bdag la stsol: oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing 'bru gsum gyis: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dbang bzhi stsol: oṃ ma hā gu ru padma rā dza dzñā na ḍākki nī sa ma ya: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi puṇye ratna ma ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dngos grub blang zhing dbang bzhi zhu/ de nas tshe 'gugs bya ba ni/ tshe chang dang tshe ril thogs nas/

hūm̐: thog ma'i mgon po 'chi med tshe yi lha: padma rgyal po gsang 'dus dbang chen bdag: mgyogs ma tshe 'gugs lha mo 'bum gyis bskor: sgo ma'i phyag brnyan steng 'og phyogs bcur 'phros: nyi zla ri rab gling bzhi rol mtsho'i bcud: sa chu me rlung 'byung lnga khams lnga dang : snang ba srid dang snod bcud skye 'gro yi: bla tshe rnam shes bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rnams: 'od zer lcags kyus bsdus nas bdag la stims: pho nya sgo ma'i tshogs kyis dbang du sdus: rig 'dzin lus la bstims pas gzi brjid rgyas: 'khor lo lnga ldan ye shes 'od kyis gang : bdud rtsis lus kun khyab pas rā ga'i mdog: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob shog: oṃ a mi dhe ba ā yurdzñā na hrī padma dha ra hūm̐: ma ma siddhi pha la dza dzaḥ de nas tshe chang tshe ril la rol: mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam: rjes kyi bya ba la/ dang po mchod bstod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ 'dod 'byung yid bzhin dbang gis rab skyud pa/ /o rgyan pad 'byung dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /phyi nang gsang gsum dpag yas mchod sprin 'bul/ /bsam 'phel dpal 'byor sbyin la bdag bstod do/ gnyis pa bshags pa ni/ oṃ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang : gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni: ma rig 'khrul pa ci mchis pa: de kun mgon por bzod par gsol:

zhes lhag chad bkang zhing yig brgya brjod: ye shes pa brtan par bya/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ mi dmigs stong gsal rang byung dkyil 'khor lha: ma 'gags zang thal chos dbyings klong du bsdu: rang rig dran pa'i rgyal sa zin gyur cig: a a āḥ zhes pa'i sgra dang bcas nas bsdu'o: bzhi pa bsngo ba bya ba ni/ hoḥ bsngo byed rgyal po ye rig shes pa'i rgyu: bsngo yul rang rtsal gshis lugs smra bo che: bsngo ba kun 'byung 'khor 'das phyogs ris bral: de dag rig pas bsal bzhag bral bar bsngo: lnga pa smon lam bya ba ni/ hoḥ srid pas bsdus pa'i mtha' yas sems can rnams: dbul phongs pre ta'i 'ching las rab grol nas: don gnyis bsod nams 'bras bu tshogs rdzogs shing : mthar thug gu ru'i go 'phang myur thob shog: drug pa bkra shis bya ba ni/ hoḥ chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' thog ma'i mgon: rtse gcig ting 'dzin 'char ba'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis 'phags mchog thugs rje'i bdag: byin rlabs 'gro kun smin pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin padma 'byung : zab yang nyi 'od gsal ba'i bkra shis shog: yi dam bkra shis dbang sdud nor lha'i mchog: dgos 'dod char bzhin 'bebs pa'i bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis bde stong gsang ba'i yum: sngags bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: dam can bkra shis sngags srung rdo rje legs: log lta bdud rigs tshar gcod bkra shis shog: chos skyong bkra shis legs ldan seṅge'i gdong : mnga' thang stobs bcu 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis klu mo nor skyong ma: 'dzad med gter la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog: gter gnas bkra shis dge bsnyen pho brang che: yul ris sa phyogs bde legs bkra shis shog: ces bsngo smon ci rigs kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ de dag gis bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po'i dbang sdud zhags sgrub kyi las byang khrigs su bsdebs pa yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba 'di'ang nor bdag tshogs kyi bdag po dang klu chen mal gro gzi chen nye bar bsrung ba'i gdod nas grub pa'i tshandho ha a su ra'i brag phug dang nye ba'i char rang gnas sgrub sde phur pa gling du grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang mi mthun dus kyi rgud pa mtha' dag rmang med du zhi nas chos 'byor bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi nyi ma slar 'char ba'i rgyur gyur cig

/ces pa'ang ngag dbang klu sgrub rgya mtshos smras rim bzhin mtshams nag ral pa can au ḍi ming gis glog klad 'phrul gyi yi ger glog 'khyugs pa bzhin 'phral du grub par bgyis pa'o// // ༈ bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po las/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying po rab gsal bzhugs so/ padma rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la gsum/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/ na mo/ bde gshegs kun 'dus gu ru yid bzhin nor/ /gus pas skyabs mchis bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob bya'i phyir/ /'dod 'byung dbang gi rgyal po myur bsgrub bgyi/ dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad gcig gi /snang srid bde chen padma 'od/ /rang byung sprul pa'i pho brang dbus/ /nor bu'i khri 'phang pad nyi'i gdan/ /rang rig hriḥdamar yongs gyur pa'i/ /padma 'byung gnas dbang sdud dmar: zhal gsum phyag drug sgeg cing sbom: gsus pa che zhing gsus khyim 'khyil: dbu skra rin chen rgyan ldan brjid: g.yas g.yon rdo rje bhandha bsnams: bar gnyis rgyal mtshan ne'u le mdzes: mtha' gnyis lcags kyu padmas sdud: rin chen rgyan ldan dpa' zhing brjid: brkyang bskum rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs: g.yas su lha lcam sgeg mo dmar: g.yon du mtsho rgyal lang tsho dkar: bde chen 'khyil zhing rgyan ldan mdzes: gnyis ka gcer mo mnyen lcug ma: zung 'jug bde chen ldan par bsgom: gtso bo'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng*/ /dbang sdud rgyal po zil gnon tshul/ /thugs kar rdo rje hrī mthar sngags/ /bde chen rang bzhin zhing kun khyab/ /rgyal ba mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus/ /'bar ba gsum gyis bdag nus bskyed/ khams gsum brtan g.yo snang grags sems/ /padma rgyal po'i sku gsung thugs/ /lha sngags ye shes rol pa las/ /'du ba gsum gyi phrin las sgo/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par mos/

oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ ci nus bzlas la mthar mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bsdu la rjes shes padma rgyal po'i nga rgyal ngang bsngo smon sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ zhes pa'ang lha 'di nyid la mi 'phrog pa'i yid ches nges shes rnyed pa'i padma'i rig sngags 'dzin pa padma myu gu klu yi ming nas/ gter gzhung nas btus la zur rgyan phran bu bcas/ rab byung 17 me sprel lo zla ba 8 tshes la the pe e waṃ du bris pa'o// // ༈ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ gsol 'debs bsdus pa padma'i myu gu bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru arya lo ki shwa ra ye/ pam̐dmam̐'i rigs mchog chos sku 'od dpag med/ pam̐dmam̐'i spyan ldan longs sku snying rje'i gter/ /pam̐dmam̐ las 'khrungs 'chi med sprul pa'i sku/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol/ /mam̐ rig 'gro sgrol rigs bzhi 'phags pa'i lha/ /mam̐ lus rgyal ba'i yum gyur myur mdzad lnga/ /mam̐ rungs 'dul mdzad dbang chen hya ghṛ/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol/ /'khom̐r lo'i dbang phyug rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*/ /'khom̐r 'das zil gnon 'phags mchog yi dam lha/ /'khom̐r lo'i tshom bu mkha' 'gro chos skyong la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol/ /de ltar gdung shugs gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /byang chub sems 'byongs snang zhen lha skur dag /'byin 'jug bde chen rdo rje'i sngags su rdzogs/ /dran rtog 'od gsal chos skur smin gyur nas/ /tshe 'dir zung 'jug go 'phang mngon gyur shog / nyer mkho'i ched du rdo ban ngor gu hyas gang dran smras so/ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon las/ longs sku ltar sgrub kyi 'don khrigs su bsdebs pa padma'i phreng ba mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// // thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la 'dud/

de yang longs sku ltar sgrub padma'i phreng ba nyams su len pa la/ gzhung las/ sngon 'gro las kyi rim pa ni: dben zhing spro la dge ba'i yul: bkra shis yid 'ong byin chags gnas: rgyud dang mthun pa'i sa phyogs su: yar tshes dge ba'i nyin dag la: dkyil 'khor spyi mthun gzhung bzhin gdab: dbus su padma 'dab brgyad bris: dkar ser dmar ljang lha yi mdog: tshom bu sa bon zhib tu bkod: mu khyud 'ja' 'od gur kyang bris: longs sku'i 'dra 'bag gsung rten bkram: bum pa rgyan dang sngags phreng bcas: rigs lnga me long shel rdo dang : dam rdzas sman raka phud kyang bsham: gtor ma rin chen nor bu'i gzugs: pad 'dab brgyad kyis bskor ba la: 'khor yang bshos chung brgyad kyis bskor: rtse mor phyag mtshan mdzes tshon spras: gzhan yang phyi nang mchod pa bshams: zhes gsungs pa ltar sbyor ba lag len gyi rim pa sngon du song nas dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor la 'jug par sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ de nyid las/ dang po skyabs yul sngon 'gro song nas: mchod pa byin rlabs la sogs gzhung chen mo nas blang : zhes gsal ba ltar/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i bla ma thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes tshogs zhing gsal btab nas/ dang po sbyor ba sngon 'gro la'ang drug /dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: kun gzhi rang rig sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yab: gsal stong ma 'gags dam chos 'byung ba'i yum: skye 'gag gnyis med dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal: rtsa ba mchog gsum de bzhin skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ snang srid ye nas zang thal gzhal yas khang : snod bcud rang rtsal rig pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'dzin med ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang : brda don brten phyir gnas lugs sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni: na mo: chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs pho brang nas:

ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'gro don yid snang sprul sku'i gnas 'dir gshegs: gang 'dul der ston 'gro mgon dpal du bzhugs: rab gus dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes ngang du mchod: dug gsum bag chags sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: rtse gcig 'dun pa'i dam bcas rab tu bstod: mtha' yas srid mtsho bsgral phyir dge ba bsngo: ma lus 'gro kun byang chub lam 'god shog: mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ bzhi pa bgegs gtor bsngo ba ni/ bgegs gtor byin brlab pa la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ sarba bhū ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ lan gsum gyis dgug /sarba bighnān na ma sarbghṛhna daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: 'dod yon glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la: so so rang rang gnas su phyir dengs shig: ci ste mi 'gro 'di ru 'tshe byed na: ye shes khro rgyal khrag 'thung thugs khros nas: phye mar brlag cing gtor bar gdon mi za/ /de bas da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig oṃ badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po ha na ha na u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i thugs ka nas: mtshon cha rdo rwa me ri'i gur khang 'phros: phra mo'i rlung yang phyi nang mi bgrod pa'i: ye shes drwa mig dum bu gcig tu gyur: oṃ badzra ā yu dha dzwa la raṃ rakṣa rakṣa: zhes srung ba'i gur khang bsgom/ drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis sbyangs spel bsgyur: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las zhing khams 'dzin ma'i khyon:

yongs su gang ba'i brda bsgyur lha mo'i tshogs: sna tshogs mchod 'dzin yid 'ong rig ma'i gar: legs par bsgyur zhing mchod sprin bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la dgu las/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum la/ hūm̐: ka dag khregs chod khyab cing gdal: āḥ zang thal ngang la rang rtsal rdzogs: oṃ: kun rgyu sa bon phyag mtshan gyur: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: gnyis pa rten dang brten par bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid zang thal klong : khyab brdal rang bzhin 'byung lnga bsnol ba yi: lhun grub gsal stong 'od kyi gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo rdzogs rgyan dang rta babs mdzes: rin chen tog mdzes 'ja' zer 'od klong gtibs: de dbus sna tshogs padma nyi zla'i steng : hrīḥlas 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs: sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: rin chen thor tshugs longs sku'i dbu rgyan la: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan dbyings la bskyod: zhi 'dzum mdzes ldan thugs rjes phyogs bcur gzigs: g.yas g.yon dang po shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu thal mo sbyar: sku stod lha rdzas dar sngon rgyan gyis bklubs: sku smad dar dmar mdzes pa'i ang rag gsol: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis legs par spras: rdo rje skyil krung mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i tshul: snang stong 'ja' lus sgrib med gsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: shar phyogs pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: thugs rje chen po kha sarpa ṇi mthing : longs sku'i cha lugs mdzes 'dzum rgyan gyis spras: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas skyabs sbyin tshul: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang phyed skyil stabs kyis bzhugs: hūm̐:

lho phyogs pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: thugs rje chen po sa snying sku mdog ser: dgyes bzhad mdangs mnga' longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras: phyag g.yas chos 'chad g.yon pas mnyam bzhag can: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum phyed skyil stabs kyis bzhugs: hūm̐: nub phyogs pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: thugs rje chen po nam mkha'i rgyal po dmar: mdzes chags 'dzum ldan longs sku'i rgyan spras ldan: phyag gnyis las kyi phyag rgya thugs kar bsnol: zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: hūm̐: byang phyogs pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: thugs rje chen po 'khor los bsgyur rgyal ljang : khro 'dzum mdzes ldan longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas zil gnon can: zhabs gnyis bshibs shing ldem pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs: thams cad shel phreng pad dkar mdzes tshul bsnams: gsal stong gzi 'bar ma bcos lhang nger gsal: hūm̐: mtshams bzhi pad 'dab tshom bu'i gdan steng du: rgyal yum sgrol ma dkar ser dmar ljang mthing : mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar sgeg mdzes pa mo: ral pa'i thor tshugs rigs lnga'i rgyan gyis spras: zhal 'dzum mdangs ldan nu ma bha ga rgyas: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas skyabs sbyin mdzad: sna tshogs mdzes ldan 'greng thabs tshul gyis bzhugs: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang sgo skyong la sogs pa: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs ma lus rnams: chu zla dang ni 'ja' tshon lhags pa ltar: gsal stong ma bcos spros bral ngang la bskyed: de ltar du gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas: 'og min bde chen bkod pa'i zhing khams nas: longs sku spyan ras gzigs dbang la 'khor sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis bskor ba spyan drangs: oṃ badzra sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub zhing khams nas: longs sku spyan ras gzigs dbang la/

sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: ma skyes skyon bral padma nyi zla'i gdan: mi shigs 'khor lo rgyas pa'i khri steng du: 'gro 'dul longs sku ye shes lha tshogs rnams: chu zla lta bur rnyog med brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: skye med snying po sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can: kha dog bral yang ma 'gags sna tshogs 'char: kun rgyu shes rab 'od kyi drwa ba'i sku: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ oṃ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ drug pa mchod pa ni: hūm̐: phyi yul tshogs drug mchod sprin lha mo'i gar: gnas lugs ngo bo dran rig sprin phung gtibs: ye grol rang byung sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'di: zil gnon longs sku'i lha la 'bul bar bgyi/ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pū dza khā hi: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta sarba pū dza khā hi:

bdun pa bstod pa ni: hūm̐: skye med ka dag rang byung snying po can/ /mi g.yo ting 'dzin gsal stong brda yi sku/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku 'phags mchog snying rje'i lhar/ /dmigs med blo 'das de bzhin phyag 'tshal bstod/ brgyad pa dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: yang gsang bla med thugs dam gcig bsdus pa: byin rlabs gter chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid mchog: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi: yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: rmad byung ting 'dzin dzap kyis rgyud bskul la: sku gsung thugs mchog dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: dgu pa bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po yab yum gyi/ thugs kar hrīḥdang tāṃ yig gsal ba'i mthar: sngags phreng zer thag lu gu rgyud sbrel ltar: g.yas g.yon 'khor bas phyi nang sdig sgrib dag: lus kun khyab pas mchog thun dngos gruub thob: slar 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems mchod: tshur 'dus byin rlabs gzi brjid bdag la thim: 'ja' lus dpal 'bar rdo rje'i sku ru gyur: rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ yum gyi sngags/ oṃ ārya tā re tu re swā hā: gcig dril sgrub sngags ni: oṃ lo ki shwa ra tāṃ tu tā re hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci nus su bzlas mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig sogs spyi ltar bya/ de nas tshogs mchod mdor bsdus bya bar spro na/ gnyis pa tshogs mchod bya ba la drug las/ dang po tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bdud rtsis bran la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐: 'og min klong yangs phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /sku gsum 'khor 'das zil gnon lha tshogs rnams/ /tshogs la gshegs shing gnas 'dir byin chen phob/ /dbang bzhi bskur la mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya satwaṃ/ gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang :

chos skyong gter srung dkyil 'khor skyong mdzad pa: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: gsum pa bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi nang dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i sprin: dngos su bshams shing blo yis sprul pa'i tshogs: stong gsum khyon ltar khengs pa'i yid 'phrog rdzas: sna tshogs mchod sprin kun tshang rgya mtsho 'dis: 'khor 'das zil gnon dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : bzhi pa bshags pa ni: hoḥ tshogs kyi nyes skyon ma rig blang dor rnams: ro gcig lta ba zag med ting 'dzin gyis: gzung 'dzin dgag sgrub nyams chag skyon gyi tshogs: bdag gzhan gnyis med ye grol ngang la bshags: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ lnga pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : dmigs bya dgra bgegs myur du khug: gnod byed srog la kī la ya: gtub cing khro rgyal zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā rakta māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na khā hi: dngos grub blangs shing tshogs la rol/ drug pa lhag ma ni/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba'i dam tshig can/ /lhag la dbang rnams bka' yi pham phab bzhes/ /sngon tshe slob dpon padma'i bka' bzhin du/ /dgra bgegs sgrol zhing bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod/ /ma mo ma tri re ma ti mu kha li tsaṇḍa ma ma bhakṣa si bha lingta khā hi/ lhag gtor 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ skabs 'dir chos skyong gtor 'bul bya/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba bdun las/ dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi yul tshogs drug mchod sprin lha mo'i gar: gnas lugs ngo bo dran rig sprin phung gtibs: ye grol rang byung sgyu ma'i rol rtsed 'di: zil gnon longs sku'i lha la 'bul bar bgyi/ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pū dza khā hi:

oṃ badzra a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta sarba pū dza khā hi: gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: skye med ka dag rang byung snying po can/ /mi g.yo ting 'dzin gsal stong brda yi sku/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku 'phags mchog snying rje'i lhar/ /dmigs med blo 'das de bzhin phyag 'tshal bstod/ gsum pa nongs bshags ni/ hūm̐: bla med theg chen rgyud sde'i sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba yan lag phyag rgya ting 'dzin sogs/ khas blangs dam tshig nyams 'gal ci mchis pa/ mthol bshags bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang : bzhi pa dbang blang ba ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med rang byung pho brang nas: bskyed pa'i sna tshogs zlos gar dkyil 'khor lha: don gnyis las bzhi'i phrin las shugs phyung nas: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi hūm̐: zhes pas dbang blang : brtan bzhugs spyi ltar byas la/ lnga pa bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐: snang stong 'ja' tshon chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: mi dmigs lha tshogs dbyings rig klong la thim: dran rig chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: ma bcos spros bral ngang la ā ru ldang : a a āḥ drug pa bsngo smon bya ba ni/ hrīḥ bdag gi bsnyen sgrub dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams kyi don du bsngo: kun kyang sa bcu lam lnga mthar phyin nas: gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / bdun pa bkra shis ni/ hrīḥ thugs rje'i gter chen 'khor 'das zil gnon lha/ /yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis/ deng 'dir mi mthun rgud pa kun zhi zhing : rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog: rjes su bsngo smon ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan la mthar stong nyid 'od gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi chos sde chen po las yan lag le tshan drug gi nang gses bla ma longs sku ltar sgrub kyi 'don khrigs padma'i phreng ba mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'di'ang dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhabs kyis bcags shing ma hā gu ru padma sambha wa phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa dang gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes 'jam dpal ya mānta ka'i rgyud lung man ngag rnams nyams bzhes mdzad pa'i gnas mchog rgyal po bal yul yang le shod ces bya bar rang gnas gsang sngags phur pa gling gnam lcags sgrub sde ru rab gnas chu pho rta lo'i nag pa zla ba'i yar tshes 6gi nyin sgo chen sprul ming du 'bod pa phyogs nyul sprang po gu hyas spel ba'i yi ge pa ni rang slob au ḍī ming can gyis bgyis pa dge bar gyur cig/

// ༈ bka' brgyad phrin las bsdus pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs so/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos sku kun bzang ston pa rdo rje sems/ /dga' rab rdo rje mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang*/ /'phags yul grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad rnams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dbang chen bskur/ /yongs rdzogs sgrub sde'i bka' babs padma 'byung*/ /gsang ba rgya mtsho'i mdzod 'dzin mkhar chen bza'/ /rgyud 'dzin rje 'bangs snying gi bu dgu la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed/ /mthu rtsal nus pa'i mnga' bdag gnubs chen rje/ /zab mo'i gter la dbang bsgyur rtsa gsum gling*/ /chos bdag lung zin rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol nyams rtogs spor/ khro bo kun 'dus spyi dpal che ba'i mchog /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rbod gtong dang*/ /drag sngags dregs 'dul la sogs bka' brgyad lhar/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /gnas yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*/ khyad par bka' srung mgon chen sde lnga sogs/ /bdun brgya nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol/ /snang srid gzhir bzhengs lha yi phyag rgyar rdzogs/ /'byin 'jug bde chen rdo rje'i sngags su dag /dran rtog 'od gsal chos skur smin byas nas/ /tshe 'dir rdo rje'i lam mchog mthar phyin shog / ces pa'ang sgrub sde'i nyams bzhes la dgos mkho'i ched au ḍīs nan bskul ngor gu hyas so/ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi rgyun khyer snying po'i don bsdus bzhugs so/ bla ma rig 'dzin sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ de'ang bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ thog mar dbang gi rgyud smin par byas shing*/ dam tshig gi srog dang ma bral bar sgrub pa nyams su len pa la/

gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan par dam tshig gi bris sku sogs rten bkram pa'i mdun du stegs bu gtsang mar ras bris sam 'bru tshom bkod pa'i khar sgrub rten gtor ma dang sman raka srung ma'i mchod gtor tshogs kyi yo byad mchod pa'i dngos po rnams 'du bya la/ rang nyid stan du bde bar 'khod pa'i mdun nang mchod ḍā dril 'thor nas bsang bum sogs nyer mkho rnams tshags su tshud par bya'o/ gnyis pa phrin las dngos la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o/ dang po tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rig 'dzin dpal chen gtso dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa sad par byas la skyabs sems ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po laḥ byang chub ma thob bar du ni: skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi: sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: 'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed do: sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir: gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod: don dam spros bral byang chub sems: rang byung mtha' bral gsal stong bsgom: gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i dge ba rnams/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams 'od zhu rang la thim par gyur/ gsum pa 'byung po la gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brlabs la/ sarba bhu ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ sa mgron dgug de nas bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni gsal stong he ru kaḥ bdag gzhan phye ba'i rnam rtog bgegs: ro gcig gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phyogs med chos sku'i klong du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro a 'thas na: kun rgyu khro mos rig rtsal bskyed: khregs chod rdo rje'i mtshon char 'bebs: nga bdag 'gong po rdul phran gtor: de bas gnyis 'dzin phyir dengs shig: om̐ he ru ka dzñā na badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa rang byung lta ba'i mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐: nga nyid ye nas dpal chen he ru kaḥ mkha' ltar khyab pa 'od gsal rdo rje'i thugs: ye shes lnga ru nam yang 'bral brlag med: rnam rtog ru tra gnyis 'dzin ka nas dag: chos dbyings brdal khyab bsrungs mtshams med par gsal: oṃ he ru ka dzñā na hūm̐ phaṭḥ nga bdag ru tra pra we sha ya phaṭḥ oṃ dharma dzñā na badzra tsakra satwaṃ: lnga pa rang byung mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: 'khor lo rnam dag rang byung bhandha'i snod: blo yi khyon rtse yangs shing rgya che'i nang : phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo sil snyan gdung ba'i dbyangs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dbang po lnga: gzugs mdzes glu dbyangs gar mo phyag rgya can: nang mchod dug lnga ye shes sman raka gtor: gsang mchod bde stong sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi lnga: sgrol mchod la sogs spyan gzigs mthun pa'i rdzas: ma tshang med pa ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ

lan gsum gsum brjod/ de nas dngos gzhi la/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: smra brjod bral ba stong pa'i gzhi: khyab brdal ngang la lhun gyis gnas: rgya chad phyogs lhung spu ris bral: oṃ dharma dzñā na tsitta hūm̐: gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ āḥ yid kyi rtog pa phra mo la: ma 'gags rtsal snang lam gyis shar: gnyis rtog rlung gi rang bzhin bskyed: oṃ badzra dharma hrī ta āḥ gsum pa rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin ni/ oṃ: kun snang 'dzin pa'i sa bon las: rten 'brel hūm̐ yig rdo rje shar: gnas 'gyu lha dang gzhal yas gsal: oṃ dharma bhrūm̐ dzñā na hūm̐: bzhi pa rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: 'byung lnga bsnol brtsegs brtan pa'i steng : rdo rje'i 'od zer gzhal yas khang : dkyil 'khor phyi nang mtshan nyid rdzogs: ye shes lugs su 'byung bar bsgom: oṃ badzra bhrūm̐ sa ma ya hūm̐: oṃ padma maṇḍa la: sūrya maṇḍa la: tsand+ra maṇḍa la: ru tra ti ra baṃ: spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: oṃ sarba shū n+ya ta badzra ātma ko3 haṃ: lnga pa brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: de dbus zla gam sgo gcig pa: pad nyi byol song gtso brgyad steng : bdag nyid che mchog he ru kaḥ smug nag dbu dgu shin tu khro: g.yas dgu gnam lcags rdo rje gdengs: g.yon dgu bhandha dmar gyis bkang : dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum gling bzhir brjid: thugs kar sems dpa' sa bon hūm̐: gnam zhal dbyings phyug sku la 'khril: phyag drug gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma hā kro ti shwa rī satwaṃ: hūm̐: shar phyogs pho brang zla gam dbus: dri za pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : thugs mchog badzra he ru kaḥ mthing nag dkar dmar zhal gsum khro: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnga:

g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar zhags: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: kro ti shwa rī yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo phaṭḥ hūm̐: lho phyogs pho brang zla gam dbus: gshin rje pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : sku yi bdag nyid gshin rje'i gshed: ser nag dkar dmar khro zhing gtum: be con ral gri dgra satwa g.yas: bhan dmar sdigs mdzub mdung thung g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: bhe ta za byed yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nub phyogs pho brang zla gam dbus: klu dbang pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : gsung mchog padma he ru kaḥ dkar dmar mthing zhal khro la gtum: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ sbrul: dril bu bhan dmar lcags sgrog g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: padma gzi ldan yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: byang phyogs pho brang zla gam dbus: gnod sbyin pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing ka dkar dmar khro la gtum: rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga g.yas: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭwāṃ thogs: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: shar lho pho brang zla gam dbus: me lha pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : yon tan rbod gtong he ru kaḥ ljang dkar dmar la khro zhing gtum: g.yas gsum rdo rje khyung dang sbrul: bhan dmar zhing dbyug gwa'u g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: nyid zhi yum dang gnyis med sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ ghu na dzñā na shrī he ru ka kro ti hūm̐ phaṭḥ

hūm̐: lho nub pho brang zla gam dbus: che mchog drag po thod phreng rtsal: dmar dkar sngo la khro zhing gtum: gri gug rdo rje ral gri g.yas: thod khrag kha ṭwāṃ lcags sdig g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: rdo rje gtum mo yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: nub byang pho brang zla gam dbus: 'jig rten khro bo he ru kaḥ dud kha dkar dmar khro zhing gtum: rdo rje lha brgyad mgo bo g.yas: bhan dmar klu brgyad mgo bo g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: 'byung bzhi bdag mo yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: byang shar pho brang zla gam dbus: khrag 'thung khro rgyal dmod pa'i sku: nag dkar dmar la khro gtum brjid: gri gug lha brgyad tsitta g.yas: dung dmar klu brgyad tsitta g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: srid pa spyi 'dul yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ sarba duṣṭāṃ e dza bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: pho brang skyong ba'i rim pa bzhin: rang mdog phyag mtshan rgyan gyis spras: khro nyer gar gyi nyams dgu ldan: zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: ma yengs ting 'dzin gsal bar bskyed: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐: oṃ badzra spho ṭa hūm̐: oṃ badzra gaṇḍe hoḥ

drug pa ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung e yi klong : sku gsung thugs yon gnas mchog nas: che mchog lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdun pa bzhugs su gsol zhing phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: che mchog zil gnon lha yi tshogs: rtog med shes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: ye grol chen po'i dkyil 'khor la: rang byung de bzhin bdag phyag 'tshal: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ brgyad pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: zil gnon dpal chen dkyil 'khor la: 'dod yon lha mo phyi mchod 'bul: gzugs sgra dri ro reg mchod 'bul: dug lnga ye shes nang mchod 'bul: bde stong dga' bzhi'i gsang mchod 'bul: phyag rgya zung 'jug gar mchod 'bul: brda skad glu dbyangs snyan mchod 'bul: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rdzas mchod 'bul: dri lnga ro brgya'i sman mchod 'bul: mkha' dbyings padma'i rakta 'bul: bcud ldan longs spyod gtor mchod 'bul: sgrol ba'i sha khrag dmar mchod 'bul: dza gad bdud rtsi'i phud mchod 'bul: rmad byung gha na'i tshogs mchod 'bul: spyan gzigs mnyes pa'i rgyan mchod 'bul: mchog gi ting 'dzin don mchod 'bul: bla med mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'di: zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mri ta ma hā rakta bha lingta ga ṇa tsakra ta na ga ṇa dharma dhā tu gu hya pū dza hoḥ dgu pa bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong : byol song gtso brgyad phyogs skyong bcu: bam̐ dang pad nyi zla gdan steng : zhi ba sgeg bzhad gsal 'tsher 'bar: mnyen lcug 'khril zhing dgyes gar ldan: khro tshogs dgod gshe rngam gtum 'jigs: 'bar zhing drag rtsal mthu stobs 'byin:

zhi dang khro gar dgyes pa'i lha: gsang ba zil gnon tshogs la bstod: bcu pa dzap bzlas la lnga/ dang po dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: bsgrub pa'i thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: chos dbyings drag sngags rang sgra 'brug ltar ldir: dbang bzhi stsol zhing dam tshig dus la bab: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub deng stsol cig / gnyis pa bzlas pa dngos la bzhi/ zhi bar bsnyen pa/ khro bor sgrub pa/ bsnyen sgrub dbyer med du bzlas pa/ las sbyor bcas so/ dang po zhi bar bsnyen pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gtso dgu'i lha rnams kyi dbu gtsug tu rigs bdag kun bzang yab yum/ spyi bo'i gnas lngar rang mthun rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang thugs srog sa bon sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ lha thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas stong gsum thams cad zhi ba'i lha dang sngags sgras gang*/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs tshur bsdus nas thim par gyur/ dam pa rigs brgya'i rtsa sngags ni/ om̐ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa sa twa kro ta mu ne ye swā hā: zhi ba zhe gnyis kyi rtsa sngags ni/ om̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ rigs lnga yab yum gyi snying po ni/ om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: zhes zhi ba'i sngags rnams sgra dal zhing 'jam la ring bar bzlas: gnyis pa khro bor sgrub pa la/ dpal chen po rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ye shes sems dpa' rdor sems dkar po'i rnam par bzhugs pa'i thugs dkyil rin chen zur brgyad nang du nyi gdan la ting 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje sngon po nas 'bru tsam gyi lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag spus bris pa tsam gyi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyen du song ljags steng āḥl bskor te shangs bug g.yas nas yum gyi shangs bug g.yon du brgyud spyi bo'i oṃ la bskor nas thugs ka nas yum gyi mkha' la bab pa las 'od 'phros/

bde gshegs thams cad mchod pas mnyes/ 'od zer slar 'dus pa dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi rang bzhin yum mkhar 'khyil ba yab kyi gsang bas rngub ste thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur/ ces gsal btab la bzla'o/ om̐ badzra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma hā kro ti shwa ri satwaṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khro bo spyi'i sngags ni/ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥ gsum pa spyi dril/ lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga'i zhal nas drag sngags 'brug sgra stong gsum gang bar bsgrags pas khams gsum chos nyid du bsgral/ ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad nas ye shes kyi me mgar gyi tshwa tshwa lta bur 'phros pas snang srid me phung gis gang*/ phyi sems can gyi las nyon phung po/ nang sgrub pa po'i rnam rtog 'khrul 'dzin/ bar gdon bgegs thams cad gzhob tu bsregs nas skye med dbyings su thim par gyur/ ces mos la/ bsnyen sgrub spyi dril sngags ni/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la ru pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces gnam lcags kyi thog rgod ltar bzla/ bzhi pa las sbyor ni/ bsnyen sgrub sngags kyi sham bu gang dgos zhi rgyas dbang drag gi kha bsgyur bya ba ni/ 'jigs pa brgyad la sogs pa sdig sgrib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa drug puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: khams gsum srid gsum gyi yon tan dang snang ba thams cad dbang du 'dus par gyur cig pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dgra bgegs dang gnod byed dug lnga thams cad tshar bcad par gyur cig hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying sngon du 'gro bas mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta gha na tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: me dpung rab 'khrigs byol song gtso brgyad steng :

che mchog dpal dgu mi bzad gar dang ldan: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dur khrod dpal chas rngam: zhi khro'i gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: ces bstod/ de nas thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor gyi: che mchog khro rol lha tshogs rnams: bskul lo thugs dam dus la bab: skye med ye shes klong yangs nas: snying po sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs: spro bsdu'i dngos grub 'byung ba'i phyir: dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: bdud bzhi dgra bgegs dpung gzhom nas: phrin las sna tshogs 'grub gyur cig: oṃ sarba bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes pas thun gtor 'bul zhing tshogs mi bya na rjes chog mchod bstod man gsham ltar byas la rdzogs rim bsdu ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas mthar bsngo smon sogs las kyi mtha' bsdu bar bya'o/ yang skabs 'gar thun rjes ma rnams su spros pa bsdu bar mos na rgyun khyer shin tu bsdus pa ni/ thog mar tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa dang*/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa ni/ skad cig gis dpal chen khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par mos la/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i dge ba rnams/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams 'od zhu rang la thim par gyur: de nas dngos gzhi ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐:

kun gzhi skye med gsal stong ngang : ma 'gags sna tshogs 'phro 'du las: spro bsgyur 'gyed pa'i sa bon gsal: oṃ bhrūm̐ hūm̐: rten dang rten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rdo rje bhrūm̐ gyur gzhal yas lte ba'i dbus: byol song gtso brgyad pad nyi ro yi steng : hūm̐ las che mchog dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: rdo rje thod pa 'dzin cing zhabs brgyad 'gyings: dbyings phyug yum 'khyud phyag gnyis gri thod 'khyud: gzi brjid gar dgu ldan pa gtso bo yi: gnas lnga yan lag bzhi ru rim pa bzhin: gshin rje rta mgrin yang dag ma mo phur: drag po 'jig rten dmod pa bya rog gdong : rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud gtso 'khor dur khrod chas: rang rang phyag mtshan sa bon 'khor bcas gsal: me dpung klong bzhugs dpa' rngam brjid par bsgom: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la ru pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ye shes dbab cing phyag mchod 'bul ba ni/ ye shes spyan drangs dam tshig bdag la thim: gnas dang phyag bgyid mchod sprin sna tshogs 'bul: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dya shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta gha na tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: me dpung rab 'khrigs byol song gtso brgyad steng : che mchog dpal dgu mi bzad gar dang ldan: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dur khrod dpal chas rngam: zhi khro'i gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa ni/ thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rdor sems kyi thugs kar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas/ snang grags snod bcud thams cad dpal chen po'i sku gsung thugs lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par gyur/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la ru pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ci nus bzla'o/ spros pa bsdu na/ hūm̐ mūṃ kro ta kro ti wa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ tsam gyis chog /shin tu spros med hūm̐ kho na la tshang*/ rjes chog sogs gong gsal ltar ram rgyas bsdus blo dang 'tshams par bya'o/ de dag ni thun phyi ma rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i rgyun khyer bsdus pa'i lugs so/ ༈ spyi don gnyis pa rjes kyi bya ba tshogs mchod mdor bsdus bya bar spro na/ dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gyis lan gsum sbyangs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gis rgyas par spel: hūm̐: stong gsum khyon ltar yangs pa'i bhandha ru: snod bcud srid pa'i gzugs snang tshogs su bshams: 'khor 'das mi dmigs yig 'brus byin gyis rlobs: bde stong bla med ye shes chen por gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs/ gnyis pa tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings skye 'gag bral ba'i pho brang nas/ /kun bzang che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams lha/ /bka' sdod gter srung dam can rgya mtsho rnams/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs gzi brjid spungs se spung : khro bo'i lha tshogs gad mo ya la la: ma sring mkha' 'gro glu gar khyugs se khyug: chos skyong dam can las byed sha ra ra: gnas 'dir gshegs la dbang bskur byin chen phob: dam rdzas tshogs la ting 'dzin bcud mchog spel: 'dir 'dus dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dbyings las 'phros pa'i mkha' 'gro mdzes ma 'phyo: phyag na nyi zla bhandha yangs pa'i snod: 'dod yon tshogs mchod lhun po ltar bkod nas: phyag rgya brda skad glu gar rtse zhing mchod: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mnyes gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa bskang ba ni/

hūm̐: gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla bye ba brgya: brjid chags mdzes ldan lta bas mi ngoms shing : rang bzhin kheng ba'i phyi nang mchod rdzas kyis: mnyes pa'i mchod rdzas phung po dpag med bkod: zhi khro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : gsang ba zil gnon lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : sgrub chen bka' brgyad thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi phyi nang mchod pa la: phud nyams lhag phri tshig la chad cing lhag: nyes sgrib skyon can rang gnong 'gyod pas bshags: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya: sogs sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes bzlas shing lhag chad bkang*/ drug pa bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: nga ni rig pa he ru ka: ro gcig lta ba khros pa'i sku: phyag g.yas thabs kyi rdo rje gsor: g.yon pas shes rab phur pa bsgril: ma rig gnyis 'dzin dgra bo rnams: snying rje'i phur bu 'debs shing bsgral: ka dag mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas shog: om̐ badzra dharma kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsgral lo/ bdun pa bstab cing 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bcom ldan kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams: chos nyid klong yangs dgyes pa'i zhal phyes shig: dug lnga ma rig bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rang grol bde ba chen por dgyes gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na khā hi: de nas tshogs la rol zhing mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob par bsam/ brgyad pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ma: dbang phyug ging dang laṅka pho nya'i tshogs: gnas bzang dur khrod 'grim zhing tshogs khang nyul: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gyon zhing bhandha thogs: skyems bzang rakta 'thung zhing ro la 'dren: nyams pa'i sha la za zhing tshogs lhag sdud: sku mdog gcer bu skra dmar sa la gzhol: lhag ma 'di bzhes bstan pa'i mel tshe mdzod:

om̐ utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: dgu pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: gsang ba zil gnon sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi: bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs ma lus pa: thugs rje phrin las mdzad phyir deng 'dir bskul: mthu stobs dpa' ba'i gzi brjid bdag la stsol: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i skabs: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan pa nub la nye: dam sri log 'dren 'byung po kha dar nas: khro chen rgya mtsho mngon spyod dus la bab: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: zhing bcu nyams pa'i dgra bo rtsad nas chod: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub pa mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ bcu pa chad mdo bya ba ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa la/ /'og min bde byed brtsegs dang mchims phu ru/ /kun bzang yab yum rig 'dzin brgyad rnams dang*/ /slob dpon chen po padma thod phreng gis/ /brgyud gsum dkyil 'khor gtad cing bstan pa'i tshe/ /dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter srung sogs/ /so so'i srog snying phul nas khas blangs bzhin/ /gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig dran par mdzod/ om̐ badzra kro ti shwa rī sa ma ya bhakṣa si bha lingta kha kha khā hi:

bcu gcig brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: bdud mo gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi bzhi ni: lhab lhub rgyan dang dar dpyangs cod pan 'phur: glu len bro rdung g.yer kha si li li: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzad du gsol: om̐ badzra pra mo ha ni hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: bcu gnyis pa rta bro ni/ de nas gtor gzhong 'og tu dgra sri bkug cing*/ hūm̐: che mchog buddha thod phreng rtsal: zhi khro gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i bro brdungs te: tshad med bzhi yi phur bu bsgrubs: btab pas dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: mnan no ru tra ma ldang cig: om̐ āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: de nas gtor gzhong yar bslangs la me tog 'thor/ bcu gsum pa dbang bzhi len pa ni/ hūm̐: bde chen 'khor lo kā ya badzra oṃ: longs spyod 'khor lo wākka badzra āḥ chos kyi 'khor lo tsitta badzra hūm̐: sprul pa'i 'khor lo gu ṇa badzra trām̐: bde spyod 'khor lo gu hya badzra hrīḥ dbang bskur yongs rdzogs yi dam lhar gyur nas: sngags dang ting 'dzin rab tu gnas gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas rang nyid ye nas yi dam lha yin bzhin ting nge 'dzin la gnas par bya/ rjes chog la/ dang po mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta gha na tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: me dpung rab 'khrigs byol song gtso brgyad steng : che mchog dpal dgu mi bzad gar dang ldan: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dur khrod dpal chas rngam: zhi khro'i gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: ces bstod/ gnyis pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig 'gal ba dang :

ma 'byor nyams dang lhag chad 'khrul pa'i tshogs: mthol zhing bshags la mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ badzra sa twa hūm̐: zhes yig brgya bzlas shing bzod gsol bya/ chad lhag bkang*/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya/ gsum pa bsdu ldang ni/ hoḥ snod bcud gzugs snang dran rig rol pa'i rtsal: rang byung gnyug ma'i ye shes lha yi tshogs: bskyed pa sprul bsgyur rdzogs pa kun gzhi'i dbyings: ka dag dran rig sbubs su mi rtog āḥ lhar snang dbyings su bsdus pas rtag mtha' bral/ a a āḥ sa mnyam par bzhag /phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ kyis lhar ldang gsang ba gsum gyis chad mtha' spang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rakṣa maṃ/ zhes go bgo zhing*/ rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ bsngo bya ka dag bsngo byed ye nas stong : bsngo yul sangs rgyas sems can kun rgyu gcig: bsngo ba'i dngos po smra bsam brjod las 'das: mtha' yas sems can rang ngo shes phyir bsngo: lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor zab mo gnyan gyi dal bzung nas: tshe rabs 'bral med yi dam lhar 'byung zhing : rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i go 'phang myur thob ste: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar shog: ces dmigs med gsal stong ngang du thun cig bzhag /drug pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos longs sprul gsum zhi khro 'dus pa yi: dkyil 'khor gnyan dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing : tshogs gnyis mthar phyin don gnyis lhun grub nas: phun tshogs yar zla ltar rgyas bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor zhing bden tshig brjod/ zhes bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi rgyun khyer snying po'i don bsdus bsgrigs chags su bkod pa 'di'ang rtsa ba gter chen nyid kyis gter gzhung la ljags bsgrigs mdzad pa'i phrin las bsdus pa sor bzhag la gsol 'debs dang gsal byed phran bu gsar du bgyis la kha 'geng dgos pa rnams bka' brgyad rang gzhung sogs rigs mthun gzhan las bsnan ste rang lugs lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi sgrub sde'i rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs bsnyen sgrub nyams len pa rnams la nyer mkhor dmigs te sgrub brtson au ḍi sogs kyis thugs bzhed bzhin bdud 'dul phrin las rol pa rtsal gyis rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu lug zla ba gnyis pa'i yar tshes su grub par bgyis pa'o//

// 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dug ri me 'bar nag po khro bo kun 'dus kyi ngan sngags zhag sgrub chog bsgrigs bklag chog tu bkod pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// // bla ma 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed gnyis su med pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ 'dir 'jigs byed dug ri nag po khro bo kun 'dus kyi ngan sngags zhag sgrub dug gi par bu mtshon cha'i las byang bklag chog tu bkod pa la gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la drug gi thog mar ji ltar 'os pa'i gnas su stegs bu kheb dmar nag gis bkab pa'i khar mchod gtor sman raka bka' gter chos srung gi gtor ma dang spyi mchod sogs bshams pa'i g.yas g.yon gang babs su phung shul gyi sa stegs dur sol gyis byugs pa'i khar hom khung dgra ling lteb cing byas pa'i khar zan gyi nya bo khrag gis byugs pa bzhag cing*/ byad thag gi sne mo dur g.yam gyi thun lam nas drangs pa rten gtor gyi res la gzugs/ khor yug tu rtsang dmar bsnol srin mo 'gros dang bya 'ug gi sgro dang thun rdzas sogs mthong rgyud ltar bsham pa phung shul ras gur phub/ gzhan yang gser skyems thun gtor dkar bgegs chad brtan tshogs kyi yo byed la sogs 'du bya'o/ thog mar brgyud 'debs ni/ e ma hoḥ sangs rgyas spyi mes rang bzhin dbyings la shar: mgon po gdod ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: rigs lnga'i gtso bo longs sku'i ston pa mchog: mi 'gyur rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs: rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad: sprul sku rdo rje sems la gsol ba 'debs: de nyid rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i rnam rgyal bum: las kyi dbang mo che la gsol ba 'debs: sde snod ma lus dgongs pa'i klong las shar: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs: mkhyen gnyis gnas lugs nyi ma mkha' la shar: mkhas pa shrī singhar gsol ba 'debs:

shes rab rtse mo sku bzhi yongs la 'gengs: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes la gsol ba 'debs: lha srin btul mdzad sde snod gcig tu bsdus: rdo rje gro bo lod la gsol ba 'debs: lha srin btul ba'i dkyil 'khor phyag rgya'i bdag: rdo rje be con ma la gsol ba 'debs: khyad chos rnam gsum gdams pa'i bka' chen bab: bal po bha su dha rar gsol ba 'debs: gshin rje 'dul rgyud so drug bka' chen bab: gnubs chen buddha dzñā nar gsol ba 'debs: bka' dgongs sgyu gsum zab chos bka' chen bab: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling la gsol ba 'debs: sku yi 'dul rgyud rdo rje rnam par rol: 'jigs byed he ru ka la gsol ba 'debs: sku yi dkyil 'khor bla med don gyis rdzogs: dug ri'i dkyil 'khor tshogs la gsol ba 'debs: zla gsang thig le dkar nag dmar po sogs: 'dus pa spyi rgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs: thugs rje'i brtse bas dgongs shing byin gyis rlobs: bum pa'i dbang bskur lha dang gnyis su med: gsang dbang ye shes bde stong zung du 'jug: sher dbang ka dag dbyings rig bya rtsol bral: tshig dbang rin chen 'khor ba yongs su grol: dbang lnga'i rjes gnang mtshams sbyor phyir mi ldog: rim skyes 'dam chu'i sbal ltar mi bying bar: gcig shar gcig po'i nya ldang ci lta bu: thod rgal nyams zad a ti'i 'bras bu 'di: rtsol med sa lam rdzogs pa'i go 'phang du: dge bas yongs su khyab pa'i don thob shog: gnyis pa skyabs sems ni/ na mo: 'di bzung byang chub snying po ma thob bar: bla ma mchog gsum 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: kun 'dus khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: gus pas skyabs mchi 'jam dpal mchog bsgrub bgyi: dkar gtor sngon du 'gro bas/ bgegs gtor bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/

na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo?khaṃ swā hā/ gsum pa bgegs 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid khro bo rdo rje nag po yi: thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya skar ltar 'phros: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs: gtor ma len phyir skad cig myur du 'dus: oṃ ya mānta ka bhū ta rā dza dza dzaḥ bzhi pa bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐ ya bhyoḥ nyon cig bgegs dang lan chags mgron: dug gsum gtor ma 'di longs la: so sor rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste bka' 'gal dam nyams na: nga nyid gshin rje khro rgyal gyi: sku gsung thugs sprul steng 'og khengs: khro chu'i mtshon cha me 'od 'khrugs: lus ngag thal ba'i rdul du rlog: de bas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis: oṃ ya mānta ka kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa srung 'khor bsgoms pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid 'jam dpal khro bo nag po yi: thugs las srung ba'i gur khang nag po 'phros: dum bu rim dgu rngam par 'jigs rung ni: phyi rol dang po ye nas stong pa'i gur: gnyis pa gnam lcags ur mo mchod rten gur: gsum pa dug rlangs khro bo nag po'i gur: bzhi pa ral gri bsam chod rdo rje'i gur: lnga pa gri gug rdo rje gtun shing gur: drug pa me ri stong nyid kā li'i gur: bdun pa 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan gur: brgyad pa khro bo dkar po nang gzigs gur: dgu pa 'jam dpal dkar po shel gyi gur: de nang bsrung bya tshud nas rdo rje yi: lte ba hūm̐ du gshin rje'i pho brang gyur: oṃ badzra ya mānta ka e ka ya ma du ru tsakra rakṣa: drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: gdug pa'i dug lnga rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i: sku lnga ye shes mchod sprin rgya mtsho ni: phyi nang dpag med khengs pa'i bdud rtsi mchog: sku mchog bdud rtsi gnyis bsdus thabs shes 'bar: zung 'jug gnyis med dgyes pa chen por bskyed: oṃ sarba pañtsa pū dza a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta oṃ āḥhūm̐:

gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa la bdun las/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐: rang byung kun gzhi mkha' ltar khyab: de las dbyings rig rtsal snang spros: kun rgyu sprul pa'i sa bon hūm̐: dbyings gyur kun snang skye med rdzogs: oṃ badzra shrī dzñā na hūm̐: gnyis pa gzhal yas lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: snang srid gdod nas e yi klong : rgyu rkyen spros pa sa bon shar: de 'gyur dug gi rlung dmar 'tshubs: zhe sdang me 'bar 'ur 'ur chem: 'dod chags rakta rlabs chen 'phyo: phrag dog keng rus ri rab brjid: ru tra sa gzhi 'khor lo bskor: rdo rje'i rmang gzhi khro chu'i dal: gru bzhi dug rlangs sngo dmar 'tsher: zur brgyad lcags bsregs dmar zhing rngam: ka gdung las gshin khro zhing gtum: nang du dur khrod brgyad ldan mdzes: thog steng don snying tsittas brgyan: srin po'i pho brang ltar snang ba: phyi nang dur khrod chas rdzogs gsal: de dbus khro chu lcags khang nang : dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum gsal: de steng gnam lcags 'khor lo ni: spu gri'i drwa ba g.yas g.yon 'khor: de dbus gnam lcags rdo rje ni: lte ba hūm̐ dang ya yis mtshan: gnas gyur skad cig gshin rje'i gshed: 'jigs byed dug ri nag po'i sku: kham nag dug gi gdong pa can: zhal dgu rngam zhing khro gtum pa: rtsa zhal dbus gdong ma he khro: g.yas g.yon kham nag srog la rngam: de steng dug gdong dmar nag mthing : de steng rigs gsum dkar dmar ser: 'jam dpal nag po'i dbang rtags rdzogs: dmar nag ral pas 'dzam gling khyab: thod skam khro rol sprul char 'bebs: sbrul nag zhags 'dren gling bzhi gtams: shangs nas dug rlangs bgegs dpung 'gyel: zhal bgrad dgra snying srog la rol: mche gtsigs sma ra smin ma mthing : dgyes pa'i gad mos stong gsum g.yo: rab 'bar bden gnyis gdug pa 'dul: rtsa phyag rdo rje phur pa 'dril:

g.yas pa bcu drug mtshon cha ni: gri khug ral gri chu gri me: kha ṭwāṃ rdo rje 'khor lo mdung : lcags kyu spu gri dbyug to dkar: ḍā ru dgra satwa zhags pa 'khyugs: tho ba gsal shing rgyal mtshan phyar: phyag g.yon bcu drug las kyi mtshon: thod khrag snying phreng rgyu ma 'dren: gtun khung lcags sgrog rnga chung ldir: mgo phreng ru mtshon dug rlangs nag: dril bu me long kong zor dmar: khram shing shwa rdel rtsis rdo nag: g.yang gzhi rdeb cing dgra yul 'joms: glang ko zhing lpags gdug pa 'dul: mgo phreng sbrul rgyan klu bdud 'dar: khrag thig zo ris dar nag brjid: tshom bu rtags rgya me dpung 'bar: spu gri'i sgro gshog stong khams g.yo: lte bar chu srin khro zhal gdangs: sku stod las kyi rtags rgya gsal: sku smad gnam lcags dbal phur rngam: byad ma dgra bo'i snying khar brdzis: sbyor yum dug ti khro mo dmar: zhal gsum sngo dmar nag la khro: spyan dgu sdang mig srid gsum g.yo: dmar nag ral pa nam mkhar khyab: thod skam dbu rgyan dug lnga 'dul: shangs nas rlung g.yos zhal gdangs bgrad: rtsa phyag gri thod yab la 'khyud: g.yas gnyis rdo rje 'khor lo phyar: g.yon gnyis phur pa ral gri brdegs: rus rgyan ga shal dar dpyangs dmar: sbrul chun gzig sham khrag zhag thig: thal tshom mi sdug rtags kyis spras: zhabs gnyis dpa' stobs yab la 'khril: kun 'dus khro bo'i thugs ka ru: khro chu dug gdong dmar nag 'bar: dbus mthing g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal: zhal gdangs spyan dgu dbu skra bskyod: rigs gsum mchod rten dbang rtags rdzogs: g.yas gsum dgra satwa g.yon gsum snying : dur khrod chas kyis sku la brgyan: sgro gshog brgyangs shing mchu sder khro: dbal phur dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: de yi thugs kar 'khor lo'i dbus: tshe bdag khro bo mthing nag 'bar: g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo gri: g.yon gsum dgra satwa sdigs mdzub me:

sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs gnyis rol stabs me dpung 'bar: de yi thugs kar rdo rje yi: lte bar srid pa 'khor lo dmar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sgeg cing khro: g.yas gnyis me dpung rdo rje gdengs: g.yon gnyis rtse gsum tsitta 'bar: dur khrod chas rdzogs rol stabs bzhugs: de yi thugs kar thig le'i dbus: hūm̐ yig mthing nag ya yig mtshan: gsal 'tsher gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: gtso bo'i spyi gtsug dmar nag me klong dbus: 'jam dpal nag po 'jigs rung mthing nag rngam: zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs byed dpal chas rdzogs: g.yas gsum ral gri gri gug rdo rje 'bar: g.yon gsum po ti snying phreng thod khrag 'thung : sgro gshog brgyangs shing rdo rje'i dbal zur ldan: de yi thugs kar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dbus: rta mgrin dmar smug zhal gsum phyag drug ni: g.yas gsum dbyug to rdo rje tho ba phyar: g.yon gsum lcags sgrog zhags pa dril bu 'khrol: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum me dpung klong na brjid: de yi thugs kar zla gdan 'khor lo'i dbus: gsang bdag mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa sdigs mdzub bsgrengs: dur khrod chas rdzogs rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs: de yi thugs kar nā da thig le'i dbus: hrīḥyig dmar ser bkrag mdangs lam mer gsal: hūm̐: gtso bo'i spyi gtsug 'ja' zer klong : 'jam dpal dkar po phyag bzhi pa: g.yas gnyis ral gri shel phreng dkar: g.yon gnyis po ti utpal dmar: skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: de yi thugs kar 'od kyi klong : rdo rje dkar po gsal stong bsgom: phyi rol 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad steng : shar du dgra nag khro bo gtum: zhal gsum phyag drug phur gsham brjid: g.yas gsum sbrul zhags rgyal mtshan gri: g.yon gsum khyab 'jug zhags pa me: dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs par bsgom: lho ru ki kang dmar nag rngam:

zhal gsum phyag drug dur khrod chas: g.yas gsum gsal shing gtun dang mdung : g.yon gsum rgyu zhags mgo snying dmar: dbal ldan drag tu rngam par bskyed: nub tu me yi spu gri kham: zhal gsum phyag drug phur gsham ldan: g.yas gsum spu gri dkar dmar sngo: g.yon gsum chu gri sngo nag ljang : dur khrod chas rdzogs dpa' zhing brjid: byang du gdong drug mthing nag rngam: g.yas gsum dug mda' rdo rje gri: g.yon gsum lcags gzhu dril bu thod: dur khrod chas ldan rngam zur bskyed: mtshams bzhir dug ti rtsa 'jib bzhi: rdo rje phur pa 'dril zhing khro: yab la dgyes shing dur khrod chas: me chu dug mtshon dbus su brjid: phyi rol sgo ma gdong can bzhi: bya rog kaṅka 'ug pa khyung : gcer mo mi sdug gzugs 'chang zhing : phyag mtshan sgo bzhi'i phyag rgya ldan: gzhan yang las gshin dmag tshogs rnams: dgra bo'i sha khrag srog la rngam: las bcol bka' bzhin sgrub par gyur: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros 'og min zhing khams nas: 'jam dpal khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sku: gshin rje gshed po'i dkyil 'khor lha: ye shes gnas nas spyan drangs te: bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: sku gsung thugs kyi nus pa bskyed: phrin las rnam bzhi'i rtsal phyungs la: phyi nang mi mthun bar chad sol: dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar bcad nas: sku gsum lha ru bdag gyur cig:

gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ ya bhyoḥ 'og min lhun grub pho brang nas: rigs bdag 'jam dpal gshegs su gsol: lho phyogs rab 'jigs dur khrod nas: 'jigs byed dug ri gshegs su gsol: gshin yul lcags mkhar nag po nas: sras mchog rigs bzhi gshegs su gsol: 'chi bdag las kyi pho brang nas: sgo skyong yang 'khor gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥdzaḥ bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: las gshin dug ri khro bo'i rgyal: bdag la dbang bskur byin brlab phyir: rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir bzhugs: om̐ ya mānta ka sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje kī la ya: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi: khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rab tu dwang bas phyag bgyid do: om̐ ya mānta ka sa ma ya: a ti pu hoḥ drug pa phyi nang gsang ba'i gtor tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba la/ dang po phyi mchod ni/ hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga dang : dur khrod bdag po dgra la rngam pa'i gar: pho nyas dgra bo'i bla 'bod 'debs pa'i gdangs: rtag tu dur khrod bdag mor sbyor ba sogs: drag po phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs 'di: khro rgyal dug ri'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe lā sye mā lye gīrti nīrti pū dza āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa nang mchod ni/ hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes ngo bo mchog: sha chen la sogs khu ba'i rdzas dang sbyar: sman mchog ngad ldan dug rigs sbyar ba'i phud: 'bru bcud myos pa'i dza gad chang la sogs: drag po nang gi mchod pa sna tshogs 'di: khro rgyal dug ri'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul:

pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥkha kha khā hi: gsum pa gsang mchod sbyor sgrol tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: lha mo dus mtshan nag mo'i mkha' lam nas: las kyi rlung gis bskyod pa'i bdud rtsi dang : rigs bzang a haṃ drug tu sbyor ba yi: bde stong dga' bzhi bsrubs pa'i bdud rtsi dang : gzhan yang ma chags chags pa chen po'i khrag: dga' chen ston pa'i gsang mchod sna tshogs 'di: khro rgyal dug ri 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ a haṃ pañtsa rakta mu kha kunda sa ma ya pū dza khā hi: hūm̐ ya: 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po mnyes pa'i rdzas: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bhandha lcang lo ru: 'bru nag gri khrag brlan dang sbags pa yi: ba liṃ gtor ma sha sna snying snas brgyan: dar nag gdugs dang bla 'khor srog rten bkod: ma rungs gdug pa'i don snying 'bras bus brgyan: tshogs mchod la sogs dgyes shing mthun pa'i rdzas: thod rnga rkang gling rol mo sna tshogs dang : dur khrod bkod pa spyan gzigs sprin ltar 'khrigs: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'di: khro rgyal dug ri 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: pha rol rgol ba gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha kha khā hi khā hi: bdun pa bstod cing bsngags pa ni/ hūm̐ e ya bhyoḥ skye med ngang las ma g.yos rigs kyi bdag: bdud bzhi 'byung po'i tshogs rnams tshar gcod phyir: sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: ral gri shel phreng pu ti utpal bsnams: zhi 'dzum mdzes ldan gzhon nu'i rnam par rol: longs spyod rdzogs sku bde stong cha lugs 'chang : sgrub la shes rab dbang bzhi stsol ba'i lha:

sku lnga ye shes rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: stobs ldan dbang phyug mu stegs rgol 'joms pa: sku yi rang bzhin 'jigs byed gtum la rngam: gsung gi rang bzhin dbang chen drag sngags ldir: thugs kyi rang bzhin gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin: tshe yi rang bzhin gzi brjid dpal dang ldan: dur khrod dpal chas 'bar ba'i gar dgus brjid: ye shes me 'bar rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'khyil: rigs gsum dbang rtags rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ e ya: gtum drag khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: srog la rngam byed 'chi bdag gshin rje'i gshed: pha rol kun gyi gshed ma lho phyogs bdag: 'jigs byed kun gyi sde dpon khro bo'i rgyal: stobs ldan rdo rje dug ri mthu bo che: sku mdog dud kha me 'od chi li li: rtsa zhal khros pa ma he'i nga ro 'byin: ra gnyis rtse nas thog ser dgra la 'debs: rtsa zhal kham nag khro gnyis hūm̐ sgra sgrog: steng gsum dmar nag mthing bas bon byad 'joms: de steng dkar dmar ser bas ban byad 'joms: zhal dgu rab tu khros pas snang srid dngangs: dbu skra dmar nag bskyod pas lha srin 'dul: g.yas pa bcu drug mtshon cha 'khrugs pa yis: dgra bo pho rgyud rtsad gcod phye mar brlag: g.yon pa bcu drug mtshon cha 'khrugs pa yis: dgra bo mo rgyud rigs rgyud mngal nas skem: rtsa phyag ri rab phur bu bsgril ba yis: pha rol rgol ba'i tshogs rnams phyung zhing brdeg: spu gri'i sgro gshog tshwa tshwa 'thor ba yis: ma rungs gdon tshogs 'byung po klad nas skem: dur khrod dpal chas rngam pa'i gar ldan gyis: snang srid yongs kyi byad kha dgra la 'beb: lte bar chu srin rkan sgra rdeb pa yis: bsam pa tsam gyis ru tra'i snying khrag rol: sku smad gnam lcags phur gsham ngar ma yis: dam nyams log 'dren bla srog gtub cing gcod: zur gsum dbal las thog ser g.yo ba yis: ma rungs bgegs tshogs phye mar rab tu 'thag:

sku la dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba yis: pha rol kun gyi rgol ba 'joms mdzad pa: 'jigs byed chen po dug ri'i sku la 'dud: hūm̐ bhyo ya: las kyi yum chen ma mo dur khrod bdag: dug ti nag mo rdo rje rab 'bar ma: snang srid yongs la dbang sgyur srog gi bdag: sku mdog dmar nag srin mo'i cha lugs 'chang : khams gsum za byed zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: dbus dmar g.yas dkar g.yon mthing srid gsum sngangs: g.yas gsum mtshon chas log lta phye mar bcom: g.yon gsum mtshon chas 'byung po'i klad khrag rol: dur khrod chas rdzogs dam nyams 'dre rgod dngangs: zhabs gnyis 'khril sbyor las kyi gshin rje bskul: ba spu'i gseb nas rang 'dra ma mo 'gyed: gshin rje'i lcam mo snang srid dbang mo che: dur khrod bdag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ ya: 'jigs byed sku yi 'khor lo yangs pa'i klong : thugs rje dbang phyug khro chu dug gdong sku: mthing nag dkar dmar rab khros rngam zhal bgrad: phyag drug mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la 'bebs: spu gri'i sgro gshog log 'dren rtsad nas gcod: dur khrod chas ldan ru tra phye mar brlag: chu srin zhal bgrad ma rungs snying khrag 'thung : gnam lcags dbal gsham bstan pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: las kyi gshin rje pha rol rgol 'joms pa: khro chu dug gdong 'bar ba'i sku la bstod: hūm̐ ya: ye shes 'khor lo rab 'bar chos kyi dbyings: gsung gi dbang phyug tshe bdag 'bar ba'i sku: mthing nag dkar dmar rab rngam zhal gsum bgrad: phyag drug rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri dang : dgra satwa sdigs mdzub me dpung dgra bgegs 'joms: dur khrod chas ldan ru tra phye mar brlag: zhabs gnyis dor stabs sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem: las kyi gshin rje pha rol rgol 'joms pa: zil gnon tshe bdag 'bar ba'i sku la bstod: hūm̐ ya: dwangs ma'i thugs mchog rdo rje'i gzhal yas klong : srid gsum 'khor los sgyur rgyal dmar ser sgeg:
