bdud dang bar chad nyon mongs log 'dren gshed: 'jigs pa'i gzugs la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad: me dpung rdo rje rtse gsum dgra bgegs 'joms: tsitta dmar po nyon mongs zhal du rngub: zhi zhing 'dzum pas 'gro rnams thabs kyis skyong : khro zhing gtum pas log par 'dren byed 'dul: zhi khro 'bar ba'i gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: grub pa'i stobs 'byin rdo rje pha lam sku: dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ ya: khor yug gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la: las kyi khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: shar du dgra 'dul nag po gtum zhing khro: lho ru ki kang dmar nag srog la rngam: nub tu me yi spu gri kham nag 'jigs: byang du gdong drug mthing nag byad ma'i gshed: kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug dpal gyi chas: phyag mtshan mtshon cha 'bar bas log 'dren gzhom: gnam lcags dbal gsham bstan dgra rtsad nas gcod: sras mchog 'bar ba sde bzhi'i sku la bstod: mtshams bzhi dug ti ma mo rtsa 'jib bzhi: snang srid dbang sgyur srid gsum srog gi bdag: khro gtum nyams ldan rdo rje phur bu 'dril: dur khrod chas rdzogs me chu dug mtshon 'khrugs: dmar chen 'bar bas gtso bo mnyes mdzad pa: yum mchog brjid pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ ya: pho brang chen po'i phyogs bzhi sgo skyong ba: las kyi gshin rje ma mo srog gi bdag: srin mo'i gzugs can dgra sha khrag la dgyes: dur khrod g.yang gzhi'i gos gyon shams se sham: phyag g.yas rang rang sgo chas log 'dren gzhom: g.yon pa'i bhan dmar dgra bgegs rakta 'thung : rngam pa'i gar sgyur bdud dpung rtsad nas gcod: sgo skyong rigs bzhi ma mor phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gzhan yang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bka' sdod pa: pho nya las byed sprul pa bye ba 'bum: rlung ltar 'tshub cing dgra yul phye mar brlag:

mi sdug gzugs 'chang 'jigs pa'i gad mo sgrog: las kyi mtha' sdud shan pa bye ba 'bum: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs 'dus la bdag bstod do: bzlas pa la 'jug khar rang nyid gtso bo sku mdog zhal phyag la sogs pa'i rnam pa gsal ba dang*/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal shugs drag po rgyun ci ring du bsgoms nas de la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa bzlas pa sngags kyi rim pa la drug /dang po dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs: deng 'dir thugs dam gnyan po rgyud bskul na: rig 'dzin sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bstan la sdang ba'i log 'dren rtsad nas chod: thugs dam dus las ma 'da' sa ma ya: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: gnyis pa bzlas pa ni/ gtso bo rnams kyi thugs kar thabs shes nyi zla kha sbyor gyi lte bar yab rnams hūm̐ mthing khog par ya dmar nag gis mtshan pa dang*/ yum gyi thugs kar bhyo dmar nag /rigs bdag gi thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar ser dbang rtags 'jam dpal nag po'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga sgo ma bzhi yi thugs kar dza hūm̐ baṃ ho/ zhes pa rnams rang mdog gsal 'tsher bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i mtha' skor du rang rang gi srog sngags rnams rang mdog la gting mdangs dmar ba tshwa zer 'khyugs pa g.yas bskor du rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar srid gsum 'gul ldeg chem chem du g.yo zhing 'khor bas/ thugs dam rgyud bskul thugs srog gi 'od kyis sngags phreng rnams gsal ba'i stobs shugs bskyed/ sngags phreng rnams kyi 'od sgras thugs srog nus stobs rgyas/ zung 'jug gi 'od dang sgras nyi zla g.yo zhing tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i klong las drag sngags me dpung mtshon cha thog rgod tshwa tshwa drag tu 'khor zhing*/ mched pas srid pa gsum gyi bdud rigs log par 'dren pa thams cad bsad gtubs thal bar brlag cing de dag gi stobs rtsal nus pa rang la thim pas gzi brjid ches cher rgyas par

bsams la sngags bzlas/ oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka kā la rū pa ki kang du tri ya ma rā dza sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes chu bo'i rgyun ltar bzla'o/ yang skabs su thugs srog sngags phreng 'od kyis rtsa khams bskul bas sku'i dpa' stobs cher g.yos pa'i shugs kyis phyi dbyings 'byung ba'i khams rnams g.yo zhing 'khrugs pas/ log 'dren byad ma rnams 'byung ba rang gshed du gyur nas rang byung gi mtshon chas gtubs shing gtor te las byed kyi pho nyas hub der lhag med du zos nas/ lhag mar 'dzin pa'i snang ba yang las rlung gis spur/ ngar 'dzin gyi rtog pa phra rags ye shes 'bar ba'i dbus su bsregs/ tshe srog dwangs ma bkrag mdangs 'od lnga'i thig ler g.yo ba rnams rigs bdag gi 'od zer gyis 'ub 'ub bsdus te/ bum pa'i bcud 'khyil zhing rgyas te lud pa rnams tshangs bug nas dbu mar brgyud de/ rtsa chen rtsa phran sogs rtsa gnas thams cad 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams pas gzi brjid rngam pa'i stobs shugs ches char 'bar zhing*/ khyad par du yang bsgrub bya dang srid gsum khams na gnas pa'i byang chub sgrub pa sogs/ rnam dkar gyi mos 'dun phra rags dang ldan pa rnams kyi 'byung khams stobs su smin te tshe bsod dpal 'byor nus stobs dkar po dge ba'i rten 'brel thams cad 'phel ba'i shugs dang*/ spobs pa'i stobs rgyas te snang stong khro rgyal gyi sku yi rnam rol gtso 'khor tha mi dad pa yom yom shig shig 'khrug 'khrug pa bro 'dus kyi rnam par gsal ba dang*/ yang skabs su dkyil 'khor lha yi 'khor lo'i rnam par mched de/ chos dbyings kyi khyon gang bar phyam brdal/ slar rim par tshur 'dus thugs srog yungs 'bru tsam la shes pa gtad pa sogs/ ting 'dzin 'phro 'du'i rtsal sbyong bar bya'o/ bsnyen rkyang gi skabs gsham gsal rbad bsad sngags rnams ma byas kyang rung ngo*/ gsum pa las sbyor dang 'brel na rbad sngags bzlas pa ni/

om̐ ya mānta ka kā la rū pa du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma raksha e ka ya ma ki kang hring kā la du ru dzaḥ pha la dzaḥ dgra bo'i bla srog la dza dzaḥ trag raksha kā la du tri dgra bo'i snying la dza dzaḥkhug: ya ma du ru dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: snying la bhyo thun thun: ya ma raṃ shag du dgra bo dza dzaḥ zhes bzlas shing 'gug gzhug drag po bya/ bzhi pa bsad sngags ni/ om̐ ya mānta ka yaksha ya ma rā dza dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: snying la chod chod: e ka ya ma du ru nā ga dgra bo'i sha la rbad rbad: tsitta zungs zungs: chum nā ga sha tri dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: ki kang kā la raksha byad ma'i yul zhing la bhyo bhyoḥ raṃ ha la du byad ma'i snying rtsa la chod chod: ma mo mu kha dunting dgra bo'i sha la rbad: rtsa la yam yam: ra tsa snying ya ma du nag po shag tshal pa ha la ha la raksha rbad chod: bhandha bhandha nṛ tri khroṃ mā ra ya byad ma bhyo bhyoḥ zhes bzla zhing thun gyis brab/ rbad bsad kyi sngags yod med gang ltar yang*/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya sbrel ba dang*/ rten 'brel snying po rnams gsum gsum bzla'o/ lnga pa dzap kyi mchod bstod ni/ oṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi:

zhes pas mchod/ hūm̐ yaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje kī la ya: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi: khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /rab gus dwang bas phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod/ drug pa thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa dang : gshin rje gshed po za byed me gdong can: dug ri nag po pha rol rgol 'joms kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa'i mthus: dmigs pa'i byad ma dgra bgegs thams cad kun: drag po'i thun gtor 'di la myur du khug: om̐ ya ma rā dza bhyo bhyoḥ dgra bo'i bla srog khug dza dzaḥ hūm̐: dzaḥyig dmar nag 'phros pa gtor mar thim: spu gri'i rang bzhin gyur nas dgra bgegs gtub: tshe bsod 'ub bsdus rnal 'byor bdag la thim: sha khrag gshin rje mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur: sman raka gis bran la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gtor ma sman raka dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: rtsa sngags kyi sham bur/ dgra bgegs sha trum mā ra ya i daṃ bha lingta ghṛ hṇa sa ma ya khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: dgra bgegs gdug pa bdud kyi tshogs: sde dpung 'khor dang bcas pa yi: sha khrag bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'di: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i tshogs la 'bul: las dang bag chags dag pa dang : rang gshed bsam sbyor ngan pa kun: kho rang la ni bzlog pa dang : rang mtshon rang la zug pa dang : rang sha rang gis za bar mdzod: rang sde rang gis phye mar thongs: rdul cha tsam yang med par mdzod: hūm̐: gtum chen rab 'bar khro bo'i rje: dug ri khro 'dus kī la ya: sras 'khor gshed chen pho nya'i tshogs: 'jigs tshul rngam pa'i nga ro yis: gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul ba dang : bdag srungs rkyen dang bar chad zlog: om̐ badzra kro ta rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsrung bzlog phrin las bcol/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa tshogs mchod bskul dang chad brtan rta bro dbang blang bsdu rim bsngo smon bkra shis bcas las gzhung chen mo bzhin bya'o/

zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshogs mchod spro bar mos na/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyis byin brlab pa ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos rnams dmigs med de bzhin nyid: sme ba'i gtsang btsog ka nas dag: rang byung rgya yan lhun grub las: ting 'dzin tshogs kyi 'khor lor shar: ye nas zag med bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ dharma dzñā na pra ti pū dza hoḥ gnyis pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: rtsa gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa yi: bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rngam chen me ltar 'bar ba yi: dur khrod e yi klong dkyil nas: 'jigs byed dpa' bo gshin rje'i gshed: dug ri me 'bar lha tshogs rnams/ tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ gsum pa tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ ya: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed chen po: 'jigs byed khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra la kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa bskang ba bya ba ni/ hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi dbang po dang : byad ma'i sha khrag rus pa nang rol bcas: ga ṇa'i tshogs kyi mchod sogs mnyes pa'i rdzas: phyi nang gsang ba'i spyan gzigs du ma 'dis: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po yi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mi mthun gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar bcad cing : mthun rkyen bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hoḥ bdag blo gti mug 'thug pos rab rmongs nas: bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa'i dam bca' g.yel ba dang : tshul bzhin ma ldan bag med dbang gyur tshogs: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol:

ces pa yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang*/ drug pa tha ma bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal 'jam dpal nag po'i sprul pa ni: 'chi bdag gshin rje dgra 'dul kī la ya: phyag gnyis 'joms byed las kyi phur bu 'dril: ru tra gdug pa'i snying la kī la ya: bcad gtub rdul du rlog cig mā ra ya: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān ru tra trig nan gzer thum rbad myog: bdun pa bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: 'joms byed mtshon cha 'bar ba'i 'khor lo yis: dgra bgegs gzugs phung phye mar rab bshig ste: bhandhar bskyil ba'i sha khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs zhal du 'bul: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta i daṃ bha lingta kha hi: tshogs la rol/ brgyad pa lhag ma gtong ba ni/ hūm̐ ya bhyoḥ dur khrod 'bar ba'i pho brang mtha' skyong ba: ya ba ya ma dregs sde shan pa'i tshogs: sha za dmar nag zangs kyi mche ba can: mi sdug gzugs can dgra la bla 'gugs 'debs: rngam stabs lang ling g.yang gzhi dmar po gyon: mgo snying thogs nas rgyu ma 'dren zhing rgyug: ging chen dbyug pa thogs nas bshugs sgra 'debs: skra dmar ral bsigs srin po'i las nyul bzhin: gshin rje'i bka' sdod dregs sde bye ba 'bum: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod: om̐ ya wa ha ri ya ma ra ti sa ma ya i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: dgu pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ rnga brdung dung bus gtor ma la raktas bran zhing dpal 'bar 'dzugs la/ hūm̐ e ya: gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: mi bzad khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: sprul pa yang sprul pha rol rgol tshogs 'joms: bzhengs shig 'chi bdag pho brang dbus nas bzhengs: dbyings nas bzhengs la rbad bskul las la chos:

pha rol dam nyams ru tra gdug pa'i tshogs: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'tshe: bsam sbyor ngan pa 'chang ba'i byad ma rnams: lo zla zhag dus tshes la ma 'da' bar: sgrol zhing brlags nas ming yang med par mdzod: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dus la bab bo 'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogs: stong gsum ru tra bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka a kro te ka sa ma ya dgra bgegs kyi bla srog dbugs la thun thun sha khrag la khā hi: bcu pa chad mdo gtong ba ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa ru/ /gsang chen rol dang arya pā lo'i gling*/ khrom gzigs 'jam dpal sku yi pho brang nas/ /'jam dpal gshin rje padma thod phreng rtsal/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rtsa gsum gling sogs kyis/ /zla gsang gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes shing*/ /zab gter gtad cing gter du bzhes pa'i tshe/ /las gshin bya rog gdong dang gter srung bcas/ /so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang*/ /bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /pha rol rgol ba 'joms pa'i phrin las mdzod/ om̐ kro ta kro ti sarba i daṃ bha lingta la khā hi: bcu gcig pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis tshogs: la la ye shes la la 'jig rten tshul: don la 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bka' nyan ma: bstan pa srung ba'i ma sring 'khor bcas kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod: om̐ ma ma shag shag dum dum le le ting ting dza dza i daṃ bha lingta khā hi: bcu gnyis pa rta bro bya ba ni/ hūm̐: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po ru: rngam chen 'jigs byed gshin rje'i lha tshogs kyi: dbal ldan ru tra'i snying khar bro rdung bas: ma rungs gdug pa'i bgegs srin phye mar bcom: phyin chad dam sri ma ldang rgyas gdab bo:

om̐ ya ma ya nan: wa ru ṇa nan: ma ru nan: ru tra laṃ nan: dam sri mā ra ya nan: bcu gsum pa dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: bde chen gsang ba snying po rdo rje'i mkha': yang dag ye shes 'jam dpal dpa' bo yi: sku gsung thugs yon 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: mthu rtsal gzi byin chen po'i dpal yon gyis: deng 'dir dbang bskur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: 'dod don yid bzhin kun kyang lhun grub nas: zab gsang dpal 'bar rgyas mdzad ston par stsol: om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka sarba siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rjes chog la drug /dang po mchod bstod ni/ om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka sa pa ri wā ra badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas mchod/ hūm̐ yaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje kī la ya: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi: khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ rab gus dwang bas phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod/ gnyis pa bshags pa ni/ hoḥ bdag blo gti mug 'thug pos rab rmongs nas: bskyed rdzogs bsgrub pa'i dam bca' g.yel ba dang : tshul bzhin ma ldan bag med dbang gyur tshogs: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: yi ge brgya pas bshags/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar la/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ldang ni/ hoḥ snang stong lha sku sgyu ma'i ngang tshul las: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug spro bsdu'i 'du tshan dag: dgongs pa zang thal dmigs med mkha' ru bsdu: a a āḥ zhes bsdus la/ slar yang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dpa' bo gcig pa'i skur lam gyis gsal la/ om̐ hriṣṭi wi kri ta na na ya ma rā dza badzra dzwa la raṃ kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ go cha'i rgya dang bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rakṣa maṃ/ go bgo zhing lus srung*/ bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ mtha' yas 'gro kun tshogs zhing padmo'i tshal: thugs rje'i sprin gtibs byin rlabs char chen po:

smin grol zab mo'i 'bras bu rab smin te: bcud kyi ting 'dzin ro brgya 'gro la bsngo: lnga pa smon lam bya ba ni/ hoḥ shes rab ye shes dpa' bo 'jam mgon gyi: go 'phang 'grub ste don gnyis gnas lnga yi: gdeng chen mi g.yo rtogs pa'i 'bras bu nyid: nam yang bag yod dge ba'i mthu ldan shog: drug pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: sku mchog gzhon nu gzi 'od rab 'khyil ba: thugs rje'i klong yangs drwa ba'i 'od zer gyis: srid pa'i ma dag lteng ka rab bskams te: lham mer rtag tu gsal mdzad bkra shis shog: bla med theg chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho yi: thos bsam sgom sgrub nyams len gling zhugs nas: don gnyis mchog la spyod pa'i nor bu nyid: nam yang kun 'grub dge legs bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis bsngo smon sogs kyis mtha' rgyas par bya'o/ de ltar 'jam dpal gshin rje khro 'dus kyi zhag sgrub chog bsgrigs bklag chog tu bkod pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal zhes pa 'di'ang bstan 'gror smin ched skyid grong smyon pas gzhung gi mtshams sbyor dang med du mi rung ba re zung bcas snga gter gong ma las blangs te rang gnas nor skyong klu'i gter phug tu bsgrigs shing nus ldan du sgrub pa 'dis kyang bstan dgra'i bdud dpung rmang med du gzhom pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gong gsal rig 'dzin grub dbang thugs mchog rdo rje'i chog khrigs 'dir rjes kyi bya ba tshogs sogs gzhung la zhal 'phang mdzad pa rnams cung zad tshig sna bstung zhing dkyus su bkod la yig chung rnams kha gsal du btang nas gsar bu ba rnams 'jug bde ba'i dbang du byas te gu hyas sbyar ba'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi bsnyen sgrub sogs nyer mkho'i phrin las snying po gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ dpag yas mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang ches 'bar bas/ /log rtog smag rum mthar mdzad khro bo'i dbang*/

/'jigs byed dug ri'i lha la nyer btud nas/ /phrin las snying po gsal byed 'di na spro/ de yang bsnyen sgrub sogs kyi tshe/ dang po ni las can dag thun drug gam/ thun bzhi nges par rang lugs pa rnams/ gzhung gi phrin las thun thams cad la bgyis na/ bsnyen grangs gnod phyir mi lcogs shing*/ de la thor thun snga thun la gter gzhung ltar dang*/ de phyin gyi thun lhag ma rnams 'di ltar 'jug pa bde phyir spros pa ste/ brgyud 'debs spyi ltar bya bsdu na/ 'jam dpal ya mānta ka'i dgongs pa yis: slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang : ro langs bde ba'i bar du byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: sku yi brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol? mthing nag e las drag po'i gzhal yas na: gshin rje chu glang brdzis pa'i gdan steng du: 'jam dpal ya mānta ka gshin rje'i gshed: gshed po khro bo dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs la gsol? 'og min chos kyi? sngon 'gro skyabs sems ni/ na moḥ 'di bzung byang chub snying po ma thob bar: bla ma mchog gsum 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: kun 'dus khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: gus pas skyabs mchis 'jam dpal mchog 'grub shog: gtor mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: gdug pa'i dug lnga rgyu can las byung ba'i/ sku dang ye shes mchod sprin rgya mtsho ni/ phyi nang dpag med khengs pa'i bdud rtsi mchog: sku mchog bdud rtsi gnyis bsdus thabs shes 'bar: zung 'jug gnyis med dgyes pa chen por bskyed: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta pū dza oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum/ lha bskyed ni/ hūm̐: bskal par brtsegs pa'i zhing rdul 'byung lnga'i khams: ye nas e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ri rab steng : rdo rje rgya gram gzhal yas lte bar hūm̐: yongs gyur 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri nag:

dbu dgu so bzhi'i phyag la sku smad dbal: rdo rje dur khrod bdag mo zhal gsum sbyor: bde chen bskul ba'i mkha' nas sras bzhi 'gyed: sgo skyong las byed sprul pa bye ba 'bum: ma 'dres gtso 'khor dran rdzogs wal gyis gsal: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas lnga'i sa bon gyis: 'og min zhing dang lho phyogs gshin rje'i gnas: rang rang pho brang klong nas spyan drangs gyur: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ ya bhyoḥ 'og min lhun grub pho brang nas: rigs bdag 'jam dpal gshegs su gsol: lho phyogs rab 'jigs dur khrod nas: 'jigs byed dug ri gshegs? sras mchog rigs bzhi? sgo skyong yang 'khor gshegs? oṃ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ bzhugs gsol phyag mchod ni: hūm̐: las gshin dug ri khro bo'i tshogs: rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir bzhugs: rab gus dwang bas phyag bgyid do: phyi mchod lha mo gar sgyur 'bul: nang mchod sman gtor rakta 'bul: spyan gzigs bkram pa sna tshogs 'bul/ bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: oṃ puṣpe sogs? rū pa sogs? oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta gu hya sa ma ya dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi:

bstod pa ni: hūm̐ ya bhyoḥ skye med ngang las ma g.yos rigs kyi bdag: longs sku tshe yi mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod: stobs ldan dbyings phyug khro tshul dpa' stobs can/ mu stegs 'joms mdzad 'jam dpal nag por bstod: gtum drag khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod nas: srog la rngam byed 'chi bdag gshin rje ni: phas rgol kun gyi gshed ma lho phyogs bdag: 'jigs byed kun gyi sde dpon khro bo rgyal: stobs ldan dug ri yab yum sku la bstod: shar lho nub byang gshin rje'i dur khrod nas: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rol pa'i gar: rigs bzhi yum sbyor ma sring dbang du sdud: sras mchog rigs bzhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: gzhan yang 'jig rten gshin rje'i bka' sdod pa: pho nya las byed sprul pa bye ba 'bum/ rlung ltar 'tshub cing dgra yul phye mar brlag /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs 'dus la bdag bstod do: 'dzab bskul ni: hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs: deng 'dir thugs dam gnyan po'i rgyud bskul nas: rig 'dzin sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bstan la sdang ba'i log 'dren rtsad nas chod: thugs dam dus la ma 'da' sa ma ya: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bzlas dmigs ni/ gtso 'khor de dag thugs ka ru: drag sngags spu gri gtams pa bzhin: 'brug ltar sgra sgrogs g.yas su 'khor: gnas pa hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du las: bdag med ye shes me dpung 'bar: snod bcud gshin rje gshed po yi: rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ngang du gsal: oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka a kro ti ka du tri ya ma rā dza ya ma raksha kro ta pa tsa la ti kā la rū pa badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzlas pa'i skyon drug spangs te gcig dril mos 'dun rtse gcig tu bsnyen pa dang*/ las rlung gi rdor bzlas dang*/ yid bzlas kyi skyo sangs dang*/

nyams kyi rtsal 'don phyir rngam dbyangs kyi bzlas pa sogs sgrub pa'i nyams dang sbyar te/ sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi srog thob nges su bsnyen cing bsgrub par bya/ gzhung las bsnyen tshad 'bum phrag bshad pa yang las rung tsam du dgongs pa las/ gang zag rab 'bring tha gsum gyi blo bsnyen tshad yang*/ gzhung tshig kho nar bcad dus su 'dod pa la ni ma lags so/ de ltar lus snang stong lha sku/ ngag grags stong gsung sgra/ yid bde stong zung 'jug khyab brdal chen por dbang 'byor ba rnams gang 'dul der ston gyi ting 'dzin 'bum phrag cig car du 'gyed pa la 'di ltar spros che ru mi mtshar yang*/ dang po las can blo rmongs rnams zab lam du 'jug bde phyir/ 'jam dpal ye shes rol pa'i mdzod chen las/ cung zad phyung ba ste rang bzos sgro btags ni ma lags so/ thun mtshams su mchod bstod bshags gsol ni/ ā li sku yi bskyed rim dang kā li gsung gi bzlas brjod/ yig brgya thugs kyi ting 'dzin zab mo'i klong du ma gyur bas nyams chag bshags shing*/ rten 'brel snying po'i sgo gsum ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas shing brtan par mos la/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya sbrel ba dang*/ rten 'brel snying po rnams gsum gsum bzlas pa'o/ oṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas mchod/ hūm̐ yaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje kī la ya: 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi: khro rgyal dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ rab gus dwang bas phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod/ āḥ 'khor 'das snang grags rdo rje gsum gyi dbyings/ sku gsum ngang rdzogs 'od gsal thig le gcig /ma skyes ma 'gags dran shes so ma'i ngang*/ mtha' yas 'gro rnams rtag tu la gnas shog / ces nyer bsdu dang bsngo ba bya ste thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug /bsnyen rtags rdzogs nas bskang brgya dang*/

me mchod ci nus su 'bad par bya'o/ gzhan yang dmigs gsal pa'i lam 'dir gcig dril rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du brtson pa la las bzhi lhun grub gcig chog yid bzhin nor bu'i ting 'dzin chos zab pa dang yon bdag sogs thag ring bsgrub bya gal chen la/ tshe dbang brgya rtsa'i dmigs phran sogs zhib cha mtha' dag rdo rje slob dpon gyi zhal lung las longs shig /de ltar 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi/ phrin las zin bris snying po gsal byed ces bya ba dang*/ 'jam dpal ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du rnam par rol pa'i lta sgom gyi drod dang khungs ldan gyi man ngag zung 'brel du bkod pa 'di yang 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i gsang mdzod du mngon par phyug pa/ me nyag sgom chen padma rgya mtsho dang tshe rabs du mar mngon spyod dmod pa'i phrin las kyi bka' bab yongs su grub pa sngags 'chang kun dga' blo gros zung gis nan cher gyis bkas bskul ngo ma ldog par/ phyogs med spyod pa'i dā ri dra skyid grong smyon pas khrom gzigs rngam pa rong gshin rje rol pa'i pho brang du sbyar ba'o// // pha) rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ e ma ho/ snang ba mtha' yas 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter/ /pad 'byung yab yum gnubs ban dzñā na'i mtshan/ /sprul pa'i gter 'byin rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs char rgyun stsol/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpal/ /gcig bsdus bdag nyid dbang chen yab yum dang*/ /thugs mchog gsang bdag las mdzad rnam gnyis la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /nyon mongs rang rgyud 'khrul pa'i dug gsum bdud/ /gnyis med ye shes sku gsum dbyings su dag /sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rol par sad/ /dbang chen he ru ka par mngon gyur shog / ces pa'ang mant+ra'i ngor gu hyas so// // ba) ༈ rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub 'don khrigs su bkod pa rngam pa'i rta skad ces bya ba bzhugs so/

/rgyal kun sor sor rtogs pa'i ye shes ni/ /gsung gi rdo rje ma chags padma'i rigs/ /bde stong gar gyi dbang phyug 'khor lo'i mgon/ /dbyer med rta phag yab yum rgyal gyur cig / de la bla ma yang gsang padma drag po gnam lcags 'khor lo'i cha lag /rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub nyams su len pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba ni/ thog mar nub phyogs su zla gam dmar po dbang g-i dkyil 'khor bzhengs la de'i steng maṇḍal khar dpal gtor zur gsum rta mgos mtshan pa me ri'i rgyan ldan 'khor bzhis bskor ba/ mdun du sman raka gtor ma/ mchod pa bcas ma tshang ba med par 'du bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thog mar skyabs sems ni/ na mo/ bla ma mchog gsum dbang chen he ru kar/ /gus pas skyabs mchi bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob bya'i phyir/ /dbang chen rta phag yab yum bsgrub par bgyi/ /lan gsum dang*/ de nas bgegs gtor chu gtsang gis bran zhing*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ḥ oṃ aḥhūm̐/ gi byin gyis brlab/ sarba bhu ta arṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dgug hūm̐: nga ni khrag 'thung dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal: rang bzhin thugs las khro chung mtshon char 'bebs: 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gtor mas tshim zhing dengs: deng 'dir 'tshe na thal ba'i rdul du rlog: om̐ badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po shag tshal pa mā ra ya rbad rbad: bhyo bhyo thun bhyoḥ de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: steng 'og me dang mtshon cha'i gur: drwa mig lcags sdig khyung gis gtams: spu gri khro chung pha lam sbrel: cis kyang mi tshugs 'khor lo'i gur: om̐ badzra ram̐ ā yur dha tsakra rakṣa hūm̐: de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod 'dod yon spyan gzigs rgyan: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dang : gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dkyil 'khor rdzas: 'dod yon mnyes mchod dpag med spel:

om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta āḥhūm̐: de nas 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/ hūm̐: ngo bo chos nyid de bzhin dbyings: rang rtsal ma 'gags stong par shar: kun rgyu sprul pa'i sa bon hūm̐: dran rdzogs gnam lcags rdo rjer bsgom: hūm̐ bhrūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: hrīḥ zla gam dmar nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang: snang srid 'khor 'das kun khyab yangs pa'i nang : padma nyi zla baṃ ro'i steng du hrīḥ dmar gsal 'phro 'du 'od zer spro bsdu las: rang nyid dbang chen hya ghṛ wa'i sku: dmar gsal me 'od 'phros shing gtum pa'i gzugs: nyi zla brjid pa'i spyan gsum 'od du 'bar: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal: rab 'jigs gtum rngam drag tu 'bar ba'i skus: skra brdzes thod phreng dar dpyang snyan chas brgyan: phyag g.yas thod dbyug nam mkha'i mthongs su phyar: g.yon pas me yi zhags pa bgegs la gzir: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad klu brgyad brgyan: gar gyi nyams dgu ldan zhing gsal bar gyur: dbu gtsug khro rgyal bya khyung ga ru ḍaḥ dmar nag me yi spu gri'i gshog rtsal 'phyo: g.yas su rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can: khro rngam khro chas khro bo'i cha lugs rdzogs: dar nag ber gsol ral gri lcags kyu 'dzin: g.yon du rdo rje phag mo dmar nag mdog: khro mo'i chas rdzogs gri thod kha ṭwāṃ bsnams: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs lam lam rtse: kun kyang dbu la rta zhal phag gdong mtshan: rgyab tu phyag na rdo rje mthing nag 'bar: rdo rje rtse lnga zhags pa 'dzin cing 'debs: mdun du yaksha me dbal dmar nag khro: tho ba dgra satwa 'dzin cing bgegs tshogs 'dul: de yi mdun du lcags sdig nag po ni: mgo dgu'i rwa gzengs kha dgus rgyal bsen za: kun kyang sku la khro chas rdzogs par gsal:

de ltar lha tshogs rnams kyi gnas gsum las 'od 'phros pas: dbang drag zla gam rol pa'i dur khrod nas: rta phag yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad skar mda' shugs kyis 'phang ba ltar spyan drangs par gyur/ de ltar spyan drangs bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal dkyus gcig tu bya ba ni/ hrīḥ zla gam dmar nag dbang drag gzhal yas nas: rta phag yab yum 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: sngon tshe ru tra pho mo btul ba ltar: da lta sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag la: gnod cing 'tshe ba'i rgyal 'gong dam sri rnams: thal bar brlag phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: 'dir gshegs 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: khyed la phyag 'tshal dus kun skyabs su mchi: ma hā kro ta hya ghṛ wa badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dam tshig phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: mchod yon khrus chab me tog bdug spos dang : mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo sogs: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di: rta phag yab yum 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: khyed rnams thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi rgya mtsho dang : sman gtor rakta'i tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang : nyams gyur bshags la dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta sarba pū dza khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ḥ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rdo rje: bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo che: rta phag yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sngon tshe ma traṃ ru tra stobs po che: dus mtshan nag po la sogs bdud dmag 'bum: thal bar brlag byed rta phag yab yum gyi: lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang nyid dbang chen yab yum gyi/ /thugs kar padma zla ba'i steng*/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dkar gsal 'tsher/ /thugs klong 'od kyi thig le'i dbus/

/pad 'byung thugs kar hrīḥdamar nag /de mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ /'od zer spro bsdu don gnyis byas/ khyad par gza' klu rgyal gdon dang*/ /dug gsum rgyu bcas rjes med bsreg /snod bcud khro bo'i zhing du gyur/ hrīḥpadma ta kṛ ta badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ de ltar bsnyen sgrub chig sgril 'bum phrag drug tu bzla'o/ /las sbyor bya bar spro na/ rang nyid dbang chen sku ru gsal: bdag dang me dbal thugs ka nas: sngags kyi 'od zer spu gri 'phros: 'dre rgod gnod byed thams cad kyi: srog rtsa rbad rbad bcad par gyur: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na 'dre rgod rgyal 'gong 'byung po'i srog la hab: snying la rbad: lus ngag yid gsum mā ra ya chings nan: zhes spu gri mtshon cha'i drag sngags dmigs pa'i gnad dang ldan par bzla'o/ de nas sdig pa snying 'dzin gyi man ngag ni/ bdag nyid hūm̐ las lcags sdig ni: mgo dgu bco brgyad rwa ldan pa: kha dgu gdangs shing mig dgu bgrad: shin tu gtum rngam 'jigs rung gyur: oṃ badzra yaksha trig nan e hur thuṃ dzaḥ gzer nad rgyal 'gong dam sri ka waka tsi rbad: brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ rang nyid sdig pa'i nga rgyal gyi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las dza dmar nag: 'phros pa yongs su gyur pa las: pho nya rang 'dra dpag med pas: 'jig rten thams cad yongs su gang : rgyal 'gong dam sri thams cad kun: thar med skad ngan tser tser bsgom: sha la sbrang ma 'du ba ltar: lcags sdig pho nya bcas pa yis: de la btogs te snying nas zhugs: srog rtsa bcad cing snying khrag 'jib: phyi nang kun nas zos pa yi: lhag ma tsam yang med par gyur: ces sngags bzla zhing*/ dam sri rgyal 'gong hab hab ljib ljib tu zos shing lhag ma med par bsams la mthar dmigs med kyi ngang du bzhag par bya'o/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig bcas bya'o/ /gzhung las/ grub rtags phyi nang gsang ba ni:

rab dngos: 'bring nyams: tha ma rmi lam du: sku 'bag ras bris rta phag gsal ba dang : gsang ba'i grub rtags 'ja' 'od du sku dngos mjal ba the tshom med: ces dang*/ rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub 'di: rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud kyi bcud bsdus snying khrag thigs pa sa ma ya: gu hya brda thim: zhes gsungs pa bzhin zab par snang ngo*/ /gnyis pa tshogs mchod bya ba la bdun las/ dang po tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bdud rtsis bran la/ hūm̐: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis me rlung chu'i: bag chags 'khrud phyir tshogs la phog: bzang ngan sme bar 'dzin pa rnams: sbyangs bkrus gtor ba'i bdud rtsir bsgyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ gsang chen dbang drag rol pa'i pho brang nas: dbang chen rta phag yab yum rtsa gsum lha/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir byin phob mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ gsum pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang : chos skyong gter srung dkyil 'khor skyong mdzad pa: 'dod yon longs spyod zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi:

bzhi pa bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas mchod pa'i sprin: dngos su bshams shing blo yis sprul pa'i tshogs: stong gsum khyon ltar khengs pa'i yid 'phrog rdzas: khyad par dur khrod drag po'i nyer spyod sogs/ /sna tshogs mchod sprin kun tshang rgya mtsho 'dis/ /dbang chen rta phag yab yum thugs dam bskang*/ khro rgyal ga ru ḍa yi thugs dam bskang*/ /rta mgrin nag po lcags ral thugs dam bskang*/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dpal chen yaksha me dbal thugs dam bskang*/ /las byed lcags sdig nag po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs yongs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hoḥ tshogs kyi nyes skyon ma rig blang dor rnams: ro gcig lta ba zag med ting 'dzin gyis: gzung 'dzin dgag sgrub nyams chag skyon gyi tshogs: bdag gzhan gnyis med ye grol ngang la bshags: zhes yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ drug pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : dmigs bya dgra bgegs myur du khug: gnod byed srog la kī la ya: gtub cing khro rgyal zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā rakta māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na khā hi: zhes bstab cing tshogs la rol/ bdun pa lhag ma gtong ba ni/ hoḥ lhag la dbang ba'i gnas nyul ma: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong mdzad rnams: lhag ma'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: om̐ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta la khā hi: brgyad pa bskul pa ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon dby-ings nas khro rgyal lha tshogs bzhengs: deng 'dir bdag gi rgyab rten phrin las bskul: sangs rgyas bstan dgra sgos dgra dam nyams la: dmar nag drag po'i zor thun snying la ya: bsad cing rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ kro ti kā li na byad ma 'byung po 'dre rgod rnams la zor bhyo bhyoḥ

rbad bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlogaḥ ces dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ skabs 'dir chos skyong gtor 'bul bya/ dgu pa chad mdo ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min dbang chen pho brang du: dregs 'dul zhal phye khro mos khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo dam ma g.yel: de 'og dur khrod me ri 'bar ba ru: klu 'dul zhal phye bya khyung khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo dam ma g.yel: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: 'byung 'dul zhal phye gter srung khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo dam ma g.yel: gdug pa'i 'byung po dam sri 'dul bar mdzod: om̐ kro ta kro ti khrom̐ ga ru ṭa he bha lingta khā hi: bcu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma sman: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas rnams: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa skyongs: khas blangs bzhin du phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma ma hriṃ hriṃ dza dza bha lingta khā hi: bcu gcig pa rta bro ni/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dbang chen he ru kas: dam sri bsgral nas rta bro rdung : chem chem mnan mnan ma ldang zhig: mchod rten nag po'i 'og tu brub: om̐ nan: a nan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: de nas gtor gzhong kha yar bzed nas 'bru 'thor/ dbang blang ba ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med rang byung pho brang nas: bskyed cing drang ba'i zlos gar dkyil 'khor lhas: don gnyis las bzhi'i phrin las shugs phyung nas: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi hūm̐: zhes pas dbang blang*/ rjes chog mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta sarba pū dza khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ḥ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rdo rje: bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo che: rta phag yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs nas bstod par bgyi/

bar bstod/ nongs bshags ni/ hūm̐: bla med theg chen rgyud sde'i sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba yan lag phyag rgya ting 'dzin sogs/ khas blangs dam tshig nyams 'gal ci mchis pa/ /mthol bshags bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang*/ de nas brtan bzhugs bya/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs nas om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐: snang stong 'ja' tshon chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: mi dmigs lha tshogs dbyings rig klong la thim: dran rig chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: ma bcos spros bral ngang la ā ru ldang : a a āḥ bsngo smon bya ba ni/ hrīḥ bdag gi bsnyen sgrub dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams kyi don du bsngo: kun kyang sa bcu lam lnga mthar phyin nas: gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / bkra shis bya ba ni/ hūm̐: gar gyi dbang phyug khro rgyal kun gyi rje: gdug pa'i g.yul bcom dbang chen hya ghṛ: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog: rjes su bsngo smon ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan la mthar stong nyid 'od gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas yul 'dong chu gtsug lag khang gi /byams pa'i snyan nas zab gter du gdan drangs pa'i rta mgrin dbang chen 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub 'di bzhin/ rta mgrin nyams len la mos pa dag la phan pa'i blos tshogs mchod sogs zhal skong dgos rigs/ rang lugs rta mchog nyi ma'i snying po sogs rigs mthun gzhan nas blangs te/ ngag 'don khrigs chags su bkod pa 'di'ang rta mchog grub pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi/ ye shes sgyu 'phrul o rgyan dri med gling pa'i skyes mthar 'bod pa khyung yul du skyes shing*/ rgyal khams phyogs med nyul ba'i sprang po ngag dbang klu sgrub dpal bzang pos shing bya lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes bdun la g.yu lo bkod rje btsun gling du bgyis pa'o//

// ༈ gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ gcod yul gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin gyi phung po bzhugs/ rang nyid skad cig gis gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar gsal khro 'dzum chags pa'i nyams can/ spyan gsum bar snang la hrig hrig gzigs pa/ zhabs stangs stabs kyis 'jig rten thams cad rmang nas ldeg cing rab tu g.yo bas/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho phrin las kyi pho nyar 'gyed pa/ phyag gnyis cang te'u dang dril g.yer gyi sgra skad 'ur sil du bsgrags pas mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing thams cad rab tu g.yos te/ rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol pa chen po mngon du byed pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud drag tu bskul bas/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la ye shes thugs rje'i byin 'od kyis rtog bral rang byung gi rig pa rjen par ston cing snang srid thams cad lhun 'byams brdal ba chen por dbang bsgyur ba'i brtul zhugs dang rdzu 'phrul thogs med stsol ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ phaṭḥ chos dbyings bde chen yum gyi klong*/ /rang byung lhun grub kun tu bzang*/ /thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar kun tu zhal/ khyab brdal 'od kyi phung po can/ /srid zhi kun gyi srog gcig pu/ /thugs bcud dgongs brgyud bye ba 'bum/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /gsang sgrom me ri 'bar ba'i rtser/ /rdo rje sems dpa' longs spyod rdzogs/ /dug lnga brdzis pa'i khri steng na/ /skyil krung rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /ye shes 'od lnga'i tshom bu 'khrigs/ /gsang mdzod brda brgyud 'bum sdes bskor/

/thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas/ /dga' rab rdo rje sprul pa'i sku/ /'od lnga'i mdangs ldan rus pas brgyan/ khyab 'jug bu mo gcer bu chibs/ /thod rnga rdung zhing rkang gling 'bud/ /snyan brgyud bka' bab 'bum sdes bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /so sa gling gi dur khrod nas/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen dmar smug bzhad/ /seng chen bsnol ba'i khri steng du/ /skyil krung rdo rje sdigs mdzub can/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thibs se thib/ /dbang sgyur rig 'dzin bye bas bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /rgya nag bsil chen dur khrod nas/ /shrī singha smug nag gtum/ /gcer bu thor tshugs sgro phod can/ /glang chen stag dang ma he chibs/ /ral gri phyar zhing thod khrag gsol/ /gtum drag rig 'dzin 'bum sdes bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rigs 'dzin la/

/mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /rgya gar bha seng dur khrod nas/ /dzñā na sū tra sngo nag gtum/ /ḍā dril 'khrol zhing stangs stabs kyis/ /stag mo grus ma'i steng na rol/ /rma bya'i gdugs dang bsil yab lding*/ /rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum sdes bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas/ /paṇa chen bi ma mi tra sngo/ /grub thob rnal 'byor spyod pa'i chas/ /rdo rje rtse lnga tshe bum 'dzin/ /bya khyung rngam pa'i steng na rol/ /'chi med rig 'dzin 'bum sdes bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /raksha srin po'i rgyal khab nas/ /padma thod phreng dmar nag sgeg khrag 'thung he ru ka yi chas/ /lha srin sde brgyad bsnol ba'i staing*/ /'gying brjid rdo rje bhandha 'dzin/ /grub thob rig 'dzin bye bas bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/

/rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /ke'u ri gsang ba yang rdzong nas/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal dkar dmar dgyes/ /dar tshon na bza' rus rgyan bklubs/ /bdud dang 'byung po bsnol ba'i steng*/ /zil ldan ḍā ru dril bu 'khrol/ /brda bsgyur dpag med thibs se thib/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /zla gam dbang gi phug pa nas/ /manda ra ba dmar gsal 'dzum/ /mkha' spyod longs sku'i cha lugs can/ /bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i khri steng na/ /bgres rgud bral ba'i tshe bum 'dzin/ /'byung lnga srog 'dzin lha mos bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug nas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes gtum rngam khro/ /bdud 'dul sngags pa'i cha lugs can/ /ru tra dam sri bsnol ba'i steng*/ /rdo rje gdengs shing phur bu 'dril/ /drag sngags rig 'dzin 'bum sdes bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/

/thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /srid gsum rnam rgyal pho brang nas/ /rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgyal/ /dkar smug khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i nyams/ /dam sri rgyal 'gong bsnol ba'i steng*/ /dor stabs zil gnon phyag rgya mdzad/ /gter brgyud bka' bab bye bas bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro 'dul sprul pa'i pho brang nas/ /grub dbang thugs mchog rdo rje ni/ /dmar smug khro la chags pa'i tshul/ /log rtog bdud bzhi brdzis pa'i steng*/ /dar nag phyar zhing phur bu gdengs/ /rig 'dzin grub thob 'bum gyis bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /tsitta rin chen pho brang nas/ /rigs 'dus rtsa ba'i bla mas rje/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'od du 'bar/ /rang byung ye shes lhang gis ston/ /thugs rje'i dbyings nas bskyod pa'i tshe/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sprin ltar gtibs/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/

/'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /gangs can bod yul gnas mchog nas/ /grub thob rje 'bangs rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dbang sgyur brtul zhugs rol pa yis/ /rdul phran re yang rgyal ba'i zhing*/ /sku dang tshom bu shigs se shig /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro ba 'dul ba'i zhing khams nas/ /thugs rje sprul pa'i skur bzhengs pa/ /'phags pa'i nyan thos dge slong dang*/ /rang rgyal dgra bcom byang chub sems/ /paṇa grub lo tsā sngags 'chang dang*/ /rnal 'byor grub thob slob dpon sogs/ /rang rang mtshan dpe'i gzi byin rdzogs/ /bdag 'dzin ru tra bsnol ba'i steng*/ /mnyam bzhag ting 'dzin phyag rgya can/ /thugs rje'-i dgongs pa mkha' ltar brdal/ /ris med gdul bya dbyings su 'dren/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad nas/ /rigs drug sems can ma lus kun/ /dpa' bo ḍākki'i sku ru bzhengs/ /rnga dung dril g.yer si li li/ /glu gar bro rdung khrigs se khrig /snang srid kun la mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /gdul bya'i lhag ma ma lus pa/ khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par bsgral/ /stong gsum brdal ba dpal gyi zhing*/ /rmad byung phrin las mtha' yas par/

/mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /snang srid rnam dag rgyal ba'i zhing*/ /phung khams rnam dag yi dam lha/ /rang rig rnam dag sangs rgyas dngos/ /bzang zhan ngan rtog 'khrul pa'i blo/ /'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /gnyis med dbyings su 'ub chud nas/ /skye med klong du sangs se sang*/ /'gags med rtsal du sha ra ra/ /rang bzhin ngang du ya la la/ /bde ba chen por a a a phaṭ/

gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog gi gcod kyi rgyud 'debs rgyas pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes/ sgom chen pa sgom bu tshul khrims kyis bskul bar brten/ bka' gter gsar rnying gi mngon rtogs rnams bsdus te/ gcod yul ba skyid grong smyon pas bris pa dge'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i 'ja' lus mkha' spyod sgrub thabs bklag chog tu bkod pa bde chen gsang lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bde chen ye shes gsang ba'i lam/ /ston mdzad ye shes mkha' 'gro la/ /btud nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs/ /bkod la bkas gnongs byin rlabs stsol/ de la gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i 'ja' lus mkha' spyod sgrub thabs nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa las/ thog mar dben pa'i gnas su mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor 'du bya la mchod gtor sogs ci 'byor bsham/ de nas rang gi mdun du nyer mkho ḍā dril nang mchod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad tshang bar byas la/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ skyabs yul gsal gdab pa la/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i rgyal yum ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dza/ na mo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas skyabs yul 'gro ba'i mgon: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: bdag gi dge 'dis ma gyur 'gro kun tshogs: 'ja' lus go 'phang thob par sems bskyed do: gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /'dir gshegs padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul/ /sdig pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang*/ /bla med gsang chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /dge tshogs kun tu bzang po'i rgyur bsngo'o/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ de nas dkar gtor sngon du 'gro bas/

bgegs gtor bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo?khaṃ swā hā/ gsum pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyo: ma cig yum chen khros ma'i thugs ka nas: bar med khyab par 'gugs pa'i pho nya 'phros: gnod byed bgegs tshogs gtor ma len phyir khug: bdag gi bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis: mchod sbyin 'di khyer rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'di ru glags blta na: bdag nyid dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro thugs khros nas: skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i mtshon cha thun du brdeg: me ltar 'bar bas bgegs dpung bsregs gtor gzhom: de bas bgegs tshogs 'byung po phyir dengs shig: om̐ badzra wā ra hī kro ti ka li ha ri ṇi sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya phaṭaḥ bzhi pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyo: bdag nyid khros ma rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas: mtshon cha me ri drag po thog ltar 'phros: gnod byed tshar gcod mtshams gcod las grub nas: tshur 'dus mi shigs rdo rje'i gur khang gyur: om̐ badzra dzwa la rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭḥ lnga pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: hūm̐: phyi snod gling bzhi nyi zla bhandha'i snod: nang bcud dbang po rnam lnga sman raka dang : gtor mchod bha ling ga ṇa tshogs kyi rdzas: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs la sogs pa: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐: ? nas shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ rū p sparshe āḥhūm̐ om̐ sarba a haṃ pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ga ṇa tsakra āḥhūm̐: om̐ ru tra ma ra ni ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta ā hūm̐: zhes lan gsum/ drug pa byin dbab cing brda sgo dbye nas dam bca' bzung ba ni/

hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod bde chen pho brang nas: dbying phyug ḍākki ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen phob: lta ba klong yangs ye shes 'char sgo phyes: nyon mongs a 'thas srid pa'i sgo bcad nas: dran rig gnyug ma'i yid kyi lha zhal mjal: 'da' ka rdo rje dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir: ma 'grub bar du mi btang srog ltar bsgrub: om̐ badzra a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ oṃ pra be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badzra tsitta hri da ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dngos gzhi la dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum dang 'byung ba rim brtseg ni/ hūm̐: ye nas chos rnams bdag med stong pa'i dbyings: āḥ ma 'gags zang thal rang bzhin rol rtsal spros: om̐: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ngang nyid las: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐ hūm̐ baṃ: de las rlung me chu sa dbang chen gzhi: bhrūm̐ gyur gzhal yas khang dang sa bon dang : phyag mtshan gnas gyur lha tshogs gtso bor gsal: om̐ swa bhā wa dharma e yam̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: pam̐ padma sūrya a tsand+ra ru tra ti ra baṃ hūm̐ baṃ ha ri ni sa badzra dzñā na hoḥ gnyis pa gzhal yas khang dang lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ e: mthing nag khyab gdal lhun grub rang bzhin la: 'byung lnga rim brtsegs rang byung gzhal yas khang : 'od zer sna lnga sgyu ma ltar shar ba'i: tshad med bzhi ldan gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa: rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba dang : drwa phyed mda' yab rin chen pu shu ldan: ka gdung dral lcam 'phan dar sna tshogs 'phyangs: rta babs chos 'khor nyi zla nor bus brgyan: dbus su rang byung rin chen sna lnga'i tog: thog steng rgyan dar phyi rol sgau khyud ldan: rdo rwa pad phreng dur khrod me ris bskor: phyi nang bkod pa yongs rdzogs pho brang gsal: hūm̐: de dbus pad nyi zla gam ti ra'i steng : bam yig dmar ser zangs gri 'bar bas mtshon: gnas 'gyur rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: gsang ba ye shes mkha' spyod yum chen sku:

dmar gsal mdangs ldan byi ru'i dbang lhun mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis chags pa'i gar stabs can: khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i spyan gsum smin ma 'bar: ral pa'i thor tshugs thod skam rigs lngas mtshan: spyi bor phag zhal mthing nag phem sgra ngur: dar dmar cod pan mkha' la bun bun bskyod: phyag g.yas zangs gri nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar: g.yon pas bhandha kha ṭwāṃ gru mor brten: rin chen snyan rgyan phyag zhabs gdu bu 'khrol: rus pa'i rgyan drug g.yer kha'i sgra dang ldan: 'khor ba stongs phyir mgo phreng ga shal 'phyangs: gcer mo bha ga nu ma rab tu rgyas: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum mkha' la gar stabs tshul: ye shes 'bar ba'i me dpung klong du gsal: gtso mo'i phyogs bzhi pad nyi bam gyi steng : ha ri ni sar bskyed pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: dkar ser dmar ljang bde spyod gar stabs can: gtso ltar 'gying ba'i phyag mtshan rgyan cha 'phyangs: tshad med bzhi ldan bde gshegs dpa' mo'i tshul: snang stong ngang la ma bcos lam gyis gsal: ham̐'u: gzhan yang phyi nang ma sring gnas nyul ma: zhing rdul grangs dang til gang phyes pa ltar: bde spyod bsgrub phyir na bun mkha' lam gang : dgyes pa'i brda gar glu dbyangs dang bcas nas: skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dza phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: mkha' spyod bde chen o rgyan pho brang nas: gsang ba ye shes ma sring ḍākki 'bum: sgrub la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir: gsang sngags pho brang gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra yo gi ni ā yurdzñā na su khaṃ pa shaṃ siddhi dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhi pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum: rigs lnga bde chen lhun grub rang bzhin 'bar: dbyings las ma g.yos rnal 'byor ḍākki tshogs: ti ra nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: byams gdung bu ltar brtse bar dgongs mdzad phyir:

ma cig yum chen tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: na mo a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod sna lnga nang mchod sman raka dang : gtor mchod ga ṇa tshogs kyi lhun po spungs: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol mthun rdzas spyan gzigs tshogs: ma sring mnyes pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di: gsang ba ye shes 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dgyes par bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badzra puṣpe? shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ rū p sparshe pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba a haṃ pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: de nas bdud rtsi 'bul zhing 'di skad do: om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: longs sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: sprul sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: ḍākki de ba dha ra'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: gter srung mchims phu brag btsan zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams: deng 'dir dbang bskur bdag la stsol: om̐ kā ya siddhi wākka siddhi tsitta siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: drug pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ baṃ bhyo: chos dbyings lhun grub gsang ba'i dbyings klong nas: thugs rje'i cho 'phrul sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur ma:

padma rā ga lhun po'i mdangs 'khyud pa'i: cha shas rab rdzogs gzhon nu gcer mo ldem: khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i zhal ras mdangs bzang g.yo: lcang lo 'khyil zhing thor tshugs rab tu mdzes: bhandha skam po'i phreng ba tshal gyis spras: 'jam pa'i le brgan cod pan dbyings la bskyod: sa gsum sngangs mdzad spyi bor phag zhal ngur: rin chen las grub snyan cha zlum la 'khyil: phyag g.yas zangs gris nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod: g.yas pas bhan dmar sgrub la dngos grub gter: kha ṭwāṃ mchan bcug dug gsum zur du 'joms: phyag zhabs gdu bu rin chen las grub 'khrol: mgul rgyan mu tig chun pos spras legs ma: rus pa'i rgyan drug g.yer kha seng seng sgrogs: drug cu mgo phreng sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem: nu ma bha ga rab rgyas bde ba g.yo: lha tshogs ldan pa'i g.yas brkyang gar ldan 'greng : sgeg pa'i dpa' mor gzhon nu'i cha shas rdzogs: pad nyi bam steng dgyes mdzad dbyangs can ma: sku las mched pa'i ye shes me ri 'bar: sa bcu rnal 'byor sems mdzad dbyings phyug ma: gsang ba ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zhi ba'i dbyings phyug dkar gsal dwangs 'dzum ma: rgyas pa'i dpa' mo bzhin bzang 'od ldan ma: dbang gi las mdzad chags pa'i bcud g.yo ma: drag po'i las mdzad rab tu gtum pa mo: las bzhi bdag mo kun kyang gtso mo'i chas: phyag mtshan rgyan ldan gar stabs shigs se shig: khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i mdangs bzang ya la la: g.yo ba rab bzhad brda skad di ri ri: spyod pa'i rnal 'byor 'khrul 'khor sna tshogs bsgyur: zab lam gsang ba'i bde ba kun ster ma: mthong na mi bzod shes rab cha shas rdzogs: byams gdung bu la brtse ba'i ma chen mo: gsang ba'i rig ma phrin las bzhi la bstod: hūm̐: dbyings phyug dpa' mo ma sring tshogs bcas la: gus pas btud de rtse gcig bstod pa'i mthus: 'chi med 'ja' lus tshe yi rig 'dzin stsol: bdun pa 'dzab bskul ni/

hūm̐: gsang ba dbyings kyi dbang phyug ḍākki'i tshogs: ye shes thugs dam 'dzab kyis rgyud bskul la: zung 'jug bde chen 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'i phyir: ma sring khyed rnams srog ltar bzung lags na: zab lam dpa' mos rtag tu grogs gyis shig: phung khams 'od lus chos sku 'grub pa yi: ma khyod bdag gi dpung gnyen mchis pa'i phyir: bzlas pa sngags kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul: thog mar gsal snang dang nga rgyal sbrel la sku la sems 'dzin pa dang yid bzlas 'ba' zhig bya/ skabs 'gar 'jam rlung kha sbyor du bzung zhing rlung bzlas sam rdo rje'i bzlas pa la bslab/ de nas skyo tshe ngag bzlas bya ba la/ bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i spyi bo ru/ /rigs bdag padma thod phreng gsal/ /rang gi thugs kar pad nyi'i steng*/ /hūm̐ yig pad rag zhun ma'i mdangs/ /tha mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ /rtsa khams ba spu'i grong khyer du/ /'bum phrag yangs pa'i ḍākki'i tshogs/ /til gyi gang bu lta bur gsal/ /spyi bo'i rigs bdag bla ma la/ /gdung shugs drag po'i gsol btab mod/ /sku las bde stong ye shes kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs spyi bo nas/ /rim zhugs rang srog sngags phreng la/ /phog pas g.yon bskor drag tu 'khor/ /spro bas 'od kyis srid zhi khyab/ /bsdus pas gzi byin lhag par 'bar/ /gtso 'khor ma lus thams cad kun/ /bde chen ye shes nyams 'ur bas/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'u ru ru/ /dga' bzhi'i bro rdung khrigs se khrig /rtsa khams ba spu tshun chad kun/ /bde dang stong par phri li li/ /dug lnga dbyings su sangs se sang*/ /dbang bzhi rgyun 'bab na ra ra/ /'ja' dang 'od du kyi li li/ /zer dang zer phreng ya la la/ /snang ba sku ru lams se lam/ /sgra grags sngags su di ri ri/ /dran rtog chos skur sangs se sang*/ /ma rig nyon mongs ka nas dag /'ja' lus zang thal chen paus ngang*/ /rtsal snang mkha' 'gro'i dā lar rdzogs/

man ngag gsum ldan gyi dgongs pa las/ rtsa sngags ni/ om̐ badzra yo gi ni ā yurdzñā na su khaṃ pa shaṃ siddhi dza dzaḥ sgrub sngags ni/ om̐ badzra yo gi ni a yurdzñā na hri da ya siddhi hūm̐: zhes ci nus dang*/ khyad par gyi las sbyor dmigs gnad rnams gud du shes par bya'o/ rlung sgrub sngags dmigs ni/ rang nyid phag mor phyi gsal nang gsal dar dmar gyi gur phub pa lta bu'i sku dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi/ 'khor lo lnga dang bcas pa gsal btab bzhin bum can sbyor ba bzhi ldan du bzung*/ de yang tho rangs rdo rje mkha' 'gro chu rlung dkar po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas/ 'ja' 'od zug bzhin du rlung rngub pa dang nar gyis drangs nas lus la bskyil bzhin bum can dang bar rlung bzung ba la ci nus su 'bad par bya/ des zhe sdang gi rtog pa 'gag /sku yi yon tan thams cad rgyud la skyes par bsam/ de bzhin du nam langs rin chen mkha' 'gro sa rlung ser po/ nyin phyed sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro nam mkha'i rlung mthing kha/ phyed yol padma mkha' 'gro me rlung dmar po/ srod la karma mkha' 'gro rlung rlung ljang gu'i rang bzhin du gyur nas/ 'ja' 'od zug bzhin du rlung rngub pa dang nar gyis drangs nas lus la bskyil bar bsam/ de ltar byas pas dug lnga'i rtog pa 'gag /sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi yon tan thams cad 'char bar gsungs pa bzhin nyams su blangs/ thun lnga la rlung bum pa can brgya dang bcu yan chag med 'dzin/ ma nus na bar rlung bzung zhing rlung sems dbang sdud kyi sngags 'di bzhin bzlas/

om̐ badzra wā ra hī aṣṭa pa shaṃ ma ma siddhi hūm̐: nor sgrub sngags ni/ om̐ badzra yo gi ni puṇye ratna pa shaṃ thun thun: dbang sdud sngags ni/ om̐ badzra yo gi ni lo ka dzñā na sarba rā ga pa shaṃ thun thun dzaḥ phrin las kun sgrub sngags ni/ om̐ badzra yo gi ni sarba karma sa dha na ye swā hā: zhes pa'i gong 'og gi sngags rnams rang mos bzhin khol phyung du bsgrub kyang chog: 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub rtags 'byung : 'on kyang rgyun du nyams len bgyis na lus ma bor bar mkha' spyod gshegs te 'ja' lus 'grub par 'gyur ro: zhes gsungs so/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig brjod/ de nas 'dod don gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ hūm̐: bde chen g.yo ba mchog gi mdzes 'phro ma: gsang gsum rab dga' cha shas sngo sangs ma: gang gus gdung bas nā da rab tu g.yo: mthong na mi mthun spang ba'i ga na mdzod: 'dzan po kun kyang yid kyu'i rab dkar bsu: chu gter rlabs su 'dar ma'i phreng ba yi: ka ti ka yi 'khor lo rab bskul ba: rā sa me yi brdas bskul sgra skad kyis: rtsi bcud myong ba'i ro mchog ci bzhin du: zag med lha mo khyod kyi phrin las mdzod: cha shas 'dab brgya'i utpal dri bsung gis: g.yo la rtag tu kun snang ngoms med bzhin: yid bzhin dpa' mo khyod kyis bsu bar mdzod: om̐ ha ri ni sa siddhi pha la hūm̐: zhes pas dbang bzhi blang*/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ tshogs mchod rgyas pa gzhung gi mu tig rtsal phreng ltar bya bar 'os kyang*/ bsnyen sgrub dus bzhi sogs la 'jug pa bde phyir gter chen nyid kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes ltar bstan pa la bcu gcig las/ dang po tshogs kyi byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir sku gsum yig 'bru 'phros: mchod rdzas la phog byin brlabs bcud mchog spel:

ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod bde chen pho brang nas: gsang ba ye shes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: phag mo rigs bzhi ma sring bye ba 'bum: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gzhan yang phyi nang skyong ba'i las byed tshogs: bka' srung gter bdag mchod 'os mgron gyur rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir byin phob mchod rdzas bcud mchog spel: 'dir tshogs skal ldan sgrub la mchog thun stsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya āḥ gsum pa mchod bskang bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang : bka' gter skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor bcas la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes par bzhes nas thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mchog thun dngos grub myur ba nyid thob ste: nyams chag bshags shing mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi: bzhi pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid drag mo phag gdong gsal ba'i mdun: shor med lcags khang nang du nṛ tri las: dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum lta bur gsal: bden stobs ni/ na moḥ mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: gsang ba ḍākki mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: bka' srung gter bdag srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa yis: sangs rgyas bstan dgra rnal 'byor sgos dgra rnams: rkyen ngan bar chod glo bur bgegs kyi tshogs: dgra gzugs tha ma'i liṅga 'di la khug: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ tri mā ra ya dza dzaḥ bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dgra bo sgrol ba'i mtshon: rdo rjes mtshan pa zangs gri thog ltar 'bebs: byad ma gnod byed mgo lus dum bur gtub: phye mar brlag cing sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod:

om̐ badzra ta ma ka ra ti ka ya gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad nṛ tri rbad rbad: bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba'i dbyings phyug dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: ma rungs dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: dgyes par bzhes shig bdud bzhi'i tshogs bcom nas: sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: lnga pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: gnas nyul dus bdag phra men ma: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: 'bar ma pho nya'i tshogs rnams la: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab 'bul: bstan srung mel tshe 'grub par mdzod: om̐ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta khā hi: drug pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: mthing nag e yi pho brang nas: dbyings phyug ḍākki'i skur bzhengs la: mthu rtsal stobs kyi thugs dam bskul: las bzhi kun 'grub phrin las bcol: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag cag byang chub mchog thob ste: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par mdzod: ces tshogs gtor 'bul/ bdun pa chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i dus: snying thig sbas dang bton pa'i tshe: khas blangs bzhin du gtor ma bzhes: yang zab bya ra 'grub par mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya i daṃ bha lingta la khā hi: brgyad pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod skyong ma sring bcu gnyis kyis: mthun rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: yul srungs lo legs bkra shis spel: dus 'khrugs nad yams zhi bar mdzod: om̐ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le ti ma ma khā hi: dgu pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bro ra ru: ma sring 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas: phyi nang bar chod thal bar rlog: las bzhi lhun grub chen por gyur: om̐ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: bgegs srin dam sri satwaṃ bha ya nan: bcu pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: zab yangs bde chen 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: gsang ba ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs:

thugs dam rgyud bskul mchog thun kun stsol nas: dbang bzhi ye shes thob par mdzad du gsol: om̐ badzra yo gi ni kā ya siddhi om̐: wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐: gu ṇa siddhi hrīḥ gu ya sarba siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rjes chog la drug /dang po gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ om̐ badzra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ? sogs kyis mchod la/ hūm̐: skye med rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul ci yang ston mdzad pa: 'gro ba kun skyob ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: dug gsum 'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod/ gnyis pa bzod gsol ni/ om̐: ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang : cho ga lhag chad 'gal zhing 'khrul: bskyed rdzogs phyi nang nor ba dang : rmongs shing bag med ci mchis pa: ma sring tshogs la bzod par gsol: om̐ ḍākki sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: sogs? ḍākki'i yig brgya brjod cing bzlas/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ldang ni/ hoḥ snang srid thams cad mkha' 'gro'i zh-ing : rang lus 'byung ba gdos bcas bral: sgra rnams brag cha'i gdangs bzhin snang : 'gyu ba dran rig ka dag ngang : a a āḥ rol rtsal thugs rje khros ma'i sku: gsal stong 'dzin med lam du shar: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ bsngo bya yul dang bral ba sangs rgyas yin: bsngo byed mkhan po stong pa rang sar grol: bsngo yul gdod nas mi dmigs a la la: lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ ma gyur thams cad gzhi dag chos kyi sku/ /ma bsgoms ma bcos ye nas rang sangs rgyas/ /'on kyang de don ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i 'gro/ /kun kyang yum chen go 'phang thob par shog / ces dmigs med bde ba chen por 'khor gsum yongs dag dbyings rig zung 'jug la mnyam par bzhag go /drug pa bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin ma: nam mkha'i lus can rdo rje ḍākki'i gtso:

dbyings phyug dpal 'bar 'dod rgu mchog sbyin mo: ma sring ḍākki'i tshogs kyis bkra shis shog: me tog gi char dbab cing shis pa brjod/ dge rtsa bsngo zhing smon lam gdab pa ni/ ji ltar lha mo khyed nyid dang*/ /bdag nyid rab tu mnyam sbyar phyir/ /'di nas 'jig rten 'og tu yang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gzugs can du/ /bdag nyid 'byung zhing 'gyur bar shog /bde zhing bde ba bsten pa dang*/ /bde ba chen por bdag 'gyur shog /'chi tshe dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ /me tog phreng dang rgyal mtshan gdugs thogs shing*/ /glu gar rol mo'i sprin gyis mdun bsus te/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i grong du khrid par shog /snang cha bde chen gar dbang he ru ka /stong cha rnam kun mchog ldan phag mo yum/ /zung 'jug dbyer mi phyed pa'i bden pa des/ /don gnyis 'dod pa yongs rdzogs bkra shis shog / ces o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos bzhi'i nang tshan gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs bklag chog tu bkod pa bde chen gsang lam zhes bya ba 'di'ang lam 'dir mos pa mi phyed pa'i blo gros can rang slob o rgyan gsang sngags 'gro 'dul gyis gsang sngags phur pa gling gis lo gsum sgrub sde'i nyams bzhes bya sla ba'i ched du chog khrigs dgos zhes bkas bskul ltar gnas gsum mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i nye ba'i tshandho ha bal yul yang le shod e waṃ sgrub sde zung ldan du phyogs nyul gyi dā ri dra mant+ra gu hya shā sa dhā ra 'bod pas gter gzhung rtsa ba sor bzhag gi kha 'gengs dgos pa rnams rang gzhung khros ma'i chog khrigs ye shes sgo 'byed sogs rigs mthun gzhan las blangs te rab byung bcu bdun chu mo lug gi lor cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin grub par bgyis pa la nyes 'gal mchis na ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol zhing dge bas rang rig ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rang zhal dngos su mjal ba'i rgyur gyur cig/

// bdud 'dul drag mo'i brgyud 'debs bsdus pa ni/ na mo gu dhe ba ḍākki nī ye/ chos sku snang mtha' longs sku snying rje'i gter/ /sprul sku pad 'byung rgyal yum sā ra dza/ /gnubs chen dzñā na gter chen rtsa gsum gling*/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ khro bo 'chol ba gsang bdag seṅge'i sgra/ /rig sngags lha mo bdud 'dul drag mo dang*/ /zab gter bka' yi srung ma dam can sogs/ /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bdud bzhi g.yul ngo las/ /rnam rgyal dpa' mo bdud 'dul ḍākki ma'i/ /go 'phang dam pa tshe 'dir thob gyur cig / ces pa'ang rdo 'brong btsun pa zung gis bskul ngor khyung po sngags pas bris// ༈ ye shes mkha' 'gro khro gnyer gtum mo rtsa ba gsum dril gyi cha lag /gdong lnga'i gsang sgrub gnam lcags ur mo'i phrin las bklag chog tu bkod pa gnas gsum ḍākki'i bka' rgya m-i atsha/ bdud 'dul ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku la 'dud/ de la 'dir mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i phrin las bklag chog tu bkod par/ stegs kyi khar mchod gtor gru gsum dmar po gtso 'khor dgu pa dar gdugs dang dkar dmar gyi rgyan can/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka /mdun du nyer spyod lnga sogs bshams la/ skyabs sems ni/ na mo: dus gsum sangs rgyas rgyal yum 'gro ba'i mgon: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: bdag gi dge des ma gyur 'gro kun tshogs: 'ja' lus go 'phang thob par sems bskyed do: dkar gtor sngon du song nas/ bgegs gtor bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo?khaṃ swā hā/ bgegs gtor ni/

hūm̐: nga ni dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong : dkyil 'khor sgrub la mi dbang 'byung po'i tshogs: mchod sbyin 'di longs gzhan du phyir dengs shig: 'khu zhing 'da' na brlag par gdon mi za: ḍākki siṃ ha mu kha gnod byed bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: thugs las sprul pa'i phyag mtshan 'bar ba'i mes: steng 'og bar mtshams med pa dum gcig dang : rab tu 'khrigs pa'i gur khang cher gyur nas: nam yang glags lta 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra dzwa la karma tsakra hūm̐ rakṣa ye swā hā: gtor mchod byin rlob ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: phyi snod gling bzhi nyi zla bhandha'i snod: nang bcud dbang po rnam lnga sman raka dang : gtor mchod bha ling ga ṇa tshogs kyi rdzas: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs la sogs pa: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba a haṃ pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ga ṇa tsakra āḥhūm̐: om̐ ru tra mā ra ni ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ byin dbab pa ni/ āḥ gzhi dbyings spros bral chos sku'i pho brang nas/ /gzhi snang lhun 'grub longs sku mkha' 'gro'i sprin/ /gang 'dul der ston sprul sku seṅge'i gdong*/ /gnas yul zhing khams kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro dang ni shugs 'gro phra men sogs/ /ye shes 'jig rten tshul 'chang sprul 'khor bcas/ /'dir byon gnas 'dir byin chen myur du phob/ /rdo rje'i sku yi gar stabs lams se lam/ /lus la byin phob rtsa yi mdud pa khrol/ /'gags med gsung gi nyams dbyangs 'u ru ru/ /ngag la nus spel bde drod bskyed du gsol/ /'khrul med thugs ni bde stong ya la la/

/sems la nyams rtogs ye shes spor du gsol/ /sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum du smin pa dang*/ /snod bcud ye shes 'khor lor byin gyis rlobs/ /rang rig ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dgyes zhal ston/ /'brel tshad byang chub thob pa'i dngos grub stsol/ dzñā na ḍākki nī ha ri ni sa sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ bhrūm̐: thod pa dmar smug brtsegs pa'i pho brang dbus: chos 'byung dmar nag gdengs ka gyen du phyogs: de nang pad nyi ro yi gdan steng du: bdag nyid mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong pa can: sku mdog mthing nag seng zhal khros pa'i gdong : g.yu ral gseb nas seng chung sprin ltar gtibs: rab brjid thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan: phyag g.yas gnam lcags gri gug mkha' la phyar: phyag g.yon bhandhar rakta bcud bzang gtams: gru mor kha ṭwāṃ brten pas dug gsum 'joms: ḍākki rgya rtags rus rgyan me long spras: thod rlon mgo phreng ga sha dar dpyangs 'phur: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang baṃ ro'i gdan la 'gying : gtso mo'i phyogs bzhir drag mo gdong can bzhi: stag dang phag zhal dom gdong lce spyang mgo: rigs bzhi gtso mthun phyogs mdog rang rtags spras: gzhan yang sgo skyong srung ma nyid sprul bcas: snang la rang bzhin bral ba gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros ma sring mkha' 'gro spyan drangs nas: bdag la dbang bskur byin rlabs mchog thun stsol:

spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod rang byung gdod ma'i klong : chos dbyings drag po e yi dur khrod nas: dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: bla med dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra ḍākki nī baṃ siṃ ha mu kha ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes pas spyan drangs dbyer med bsgom/ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum: chos dbyings ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma: rigs lnga bde chen lhun grub rang bzhin 'bar: dbyings las ma g.yos rnal 'byor ḍākki'i tshogs: gus pas phyag bgyis brtan par bzhugs su gsol: om̐ na mo a ti pu hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong can gtso 'khor la: phyi mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'bul: nang mchod sman raka gtor gsum bha ling 'bul: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol ga ṇa tshogs mchod 'bul: rkang gling thod rnga rol mo sgra ldan 'bul: om̐ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa bam ri 'bar ba ni/ bhyo bhyoḥ baṃ ri thod mkhar 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug seṅge'i gdong : g.yu ral sprugs pas stobs bcu'i phrin las rdzogs: khro mo'i gdong ni za byed 'jigs la rngam: dmar la 'khyil ba'i spyan rtsa sdang mig bgrad: rno ba'i 'od ldan 'bar bas phyag mtshan gdengs: mdangs ldan 'od ris dmar chen bhandha gtams: mkhar phur las mtshon rtse gsum gyen du gzengs: ma rgyud 'bum gyi gtso mos rus rgyan gsol: me long 'od ldan lhag lhag ma sring sdud: nu ma bha ga rgyas pa'i bde drod 'phel: 'khor ba stong phyir mgo phreng tshal du dngar: brkyang bskum 'gying ba'i dga' bzhi'i gar dang ldan:

'bar zhing sreg pa'i me dpung sku la 'khril: ye shes mkha' la rol pa seṅge'i dpal: dur khrod rgyan drug spras la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ sku yi sprul pa bde chen mkha' 'gro ma: nad gdon zhi mdzad dkar mo seng gdong ma: dza landha ra'i gnas kyis dbang mo che: badzra ḍākki'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ gsung gi sprul pa brda sgrogs mkha' 'gro ma: tshe bsod dbang sdud dmar mo stag gdong ma: lam pā ka yi gnas kyi dbang mo che: padma ḍākki'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ thugs kyi sprul pa ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: gnas lugs mngon gyur phag gdong mthing nag ma: a tsi rta yi gnas kyi dbang mo che: buddha ḍākki'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ yon tan sprul pa dga' bzhi mkha' 'gro ma: 'byor drug rgyas mdzad ser mo dom gdong ma: tri sha ku na'i gnas kyi dbang mo che: ratna ḍākki'i yon tan phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ phrin las sprul pa rab g.yo mkha' 'gro ma: dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad sngon mo spyang gdong ma: tshandho ha yi gnas kyi dbang mo che: karma ḍākki'i phrin las phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ sgo skyong sgrol byed dus kyis pho nya mo: lo zla zhag dus phra men drug cu bzhi: bdud mo srin mo 'chi tshe srog bdag ma: ye shes las grub 'khor dang bcas la bstod: dzap bskul ni/ bhyo: bskul lo bzhengs shig ma sring ḍākki tshogs: thugs rje'i sku mchog mngon sum mtshon pa dang : rig sngags sgrub pa'i nus rtsal shugs phyungs la: bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dngos grub stsol: bzlas pa ni/ thugs kar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng mthing la gting mdangs dmar ba'i ngad chags pa sgra gdangs di ri ri sgrog pa g.yon du 'khor ba las 'od zer dpag tu med pa cher 'phros pas nang gi gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad bskul/ de thams cad las kyang 'od zer ches cher 'bar zhing mched pas las nyon sdig sgrib pha rol gyi byad grib sogs nyes ltung thams cad dag ste sku mdog mthing 'od bkrag mdangs gzi brjid cher 'bar bas/
