phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rab 'byams gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor longs spyod 'byung lnga'i bcud thams cad shugs kyis bsdus te 'khor 'das kun na 'gran zla dang bral khyab bdag dpa' mo chen mor nga rgyal bskyed la/ om̐ baṃ ḍākki siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ zhes rtsa sngags dang*/ om̐ badzra ratna padma karma buddha ya ha ri ni sa ḍākki sa ma ya hūm̐ bhyoḥ zhes las sngags bzlas pa'i tshe khyad par gdong can lnga la sogs pa'i spro bsdus las bzhi mchog dang bcas pa bsgrub pa'i ting 'dzin gang 'dod du bsgyur shes par bya'o/ yang bzlog ni/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ ces lus kyi gnas drug tu bkod pas/ ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro phra men shugs 'gro thams cad kyi srog snying drag tu bskul ba'i shugs kyis/ sngags 'bru rnams las 'od zer me'i tshwa tshwa drag tu khol zhing phyur ba las srid gsum thams cad drag sngags thog rgod kyi char phab pas pha rol byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa bsregs bcom rjes shul med par brlag /slar yang thugs rje'i shugs las bskal ba'i 'thor rlung g.yos pas 'dzin snang bag chags dang bcas pa dbyings su gtor te sbyangs/ snang srid thams cad khro mo'i sprin rab tu 'khrigs pa'i rta bros gzir bas dgra bgegs byad gdon log 'dren thams cad nam yang ldang med thugs rjes dbyings su rgyas btab par mos la/ phaṭḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ de yang sgrub pa'i skabs su rtsa sngags dang*/ las phran skabs drag sngags bcu bzhi/ zor las sogs kyi tshe yang bzlog ste zlog sngags rnams 'dir bzhugs pas skabs 'dir bsnyen sgrub kho nar bya ba la dgos pa chung phyir zur yang bar byas so/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams bzlas rjes mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong can gtso 'khor la:

phyi mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'bul: nang mchod sman raka gtor gsum bha ling 'bul: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol ga ṇa tshogs mchod 'bul: rkang gling thod rnga rol mo sgra ldan 'bul: om̐ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ma hā ta na ga ṇa pū dza kha kha khā hi: zhes mchod la sngags bstod ni/ bhyoḥ rgyal kun rdo rje rnal 'byor rigs: drag mo khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs: nam mkha'i mdog can me 'od 'phros: seṅge'i gdong can lha mor bstod: mthar thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ ma skyes rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i skur ston pa: 'gro ba'i don mdzad ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: nam mkha'i mdog can dbu ni seṅge'i gdong : ye shes me ris ma rig mun pa gsal: thugs rje'i me dpung srid gsum ma lus sreg: 'jigs byed chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsgral ba'i phung po lhag med zhal du gsol: dug gsum sha khrag sku gsum klong du rol: sgo gsum mi mthun bar chad med par mdzod: stong nyid bya bral gnyug ma'i ye shes che: mtha' bral ro gcig phyag rgya chen por gyur: ka dag 'od gsal chos sku 'du 'bral med: mnyam rjes dbyer med rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur cig: de nas bsnyen sgrub sogs rgyun khyer gyi skabs rjes chog 'og nas 'byung ba ltar byas pas chog skabs 'gar tshogs mchod sogs spro bar 'dod na/ gsol mchod rgyas bsdus gang rigs sngon du song nas bshags skong bya/ rang lugs rig 'dzin srog sgrub tshig lhug mthar/ tshogs mchod dngos la 'jug pa ni/ thog mar byin gyis brlab pa la/ hūm̐: bdag nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros nyes skyon bsregs gtor bkrus: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis 'dod yon dpag med pa: 'khor 'das yongs la mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/

de nas tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod rang byung gdod ma'i klong : chos dbyings drag po e yi dur khrod nas: dbyings phyug ḍākki seng gdong 'khor bcas rnams: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang : bka' gter skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor bcas la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes par bzhes la thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mchog thun dngos grub myur ba nyid du stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: skong bshags ni/ bhyoḥ khyad par mnyes shing mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni: dur khrod pho brang rgyan spyod bkod pa 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: thod pa ltag sprod zhing lpags g.yogs pa 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: mchog chen gri rkang gling bu'i dbyangs ring 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: bhandha lcang lo rakta rnam lnga'i tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: sha chen tshil chen dri gsur ngad ldan 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: dmar chen dpal chen dar nag ba dan can: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: dgra bgegs sha khrag ri ltar spungs pa'i tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: zhing lpags rgyal mtshan dar nag g.yab mo phyar: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: phyag mtshan rnon po mtshon cha 'khor lo'i rtsibs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: ging pa gar pa dpa' mo'i gar bsgyur tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: gnas nyul dus mtshan ma mo gcer bu 'bum: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: gzhan yang mthun pa'i dam rdzas dgyes pa'i phud:

ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: 'bod pa'i gdangs chen 'brug ltar ldir ba bcas: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: bhyoḥ mchod rdzas sgrub rdzas skong rdzas sna tshogs kyis: rdo rje mkha' 'gro seng gdong thugs dam bskang : padma mkha' 'gro stag gdong thugs dam bskang : sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phag gdong thugs dam bskang : rin chen mkha' 'gro dom gdong thugs dam bskang : phrin las mkha' 'gro spyang gdong thugs dam bskang : las byed lcags gdong nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : las bdag mtshan mo sgra sgrogs thugs dam bskang : sprul pa ma mo mched gsum thugs dam bskang : yang sprul srin mo stong sde'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam dngos grub stsol: ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i spyan lam du: mchod pa lor zlar 'das pa mthol lo bshags: tshogs dang bskang mchod chag pa mthol lo bshags: sbyor sgrol gnad du ma khel mthol lo bshags: dus sgrub dus su 'das pa mthol lo bshags: dus min las la sbyor ba mthol lo bshags: bcu nya stong bzhi chag pa mthol lo bshags: rten 'brel sna tshogs chags pa mthol lo bshags: thabs shes kha 'gyed spyod pa mthol lo bshags: bde stong zung du ma 'jug mthol lo bshags: dam tshig spang blang bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: rdo rje'i sngags dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags: 'gyod tshangs dge bas mnyam nyid la gnas shog: ces yig brgya bzla/ bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: sras mchog gyad kyi phur bu kī la ya: gdeng zhing 'dril nas gzir 'debs dus la bab: ru tra gdug pa'i snying la mā ra ya: auṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya rbad rbad bhyo bhyoḥ gtubs te 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dam nyams dgra bgegs ru tra bsgral ba yi: sha khrag don snying dbang po sna tshogs 'di: ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas nam yang bgegs srin mi ldang mdzod:

om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: tshogs la rol/ lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: gnas yul dus bdag phra men ma: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: 'bar ma pho nya'i tshogs rnams la: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab 'bul: bstan srung mel tshe sgrubs par mdzod: om̐ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta kha kha khā hi: thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: mthing nag e yi pho brang nas: dbyings phyug ḍākki'i skur bzhengs la: mthu rtsal stobs kyi thugs dam bskul: las bzhi kun 'grub phrin las bcol: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag cag byang chub mchog thob ste: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par mdzod: ces tshogs gtor 'bul: de nas chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i dus: snying thig sbas dang bton pa'i tshe: khas blangs bzhin du gtor ma bzhes: yang zab bya ra 'grub par mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya i daṃ bha lingta la khā hi: brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod skyong ma sring bcu gnyis kyis: mthun rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: yul srungs lo legs bkra shis spel: dus 'khrugs nad yams zhi bar mdzod: om̐ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le ti ma ma khā hi: rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bro ra ru: ma sring 'dus pa'i bro rdung bas: phyi nang bar chod thal bar rlog: las bzhi lhun grub chen por gyur: om̐ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: bgegs srin dam sri satwaṃ bha ya nan: dbang blang ba ni/ hūm̐: zab dbyings ye shes 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: bdud 'dul ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs: thugs dam rgyud bskul mchog thun dngos grub stsol: dbang bzhi ye shes thob par mdzad du gsol: om̐ badzra siṃ ha mu kha ḍākki nī kā ya siddhi om̐: wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐: gu na siddhi hrīḥ gu hya sarba siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong can gtso 'khor la:

phyi mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'bul: nang mchod sman raka gtor gsum bha ling 'bul: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol ga ṇa tshogs mchod 'bul: rkang gling thod rnga rol mo sgra ldan 'bul: om̐ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ma hā ta na ga ṇa pū dza kha kha khā hi: zhes mchod la bstod pa ni/ bhyoḥ rgyal kun rdo rje rnal 'byor rigs: drag mo khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs: nam mkha'i mdog can me 'od 'phros: seṅge'i gdong can lha mor bstod: bzod gsol ni/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor cho ga'i yan lag ma tshang dang : ma 'byor dam nyams 'di phyi'i sgrib g.yogs rnams: ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bshags: yig brgya bzlas/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar dang*/ bsdu ldang ni/ dkyil 'khor ngo bo 'dzin med stong pa'i ngang : hūm̐ yig gyen ldog mi dmigs chos skur āḥ gsal stong gdod ma'i dbyings phyug mngon gyur shog: a a āḥ zhes bsdus la/ om̐ baṃ ḍākki siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ bhyoḥ slar ldang zhing go cha'i rgya dang bcas/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rakṣa maṃ/ go bgo zhing lus srung*/ bsngo smon ni/ hoḥ ji snyed phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun thugs rje'i bdag: brtse bas dgongs phyir smin mdzad smon lam tshogs: grub ste ci lta'i bdag gi dge tshogs kun: mtha' yas ma gyur byang chub 'thob phyir bsngo: bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas gsang ba'i yum: ye shes mkha' 'gro nam mkha'i 'od: rab dga'i mdangs ldan g.yo ba mo: seng gdong ḍākki'i bkra shis shog: de ltar byad khrol gser gyi lde mig gi gdong lnga'i gsang sgrub ur mo'i gzhung ci bzhin las/ sngon rjes sogs rigs mthun gzhan nas mi 'gal bar brgyan te bkod pa 'di yang mnga' bdag nyang chen gyi gdung*/ sprul sku nam mkha' 'gro 'dul gyi dbon rigs su gyur pa/ rig sngags 'chang ba dbang chen mthu stobs 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis bskul ba ltar/ zab rgya mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod cha shas tsam 'dzin pa dus mtha'i sngags 'chang skyid grong smyon pas kong yul sa yi thig le/ kra ti drag sngags rol pa'i yang dben sku gsum rdo rje'i gzhal med khang chen du sbyar ba 'dis bdud rigs log par 'dren pa dmigs med du gzhom zhing*/ gsang chen gyi theg pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /de ltar rig 'dzin chen po'i chog khrigs las mdun bskyed byad bzlog dang 'brel ba'i cha shas rnams bsdus nas bsnyen sgrub dkyus mar 'jug bde bar byas pa dang chad brtan bskul gsum rta bro sogs kha 'gengs dgos pa rnams gsang ye sogs rigs mthun gzhan nas bsnan la go rim cung zad 'khrugs bsdebs dang bcas gu hya shā sa na dha ras bgyis pa 'gro kun byad phur gtad gsum gyi g.yul las rgyal ste bdud 'dul ḍākki'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ ye shes mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge'i gdong can las: bsrung bzlog rgyun khyer ngag 'don bzhugs so:

mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i rgyun khyer ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: 'khor ba dong sprugs sems bskyed do: snang srid ye stong rdzogs pa che: de'i ngang chos 'byung gzhal yas khang : me rlung thog ser 'khrugs pa'i dbus: pad nyi bam steng rang gi sems: skad cig dran rdzogs mkha' 'gro ma: mthing nag seṅge'i gdong pa can: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum bgrad: ljags brkyangs g.yu ral nam mkhar gzengs: skam rlon thod pa'i dbus rgyan dang : do shal dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar phyar: g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang bsnams: gru mor kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum bcug: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs 'gying : thugs ka'i bhyo mthar sngags g.yon 'khor: de 'og me rlung thog mtshon 'khrugs: phyi nang ban bon byad ma yis: sngags zor rbod gtong ngan pa kun: bsad bcad brlag gtor phyir bzlogs nas: tshur 'dus mtshon cha sna tshogs gyur: me dpung 'bar bas bskor bar gyur: rtsa ba'i sngags/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ srung bzlog sngags ni/ hūm̐ badzra tu ra na ma swā hā: e sa bhyo zlog: e ka ya ma du tri rbad: ces bskyed rim gsal ba'i ngang nas ci nus bzlas: thun mthar mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma hūm̐ du gyur nas nam mkhar thim: snang srid brda mtshon gsal stong zung 'jug ngang la bzhag: de ni rgyun khyer bsrung bzlog go: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rjes jo bo gze rgyal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so// // rlung zhags mkha' 'gro'i gsol 'debs bde chen dpal bskyed bzhugs so/ na mo/ spros bral chos sku'i klong yangs nas/ /chos sku kun tu bzang mo la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /chos sku'i gnas lugs rtogs par shog /lhun grub longs sku'i gzhal yas nas/ /longs sku mkha' 'gro sde lnga la/

/gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /lhun grub snang bzhi mthar phyin shog /thugs rje kun khyab pho brang nas/ /sprul sku ye shes mtsho rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rlung sems rang dbang thob par shog /bde stong e yi pho brang nas/ /yang sprul rlung zhags ḍākki la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /gtum mo'i bde drod 'bar bar shog /'khor lo lnga yi pho brang nas/ /rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dga' bzhi ye shes smin par shog /gnas yul nyer bzhi'i pho brang nas/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /gang 'dul 'gro don mthar phyin shog /rlung sems las su rung ba'i mthus/ /dhū ti'i rtsa mdud rab grol nas/ /sa bcu lam lnga mtha' ru phyin/ /'khor lo tshogs chen sa thob shog / ces pa'ang gnam lcags smyon pas bris// // rlung zhags mkha' 'gro'i las byang bde chen dpa' mo'i rol rtsed ces bya ba bzhugs so// // dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mkha' klong nas: thugs rje thabs kyi ḍākki'i skur: rnam rol khyab bdag rlung zhags kyis: khams gsum nyon mongs 'ching la 'dud: khrag 'thung padma drag po'i yum bka' rtsa rlung dpal bskyed ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa ni/ las rim khrigs chags su bsdebs pa'i sdom la: skyabs saims mtshams gcod byin brlab sngon 'gro dang : lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag mchod dang : bstod pa 'dzab bzlas gtor 'bul dngos gzhi'o: tshogs mchod lhag bskul chad brtan rta bro dbang : bzod gsol nyer bsdu bsngo smon bkra shis rjes: zhes dang sngon 'gro'i dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: mchog gsum rtsa brgyud bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: byin rlabs ngo bo pad 'byung thugs rje'i bdag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal ḍākki sku dngos mchog: brtse chen ye nas 'bral med skyabs su mchi:

lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ na mo: dbyings rig ngo bo ma bcos lhun grub las: gcig tu 'gags med shar ba snying rje'i yul: 'khor 'das cir snang ma gyur sangs rgyas zhing : gdod nas 'khor gsum yongs dag sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ dkar gtor sngon du 'gro bas/ bgegs gtor bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo?khaṃ swā hā/ gsum pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ ma gcig yum chen khros ma'i thugs ka nas: bar med khyab pa'i 'gugs byed pho nya 'phros: gnod byed bgegs tshogs gtor ma len phyir khug: bdag gi bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis: mchod sbyin 'di khyer rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'di ru glags blta na: bdag nyid dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas: skar ltar 'khrugs pas mtshon char thun du brdeg: me ltar 'bar bas bgegs dpung bsregs gtor gzhom: de bas bgegs tshogs 'byung po phyir dengs shig: om̐ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa mtshams gcod srung 'khaur ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ bdag nyid khros ma rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas: mtshon cha me ri drag po thog ltar 'phros: gnod byed tshar bcad mtshams gcod las grub nas: tshur 'dus mi shigs rdo rje'i gur khang gyur: om̐ badzra dzwa la rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: lnga pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ hūm̐: phyi snod gling bzhi nyi zla nor bu'i snod: nang bcud dbang po rnam lnga sman raka dang : gtor mchod bha ling ga ṇa tshogs kyi rdzas: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs la sogs pa: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur:

om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba a haṃ pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha liṃ ta ga ṇa tsakra āḥhūm̐: om̐ ru tra ma ra ṇi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs shing bdud rtsis bran no/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi yi dang po bskyed rim ni/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las rlung lnga bsnaul ba'i dal: pho brang rgyan rdzogs gru bzhi sgo bzhi mdzes: mtshan nyid kun tshang 'ja' zer klong dgu ldan: sna tshogs tog mdzes de yi dbus nyid du: nyi zla padma g.yung drung ljang gsal steng : ye shes mkha' 'gro ljang 'od mdangs dang ldan: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gar stabs 'gying tshul ldan: zhal 'dzum mdzes shing ratnas dbu la brgyan: thor tshugs dar dpyangs zar bus sku rgyab khebs: rus pa'i rgyan 'phyang nu ma bha ga rgyas: phyag g.yas rlung zhags g.yon pas tshe bum 'dzin: phyag gdub zhabs gdub rin chen se mo do: gcer mo 'gying stabs bde stong lhag ge ba: phyogs bzhir rang 'dra las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: sku mdog ljang gsal g.yas pas rlung zhags 'dzin: g.yon pas nor bu padmas mtshan pa bsnams: gar stabs bsgyur zhing dbang sdud mgyogs mar gsal: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'od zer gyis: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho bsgrub phyir spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ phyogs bcu mi mngon rang byung e yi mkha': chos 'byung ljang nag rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas: dbang sdud rlung gi bdag mo 'khor dang bcas: khams gsum dbang du bsdud phyir gshegs su gsol: om̐ baṃ ḍākki yaṃ hūm̐ dza hoḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: thabs shes rang bzhin nyi zla g.yung drung steng : dbang sdud zhags pa 'gyed pa'i pho brang dbus: phyi yi tshogs drug nang gi snang 'gugs phyir:

rlung gi gdan la dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: om̐ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jo sgeg dpa' mo g.yo ba'i shugs 'chang ma: mdangs ldan sring mo dga' ba'i bde spel ma: srid gsum dbang sdud las kyi ḍākki ma: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: om̐ na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: mu tig mdangs ldan zla rgyas byams pa'i bcud: rgya skag ngad ldan dmar gsal rgyun 'byung rdzas: bde chen ngang tshul dpa' mo dgyes pa'i phud: 'khor lo'i mnga' bdag dbang mo che la 'bul: om̐ badzra puṣpe sogs ?shabda a haṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: hūm̐: bde ba yab la stong pa yum: zung 'jug sbyor ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim sogs: ro mngar reg bya 'jam pa yi: phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : dug lnga ma spangs ye shes ngang : nyon mongs rang grol chags med rdzas: sku lnga lhun grub nang mchod 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : gsang ba ḍākki rig ma'i tshogs: gar sgyur bde ba'i mkha' lam du: rlung gis bskyod pa'i rdo rjes bsrubs: mnyes phyir yid kyi chu gter 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : lcang lo can gyi bhandha ru: sha lnga pañtsa rdzas kyis gtams: zag med bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : dung zhal bde ba chen po'i nang : mdangs ldan dmar chen 'od du 'bar: sna tshogs rakta'i mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : ru tra bsgral ba'i thod pa ru: dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dbang po spungs: bsgral ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : ye nas rmad byung ngo bo'i rdzas: rang byung ma 'gags ye shes kyi: dmigs med mchog gi mchod pa 'bul:

mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : phyi nang mnyes pa'i rten rdzas mchog: me long mda' dar bla 'khor sogs: spyan gzigs du ma'i mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : om̐ ma hā sarba pū dza me gha mu tra spha ra na sa ma ye swā hā: drug pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: ye shes dbyings kyi ḍākki dpa' mo che: rlung sems mdangs ldan 'ja' 'od ta la la: dgyes chags khro la 'dzum bag shigs se shig: rin chen rgyan ldan 'dod rgu'i gter 'dzin ma: cod pan mdzes pa'i thor tshugs ldems se ldem: phyag g.yas rlung zhags snang srid dbang du sdud: g.yon pas tshe bum rtsa rlung thig le bskyed: phyag gdub zhabs gdub rin chen khro lo lo: rus pa'i rgyan ldan g.yer kha si li li: nu 'bur rgyas shing lte ba rab tu zlum: bha ga rab rgyas bde drod chi li li: gar stabs sgeg mo'i 'khril ldem khyugs se khyug: g.yung drung pad zla'i gdan la 'gying mdzad ma: dbang sdud rlung gi bdag mor phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phyi rim las byed mgyogs ma'i shugs 'chang ma: dus bzhir 'gyu ba'i yid 'ong gar mo bzhi: rin chen rgyan ldan 'dod rgu char bzhin 'bebs: ljang gsal mdangs ldan tshogs drug snang ba 'phrog: g.yas pas rlung zhags lha mi dbang du sdud: g.yon pas thabs shais pho mo'i blo sems 'gugs: rus pa'i rgyan ldan dar dpyangs pu ru ru: gcer mo gar sgyur nu ma bha ga rgyas: 'jo sgeg mdzes ldan lha mo bzhi la bstod: khyod la bstod cing phrin las bcol ba ni: phyi nang snod bcud mi nor dbang du sdud: nang gi rtsa rlung bde drod thig le bskyed: gsang ba dga' bzhi ye shes mngon gyur nas: dbang sdud 'ja' lus mkha' 'gro 'grub gyur cig: bdun pa 'dzab bskul ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba dbyings kyi dbang phyug ḍākki'i tshogs: ye shes thugs dam 'dzab kyis rgyud bskul la: zung 'jug bde chen 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'i phyir:

ma sring khyed rnams srog ltar bzung lags na: zab lam dpa' mos rtag tu grogs gyis shig: phung khams 'od lus chos sku 'grub pa yi: ma khyod bdag gi dpung gnyen mchis pa'i phyir: bzlas pa sngags kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul: bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i skur gsal ba'i/ gtsug tor nam mkha'i 'khor lo ru/ /rigs bdag padma thod phreng rtsal/ /'khor lo lnga ru rim pa bzhin/ /rdo rje padma sangs rgyas dang*/ /rin chen las kyi ḍākki lnga/ /sku mdog dkar dmar mthing ser ljang*/ /rang 'dra'i rigs kyi yab dang sbyor/ /thugs srog ha ni baṃ ri sa'i/ /mtha' mar rang mdog sngags kyis bskor/ /rtsa khams ba spu'i grong khyer du/ /'bum phrag yangs pa'i ḍākki'i tshogs/ /til gyi gang bu lta bur gsal/ /spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum la/ /gdung shugs drag po'i gsol btab mod/ /thugs srog oṃ dang sngags phreng las/ /bde stong ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /sbyor mtshams nas byung gnas lnga yi/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i spyi bo nas/ /rim zhugs rang srog sngags phreng la/ /phog pas g.yon bskor drag tu 'khor/ /spro bas 'od kyis srid zhi khyab/ /bsdus pas gzi byin lhag par 'bar/ /gtso 'khor ma lus thams cad kun/ /bde chen ye shes nyams 'ur bas/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'u ru ru/ /dga' bzhi'i bro rdung khrigs se khrig /rtsa khams ba spu tshun chad kun/ /bde dang stong par phri li li/ /dug lnga dbyings su sangs se sang*/ /dbang bzhi rgyun 'bab na ra ra/ /'ja' dang 'od du kyi li li/ /zer dang zer phreng ya la la/ /snang ba sku ru lams se lam/ /sgra grags sngags su di ri ri/ /dran rtog chos skur sangs se sang*/ /ma rig nyon mongs ka nas dag /snod bcud mkha' 'gro'i da lar rdzogs/

man ngag gsum ldan gyi dgongs pa las/ om̐ ḍākki ha ri ni sa pa shaṃ te dzwa hrī dha ya su khaṃ sarba siddhi dza dza: zhes sngags dang dmigs gnad sbyar te/ /thog mar yid bzlas dang*/ /de nas skyo tshe rags pa rlung bzlas dang phra ba rdor bzlas sngags kyi skyon drug spangs nas/ /bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad 'khyol bar byas la/ /mtshan ma byung dus dngos grub len zhing gtang rag rgya chen bya'o/ sham bur/ om̐ sarba shwa ri pun+ye lo ka pa shaṃ ma ma thun thun dza dzaḥ zhes bzlas/ gzhan yang las sbyor spyi dang bye brag gi sngags rnams gang 'dod spros shes par bya'o/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mthar mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: mu tig mdangs ldan zla rgyas byams pa'i bcud: rgya skag ngad ldan dmar gsal rgyun 'byung rdzas: bde chen ngang tshul dpa' mo dgyes pa'i phud: 'khor lo'i mnga' bdag dbang mo che la 'bul: om̐ badzra arghṃ pā dyaṃ sogs? shabda āḥhūm̐: ma hā pañtsa la khā hi: ma hā bha liṃ ta la khā hi: ma hā rakta la khā hi: ma hā sarba pū dza la khā hi: hūm̐: 'jo sgeg dpa' mo g.yo ba'i shugs 'chang ma: mdangs ldan sring mo dga' ba'i bde spel ma: srid gsum dbang sdud las kyi ḍākki ma: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: 'byor ba drug ldan rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: mos pa rnam bzhi dbang gi dngos grub stsol: dgra bgegs tshar gcod drag po'-i dngos grub stsol: las bzhi lhun gyis 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: ye shes mkha' 'gro lha tshogs khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje: mdzad pa'i phrin las: skyob pa'i nus mthu: ster ba'i dngos grub: bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' bas: deng 'dir bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams la mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol: om̐ ḍākki ha ri ni sa pa shaṃ te dzwa hrī dha ya su khaṃ sarba siddhi dza dza:

kā ya siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa om̐: wākka siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsitta siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sarba siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ brgyad pa thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ snod bcud yongs khyab sha lnga bdud rtsi'i tshogs: me rlung sbyor bas sbyangs spel stobs bskyed pa: 'bru gsum nus ldan zag maid bdud rtsir bskyil: kun bzang mchod sprin dpag med 'char bar gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ hūm̐: ma skyes rdzogs pa chos dbyings las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i sku: ma gcig dbyings phyug mkha' 'gror bzhengs: rdo rje rin chen padma las: kun kyang ljang 'od rlung shugs can: rin chen rgyan cha khro lo lo: sna tshogs cod pan pu ru ru: rgyan drug dril g.yer si li li: rol mo glu dbyangs di ri ri: snang srid 'gul ldeg khyams se khyam: 'od dang zer du spungs se spung : dgyes pa'i 'dzum mdangs lhags se lhag: bde ba'i chu rgyun na ra ra: 'du 'bral med par dungs se dung : ma lus 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs: dam rdzas rmad byung a mṛ ta: 'dod yon longs spyod gter chen po: 'khor ba rgyu bsgral rakta dang : tshogs kyi 'dod yon dpag med pa: ro bcud mdangs ldan zad mi shes: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: 'byung ba bzhi yi bcud dang zhag: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: snang srid sha khrag drod dbugs mdangs: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: 'khor 'das thams cad dbang du sdus: dbyer med nyams rtogs rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: log rtog bdud rigs snang ba sgyur: snang srid chos la 'god par mdzod: nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad sol: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha liṃ ta ga ṇa tsakra sarba pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes mchod 'dod don gsol la/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la bcu gcig /dang po tshogs rdzas bdud rtsis bsang zhing*/

hūm̐: bdag nyid mkha' 'igaror gsal ba'i thugs ka nas: dngos 'dzin sbyang phyir ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum 'phros: tshogs kyi nyes skyon bsregs gtor sbyangs shing bkrus: byin gyis brlab phyir oṃ'aḥ.āḥhūm̐ gsum 'phros: rdzas la phog pas bskyed cing spel ba yis: zag med bdud rtsi ro mchog dpag med gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams nas: ma gcig ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor: yang 'khor ḍākki bye ba 'bum: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: glu len gar sgyur shigs se shig: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: gter srung las byed sha ra ra: byin rlabs sprin ltar thibs se thib: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs nas kyang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ gsum pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: mchod pa'i lha mo gar sgyur tshogs: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : chos skyong gter bdag dam can la: 'bul lo mchog gi dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba sa ma ya ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: bzhi pa skong bshags ni/ hūm̐: snang srid khyon ltar rab tu bkang ba yi: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bla med rdzas: spyan gzigs la sogs kun tshang rgya mtsho 'dis: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang : dbyings phyug bde chen dpa' mo'i thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud mgyogs ma sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : bka' srung gter bdag pho nya'i thugs dam bskang : snang srid mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : thugs dam gnyan skong nyams chag nyes ltung rnams: 'dod yon tshogs kyis bshags so dag gyur cig: yi ge brgya pa bzla'o: lnga pa bsgral bstab ni/ na mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba ting 'dzin phyag rgya sngags:

gsang ba ḍākki ma sring bye ba 'bum: bka' gter skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor bcas kyi: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa yis: sangs rgyas bstan dgra rnal 'byor sgos dgra dang : rkyen ngan bar gcod glo bur bgegs kyi tshogs: dgra gzugs tha ma'i liṅga 'di la khug: oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phur bu thogs la: hūm̐: sras mchog gyad kyi phur bu kī la ya: gdengs shing 'dril ba'i gzir 'debs dus la bab: ru tra gdug pa'i snying la mā ra ya: phye mar brlag cing bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya rbad rbad bhyo bhyoḥ hūm̐: gsang ba dbyings phyug dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: ma rungs dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: dgyes par bzhes la bdud bzhi'i tshogs bcom nas: sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: drug pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: gnas nyul dus bdag phra man ma: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: 'bar ba pho nya'i tshogs rnams la: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab 'bul: bstan srung mel tshe 'grub par mdzod: om̐ u tstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ ham̐'u: mi mngon ka dag lhun grub 'og min zhing : gsang ba e yi dbyings nyid klong dkyil nas: rigs kyi bdag po gu ru thod phreng rtsal: dbyings phyug dpa' mo khams gsum dbang sgyur yum: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi shugs 'gro phra men tshogs: thugs dam bskul lo 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhengs: da lta snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus mthar 'dir: ma rungs bdud rigs 'byung po sna tshogs kyis: gsang sngags bstan la gdug rtsub sdang zhing gshe: sgrub par 'tshe rgod g.yo ba'i log 'dren tshogs: myur mgyogs thugs rje'i stobs kyis dbang du sdus:

tshad med bzhi yi nus stobs dpung bskyed la: ma dag gzugs kyi phung po gum gum chums: ngag gi sdang dgra smod tshig lkugs su chugs: sems kyi zhe sdang gdug pa'i dbyings su choms: sdig sgrib bag chags 'od du ya la la: rang rig gzhi grol ka dag sangs se sang : snang srid mkha' 'gro'i zhing du me re re: ma rig nyon mongs gzung 'dzin dbyings su sgrol: 'khor 'das mnyam par sbyor ba'i phrin las mdzod: brgyad pa chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar bskal tha ma'i dus: snying thig sbas dang bton pa'i tshe: bka' srung gter bdag rgya mtsho yis: khas blangs bzhin du gtor ma bzhes: yang zab bya ra 'grub par mdzod: sarba dharma pā la i daṃ bha liṃ ta khā hi: dgu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod skyong ma sring bcu gnyis kyis: mthun rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: yul srungs lo legs bkra shis spel: dus 'khrugs nad yams zhi bar mdzod: om̐ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le te te ma ma khā hi: bcu pa rta bro brdung ba n-i/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bro ra ru: ma sring 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas: phyi nang bar gcod thal bar rlog: las bzhi lhun grub chen por gyur: om̐ nanaḥ a nan: hūm̐ nan: dgra bgegs dam sri satwaṃ bha ya nan: bcu gcig dngos grub blang ba ni/ hrīḥm: mchog gi dbang bskur spyi bor stsol: padma thod phreng gtsug tu thim: sku yi dbang bskur lus la stsol: rdo rje mkha' 'gro dpral bar thim: gsung gi dbang bskur ngag la stsol: padma mkha' 'gro mgrin par thim: thugs kyi dbang bskur yid la stsol: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro snying khar thim: yon tan dbang bskur sgo gsum stsol: rin chen mkha' 'gro lte bar thim: phrin las dbang bskur brtan par stsol: las kyi mkha' 'gro gsang bar thim: hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: gsang ba ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: tshe chos zas nor dngos grub stsol:

snyan grags mnga' thang dngos grub stsol: 'jam phrug gos kyi dngos grub stsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun: deng 'dir bdag gis thob gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ha ri ni sa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kā ya wākka tsitta gu na karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rjes chog la drug las/ dang po mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: mu tig mdangs ldan zla rgyas byams pa'i bcud: rgya skag ngad ldan dmar gsal rgyun 'byung rdzas: bde chen ngang tshul dpa' mo dgyes pa'i phud: 'khor lo'i mnga' bdag dbang mo che la 'bul: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda a haṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: hūm̐: 'jo sgeg dpa' mo g.yo ba'i shugs 'chang ma: mdangs ldan sring mo dga' ba'i bde spel ma: srid gsum dbang sdud las kyi ḍākki ma: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: gnyis pa bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam las 'gal ba dang : ma 'byor nyams dang chad lhag 'khrul pa'i tshogs: mthol zhing bshags la mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: ces yig brgya bzlas: brtan bzhugs bya/ gsum pa rdzogs rim bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐: klong yangs nam mkha'i cho 'phrul sgyu ma bzhin: bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor mi dmigs chu zla ltar: ka dag dbyings rig klong du badzra muḥ 'gags med rol rtsal sku gsung thugs su rdzogs: a a āḥ bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ ma sring mkha' 'gro gnyan gyi dal bzung nas: bskyed rdzogs phyi nang dge bcu'i nyams len mchog: brtson 'grus zab mos myur blangs bgyis pa'i tshogs: ma gyur srid pa'i mtsho sgrol ched du bsngo: lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ ting 'dzin 'dus pa gnyan gyi dal bzung nas: ma sring ḍākki srog ltar sgrub pa yis: dam tshig g.yel ba med pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rgyud thams cad du: zab lam rjes bzung mchog gi dga' ston gyi:

'bras bu smin nas rnga yab dpal ri ru: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'tshogs par shog: drug pa bkra shis ni/ om̐: chos sku'i bkra shis yum chen pha rol phyin: gnas lugs rang rtsal mngon rdzogs bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis ḍākki dbyings phyug ma: cir snang sgyu mar rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rlung zhags dbang mo che: 'bras bu kun kyang lhun grub bkra shis shog: gang 'dul bkra shis mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i tshogs: lam bzhi mtha' ru phyin pa'i bkra shis shog: sna tshogs bkra shis ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ma sring 'khor tshogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: rten 'brel bkra shis bden gnyis mtha' ru phyin: 'gro don nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam bkra shis shog: nyin yang bkra shis mtshan yang bkra shis nas: dus drug rtag tu bde legs rgyas par shog: ces shis pa'i me tog char du dbab bo/ de ltar mkha' 'gro'i chog khrigs 'di yang*/ skal ldan gyi slob bu du mas yang yang bskul ngor/ gter gsar gyi mkha' 'gro gzhung rnams nas mi 'gal bar brgyan te/ nor skyong klu mo gzi ldan gyi pho brang g.yu mtsho rten 'brel la kha'i mgul du skyid grong smyon pas bkod pa dge bar gyur cig /slar yang rlung zhags mkha' 'gro'i las byang 'di nyid la go rim cung zad mi 'dra ba 'dug pas gsang ba spyi ltar bcos shing zhu dag phran bu bcas rab rgyan sa stag lor dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyin gu hyas par bskrun zhus pa 'dis skal ldan rnams la bde chen mchog gi dngos grub mngon du byed pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // sgrub pa'i skabs ni dzap bskul mgor bhrūm̐ bi shwa sogs dzap khang dbye/ de nas bsnyen pa dmigs bzlas khyug tsam grub rjes/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i gnas lnga ru/ /rigs lnga mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas/ /thugs srog sngags phreng 'od zer gyis/ /mdun bskyed mkha' 'gro'i thugs rgyud bskul/

/gnyis ka'i thugs srog sngags phreng las/ /rang 'od sgra bcas g.yon bskor du/ /'khor ba'i 'bum phrag sde lnga yi/ /lha tshogs ma lus thugs kar phog /kun gyi thugs srog sngags phreng ni/ /rang sgra dang bcas 'khor ba dang*/ /bzod med bde ba'i nyams 'bar zhing*/ /thams cad gtso bo nyid la ni/ /g.yon du kyil kyil bskor ba dang*/ /zhal nas sngags dbyangs kyu ru ru/ /zhabs kyis bro rdung khrigs se khrig /srid gsum yom zhing dbang du sdus/ /nyams rtogs yon tan gong du spel/ /tshur bsdus rang la thim pa yis/ /mchog thun dngos grub thob par dmigs/ gnad ni bdag bskyed kyi gsal snang 'bar bas mdun bskyed zil gyis gnon pa/ bar du srog gi 'khor lo bskor bas dam tshig mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus/ thun mthar srog gi 'od dmar gyi thig le rang la bsdu ba ni/ mkha' 'gro'i srog 'phrog pa'o// // tsha) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi las byang 'ja' lus srog sgrub ngag 'don chu babs su bkod pa bzhugs so/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa 'chi med mgon po tshe mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ de'ang tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi las byang 'ja' lus srog sgrub ngag 'don chu babs su bkod pa la/ sbyor ba ni/ thog mar sgrub gnas byin ldan sogs dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i gnas su byi dor legs par byas la mdun stegs tshe lha'i sku rten bris 'bur sogs legs par bkram pa'i dbus su tshe gtor rta mgos brgyan pa g.yas g.yon du tshe ril tshe chang rgyab tu mda' dar mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod bcas bshams/ rang nyid bde ba'i stan la bag pheb 'khod pa'i mdun du bum pa ḍā dril 'thor nas nang mchod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad tshang bar bsags la kun slong rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ skyabs yul mdun mkhar gsal la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/

e ma hoḥ 'og min rnam dag bkod pa'i pho brang nas: chos sku snang mtha' tshe bdag yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dbyings rig mkha' spyod gsang ba'i pho brang nas: gtso mo tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro sde lnga la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rnga yab padma 'od kyi pho brang nas: mtshungs med gu ru padma yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bod yul yang rdzong shel brag gnas mchog nas: gnubs ban buddha dzñā na yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: brda bzhi bka' bab lung bstan pho brang nas: rig 'dzin gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'chi med mkha' 'gro rdo rje'i snying phug nas: zab chos yang snying lcags kyi rgya mdud la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zab rgya bka' gtad skyong ba'i pho brang nas: bka' skyong dam can gter gyi bdag po la: gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: brgyud pa'i bla ma rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus: thugs rje byin rlabs gzi byin mchog g.yo ba'i: nus chen brtse ba'i dbang bzhi deng bskur nas: nam yang mi shigs rdo rje'i sku gyur te: 'od zer 'ja' lus gzugs mchog der gnas shog: om̐ hrīḥ.ā yurdzñā na ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes gsol 'debs rdzogs nas mi dmigs ting 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi blangs/ gzhung dngos la 'jug pa la'ang*/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ thog mar sbyor ba sngon 'gro la bdun/

dang po skyabs sems ni/ mdun mkhar bla ma tshe dpag med dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro bar mos la skyabs sems 'jug pa gcig gis bskyed pa la/ e ma hoḥ sku gsum klong yangs ye shes snying po'i thugs: gdod nas rang byung ka dag ji bzhin du: 'bad rtsol bral ba'i ngang nas sems bskyed do: skye 'chi du khaḥmi dmigs bag yod blos: sgyu ma'i gar tsam mchog gsum dkyil 'khor lha: sgrub pa'i snang tshul de bzhin skyabs su mchi: lan gsum dang mthar tshogs zhing rang la bstims/ dkar gtor spyi 'gros ltar song ste/ gnyis pa bgegs gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo?khaṃ swā hā/ gsum pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdag nyid 'bar ba dbang gi sku: dkyil 'khor bar gcod tshe yi bdud: mchod sbyin khyer la rang sar dengs: bar du gcod pa rdul du rlog: om̐ hya ghṛ wa badzra wā ra hī gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: gsang 'dus tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: 'od zer glog stong drwa ba 'gyed: 'byung lnga mi shigs rdo rje'i gur: las kyi tshe bdud mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra padma tsakra hūm̐ bhrūm̐: lnga pa mchod pa byin rlob ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod bcu drug nang mchod sman raka gtor: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med bde ba'i rgyun: zag med ye shes chen po'i dgyes pa bskyed: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta bha lingta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā su kha dharma dhā tu āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis rim bzhin sbyang ngo*/

drug pa byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐: mkha' klong ye shes pho brang nas: snang mtha' sangs rgyas thog ma'i mgon: tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: brda gar rgyan cha khro lo lo: byin rlabs sprin chen thibs se thib: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: 'dir 'tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī phaiṃ phaiṃ: a be sha ya a āḥ bdun pa dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐: deng 'dir 'chi med tshe yi dal bzung nas: sgo gsum yal bar mi 'dor srog ltar sgrub: dam tshig dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i gzhung bsrangs nas: rten 'brel bskyed rdzogs zab mo mig ltar brtse: oṃ dzñā na tsakra he ru ka a yu ṣe sa ma ya satwaṃ: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdag mdun khro bor sgrub pa gsum las/ dang po la'ang drug /dang po dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings rlung me sa chu las: 'byung ba yongs gyur gzhal yas khang : ma bcos lhun grub zhing khams nas: chu nang zla ltar dkyil 'khor gsal: hūm̐ ā yurdzñā na bhrūm̐: gnyis pa lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: dran rig rang snang gnyis med zla gdan du: shes rig ngo bo g.yung drung ljang gsal steng : gsal stong hrīḥlas tshe bdag yab yum ni: gu ru padma gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: tshe yi bdag po padma dbang gi lha: sku mdog dmar gsal dri med rā ga'i mdog: longs spyod rgyan ldan zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: mnyam bzhag sbyor tshul tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: sems kyi dwangs ma dkar dmar bcud kyis bkang : phyed skyil pang du shes rab kun 'dus ma: dmar mo chags nyams bcu drug lang tsho ldan: rin chen rgyan ldan tshe bum mda' dar 'dzin: dga' bzhi dbang sdud tshe yi bcud 'dzin bsgom: phyi rol sgo ma tshe yi las mdzad ma: dkar ser dmar ljang lha mo mgyogs ma bzhi: rang mdog rgyan ldan gar stabs khro chas can: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma:

phyag g.yas tshe bsod bcud bsdus tshul du bsgom: phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams nas kyang : tshe yi lha tshogs gsal 'tsher gzi 'bar bsgom: 'od 'phros tshe yi lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: rnga yab mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i zhing : bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas: tshe bdag padma yab yum dang : sgo ma mkha' 'gro tshe bdag rnams: mkha' spyod tshe yi gnas mchog nas: gshegs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na badzra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhi pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal sdig bshags mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gsang 'dus tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: brtan bzhugs phyag 'tshal sdig pa bshags: phyi nang gsang gsum sprul pa'i tshogs: sku bzhi lhun grub mchod pa 'bul: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: badzra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: lnga pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral rdo rje'i sku: mnyam bzhag tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: mi 'gyur g.yung drung longs spyod rdzogs: 'ja' lus rang byung padma 'byung : rig 'dzin tshe yi lha la bstod: bde stong gar sgyur gsang ba'i yum: 'chi med bcud 'dzin yab la stob: mda' dar tshe bum rgyan lhub mdzes: lha lcam tshe yi bdag mor bstod: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi tshe 'dzin ma: 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus khams lngar stim: rlung lnga'i grogs mdzad bde skyed ma: rigs bzhi tshe yi lha la bstod: hūm̐: kun 'dus sgrub cing bsnyen pa'i lha: gzi brjid 'od klong dpal du 'bar: tshe bsod bcud bsdus lus la stims: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: gu ru tshe lha yongs rdzogs kyi: dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs la bstod: drug pa 'dzab dmigs ni/

thugs kar padma zla gdan steng*/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung ljang gsal yi/ /lte bar hrīḥyig dmar po'i nang*/ /tshe rten āḥyig dkar po dang*/ /srog gi ngo bo nṛ ljang mtshan/ hrīḥmathar sngags phreng dmar po 'phros/ /'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro don mdzad/ /'khor 'das snod bcud dngos po kun/ /bsdus nas rang la thim pa yis/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob/ rtsa bsnyen ni/ om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig bcas bzlas/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed la gnyis/ dang po dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bskyed cing bzlas pa ni/ om̐ swa bhā wa shuddho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: 'og min lhun grub brdal khyab chen po'i klong : rin chen padma rdo rje'i sa gzhi la: ye shes lnga yi pho brang gzhal med khang : gru bzhi sgo rgyan rta babs mtshan nyid rdzogs: mi sgrib zang thal 'od klong 'khyil ba'i dbus: rma bya brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin chen khrir: padma nyi zla'i gdan la thog ma'i mgon: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med: padma 'byung gnas ye shes ngo bo mchog: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag 'chi med tshe bum 'dzin: longs spyod rab rdzogs bde stong skyil krung gis: pang du ye shes dpag med dkar gsal 'dzum: pad phreng tshe bum 'dzin pa'i mgul nas 'khyud: skra grol rin chen padma'i rgyan drug mdzes: yab yum gnyis med nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi: thugs rje rol pa ye shes sku lnga'i mdangs: phyogs bzhir glang chen rta mchog seṅge dang : shang shang padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: rdo rje rin chen sangs rgyas las kyi rigs: tshe dpag med mgon yab yum dkar gsal mthing : ljang gsal gtso bo'i chas ldan tshe bum la: rdo rje rin chen 'khor lo rgya gram mtshan: phyi rim phyogs mtshams padma 'dab brgyad la: sgeg phreng la sogs bkra shis lha mo brgyad:

g.yas pas mda' dar g.yon pas tshe bum 'dzin: sgo bzhir tshe yi khro bo rta mchog dpal: dkar ser dmar ljang lcags kyu zhags pa dang : lcags sgrog dril bu tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: rigs kyi yum 'khril rang rang 'khor tshogs 'bum: gzhan yang phyi nang steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun: tshe yi rig 'dzin drang srong srung ma'i tshogs: bsam gyis mi khyab 'od zer glog stong 'khyugs: mdor na chos dbyings zhing kun ma lus pa: 'chi med tshe lha'i dkyil 'khor zer dpung 'khrigs: kun kyang ye shes snying po mtshan dpe'i sku: thugs rje'i 'od snang nyi zla ther 'bum bzhin: 'od dang zer 'khrugs lta bas mi bzod cing : 'bar ba'i shugs kyis tshe bdud 'byung po gzhom: tshe yi sngags sgra 'brug stong lta bur ldir: sgrub la 'chi med dngos grub stsol bar bsgom: de nas rang gi thugs kar gnam lcags kyi: rgya gram lte bar nyi zla'i gwa'u nang : srog rten nṛ yig ljang gur 'od lnga 'phros: g.yas su tshe srog mi 'gyur āḥdakar po: g.yon du brtan par byed pa'i hūm̐ mthing kaḥ gsum ka bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro: 'khor 'das kun gyi tshe dpal bsod nams stobs: ma lus skad cig sdud pa'i nus pa ldan: de las 'od zer gzung thag gnyis med 'phros: mdun bskyed thugs kar nyi zla'i gwa'u'i nang : hrīḥyig dmar gsal rab tu 'tsher la phog: gdung bas rgyud bskul bde stong gzi brjid g.yos: rang mdangs rtsal 'phros rigs bzhi 'khor tshogs kyi: stobs bskyed rang rang sku las 'od tshogs 'phros: phyogs dus rgyal ba rab 'byams tshe byin dang : nyi zla rgyu skar sa chu me rlung bcud: 'jig rten khams kyi tshe dpal srog gi rten: āḥnṛ hūm̐ gi rang bzhin 'ub 'ub tu: ring par bsdus shing tshe bum mer gyis khengs: chil chil khol bas thams cad gtso bum ru: sib sib blug cing tshe 'dzab di ri ri: bdud rtsi khol zhing phyur ba bar med babs:

yab yum sbyor mtshams byang sems dkar dmar rgyun: lhan cig bdag gi spyi bo'i tshangs bug zhugs: gsang gnas yan chad dkar dmar ltem gyis gang : de yang tshe yi ngo bo bcud kyi bcud: dwangs ma'i dwangs ma thams cad 'ub kyis drangs: nṛ hūm̐ āḥl thim pas bkrag mdangs 'bar: 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros te: snod bcud khyab pas 'khor bcas tshe dpal gyi: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad 'ub 'ub bsdus: snying kha'i 'bru gsum la thim srog rtsa gang : bdag nyid bkrag mdangs 'od 'bar rdo rje'i sku: dngos su gyur te nyi zla'i gwa'u nyid: kha 'grigs 'og gi rdo rje rgya gram gyi: rwa bzhi gyen langs bsnol mar rgya mdud du: rgyas btab rwa rtser 'od zer me tshwa 'phros: rtsa gnas ba spur rta mgrin grangs med bstim: bar gcod srung zhing bdud tshogs 'byung po bsregs: rgya mdud steng du ye shes tshe dpag med: dkar gsal tshon gang 'gyur med rtag bzhugs bsgom: sgrub sngags ni/ om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ ma ma pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gnyis pa tshe 'gugs pa ni/ mdun bskyed rang nyid padma'i sku: tshe lha rigs lnga 'dus pa'i ngo bo la: gsol btab mos gus gdung bas thugs dam bskul: 'khor 'das bcud bsdus stobs rtsal gzi byin bskyed: mda' dar sna lnga g.yab cing tshe 'gugs bskul: gsungs pa bzhin/ mda' dar g.yab cing snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas/ hūm̐: sngon tshe ka dag chos sku'i klong : lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas dang : dbyings phyug lha mo tsaṇḍa lī: 'chi med rdo rje'i skur bzhengs te: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: rgyun chad med par thugs rje yis: 'gro ba 'dren par dam bcas bzhin: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: de 'og dag snang longs sku'i zhing : rā ga ra ta'i dbang phug tu:

rig 'dzin mtsho skyes rdo rje dang : mkha' 'gro lha lcam manda ras: dbang chen rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs nas: skye 'chi bgres rgud bral bar gyur: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: rgyun chad med par thugs rje yis: 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dam bcas bzhin: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: de 'og 'gro 'dul phrin las zhing : brag dmar gnam rdzong g.ya' ma lung : slob dpon pad 'byung mtsho rgyal gyis: dus la bab pa'i thugs bskyed nas: rten 'brel rdo rje'i tshe bsgrubs pas: 'chi med lha tshogs dngos su byon: skal ldan smin grol byin gyis brlabs: rdo rje tshe srog sgrub lung bstan: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: rgyun chad med par thugs rje yis: 'gro ba 'dren par dam bcas bzhin: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: sngon dus tshe yi khungs re brtan: da lta sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyis: sgrub rten dam rdzas dngos su bshams: bskyed rdzogs dbyer med rnal 'byor gyis: 'chi med rdo rje'i srog bsgrub ste: 'gro kun sgrol bar dam bca' bzhin: sku gsum tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: dam tshig gnyan po'i dus la bab: sprul pa'i 'od zer pho nya yis: stong gi 'jig rten rab 'byams gang : ye shes rdo rje'i stobs nus kyis: 'chi bdag sde brgyad 'byung po gzir: bla tshe nyams pa thams cad khug: snang srid 'byung lnga nyi zla yi: nus bcud bsdus la tshe dpal bskyed: ye shes sku lnga'i rang bzhin du: mi 'gyur mi shigs rgyas thob cig: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings ḍākki tshe 'gugs ma: mthing gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'tsher: nam mkha'i bcud bsdus sems la stims: g.yung drung tshe yi rgya mdud stsol: hūm̐: shar phyogs mgyogs ma lcags kyu ma: dkar gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'tsher: rol mtsho bdun gyi bcud bsdus la: rdo rje tshe yi rgya mdud stsol:

hūm̐: lho phyogs mgyogs ma zhags pa ma: ser gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'bar: ri rab gling bzhi'i bcud bsdus la: rin chen tshe yi rgya mdud stsol: hūm̐: nub phyogs mgyogs ma lcags sgrog ma: dmar gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'tsher: snang srid dkar dmar bcud bsdus la: padma tshe yi rgya mdud stsol: hūm̐: byang phyogs mgyogs ma dril bu ma: ljang gsal rang mdangs 'od du 'tsher: rtsa rlung thig le'i bcud bsdus la: las kyi tshe yi rgya mdud stsol: hūm̐: thugs las sprul pa'i mgyogs ma ni: rang rang rigs mthun dpag med 'phros: mthu stobs mnga' thang rgyas pa yi: 'dzam gling kun gyi bcud bsdus la: 'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gtso mchog sku lnga rigs 'dus lha: 'khor 'das lam gsum tshe dpal gzi 'bar lhun: padma 'byung gnas rig 'dzin tshe yi lha: ye shes rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: dkar mo tshe bdag sku yi dbang bzhi stsol: dmar mo tshe bdag gsung gi dbang bzhi stsol: sngon mo tshe bdag thugs kyi dbang bzhi stsol: ser mo tshe bdag yon tan dbang bzhi stsol: ljang mo tshe bdag phrin las dbang bzhi stsol: sku lnga rdo rje'i srog tu rgyas thob cig: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ ma ma pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

zhes lan grangs ci mang bya zhing dmigs pa bskyar/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig bcas brjod/ gsum pa khro bor bsgrubs pa la brgyad/ skabs 'dir 'chi med tshe mchog sgrub pa la bar chad sel phyir tshe rta kha sprod bya ba gal che bas des na 'dir hya ghṛ wa'i mngon rtogs bya ba la/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ hūm̐: na mo bla ma dbang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha la skyabs su mchi: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i las byed phyir: mngon spyod drag po bsgrub par dam bca'o: ram̐ ram̐ ram̐ yam̐ bi shuddhe kham̐ sarba ye swā hā: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang mchod rdzas byin gyis rlabs/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed cing spyan drang ba ni/ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: padma sūrya tsand+ra ti ra baṃ hūm̐ bhyo: zhes yongs su gyur pa las rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang phyi nang stong gsal 'ja' zer 'khrugs pa'i klong du padma nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la: rang nyid dbang chen rta mgrin sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa ral pa'i khrod nas rta zhal ljang nag rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs pa: phyag g.yas dbyug pa dang : g.yon tshe bum lcags sgrog 'dzin pa: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad kyi rgyan gyis spras pa: yum rdo rje phag mo dmar skya gri thod 'dzin pa mgul nas 'khyud pa yab yum bskal pa'i me ri dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir gar mo tshe'i pho nya bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang ste phyag g.yas rang mdog gi phyag mtshan dang : g.yon 'chi med tshe yi bum pa 'dzin cing rang byung ye shes 'od kyi klong du gsal ba'o: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis dbang chen he ru ka'i lha tshogs spyan drangs: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ

zhes spyan drangs/ gsum pa dbyer med du bsre zhing phyag bya ba ni/ om̐ badzra tiṣṭha lhan: gyis rten la brten par bya/ om̐ na mo a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ sa phyag dang brda lan byas par mos/ bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ me tog dmar po dbang gi rdzas: dri zhim kun khyab dwangs ma'i sprin: snang gsal 'od kyis ma rig gzhom: mdangs ldan bdud rtsi dri yi chab: longs spyod bsod nams zhal zas bcud: sman raka gtor ma dgyes pa'i rdzas: tshogs mchod spyan gzigs rol mo'i dbyangs: blo yi blangs nas sprul pa'i tshogs: dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pū dza ye pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi: lnga pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: snang srid kun kyang dbang drag dkyil 'khor zhing : snod bcud gzugs rnams rta mchog rol pa'i sku: sgra grags skye med hya ghṛ wa'i gdangs: ma 'dres thugs nyid gnas lugs snang mtha' yas: rol pa'i rtsal chen khrag 'thung dgyes pa'i gar: dbang chen tshe bdag lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: drug pa bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang gi thugs kar pad nyi gdan la thugs srog hrīḥdamar nag gi mthar/ sngags phreng rang sgra dang bcas g.yas su 'khor ba'i 'od zer me tshwa lta bu 'phros/ tshe gegs log 'dren thams cad thal ba bun bun du bsregs/ 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par mos la/ tshe sgrub sngags ni/ om̐ badzra ā yur garbha hya ghṛ wa hṛ da ya swā hā: ci nus dang*/ bdun pa tshe dbang 'gugs pa ni/ mda' dar g.yab la/ om̐: skye med chos sku'i pho brang nas: āḥ 'gags med longs sku snang mtha' yas: hūm̐: sprul sku khro rgyal dbang chen sku: trām̐: yon tan tshe yi pho nya 'gyed: hrīḥ deng 'dir phyogs bcu'i thugs rje bsdus: ha: bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs:

ri: 'chi med dbang chen don rtogs nas: ni: snying po ka dag 'od kyi sku: sa: rang bzhin rdo rje'i srog 'khor tshugs: srog sgrub sngags ni: om̐ badzra dzñā na hṛ da ya hya ghṛ wa ā yur siddhi hūm̐: bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ skabs 'gar bla 'gugs spro bar mos na phud rgod dang gser skyems bshams la/ mda' dar g.yab cing bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ mi mngon nam mkha'i klong yangs nas: ma yum chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: tshe bdag rdo rje rnam 'byor ma: tshe 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mos bskor: yang sprul rigs bzhi pho nyar 'gyed: dbu skra thor tsugs shigs se shig: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: myur mgyogs gar stabs khyugs se khyug: byin rlabs 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: thugs rje'i glog dmar tshubs se tshub: nus rtsal gzi brjid spungs se spung : bla 'gugs mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: thugs dam bzhengs bskul dus la bab: phud rgod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gi: bla tshe bdud kyis 'phrog pa rnams: da lta nyid du khug la shog: lha srin 'byung po'i rigs rnams kyis: bla 'di sba'am brkus pa rnams: phyogs bcur khyab pa'i pho nya yis: gab khung phud de khug la shog: rgyal bsen sman mo 'dre rgod kyis: bar du gcod cing gnod srid na: rtsal chen drag pos chad pa phob: las kyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: mi bla bdud la ma bskur 'tshal: bla rten srog mkhar 'di la khug: don med bla 'khyams ma 'ded par: dmod pa'i bla 'di khug la shog: ming dang gzugs phung 'di la khug: gnas dang mal sa 'di la khug: srog dang rten phur 'di la khug: tshe yi dar thag rgyud nas khug: srog gi mda' mo'i rgyud nas khug: bla yi rdo rje'i rgyud nas khug: ming gi mtshan byang rgyud nas khug: ma sring mkha' 'gro mthu ma chung : rbad pa'i pho nya rtsal ma zhan:

mngags pa'i ra mda' bang ma bul: 'khyams pa'i bla 'di khug la shog: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i bdud gzhom pa'i: me dpung tshwa tshwas khongs la shog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ oṃ badzra muṃ wā ra hī ḍākki nī ha ri ni sa dzaḥ ā yurdzñā na ṇi badzra aṃ ku sha ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes mda' dar g.yab cing mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum gyis phyogs bcur khyab ste: bla tshe yal ba thams cad bsdus shing : chaig la bstim par bsam: mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig spyi ltar sbyar bas 'thus/ brgyad pa chos skyong gi gsol mchod la/ khyad par gnod sbyin mdung dmar can gyi gsol mchod ni/ rang nyid dpa' bo rta mgrin gyi nga rgyal dang bcas/ hoḥ rang nyid dbang chen 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas byang phyogs mchong lding smug po'i pho brang nas: gnod sbyin 'bar ba 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs: om̐ badzra sha yakṣa tsa dzaḥdzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha ki na: nyi ma byang phyogs pha ki na: tshangs pa 'phrul gyi pho brang nas: dbang chen 'bar ba'i bka' nyan pa: gnod sbyin shan pa mdung dmar can: ma thogs gnas 'dir da tshur byon: slob dpon padma'i bka' bzhin du: rig 'dzin bdag gi phrin las sgrubs: spyan gzigs phyi yi mchod pa 'bul: sman raka nang gi mchod pa 'bul: sbyor sgrol gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: ba ling sha khrag mchod pa 'bul: mthun rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: bka' dang bstan pa srung du gsol: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya ghri ba shu la dhe ba yakṣa bha lingta kha kha khā hi: de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ dzaḥ mi mngon lhun grub tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dbyings: rin chen du ma las grub pho brang dbus: dbang chen bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad pa'i phyir: gnod sbyin tshul 'chang btsan rgod mthu bo che:

bswe khrab bswe rmog gsol nas rta dmar zhon: phyag g.yas btsan mdung g.yon pas nor bu 'dzin: zhags dmar dang ni stag ral gzig shubs brgyan: 'khor du gnod sbyin bu mo nor 'dzin bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang dar 'phen ne'u le 'dzin: rin chen rgyan ldan 'gro ba'i bsod nams bsdus: longs spyod 'gugs phyir gar thabs mkha' la bsgyur: sprin ltar gtibs shing ma nges cha lugs 'gyed: res 'ga' lha yi dge bsnyen tshangs pa'i gzugs: res 'ga' gnod sbyin chen po dkor bdag gzugs: res 'ga' dgra la rbad tshe shan pa'i gzugs: khyod ni dbang chen padma'i bka' nyan mchog: tshangs pa dung thod gnod sbyin me 'od gdong : chos skyong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa yis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i bar chad bsal ba dang : phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'gro ba thabs kyis sgrol: rnal 'byor bdag gi tshe bsod longs spyod spel: dkyil 'khor sgrub la mi dbang bar chod rigs: log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs rnams kun: btsan rgod shan pa khyod kyis sgrol bar mdzod: ces sngags ni: om̐ shu la de wa tsa tri yakṣa swā hā: om̐ badzra pra mo ti ri yaksha ku mā rā dza swā hā: mchod sngags ni: sarba i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol ba sogs rgyun ldan ltar bya/ skabs 'dir rang lugs bka' gter srung ma'i gsol kha spyi 'gros rgyas bsdus gang rigs 'don/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gnyis/ tshogs mchod dang rjes chog go /de la tshogs mchod bya ba'i rim pa ni/ tshogs kyi yo byad phun sum tshogs par bsham/ spro na na rag bshags pa'am bsdu na brjod med don bshags mthar sman raka gtor ma'i bskang ba rnams song nas gtor bsngos tshig lhug mthar/ dang po la'ang bcu bzhi las/ thog mar tshogs byin rlob ni/ chu chang gis bran la/ om̐ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las tshogs gzhong bhandha lcang lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du tshogs mchod ngo bo ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ dang om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis sbyangs pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur:

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyang*/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang gi rnal 'byor gyi: thugs las byin rlabs yi ge 'phros: snang ba'i bag chags sbyangs par gyur: tshogs rdzas zag med pū dza hoḥ gnyis pa tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: snang mtha' rig 'dzin tshe dpag med: rgyal sras drang srong brgyud par bcas: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: cod pan dar dpyangs pu ru ru: rnga sgra dung gling 'u ru ru: g.yer kha dril bu si li li: ḍā ru cang te'u khra la la: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: dur khrod tshogs khang mdangs dang ldan: rnal 'byor pho mo dam tshig gtsang : 'dir tshogs smon lam skal par ldan: mchod rdzas tshogs mchod bcud mchod rgyas: bla ma rig 'dzin rgya mtsho rnams: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin chen phob: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ ma hā gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa a be sha ya a āḥ gsum pa tshogs mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma rgya mtsho tshogs la rol: yi dam rgya mtsho tshogs la rol: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho tshogs la rol: dam can chos skyong tshogs la rol: yul lha gzhi bdag tshogs la rol: rigs drug pa ma tshogs la rol: a la la ste bzhes su gsol: bzhi pa tshogs phud 'buul ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas skal ldan bdag cag la: phyi nang mchog thun dngos grub stsol: gu ru de wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: lnga pa bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: phyi nang spyan gzigs mchod pa bshams: lha tshogs mnyes pa'i bskang rdzas 'di: 'chi med lha yi thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: tshe bdag dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi: lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : zhal zas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang :

bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs dam bskang : rakta dmar gyis thugs dam bskang : sgra dbyangs rol mos thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang : spyan gzigs du mas thugs dam bskang : sna tshogs mchod pas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: drug pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings klong yangs rin po che: dug lnga ye shes ngo bo nyid: dgag sgrub spang blang re dogs bral: bdag gzhan kun slong mthol lo bshags: phyin chad ye grol la gnas shog: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang*/ bdun pa bsgral ba ni/ tshogs tha ma la raktas bran zhing dmigs bya dgug pa ni/ hūm̐: mdun du lcags snod gru gsum nang : gzugs ling dgra bo'i rten mkhar la: chos skyong pho nya'i bden pa'i mthus: gnod byed dgra sri myur du khug: badzra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ de nas phur bu thogs la bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen khrag 'thung thugs kyi sras: rdo rje gzhon nu phur pa'i sku: gnam lcags rngam pa'i dbal ldan 'di: byad ma'i snying du kī la ya: nṛ tri myog thum dgra bo rbad: bdud rtsi'i bran la zhal du bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: dbang chen lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: byad ma bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rngam yangs chos nyid lto bar bskyil: ldog med ye shes dbyings su hoḥ brgyad pa tshogs la rol ba ni/ hoḥ rdo rje rgyal po dgongs su gsol: dngos grub 'byung ba'i rdzas chen mchog: rmad byung yon tan kun tshang 'di: 'dir 'dus ya mtshan gnang bar stsol: lan gdab pa la/ hoḥ gzigs shig gsang gsum bla med chos: ro gcig ting 'dzin zas mchog 'di: bzang ngan blang dor bral ba yi: rtog med ye shes a la la hoḥ dgu pa lhag zhus sngon du song nas lhag ma kha phrus bran la 'bul ba ni/

hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan dregs pa'i tshogs: phud la mi dbang lhag sdud ma: bka' yi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra 'byung po zhal du thob: utstshiṣṭa bha lingta kha kha khā hi: bcu pa bskul bya ba ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: chos dbyings ngang las drag por bzhengs: sngon gyi thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: thugs dam ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: gsol kha'i gtor 'bul phrin bcol bcas mthar dbyung*/ bcu gcig pa chad mdo bya ba ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min gnas mchog tu: snang mtha' ḍākki gos dkar gnyis: dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbang phyug ging sman khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: de 'og mā ra ti ka ru: pad 'byung manda ra ba gnyis: 'chi med rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor phyes: 'bar ma pho nyas khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: de 'og zangs mdog dpal ri ru: gdong dmar srin po 'dul mdzad cing : kha byang bka' rgya gtad pa'i tshe: chos skyong ging bzhis khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: o rgyan gter bdag gling pa yis: sha za ḍākki'i pho brang nas: rtsa gsum tshe sgrub zhal phyes tshe: bstan srung dam can khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo srungs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

bcu gnyis pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma sman: bstan skyong ya ma bcu gnyis rnams: gtor ma bzhes la bstan pa srungs: sngon gyi tha tshig dran par gyis: ma ma hriṃ hriṃ dza dza phaiṃ phaiṃ la la le le kha kha khā hi: bcu gsum gtor gzhong 'og tu dgra sri lan gsum bkug ste/ rta bro ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kas: dam sri bsgral nas rta bro brdung : chem chem dgra bo'i mgo la rdung : mnan mnan nam yang ma ldang zhig: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ bhrūm̐ tsakra ya dgra bo nan: gtor gzhong kha yar bstan te 'bru 'thor ro/ om̐: 'grub par gyur cig dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: āḥdagyes par gyur cig mchod sprin rgya mtsho mchod: hūm̐: bde bar gyur cig mtha' yas sems can rnams: hrīḥ 'grub par gyur cig bkra shis bde legs shing : trām̐: brtan par gyur cig smon lam mthar phyin shog: bcu bzhi pa dngos grub len pa ni/ hūm̐: tshe la dbang ba rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: tshe chos zas nor srid kyi dngos grub stsol: tshe yi dbang bzhi smin grol mchog thob nas: tshe bsod mnga' thang 'byor rgyas thob gyur cig: rtsa sngags sham bur/ kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: tshe rdzas rnams spyi bor blangs shing dngos grub zhu ba la/ e maḥ rje btsun 'gro mgon thugs rje can: pad 'byung sku lnga yab yum tshe dpag med: gnyis med gsang ba'i yum mchog dbyings phyug ma: tshe lha rig 'dzin rgyal ba 'dus pa'i tshogs: bkra shis bum pa lha yi gzhal yas khang : 'chi med tshe bcud bdud rtsis rab tu bkang : bkrag mdangs 'od 'bar sgrub tshad mtha' ru phyin: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la da bab na: mgon po khyod kyi tshe zhag dus 'dir lags: thugs la le lo btang snyoms ma mdzad par: rdo rje'i nam langs nyi zla nam mkhar shar: rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis: rig 'dzin sgrub la tshe yi dbang mchog bskur:

skye 'chi med pa tshe yi dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags sham bu ni: om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa a yurdzñā na hrīḥm ma pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: om̐ badzra ratna buddha padma karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ hūm̐ swā om̐ hā a bhi ṣiñtsa satwaṃ: zhes dbang blang zhing tshe chu 'thung : sgrub rdzas ril bu lnga myong zhing : tshe chang nang gi ril bu yang : tshe sgrub yin na so sor sbyin: tshe ril tshe chang kun la rol: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ nyams su myong bar bya'o/ gnyis pa rjes chog la lnga/ dang po mchod bstod ni/ om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral rdo rje'i sku: mnyam bzhag tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: mi 'gyur g.yung drung longs spyod rdzogs: 'ja' lus rang byung padma 'byung : rig 'dzin tshe yi lha la bstod: bstod par 'os pa thams cad la: zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi: lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu: mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi: gnyis pa bzod gsol ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyis stsal ba/ /de kun mgon po'i bzod par gsol/ om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya brjod/ brtan bzhugs ni/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*/ /nad med tshe dang dpal 'byor dang*/ /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes me tog 'thor ro/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ldang ni/ hoḥ mi dmigs snang mtha'i dkyil 'khor tshe yi dal: dgongs pa zang thal chos sku'i klong du hoḥ rang rig gdod ma'i gnas lugs rgyal sa zin: ma bcos spros bral ngang du a la thim: a a āḥ zhes dmigs med chos nyid sgyu ma'i ngo bo skyong*/ om̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ

skad cig gis o rgyan tshe dpag med gsal bar gyur/ go cha'i rgya dang bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rakṣa maṃ/ go bgo zhing lus srung*/ bzhi pa bsngo smon ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'chi med gsang ba'i dal bzung nas: sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gcig tu sgrub pa'i mthus: dge ba rgya mtshos sems can smin gyur nas: kun bzang pad 'byung go 'phang myur thob shog: lnga pa bkra shis brjod ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum 'khor lo pad 'byung mkha' 'gros bskor: zung 'jug tshe la rab tu dbang ba yi: 'chi med bdud rtsis rtag tu ngoms byas nas: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis brjod cing me tog 'thor/ tshe sgrub rnam bzhi'i smon lam bzhugs so/ hrīḥ tshe mtha' yas pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang*/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag med snang mtha' yas/ /tshe 'phrang 'jigs kun skyob mdzad zil gnon rtsal/ /mi shigs tshe yi bdag nyid padma 'byung*/ /mi brjed gzungs thob tshe 'dzin mtsho rgyal ma/ /'byung lnga'i bcud 'dzin tshe bdag sgo ma bzhi/ /'byung po'i tshe jag mthar byed hya ghṛ/ /zab gter gnyan gyi srung ma seṅge'i gdong*/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /rab gus gdung bas gsol ba snying nas 'debs/ /myur mgyogs thugs rje lcags kyu'is rtsal phyung nas/ /'ja' lus tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi byin rlabs kyis/ /gnas 'dir skyes chen zhabs pad brtan pa dang*/ /dge 'dun 'dus sde sku tshe ring ba dang*/ /mkha' mnyam yongs la bde skyid 'byung bar shog / de ltar tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi las byang 'ja' lus srog sgrub ngag 'don chu babs su bkod pa zhes bya ba 'di bzhin rtsa ba'i gter gzhung le'u phran kha thor du bzhugs pa rnams dkyus gcig tu bsdebs la kha 'gengs dgos pa re gnyis rang lugs tshe sgrub rdo rje'i go khrab sogs rigs mthun gzhan nas bsabs te nar 'gros su bklag chog par byas pa 'di'ang gsang sngags phur pa gling gi sgrub sde gsar bu ba rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub nyams len skabs nye bar mkho ba'i ched 'di ltar dgos zhes sgrub brtson mant+ra sogs kyis bskul ngor gnam lcags pa bstan 'dzin ming gis grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams sku tshe mi shigs snang mtha'i ngo bo ru 'tsho zhing bzhes la don gnyis phrin las kyi mdzad pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig/

// dza) tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi bskang ba 'chi med dpal gyi ljon pa bzhugs so/ hrī/ tshem̐ dang ye shes mnga' bdag padma 'byung*/ /tshem̐ yi dbang mo lha lcam manda ra/ /tshem̐ lha 'byung bzhi gnas dag lha mo bzhi/ /tshem̐ bdag rta mgrin bka' srung bskang ba'i rdzas/ /rnam̐m bkra'i meṃ toṃg 'bum bzhad lang tsho ldan/ /rnam̐m kun g.yo ba'i bduṃg spoṃs zhing kun khyab/ /rnam̐m par gsal ba'i sgroṃn meṃ nyi brgya'i gzi/ /rnam̐m dag lha chu'i driṃ chaṃb mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /rnam̐m pa kun ldan ro brgya'i zhaṃl zaṃs brdal/ /rnam̐m mang snyaṃn paṃ'i phyi mchod sna tshogs kyis/ /rnam̐m mkhyen tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /rnam̐m smin 'chi ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ /kum̐n tshang rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a mṛ ta/ /kum̐n rtog dug lnga bsgral ba'i rakta bskyil/ /kum̐n khyab gtor tshogs sbyor sgrol gsang mchod sogs/ /kum̐n bzang mchod sprin ltar dmigs bskang rdzas kyis/ /kum̐n mkhyen tshe dpag lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /kum̐n snang mi rtag skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal sol/ /snam̐ng stong zung 'jug mngon gyur snang mtha' yas/ /snam̐ng srid dag pa lha sngags dkyil 'khor gsal/ /snam̐ng srid 'dzin zhen med pa'i lta sgom gyis/ /snam̐ng mtha' tshe yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /snam̐ng yul gzugs phung 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol/ /mam̐ dag gnod sems srog bcad sgrib gnyis byang*/ /mam̐ rig dbang gis lha sgom sngags bzlas g.yel/ /mam̐ rungs 'khrul dbang rtsa gsum dam tshig nyams/ /mam̐ tshang lhag chad nyams chag mthol zhing bshags/ /mam̐ lus 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /mim̐ 'da' chos dbyings klong shar 'chi med lha/ /mim̐ min 'khrul gzugs 'khor ba'i re dogs chod/ /mim̐ dmigs ka dag ngang la mnyam bzhag mthus/ /mim̐ 'jigs rig pa'i btsan sa zin gyur cig / ces yig brgya brjod/ lam 'dir mos pa dar rgyas ming gis bris so//

// wa) ༈ tshe sgrub zab mo lcags kyi rgya mdud las/ spros med rgyun khyer snying po dril ba bzhugs so/ 'chi med mgon po o rgyan tshe dpag med/ /dbyer med khyab bdag bla ma la btud de/ /spros med rgyun khyer snying dril 'dir spro na/ /bka' yis gnang ba stsol la byin gyis rlobs/ de yang tshe sgrub zab mos bsnyen sgrub sogs rgyun gyi rnal 'byor skabs/ thog mar bsham bkod 'dzoms na sgrub rten tshe gtor dang sgrub rdzas sman raka nyer spyod sogs spyi ltar 'du bya la/ rgyun khyer lta bu la ma 'dzoms kyang yid kyi sprul pas 'thus/ dngos gzhi sngon dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po skyabs yul mdun du gsal btab la/ mgon po tshe dpag med kyi dgongs pa yis: lha mo tsaṇḍa lī la thugs brgyud nas: 'chi med padma 'byung gnas byin brlabs te: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: tshe yi rig 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs: skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa ni/ hrīḥ bla ma tshe dpag med pa dang : tshe dbang rig pa 'dzin rnams la: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'gro ba sems can kun don du: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba yi: rig 'dzin thob par sems bskyed do: mi 'gyur rtag pa rdo rje'i sku: tshe bdag rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jig rten dang ni 'das pa yi: bcud rnams ma lus mchod pa 'bul: srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i las: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol lo bshags: 'chi med rig 'dzin grub la sogs: tshogs gnyis rnams la yi rang ngo : bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi: tshe yi bar chad sel bar bskul: ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: 'gro rnams tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shing : thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog: lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥtshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ ces tshogs zhing rang la bstims nas/ dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/

mkha' dbyings rlung me sa chu las: 'byung lnga yum gyur gzhal yas khang : ma bcos lhun grub zhing khams nas: chu nang zla shar dkyil 'khor gsal: hūm̐ ā yurdzñā na bhrūm̐: lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: dran rig rang snang gnyis med zla gdan du: shes rig ngo bo g.yung drung ljang gsal steng : gsal stong hrīḥlas tshe bdag yab yum ni: gu ru padma gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: tshe yi bdag po padma dbang gi lha: sku mdog dmar gsal padma rā ga'i mdangs: longs spyod rgyan ldan zhal gcig phyag gnyis ni: mnyam bzhag sbyor tshul tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: sems kyi dwangs ma dkar dmar bcud kyis bkang : phyed skyil pang du shes rab kun 'dus ma: dmar mo chags nyams bcu drug lang tsho ldan: rin chen rgyan ldan tshe bum mda' dar 'dzin: dga' bzhi dbang sdud tshe yi bcud 'dzin bsgom: phyi rim sgo ma tshe yi las byed ma: dkar ser dmar ljang lha mo mgyogs ma bzhi: rang mdog rgyan ldan gar stabs khro chags can: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma: phyag g.yas tshe bsod bcud bsdus tshul du bsgom: phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams nas kyang : tshe yi lha tshogs gsal 'tsher gzi 'bar bsgom: 'od 'phros tshe yi lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: rnga yab mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i zhing : bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas: tshe bdag padma yab yum dang : sgo ma mkha' 'gro tshe bdag rnams: mkha' spyod tshe yi gnas mchog nas: gshegs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: oṃ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa ā yurdzñā na sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal sdig bshags mchod 'bul ni/ hūm̐: gsang 'dus tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: brtan bzhugs phyag 'tshal sdig pa bshags: phyi nang gsang gsum sprul pa'i tshogs: sku bzhi lhun grub mchod pa bzhes: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐:

badzra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pū dza hoḥ ma hā maṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā pañtsa rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi: bstod pa bya ba ni/ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral rdo rje'i sku: mnyam bzhag tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: mi 'gyur g.yung drung longs spyod rdzogs: 'ja' lus rang byung padma 'byung : rig 'dzin tshe yi lha la bstod: bde stong gar sgyur gsang ba'i yum: 'chi med bcud 'dzin yab la bstod: mda' dar tshe bum rgyan ldan mdzes: lha lcam tshe yi bdag mor bstod: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi tshe 'dzin ma: 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus khams lngar bstim: rlung lnga'i grogs mdzad bde skyed ma: rigs bzhi tshe yi lha la bstod: dmigs pa ni/ rang gi thugs kar gnam lcags rdo rje ni/ /rgya gram lte bar nyi zla'i gwa'u'i dbus/ /thugs srog hrīḥdamar gsal 'tsher g.yas g.yon du/ /tshe dang srog rten aḥdakar nṛḥljang mtshan/ /hrīḥmathar sngags phreng dmar po g.yas bskor las/ /'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro kun sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /slar 'dus phyogs dus rgyal ba'i byin mthu dang*/ /nyi zla rgyu skar sa chu me rlung bcud/ /'khor 'das kun gyi tshe dpal bsod nams kun/ /āḥnṛ hūm̐ gi rnam par 'ub 'ub tu/ /rim par bsdus shing tshe bum mer gyis khengs/ /spyi bor bla ma'i ngo bo tshe dpag med/ /yab yum sbyor mtshams byang sems dkar dmar rgyun/ /lhan cig tshangs bug nas zhugs lus kun gang*/ /dwangs ma 'bru gsum la thim bkrag mdangs 'bar/ /'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog thob dmigs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa āḥyurdzñā na hrīḥ ci nus dang*/ khyad par rdzogs rim dang sbyar na rang gi dbugs tshur rngub pa dang 'khor 'das snang srid kyi tshe bcud rnams tshur bsdus thugs ka'i srog yig la thim par bsgoms shing*/ nang 'jug kho na grangs bsags pa dang sngags rnams kyang yid bzlas rkyang pa bya/

thun min rlung bum can 'byongs na de nyid gnad du bsnun pa dang*/ de ltar ma nus na'ang*/ rlung 'byin 'jug gnas gsum dang sbyar nas 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas pa la bslab par bya ba ste 'di ni tshe sgrub kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ mthar yang nyi zla'i gwa'u kha 'grigs nas/ /'bru gsum tshud pa'i rdo rje rgya gram gyi/ /rwa bzhis rgyas gdab rwa rtser me tshwa 'phros/ /rtsa gnas ba spur rta mgrin grangs med bstim/ /sngags phreng drwa bas gwa'u bcings pa yis/ /bar chod srung zhing tshe bdud bsregs par mos/ oṃ badzra āḥyur garbha hya ghṛ wa hri da ye swā hā/ de nas spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum yang*/ /ye shes bdud rtsir 'od zhu srog rten la/ /thim pa'i rgya mdud steng du tshe dpag med/ /dkar gsal tshon gang 'gyur med rtag bzhugs
