mos/ zhes pas rgyas gdab/ oṃ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa āḥyurdzñā na hrīḥmā ma pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes brjod mthar 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du bzhag skye 'chi med pa'i rig pa ni/ /gdod nas dag pa'i tshe dpag med/ /ngo shes g.yo med gdeng thob na/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sku 'grub 'gyur/ /de phyir nyams len gnad 'di gces/ /spro na tshe 'gugs pa ni/ de nas mdun bskyed rang nyid padma'i sku: tshe lha rigs lnga 'dus pa'i ngo bo la: gsol btab mos gus gdung bas thugs dam bskul: 'khor 'das bcud bsdus stobs rtsal gzi byin bskyed: mda' dar sna lnga g.yab cing tshe 'gugs bskul: zhes pas/ rgyas na tshe 'gugs thugs rje'i pho nya bya/ bsdu na/ hūm̐: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi tshe 'dzin la: sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang gar: mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin pa mo: lha klu mi yi bcud bsdus nas: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: tshe yi rig 'dzin myur 'grub mdzod: de nas rgyas gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab la: sra brtan 'gyur med rgya yis gdab: rim bsdus 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rnams: brtan par gyur cig badzra hoḥ thun mtshams rgyas gdab dmigs med dbyings su bzhag /rjes su dngos grub len pa ni/ hūm̐: tshe la dbang ba rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: tshe chos zas nor srid kyi dngos grub stsol: tshe yi dbang bzhi smin grol mchog thob nas: tshe bsod mnga' thang 'byor rgyas thob gyuracig: ces rtsa sngags bzla zhing de'i mthar/ kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ mi dmigs snang mtha'i dkyil 'khor tshe yi dal: dgongs pa zang thal chos sku'i klong du bsdu: rang rig gdod ma'i gnas lugs rgyal sa zin: ma bcos spros bral ngang du a la thim: aḥ.aḥ.āḥ zhes dmigs bral chos nyid sgyu ma'i ngo bo skyong*/ oṃ gu ru ḍākki ha ri ni sa āḥyurdzñā na hrīḥ

sa slar ldang la rjes thob kyi spyod lam bskyang zhing bsngo smon bya ba ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'chi med gsang ba'i dal bzung nas: sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gcig tu bsgrubs pa'i mthus: dge bcu rgya mtshos sems can smin gyur nas: kun bzang pad 'byung go 'phang thob gyur cig: bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum 'khor lo pad 'byung mkha' 'gros bskor: zung 'jug tshe la rab tu gnas dbang ba'i: 'chi med bdud rtsis rab tu ngoms byas nas: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog: ces bsngo smon shis brjod ci rigs pas mtha' rgyan par bya'o/ gzhan yang rdzas sman bcud len la brten nas tshe gso thabs dang*/ bsnyen tshad rtags rnams gzhung chen mo las gsal ba bzhin nyams su len no/ phan yon ni rtsa ba las rtag tu tho rangs nyi shar khar: brgya rtsa re re nges par bzla: snum zad mar me bsnan pa'am: nad pa sman gyis gsos pa ltar/ zad pa bsring zhing bri ba 'gengs: nyams pa spel lam rgyas par byed: tshe la rang dbang thob par 'gyur: mdor na rang don gzhan don dang : gdul bya phrin las 'dod pa'i don: ji ltar bsgrub cing rnal 'byor pa'i: sku tshe ring nas ci bsam 'grub: de bas mchog thun gang bsgrub kyang : tshe sgrub pa la nan tan 'tshal: tshul bzhin sus bsgrubs tshe mthar phyin: tshe tshad dag la dbang 'byor bas: bya byed gang brtsam rgyas bsdus dang : spang blang ji ltar 'dod bzhin chog: ces gsungs so/ zhes pa'ang rang slob ye shes rgyal mtshan nas 'di ltar bris zhes yang yang bskul zhing yi ge'i mthun gyur kyang mdzad par brten sgo chen sprul ming nas gter gzhung dgongs pa bzhin sbyar ba'o// // zha) ༈ tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi/ bsnyen yig padma'i do shal bzhugs so/ bla ma tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ tshe sgrub zab mo'i nyams len la 'jug pa'i gang zag gis spros med nyams su len par 'dod na/ thog mar yid 'ong dben pa'i gnas su sku gsung thugs rten dang nyer spyod sogs gang 'byor bshams pa'i gong du tshe gtor bum gzugs rta mgos mtshan pa g.yas g.yon sman raka dang tshe rdzas tshe chang mda' dar sogs 'byor na 'du bya/

med kyang bsnyen rkyang gi skabs tshe gtor kho nas kyang chog par bshad/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril nang mchod 'thor nas sogs sbyor ba'i chos rnams sngon du song nas/ dngos gzhi dus tshes dge ba'i thog mar bsang dang*/ sde brgyad mchod pa rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gzhung ltar tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs grub na legs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur phyir spyi dang mthun/ srod thun gyi snga log stan bde bar bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod la sngon 'gro'i rim pas blo sbyangs pa'i mthar/ skad cig gis rang nyid rta mchog he ru ka yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pas bgegs gtor byin rlabs dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas gtor ma bsngos la/ hūm̐: bdag ni 'bar bsogs kyi mthar hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang gu gul bdug thun gyis brabs la dmigs gnad dang ldan pas srung 'khor bsgom/ skabs 'dir rgyal chen sde bzhir phrin las bcol la gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ tho 'dzugs tshul spyi khyab ltar shes/ de nas phyi nang gi mtshams bcad/ skyabs yul gsal btab nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed yan lag bdun pa rnams grub nas tshogs zhing rang la bsdu/ dngos gzhi bskyed rim mchod bstod bar btang la/ skabs 'dir bzlas pa dngos la/ thog mar sku yi rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa nga rgyal brtan pa rnams re re bzhin gsal gdab ste/ thog mar sku yi gsal snang la sems bzung*/ de la cung zad brtan pa thob tshe rang gi snying dbus g.yung drung ljang gsal steng rdo rje rgya gram 'phred nyal gyi lte bar nyi ma 'og zla ba steng byas pa'i kha sbyor gwa'u kha bye ba'i dbus su/ srog gi yi ge hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang ldan par bskyed pa'i g.yas su tshe rten āḥdakar po/ g.yon du srog rten nṛ ljang gu gsal ba gsum ka 'od zer 'bar bar gsal gdab/ yang srog gi rig pa hrīḥmathar sngags phreng gis bskor bar dmigs te bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis sngags phreng g.yas bskor gyis drag tu 'khor ba'i 'od zer las byung ba'i mchod sprin lha mo grangs med 'phros phyogs dus rgyal ba'i zhing khams ma lus dus gcig tu khyab/

kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa mchod cing mnyes par byas/ de dag gi thugs rje byin stobs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur bsdus srog yig la thim pas gzi brjid dang 'od zer mchog tu 'bar/ slar ma dag pa'i khams gsum 'gro ba rnams la spros pas 'gro drug srid pa'i las snang sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa skad cig gis nyi mas ba mo bcom pa bzhin sbyang*/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pas/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i byin rlabs nyi zla rgyu skar sa chu me rlung sogs 'jig rten khams kyi tshe dpal bsod nams thams cad āḥnṛ hūm̐ gi rnam par tshur bsdus pas rang dang spyi bo'i bla ma tshe dpag med yab yum du gsal ba'i sku yi dbyibs dang phyag gi bum par zhugs/ bdud rtsi ma shong ba'i tshul du phyir lud pa dang*/ yab yum kyang bde ba chen por rol pa'i bde nyams 'bar zhing sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ba de nyid bum pa'i bdud rtsi dang lhan cig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun na ra ra babs nas rang gi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas zhugs te lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dwangs ma 'bru gsum la thim pas bkrag mdangs 'bar zhing 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros shing 'od kyi reg pa'i mod la phyi snod 'jig rten rab 'byams tshe yi dkyil 'khor du lam lam/ nang bcud 'gro ba mgon po tshe dpag med kyi sku ru shig shig /sgra grags ma lus tshe yi dzap sgra di ri ri sgrogs shing rtog tshogs thams cad chos nyid du thal thal/ mdor na tha mal gyi snod bcud stong ste 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog thob par bsams la yid bzlas dang*/ rlung bzlas la bslab/ de nas skyo tshe ngag gi bzlas pa la brtson par bya'o/ mthar nyi zla'i gwa'u kha 'grigs pa'i dbus su bla tshe srog gi rten yig 'bru gsum po de'i nang du tshud nas gzhom zhig bral bar gyur par bsam/

de nas rdo rje'i ra bzhi gyen du langs te gwa'u phyi nas sgam la lcags shan gyis bsdams pa bzhin du rdo rje'i rgya yis bsdams pa'i ra rtse rnams nas me yi tshwa tshwa zi ri ri 'bar ba dang tshe bdud bar chad thams cad bsregs/ lus rtsa gnas ba spu rnams nas kyang rta mgrin grangs med pa 'phros/ rta sngags kyi phreng bas bcings pas bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i mos pa dang bcas rta sngags cung zad bgrang bar bya'o/ slar spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum kyang 'od du zhu nas srog rten la thim pas rdo rje'i rgya mdud lte bar tshe dpag med dkar gsal tshon gang ba zhig 'gyur med rdo rje lta bu'i tshe mi 'gyur g.yung drung rtag brtan gzhom zhig bral bar bzhugs pa la rig pa gtad de/ las kyi sngags cung zad bzla ba dang*/ mthar dmigs pa spro bsdu dang bral ba'i ngang nas/ gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i rgyun bskyang bar bya'o/ de ltar bsnyen pa'i tshad kyang 'bum phrag bco lnga kha skong dang bcas pa dang gzhan gnyis thun mthar ci nus bzlas shing dmigs bsal gdab/ spro bar 'dod na tshe 'gugs kyang bya'o/ mthar mchod bstod bshags pa spyi ltar bya zhing rten la bzhugs su gsol/ rjes su mi dmigs ka dag gi ngang du bsdus la slar ldang zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo la bkra shis smon lam bcas mtha' bsdu bar bya'o/ bsnyen pa thems nas dbang bzhi blang zhing gtang rag tshogs kyi mchod pa dang*/ kha skong me yi mchod pa byas na nus pa myur/ de nas mtshams grol ba'i rjes su srog bslu dang lam 'phrang bcos pa sogs rgyab dpung dge ba'i spyod pa la'ang 'bad par bya'o/ zhes tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi bsnyen yig nyung ngur bsdus pa 'di'ang lam 'dir mos pa mi phyed dge ba'i blo can gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i ming can des rang gi nyams len la nye bar mkho ba'i ched du zin thun du bgyis pas 'gro kun tshe yi bar chad zhi zhing tshe mthar phyin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

// ༈ rtsa gsum spyi la 'jug pa'i me mchod phrin las bzhi ldan don gnyis dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ de yang 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i gter byon las bzhi me mchod bklag chog tu bkod pa la lnga/ dang po rtsa gsum bsnyen sgrub kha skong zhi ba'i me mchod la/ thog mar sbyor ba'i rim pa ni/ gter gzhung las/ rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs gang rung gi: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mthar son rnal 'byor pa'i: don gnyis 'bras bu myur du 'byin 'dod na: phyi yi 'byung khams gza' skar dus sbyor dang : nang 'byung lus kyang rgyan gos kha dog bsgyur: zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi yi dang po la: thab dbyibs zlum dkar rdo rjes mtshan par byas: spungs rdzas spyi dang zhi bar til dkar nag: ces gsungs pa ltar/ sbyin sreg bya ba'i dus kyang yar tshes gza' skar shis pa'i dus snga dro'i char rang nyid chas gos dkar po bsgyur la/ kha shar du gyu ba'i mdun g.yas su mchod rdzas gtor ma sman raka zhi ba'i 'bul gtor mchod pa sna bdun sogs mdzes par bkod/ g.yon du sreg rdzas rim par ku sha dpal 'bar rlung g.yab mar khu yam shing til dkar nag gtso bor byas pa'i spung rdzas dang tambu la gos zung rnams bkod/ rang mdun du ḍā ma ru rdor dril dgang blugs nang mchod sogs bzhag pa'i stegs mdun gangs ri bam̐ mtshan bris pa bcas tshags su tshud par bya/ sa slong sngon du 'gro ba'i mdun phyogs nye ba'i sar thab stegs gru bzhi ba byung gis byugs pa'i khar thig mtshon btab cing ba byung ngam dri'i chus chag chag gdab/ zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor lte ba 'dab brgyad rdo rje'i mtshan pa phyi rol rdor phreng zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje'i mtshan pa thams cad kha dog dkar por bsgyur la me tog gcal du bkram/ zhi bar 'os pa'i sman shing sogs kyi thab zlum por brtsegs pa slob dpon dang zhal sprod bya/

bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar sngon du song nas bzlas pa'i rjes las bum sgrub pa ni/ las bum bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i nang du padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang sngon phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa: khro bo'i chas thams cad ldan pa'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur: badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las sku: 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu stobs can: khro bo rgyal po khyod la bstod: las rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba de las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar mos la: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzlas/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying dang mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ mthar khro bo 'od du zhu ste chur thim pas de'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs snyed pa'i khro bor gyur pas phrin las mdzad par mos: de nas bdag bskyed 'od gsal du bsdu la rjes thob sgyu ma'i lha skur skad cig gis ldang*/ lha yi nga rgyal la gnas bzhin par/ rdor dril bsang sbyang ni/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rigs lnga'i rang bzhin thabs kyi rdo rje las sems can thams cad smin par byed pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro bar gyur: om̐ ma hā badzra hūm̐: zhes rdo rje lan gsum gsor/ āḥlas dbyings phyug yum lnga'i rang bzhin shes rab dril bu'i rnam pas sems can thams cad rig pa sad par byed pa'i chos sgra rgyun mi chad par gyur: om̐ ma hā ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes dril bu dkrol: rdor dril thabs shes kyi phyag rgyas snying khar bsnol zhing :

hūm̐: thabs shes zung 'jug chos nyid mtshon: ma lus 'gro rnams sad pa dang : sems can smin par bya ba'i phyir: rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol: om̐ badzra ghaṇḍe hūm̐ āḥ 'di nas sbyin sreg mthar dbyung gi bar du lag rdor dril dang ma bral ba dang lag pa pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba dang sems ting 'dzin las mi 'bral ba ste dam tshig gsum dran par byas la mchod rdzas rnams/ bdag nyid lhar gsal thugs las 'phros pa yi: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ zhu ma dag dri ma sbyangs: bhrūm̐ las sna tshogs ratna'i snod yangs par: oṃ las dam tshig rdzas rnams bdud rtsir rtogs: āḥhūm̐ ho yis snang srid gang bar spel: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tkhaṃ swā hā sogs lan gsum dang*/ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ bde stong ye shes kyi rnam rol kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho mkha' khyab tu phyag rgya sad par

bsam mo/ sreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsi'i bran la rdo rje rtse gcig pas reg ste/ oṃ swā hā/ rdzas rnams bkru/ yam shing la/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhun mar la/ oṃ shrī swā hā/ rdzas gzhan rnams la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs/ agne ye dzwa la ram̐/ zhes pas me sbar/ hūm̐ gis rlung g.yab/ oṃ agni swā hā/ zhes blug gzar mar khu'i thigs pas gso/ oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ ku sha bkram/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi snang srid rnam dag gi thab dang dam ye dbyer med kyi thab lha bskyed pa ni/ āḥ 'khor 'das ye dag lhun grub rgyal ba'i zhing : sor rtog ye shes na bza' dkar mo'i mkhar: ye shes sgyu ma rol pa'i dkyil 'khor pa: chu zla'i zlos gar ma 'dres rdzogs par gsal: hūm̐/ thab dbus skad cig dran rdzogs spyan ras gzigs: sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: rin chen thor tshug? lta bu 'khor 'das zil gnon ltar sbyar na dang*/ rdor sems ltar na/ hūm̐/ thab dbus skad cig rdo rje sems: dkar gsal zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan 'bar: dbu skr dang mkha' 'gro ltar na/ hūm̐/ thab dbus skad cig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: gsang ba ye shes mkha' spyod? sogs nas spyan 'dren bar btang*/ de nas bzhugs gsol dang phyag 'tshal grub nas mchod pa'i skabs mchod sngags kha phral la mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ zhes spyi 'gros sam yang na lha mtshan kha bsgyur la/ oṃ gu ru badzra sa twa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ lta bu'i thab tu cung zad re 'bul/ de bzhin nang gsang gi mchod pa'i skabs sman raka gtor gsum 'bul ba sogs gzhung so so ltar sbyar la/ gzhung gang yin gyi bstod pa grub ma thag /de nas byon skyems dgang blugs kyis 'bul ba ni/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu ram̐ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes:

nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od dkar rab 'phros te: zhi ba'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam: gzhung so so'i rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khus blug gzar bkang ba kha sbyar te g.yas su bskor nas lan bdun bar phul/ mthar rtsa sngags dang bcas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas lha ma gsal zhing sngags ma dag pa dang ting nge 'dzin ma gsal zhing cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa sogs nyams chag 'gal 'khrul thams cad byang zhing lhag chad kha bkang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang 'dod gsol ni/ ram̐: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ thog med bsags pa'i sdig ltung nyams chag dang : sngon las 'phral rkyen byad phur rbod gtong sogs: mi mthun dgra gdon rkyen ngan bar chad kun: ma bcos rig pa'i ngang du zhi gyur cig: oṃ sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes dang gzhan yang yam shing spung rdzas rnams gong bzhin lha so so'i rtsa sngags kho na'i 'bul la brgya rtsa re'i mtshams 'dod gsol gong ltar sbrel la bya/ tshul de lta bu'i bsnyen sgrub kha skong yin na bsnyen pa'i bcu cha dang gzhan du stong phrag gcig las mi nyung bar long skabs dang bstun te brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bskyar la rdzas rdzogs pa dang*/ sngar bzhin gzhung gi mchod pa'i skabs mchod rdzas gong bzhin lhag med thab tu dbul/ de nas sman raka gtor ma yang 'bul la/ oṃ badzra tambu la ye swā hā/ zhes so rtsi dang*/ oṃ badzra wasatra ye swā hā/ gos zung yang 'bul/ phyag rgya dril stabs dang bcas bstod pa gzhung ltar bya/ las rdor pas thab dkyil la phyag 'tshal zhing bshags pa ni/ hoḥ chos nyid don la nor 'khrul mi dmigs kyang : lta dman rig pa'i 'ub tu ma chub pa'i: lha sngags ting 'dzin cho ga yo byad rdzas: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul rang gnong bzod par gsol:

yi ge brgya pa bzlas pas 'khon bcugs sbyang*/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ sogs kyi mthar ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la thim par gyur/ zhes dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing*/ bsngo smon dang bkra shis mdor bsdus byas la rjes chog tshogs skong nas bkra shis bar mthar dbyung ngo*/ zhi ba'i me rang zhi la btang ba'am long khom med tshe 'o ma dang dri bzang gi chus gzhil la thal ba ri rtser rlung la bskur bar gsungs so/ de dag ni kha skong zhi ba'i me mchod spyi 'gros ltar grub bo/ dmigs bsal sgrub mchod sogs kyi skabs nyin snga ma'i tshogs mchod grub nas mchod bstod mgor rtsa bsnyen mthar sa ma ya satwaṃ/ brjod pas tshom bu lha grangs dang mtshungs par bkod/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol zhing mchod bstod sogs rgyun ldan ltar bya bas 'thus/ dngos gzhi sbyin sreg skabs me sbar te ku sha bkram pa'i rjes thog mar gzhung gi spyan 'dren btang la tshom bu spos rol dang bcas thab la bskor zhing tshom bu'i rtse mo bcad pa thab tu gtor la bzhugs su gsol/ āḥ 'khor 'das ye dag sogs thab lha bskyed la spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dor nas phyag 'tshal man gong dang mtshungs la sbyin sreg grub nas mchod bstod bshags pa'i rjes ye shes pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gshegs par gyur/ dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la thim par gyur/ zhes tshom bu dkyil 'khor du gdan drang ba khyad par ro/ de dag ni kha skong zhi ba'i me mchod grub bo/ ༈ zur du phrin las 'og ma gsum dang sbyar tshul yang*/ gter gzhung las/ 'og ma gsum yang gong bzhin rig pas 'phrul: nor bu mchog la byi dor mchod pa bzhin: gang zhig 'dir brtson 'bras ster e ma rmad: ces gsungs pa bzhin/ gnyis pa rgyas pa'i me mchod ni/ sbyor dngos phal cher zhi ba dang mtshungs la/ dmigs bsal ni/ gzhung las/ rgyas par gru bzhi ser po rin chen mtshan:

zhes dang*/ rgyas par rin chen 'bru sman dar zab ser: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ sbyin sreg bya ba'i dus kyang yar tshes gza' skar shis pa'i dus nyin gung char rang nyid chas gos ser por bsgyur la/ kha lho ru gyu ba'i mdun g.yas su mchod rdzas gtor ma sman raka rgyas pa'i 'bul gtor ser po gru bzhi mchod pa sna bdun sogs mdzes par bkod/ g.yon du sreg rdzas rim par ku sha dpal 'bar rlung g.yab mar khu yam shing dkar gsum mngar gsum dang mar khu gtso bor byas pa'i spungs rdzas sogs sngar ltar mtshungs/ rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi lte bar 'dab brgyad nor bu'i mtshan pa phyi rol nor phreng zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa thams cad kha dog ser por bsgyur la me tog gcal du bkram/ rgyas par 'os pa'i yam shing 'bras bu can gyi shing sogs ser por kha bsgyur la sbrang rtsi dang mar khus brlan/ thab gru bzhir brtsegs pa khyad par ro/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rdor dril byin rlabs nas mchod pa'i bar zhi ba ltar dang*/ gzhung gang yin gyi bstod pa grub ma thag /dgang blugs 'bul skabs dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu raṃ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od ser rab 'phros te: rgyas pa'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam: gzhung so so'i rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khu'i blug gzar bkang ba kha sbyar te g.yas su bskor nas lan bdun bar phul/ mthar rtsa sngags dang bcas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang grags pa lung rtogs yon tan thams cad oṃ sarba puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes dang 'dod gsol ni/ raṃ: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod:

hoḥ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa dang : nyams dang rtogs pa sa lam yon tan rtsal: stobs dang snyan grags gdul bya phrin las kun: rtsol med rig pa'i ngang du rgyas gyur cig: bhrūm̐ puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes dang gzhan yang yam shing spungs rdzas rnams gong bzhin lha so so'i rtsa sngags kho nas 'bul la brgya rtsa re'i mtshams 'dod gsol gong ltar sbrel te brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bskyar nas rdzas rdzogs pa dang*/ mchod bstod sogs snga ma ltar mtshungs la me thal gter bum du sba ba yin no/ ༈ gsum pa/ dbang gi me mchod ni/ sngon 'gro sogs gong ltar mtshungs la thab kyi khyad par ni/ gzhung las/ dbang la zla gam dmar po padmas mtshan: zhes dang*/ dbang la me tog glang sna dmar po sogs: 'bru sman shing 'bras dar zab dmar po'i rigs: sindhu ra dang li khri mtshal dang sbyar: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ sbyin sreg bya ba'i dus kyang zla ba mar gyi ngo dang dus tshes khyad par can mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus sogs dgong mo'i char rang nyid chas gos dmar por bsgyur la/ kha nub tu gyu ba'i mdun g.yas su mchod rdzas gtor ma sman raka dbang gi 'bul gtor dmar po zla gam mchod pa sna bdun sogs mdzes par bkod/ g.yon du sreg rdzas glang sna ug chos sogs me tog dmar po'i rigs dang 'bru rigs shing tog sogs myos byed kyis sbags la mtshal dmar gyis kha bsgyur ba'i spungs rdzas sogs sngar ltar mtshungs/ dbang gi dkyil 'khor dmar po zla gam lte bar 'dab brgyad dang padma'i lcags kyus mtshan pa phyi rol pad phreng zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje'i mtshan pa thams cad kha dog dmar por bsgyur la me tog gcal du bkram/ dbang la 'os pa'i yam shing tsandan sogs kha dog dmar po'i rigs dang thab zla gam brtsegs pa spor byed kyang smad tshong ma'i lag nas byung ba'i me sogs khyad par ro/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rdor dril byin rlabs nas mchod pa'i bar zhi ba ltar dang*/

gzhung gang yin gyi bstod pa grub ma thag /de nas dgang blugs 'bul skabs dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu raṃ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od dmar rab 'phros te: dbang gi phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam: gzhung so so'i rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khus blug gzar bkang ba kha sbyar te g.yon du bskor nas lan bdun bar phul/ mthar rtsa sngags dang bcas/ khams gsum srid gsum rlung sems snang ba thams cad oṃ sarba wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes dang 'dod gsol ni/ raṃ: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ rgyal ba'i mthu byin lha 'dre'i srog snying dang : che dgu gnyen bcu rgyal blon btsun mo sras: 'khor 'bangs pho mo zas nor longs spyod tshogs: 'bad med rig pa'i ngang du dbang sdud gyur: hrīḥ wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes dang gzhan yang yam shing spungs rdzas rnams gong bzhin lha so so'i rtsa sngags kho na'i grangs bzung la padma'i rgya dang bcas g.yon ma'i kun spyod kyis 'bul la brgya rtsa re'i mtshams 'dod gsol gong ltar sbrel la brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bskyar nas rdzas rdzogs pa dang*/ mchod bstod sogs snga ma ltar mtshungs la me thal yang chu klung chen por 'dor ba khyad par ro/ bzhi pa drag po'i me mchod ni/ spyir snga ma rnams dang phyogs mtshungs la dmigs bsal gyi khyad par ni/ gzhung las/ drag po'i gru gsum mthing nag ral gris mtshan: zhes dang*/ drag por zangs lcags yungs dkar sha khrag tshwa: dug can shing dang 'bru nag dgra gzugs sbyar: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ sbyin sreg bya ba'i dus kyang drag po la shis pa'i zla ba mar gyi ngo nyer dgu sogs 'phrod sbyor rtsub pa'i dus srod kyi char rang nyid chas gos nag por bsgyur la/

kha byang du gyu ba'i mdun g.yas su mchod rdzas gtor ma sman raka drag po'i 'bul gtor nag po gru gsum mchod pa sna bdun sogs bkod/ g.yon du sreg rdzas gzhan spyi dang mtshungs la khyad par gyi rdzas tshwa sna gsum dang dug sna gsum lcags zangs thal ba sha khrag sogs las sbrus pa'i ril bu'am phye ma gang rung dang gzhan du dgra gzugs liṅga sogs 'du bya ba'am/ spyi ltar rdzas spyi mthun ltar la dug khrag dang nag po'i tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba tsam gyis kyang rung ngo*/ drag po'i dkyil 'khor nag po gru gsum lte ba ral gris mtshan pa phyi rol ral gri'i phreng ba thams cad kha dog nag por bsgyur/ drag por 'os pa'i yam shing dug shing dang tsher ma can sogs nag pos kha bsgyur ba dug khrag gis ngar gyis brlan pa thab gru gsum brtsegs pa khyad par ro/ dngos gzhi sngar dang 'dra la/ dgang blugs 'bul ba'i skabs dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu raṃ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od ljang rab 'phros te: drag pos phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam: gzhung so so'i rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khus blug gzar bkang ba kha sbyar te g.yon du bskor nas lan bdun bar phul/ mthar rtsa sngags dang bcas/ nyon mongs dug gsum dang dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad sarba mā ra ya phaṭ/ zhes dang 'dod gsol ni/ raṃ: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ sngon las 'phral rkyen bstan dgra sgos dgra dang : ma rungs sems can gzugs can gzugs med dang : byad stems rbod gtong than dang ltas ngan bcas: skye med rig pa'i ngang du brlag gyur cig: hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ zhes dang gzhan yang yam shing spungs rdzas rnams gong bzhin lha so so'i rtsa sngags kho nas grangs bzung la mthe chung sbreng ba'i g.yon kho nas 'bul la brgya rtsa re'i mtshams 'dod gsol gong ltar sbrel la brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bskyar nas rdzas rdzogs pa dang*/

mchod bstod sogs snga ma ltar mtshungs la me dug khrag gis bsad la thal ba yang mnan pa bzhin bya ba ni lag len gyi khyad par te so so'i skabs phyed par bya'o/ lnga pa las bzhi lhun grub kyi me mchod ni/ spyir zhi ba ltar la khyad par ni/ gzhung las/ lhun grub drag po dbus nas rim can sbyar: zhes dang*/ lhun grub til yungs me tog shing 'bras sogs: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rang nyid chas gos sngon por bsgyur la/ 'bul gtor las bzhi'i gdan can 'brang rgyas sngon po mchod pa zhi ba dang mtshungs la kha dog sngon por bsgyur/ bsreg rdzas zhi rgyas bzhin gtso bor byas/ dkyil 'khor drag po dbus su byas pa'i las bzhi ka tshang ba'i lte bar 'dab brgyad 'khor los mtshan pa phyi rol rdo ra 'od phreng zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa thams cad kha dog mdzes mtshon la gzhi sngon por bsgyur la me tog gcal du bkram/ mchog gi las la 'os pa'i sman shing sogs la yam shing dang*/ thab dbyibs las bzhi'i rang gzugs ltar brtsegs pa khyad par ro/ dngos gzhi sogs zhi ba ltar dang*/ dgang blugs 'bul skabs dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/

sna tshogs 'od kyis rab 'byams las bsgrub bsam: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu raṃ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i sna tshogs 'od 'phros te: lhun grub rab 'byams phrin las sgrub par bsam: gzhung so so'i rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khus blug gzar bkang ba kha sbyar te g.yas bskor gyis lan bdun bar phul/ mthar rtsa sngags kyi mthar 'dod gsol ni/ raṃ: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsir 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sdig sgrib zhi ba dang : tshe bsod dpal yon 'byor drug rgyas pa dang : 'khor 'das mos bzhi snang sems dbang du bsdus: gnod byed tshar gcod drag po'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba shāntiṃ puṣṭiṃ wā shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ swā hā: zhes dang gzhan yang yam shing spungs rdzas rnams gong bzhin lha so so'i rtsa sngags kho na'i 'bul la brgya rtsa re'i mtshams 'dod gsol sbrel te brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bskyar nas rdzas rdzogs pa dang*/ mchod bstod sogs zhi ba ltar mtshungs so/ ro sreg ni zhi sreg gi cho ga zla ba'i 'od zer du gsal bas 'dir ma bkod la/ mkhyen par 'dod na der shes par bya'o/ de ltar spros med bsnyen sgrub la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i las bzhi me mchod nor bu sna tshogs mdog can zhes zab gnad khyad par can 'di nyid rje gter chen bla ma padma rgyal po 'gro 'dul gzhan phan gling pa rtsal gyis gnas mchog padma bkod 'khor lo lnga yi ya gyal bde chen 'khor lo'i gnas 'brug la mar me kong bum nas gter du bzhes pa'i zab gter sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi cha lag rtsa gsum spyi la sbyar chog pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams pa 'di'ang gter kha gong 'og gi bsnyen sgrub nyams len pa rnams la nyer mkho'i ched rtsa ba'i gter gzhung la man ngag gis zur brgyan te bklag chog mar bkod pa 'di yang gter chen bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i 'bangs gu hyas bgyis pa'i yi ge pa sgrub brtson au ḍi'o//

// lo gsum bsnyen sgrub mtshams kyi khog dbub mkhyen brtse'i dgongs rgyan sgeg mo'i me long bzhugs so// na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ mkhyem̐n gnyis ye shes gsal ba'i ā darshar/ /brtsem̐ chen snying rje'i gzugs brnyan rnam bkra bas/ /gdul bya'i khams dbam̐ng dang 'tshams nus pa'i dpal/ /mi zad rtag 'char dang pom̐'i sangs rgyas rgyal/ de yang lo gsum bsnyen sgrub mtshams kyi khog dbub mkhyen brtse'i dgongs rgyan sgeg mo'i me long zhes bya ba dben gnas ri sul du sgrub pa'i dam bca' bzung nas bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i lam la mos pa rtse gcig pas lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa'i rang ltos kyi gang zag pho mo rang dang rgyud tshod mtshungs pa'i dman bu rnams kyi nyams len la phan pa'i ched du cung zad smra bar byed pa la/ de la thog mar lo gsum phyogs gsum gang du nyams su len pa la sgrub pa'i gnas kyang dben zhing rgyal ba gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa sogs mdor na 'gal rkyen nyung zhing yo byad mthun rkyen sogs dgos pa'i nyer mkho tshang ba gal che la/ de dag gi rgyab rten bsod nams kyi dpung bskyed pa'i thabs dang bar chad sel ba'i sna sel du/ dang po ni/ rang rgyud sbyong ba la/ lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang phyir sātstsha gdab pa/ nye'u 'don pa/ srog bslu/ rnam 'joms sme brtsegs kyi khrus bya/ ngag sgrib sbyang phyir/ na rag dong sprugs dang yig brgya bzlas/ yid sgrib sbyang phyir sems bskyed blang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blugs/ gsum ka'i phyir du phyag skor dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la tshogs skong rgya cher bya/ de bzhin du sgrub khang gi shar du sher phyin/ lhor stobs po che/ nub tu lang kar gshegs/ byang du tog gzungs dang grwa nga klog par gsungs pa bzhin grub na legs/ thog mar bla gab med pa'i sar bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rgyag brngan lha bsang sogs mgron bzhi spyi mchod dang chu gtor mdos glud sogs mchod sbyin ci nus bya/

de bzhin dge 'dun gyi sde la bsnyen bkur dang nad pa dbul phongs bya rigs chu gnas sogs la sbyin gtong byas te sgrub pa mthar phyin cing bar chad med pa'i smon lam gdab bo/ sgrub gnas gsar pa yin na sa brtag slong dbang du bya ba/ sbyang zhing bsrung ba rnams sgrub khog ltar shes par bya yis sgrub gnas rnying pa la mi dgos so/ de lta bu'i gnas su bsnyen sgrub nyams su len pa'i skabs/ thog mar stan 'og tu sa dkar gyi g.yung drung bris pa'i steng rtswa ku sha rtse mo mdun bstan du bsnyal ba'i khar mal stan legs par bca' ba sogs sbyor ba'i chos rnams legs par grub pa bya/ nyams len dngos la 'jug pa ni/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas skyabs sems tshogs bsags kyis rgyud sbyangs/ so so'i sgrub thabs gzhung bsrangs te mchod bstod bzlas pa'i bar la btang*/ bzlas pa grub pa dang gsol kha nas tshogs skong chad brtan rta bro mchod bstod bsdu rim lhar ldang byas te bkra shis bar brjod rjes sngar gyi lhar ldang gi nga rgyal de ka'i mur/ rtsa sngags kyi gsal gdab tsam brjod pa dang chabs cig sngon gtor sde brgyad mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas mchod gtor rnams/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃḥ sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan gsum gyis bsngos/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di/

bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ces ci 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gātstshaḥ sa rang gnas su gshegs par bsam la/ 'jam rol dang bcas gtor ma dang gser skyems phyir 'bul/ gnang ba byin nas rang gnas su gshegs par bsam zhing*/ kun rdzob kyi sbyang ba dang*/ chos thams cad stong nyid du shes pas rang bzhin med par rgyas gdab/ de nas bgegs gtor byin brlab cing sngags kyis bsngo/ las byang ltar bka' bsgo zhing mtshams bcad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas phyi mtshams bcad pa ni/ sgrub khang gi sgo drung du tho 'dzugs pa la/ rgyal chen bzhi'i sku'am sngags byang rgyal mtshan dang bcas pa btsugs la so so'i mdun du stegs gtsang mar gtor ma dkar zlum mdun mtheb skyu ril bus mtshan pa dang*/ de yi mdun du g.yon phyogs nas brtsam pa'i chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga bcas bshams/ sgrub pa po rnams sgrub khang nas don te tho mdun du 'khod la/ rgyal tho'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rang byung mchod pa'i phung po ni: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bus: dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar gyur:

om̐ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod pa dang*/ gtor gzhong ratna'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum rgya dang bcas pas brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi nas rgyal po chen po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par bsam/ om̐ dhriṣṭā rāṣṭā ya swā hā: om̐ bi ru ḍha kā ya swā hā: om̐ bi ru pākṣā ya swā hā: om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pra tītstsha swā hāḥ sa mchod/ om̐ dhriṣṭa rāṣṭā ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ bi rū dha kā ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ bi ru pākṣā ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zab cing rgya chen gzigs pa po/ /yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras/ /shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi/ /rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/

ces phrin las bcol/ om̐ dhriṣṭā rāṣṭā ya swā hā: om̐ bi ru ḍha kā ya swā hā: om̐ bi ru pākṣā ya swā hā: om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: mthar/ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hāḥ sa brtan bzhugs bya/ gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol/ bar mtshams dam sri mnan pa sogs spros pa yod med gnyis su snang bas 'dir spro bar mos na/ dang po ni/ rang gzhung las stobs chen ma hā ba la'i lto bar khro zhal nang du liṅga bri ba dang bskyed pa sogs gsungs kyang spyir btang du dug shog la dam sri liṅga bya mchu can yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa'i snying khar dza tri na tri dza kha sprod mthar mgrin pa nas brtsams te yig mgo phyir bstan pa/ ya ma dam sri ya ma pa ri mā ra dza dzaḥ nan nan/ tri'u tri'u mā ra ya na ma sho dzaḥ khug nan/ zhes dang gzugs kyi mthar yig mgo nang du bstan la/ dus drug dang bcur rgyu ba'i nyul le dam sri rgyal 'gong 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum mthu stobs thams cad non cig bskal pa stong gi bar du ma ldang zhig om̐ lam̐ hūm̐ lam̐ satwaṃ bha ya nan/ zhes pa rnams kyi mthar dza khraṃ gyis bskor ba bris la/ grub na snga nyin lta bu bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i ling khrus dang 'gugs gzhug drag po byas la/ 'dre lteb tu bcag cing tshon skud kyis bcings/ thod ngan nam khyi thod lta bur bcug phung ras kyis dril la rtsang gis gzir ba'i mnan chas bya/ sgo drung du dong gru gsum brus pa la bkod/ de tsam mi 'grub pa'i skabs liṅga dong nang du btings/ slob dpon gyis gser skyems thogs la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha:

khyad par skabs gang yin pa'i lha mtshan kha bsgyur la lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras: bka' gnyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang : sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ces pa'i tshig mtshams gsum la gser skyems phul/ 'dir khro bo'i rigs la de'i nga rgyal bzung des 'thus/ zhi ba'i rigs la khro bo'i nga rgyal bzung dgos pas gu ru zhi ba la artsig brjod de bla ma drag po dang thugs rje chen po la rta sngags kyis rta mgrin gsal gdab sogs 'gres sbyar la/ om̐ badzra kro dha ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ phaṭḥ e yaṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ/ mdun du las kyi gshin rje kha tham nag po sa rim pa dgu'i bdag po nag la 'jigs shing srog la rngam tshul can/ 'chi bdag kha shin tu gdangs pa'i nang du na nag po yongs su gyur pa las dug gi rus sbal nag po khang sgrom gyi dbyibs can/ de'i dbus su tri nag po las dam sri pho mo mdog mi sdug cing sngo la ham pa mya ngan gyi gzugs can rid cing nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gyur/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i? khyad par skabs gang yin pa'i lha mtshan sbyar la/ lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sprul pa yang sprul phyag brnyan dang bcas pa rnams kyi? bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyi dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i ya ma dam sri mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig

tri yaṃ dzaḥtri badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug byas la/ de nas thun brdeg cing mnan pa ni/ hūm̐: sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer nas: 'chi bdag kha tham nag po bzhengs: nad rlangs dug gzer 'phro zhing bzhengs: za byed gdug pa'i khro zhal gdongs: 'joms byed rno ba'i sgrol mche gtsigs: 'jib byed g.yo ba'i dbal lce rkyongs: snyob byed 'chi bdag lag pa rkyongs: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan dang : sgrub la bar gcod dam sri'i rigs: sgab 'dre yul 'dre rgyal 'gong dang : gson 'dre pho mo shi 'dre'i rigs: grib can la sogs gnod byed rnams: 'chi bdag gnod sbyin khyod la gtad: deng bzung bskal pa ma stong bar: ma shor zungs shig lag ma shor: gal te shor ram btang srid na: bdag nyid gtum drag he ru kas: srid gsum bshig cing stong gsum 'gul: mthu chen drag rtsal rdul du brlag: de bas byang chub mchis kyi bar: gtad do ma shor phrin las mdzod: om̐ tsaṇḍa he ru ka ya ma rā dza kha thaṃ kha thaṃ: dam sri 'byung po waka thaṃ spur thaṃ nan:

'og gi 'don tshig dang bstun te skyer phur sor bzhi pa gdab/ thun rdzas brab/ gu gul bdug /dur rdo la ri rab gling bzhi dang rgya gram bris pas mnan la/ hūm̐: dam sri bya ba'i las ngan 'dis: rdo rje slob dpon sku la bsdos: mched lcam rnams la gnod cing bskyal: rgyal khams kun tu mi dge btang : gsang sngags lam gyi sgo yang bkag: bka' 'das nam yang ma btang bas: da ni khro bo'i phur tshogs gdab: thun tshogs gdab ste dud tshogs gtibs: gtub cing srin po'i zhal du bstab: ri rab brjid pa'i 'og tu mnan: zhes mthar 'bebs ring 'og tu sa chu me rlung rim pa bcu gsum re dang sātstsha nag pos mnan/ hūm̐: gcig ni brjod med nyag gcig rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa phyag rgya bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya: drug pa pha rol phyin drug rgya: bdun pa yan lag bdun gyi rgya: brgyad pa rnam thar brgyad kyi rgya: dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya: bcu pa khro rgyal bcu yi rgya: khyod la rgya bcu bcings te gdab: ri rab brjid pas steng nas mnan: dpa' bo'i bro ra byas te brdungs: bskal pa bye snyed mtha' ru mnan: om̐ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan: 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du khro rgyal 'khor bcas bzhugs par bsams la/ mched lcam rnams srin lag lu gu rgyud du sbrel te las byang so sor 'byung ba'i bro brdung hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod do/ de nas sgo byang gdags pa phyi nang gnyis ni/ phyi'i sgo gong du ra sog gam ro ras la sogs par dbang chen rta mgrin yab yum la bya khyung sde lngas bskor ba snying po 'dod gsol bris pa dang skyer phur la snying po bris te rgyab tu btags pa bkod/ dmar gtor dang mchod yon sogs bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍ bsang swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod du gtor mchod rnams phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos por gyur:

om̐ āḥhūm̐: sgrub khang pho brang chen po'i ya them phyi rol du hrīḥlas rta mgrin pa dbyug thod khrag 'dzin pa sgo yi nang logs su hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang gu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa: gnyis ka'ang 'bar ba'i khro bo nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can khro bo'i rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa'i spyi bor om̐: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros ye shes pa spyan drangs badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur so so'i rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan par gyur: om̐ badzra kro dha hya ghṛ wa a mṛ ta kunḍa li bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: puṣpe? sogs shabda āḥhūm̐: gis bar gyis spyan 'dren dbang bskur rgyas gdab gtor mchod bcas phul ba la phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐: sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ldan lha yul nas: bcom ldan che mchog lha yi bka' stsal ltar: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i mchog la nges bzhugs kyi: dngos grub rgya mtsho bdag gis ma thob par: khro chen 'jigs byed dpal chen rta mgrin gyis: sgrub la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs srungs shig: om̐ badzra kro dha hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa bzlas/ hūm̐: khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yis: bar chad byed pa'i bgegs srungs shig: sprul pa'i 'od zer dgra bgegs 'dul: dngos grub bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'khyil: bgegs kyi sbyor ba rgyun chod cig: om̐ a mṛ ta kunḍa li tshindha tshindha dam sri ma rā ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sngags bzhin bzlas mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi sgrub pa 'di nyid dbu btsugs nas ma rdzogs kyi bar du phyi yi bar chad nang du ma btang zhig: nang gi dngos grub phyi ru ma btang zhig: sgrub pa'i phrin las myur du stsol mdzod cig: ces 'dod don gsol slar yang*/

'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya/ sgo 'di'i yan chad su yang ma 'da' zhig: ces brjod/ de nas nang du yong ste srung 'khor bsgoms shing bkra shis rgyas bsdus gang 'tshams bya/ ye dharmā? bdag cag byang chub sgrub? bgegs rigs stong phrag? sogs/ mtshams kyi mgo mjug kun tu sgrub pa la bar chad med cing bkra shis pa'i phyir/ bkra shis brjod pa gal che bar gsungs/ de nas bzung ste phyi nang gi rgyu 'grul bcad de rang gis mi sogs gzhan mthong na mtshams bug pa dang*/ gzhan gyis rang mthong na ral ba yin pas dmigs 'og tu ma chud pa dang mi 'phrad par bya zhing chas ka'i gtong len cing mi byed/ cis kyang dgos na srung 'khor drag tu bsgom dngos chas gtong len sogs kyi rkyen nyams grib sbyang phyir rdor sems sme brtsegs lta bu'i khrus bum bsgrubs te 'thor 'thung bya/ dngos gzhi ni phyi thun dbang gi dus su mgo 'dzugs dgos pa yin pas de la lo dang por sngon 'gro'i skabs kun slong bcos pa nas bzung blo sbyong zhag brgya dang*/ nang gi sngon 'gro 'bum lnga bsags sbyang gi rim pa rnams grub nas lo rim gnyis pa bsnyen pa'i dngos gzhi skabs gong ltar sgrub thabs gang yin gyi gzhung bsrangs te tshogs skong nas bsdu ldang bkra shis bar snga ma ltar dang*/ tho gsol grub nas gtor ma phul la rab gnas bya bkra shis mdor bsdus brjod de re zhig grol/ slar dgong mo srod thun gyi skabs thun mtshams lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ rang nyid skad cig gi rdo rje he ru ka khro gtum bzod par dka' ba'i skur gyur/ de nas bgegs gtor bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ sarba bhighnān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo?khaṃ ghṛ hna daṃ ba liṃ dye swā hā/

lan gsum gyis bsngos te gzhung gang yin gyis bgegs bskrad/ gu gul bdug /hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ thun gyis brabs shing bgegs gtor phyir bskyal/ nang du logs pa dang sgrub sgo bsdams te gzhung gi mtshams bcad 'don mthar/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ rang gi thugs srog nas 'od zer me dpung khro chung gi tshwa tshwa grangs med pa 'phros bgegs tshogs rnams bskal pa'i pha mthar bskrad cing 'od zer tshur 'dus pas rdo rje'i srung gur gzhom zhig dang bral ba cis kyang mi shigs pa'i rang bzhin du gsal btab/ 'di mtshams mgo tshugs nas mthar ma phyin bar mi bsdu zhing nyin re'i thun mjug tu dmigs pas gsal tsam byas pa'i mthar mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa gnad yin no/ de nas bsam gtan stan la bag phebs par 'khod de thog mar kun slong legs par bcos shing dam bca' bzung*/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs nas skyabs sems tshogs bsags rnams rgyun ltar la skabs 'dir bgegs bskrad srung 'khor rnams sngar song zin pas mi dgos shing mchod rlob nas bzlas pa'i bar dkyus ltar bya/ bstod pa'i mthar dngos gzhi gtso bo gsal snang dang nga rgyal sbrel ma cung zad bya zhing bzlas pa la 'jug /grub ma thag dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig gam mchod bstod song nas rjes chog nyer bsdus kyi bar grub nas thun mtshams lha skur ldang la bsngo smon bkra shis brjod/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba dang nyal ba'i rnal 'byor rnams rang lugs chos spyod sa brtol ljon bzang ltar shes par bya'o/ sang zhogs thor thun du sngon 'gro rgyun ldan ltar song nas dngos gzhi gsol 'debs nas bsnyen pa'i bar srod thun ltar mtshungs la/

snga thun yang de bzhin skyabs sems kyi rjes bgegs gtor byin rlabs bsngo ba rnams dor nas srung 'khor mtshams gcod nas brtsams thor thun bzhin shes par bya/ phyi thun gyi mjug bsnyen bstod grub nas gsol kha la 'jug phrin bcol sogs mthar dbyung nas gzhung gi rjes chog mchod bstod nong bshags brtan bzhugs bsdu ldang bsngo smon bkra shis sogs gong ma rnams dang rigs 'gres/ srod thun ni gong zhus ltar ro/ de ltar thun bzhi dang thun mtshams kyi las bzhi sogs sbrel tshul thun bzhi rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i rang lugs thun mtshams chos spyod las ji ltar gsal ba bzhin nyams su len par gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/ de ltar bsnyen pa grub nas sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i skabs dzapa ྄khang dbye ba ni/ brgyud 'debs nas bstod pa'i bar btang*/ bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig bskyed la/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ sa rten par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi 'khor lo logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar me ri 'dab sbyor gyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam mo/ zhes se gol gtogs pas gsal gdab la bdag mdun dbyer med du dmigs nas dzap bskul dang bsnyen dmigs mthar bsnyen pa khyug tsam bzlas nas sgrub pa gtso bor bzung*/ grangs ni bsnyen pa'i bcu cha bzla bar gsungs so/ de bzhin las sbyor ni so so'i gzhung ltar sbyar la sgrub pa'i bcu cha bzla/ gzhan thun dang sngon rjes rnams bsnyen pa dang phyogs mtshungs so/ bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa grangs rtags thems nas dngos grub la 'jug pa'i snga rol du sgrub pa sang grol rgyu'i de ring gi dgong thun mjug tu dngos grub kyi rdzas gsar pa bshams la srod thun bzlas pa'i gsham du/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dgongs te/

sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i rnam pas bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la thim pas ye shes mchog gi gzi byin 'bar bar gyur/ bsnyen sgrub sngags gsham du / kā ya wākka tsitta gu na karma sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes btags pa brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ phyir nangs thor thun la phrin las gzhung bsrangs te/ bzlas pa kha skong mchod bstod bcas grub nas gsol kha khyug tsam btang nas skong bshags tshogs mchod bsgral bstab bar gzhung ltar la skabs 'dir dngos grub la mi dbang zhing blta nyan gyi bgegs tshar bcad pa'i phyir bgegs bskrad srung 'khor byin 'bebs bcas bya/ de nas ye shes lha la mkhon gcugs bshags phyir gnong 'gyod drag pos ye shes sku mchog ma/ yig brgya bcas song nas dngos grub blang ba dngos la 'jug pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros mdun bskyed lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs dam rjes su dgongs te sku'i gnas dang sbyor mtshams nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub rnams kyang byang sems bdud rtsi 'od zer 'bar ba'i rnam par spyan drangs/ bdag la thim pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsams la/ bsnyen sgrub sngags kyi sham du/ sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes btags pa brgya stong bzlas mthar rang gzhung gi dngos grub blang ba'i tshig brjod la/ sgrub rten lhar gsal ba'i gnas rnams nas 'od zer sna lnga rang gi gnas lngar thim pas mi zad rgyan 'khor lnga dang thun mchog rigs kyi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam la/ sgrub rten rnams gnas lngar gtugs shing bdud rtsi myang*/ dngos grub kyi rdzas cha gsum du bgos pa'i phud dang po dkyil 'khor gyi lhar phul/ cha gcig sbyin sreg gi rdzas la bsre/ cha gcig rang gis longs spyod par bya'o/

de nas chad lhag kha skong rtsa sngags kyi bcu cha me mchod bya bar gsungs pa bzhin nyin 'di rang du dbu 'dzugs par mos na skabs 'dir rtsa gsum spyi la 'jug pa'i me mchod phrin las bzhi ldan don gnyis dpal ster ltar zhi ba'i sreg blugs rdzas gtso bo til dkar nag dang rtsa bsnyen kho nas bsnyen pa'i bcu cha sogs nyin grangs ci nus su phul/ lhag gtor man chad dkyus ltar bya'o/ lo gsum tha ma'i skabs yin na 'dir sngar btson 'dzin byas pa'i lhag ma rnams kyang lhan cig tu spungs la phyir gtong*/ chos skyong gtor 'bul skabs su de dag gi gtor ma rnams yang thog lta bur 'bul/ chad brtan la rgyun bzhag phyir bskyang zhing rta bro brdung*/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod rgyas par byas la nongs pa bshags/ mdun bskyed kyi lha ye shes pa rnams ras bris dang dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bdag gi rnal 'byor yang 'od gsal du bsdu zhing rgyun spyod go bgo /de nas mtshams dkrol zhing dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rgyal chen bzhi dang sgo byang gnyis bcas so so'i mdun du dkar dmar dang*/ nyer spyod bcas bsham/ phyi rol tho rtsar phyin te/ mchod pa byin rlob ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rang byung mchod pa'i phung po ni: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bus: dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar gyur: om̐ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod pa dang*/ gtor gzhong ratna'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum rgya dang bcas pas brlab/ om̐ dhriṣṭā rāṣṭā ya ma hā ba lingta khā hi khā hi: om̐ bi ru ḍha kā ya ma hā ba lingta khā hi khā hi: om̐ bi ru pākṣā ya ma hā ba lingta khā hi khā hi: om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya ma hā ba lingta khā hi khā hi:

arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pra tītstsha swā hāḥ sa mchod/ zab cing rgya chen gzigs pa po/ /yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras/ /shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi/ /rgyal chen bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyi bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ces phrin las bcol/ om̐ dhriṣṭā rāṣṭā ya swā hā: om̐ bi ru ḍha kā ya swā hā: om̐ bi ru pākṣā ya swā hā: om̐ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: mthar/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/

zhes pas nongs pa bshags/ om̐/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ badzra muḥ zhes gshegs gsol bya/ de nas sgo byang phyi nang bkrol ba ni/ phyi sgor mchod gtor bshams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ badzra kro dha hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ arghaṃ? sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dbang chen he ru kaḥ yab yum sprul pa 'khor dang bcas: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar yang phyin: bar gyi sgo mtshams phye ru gsol: rtog med chos dbyings ngang la gshegs: bkra shis dge legs mdzad du gsol: badzra muḥ zhes lha gshegs sgo byang bsdu'o/ de nas nang sgor mchod gtor bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ om̐ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kunḍa li i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ arghaṃ? sogs mchod/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dam tshig bdud rtsi'i mchog: yab yum sprul pa 'khor bcas rnams: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring dkyil 'khor mthar phyin pas: nang gi srung 'khor bkrol du gsol: dam tshig ye shes dbyings su gshegs: bkra shis dge legs brtan du gsol: om̐ badzra muḥ sa gshegs/ me tog dang gser skyems dang bcas sgo byang bsdu'o/ gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol/ mthar sgrub khang la g.yas su bskor zhing nang du logs la gtang rag 'bul ba sogs dga' ston la longs spyod/ gzhung gi bsngo smon dang bkra shis brjod/ gzhan yang zhal nas gsungs pa'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pas thog drangs las so sor 'byung ba'i shis brjod rgyas par spel la/

me tog gi char du bsnyil te/ rol mo snyan par 'khrol ba sogs kyis dge legs rgya cher bya'o/ de nas bsdu rim gyi tshe yang*/ srung 'khor nas bsdu zhing rjes chog tshang bar byas te/ nang mtshams grol ba'o/ de nas zhag gsum dang bdun sogs ji rigs su thun ma chag tsam dang*/ tshogs skong bskang gsol sogs gtang rag gi tshul ci nus dang*/ bsngo smon mtshams sbyar la 'bad/ de nas phyi mtshams grol nas kyang chos dang mthun pa'i grogs dam tshig ldan pa re gnyis dang 'phrad la rim gyis gzhan du 'phrad par bya ba las hur rgyugs mi byed/ sngar bsgrubs zin pa rnams rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du bzung*/ tha na yang rtsa gsum gang yang rung ba'i yi dam gcig gtso bor bzung ste gzhan rnams snying po tsam re ma chag par cis kyang bya dgos so/ de ltar dben gnas ri sul dang sgrub pa'i sde rnams su bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i lam la bsten nas rtse gcig tu lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa'i e wam̐ sgrub sde zung sogs rang la ltos pa'i gang zag gsar bu ba pho mo rnams kyis nyams len la nye bar mkho ba'i ched bskul ngor rang lugs bla ma zhi drag gi sgrub pa chen po'i khog dbub la gzhi bcol/ dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes mthong rgyun man ngag gis brgyan te zur 'gengs cung zad dgos pa rigs mthun gzhan las kyang bsabs te bkod pa 'di'ang ris med bstan pa yongs kyi mnga' bdag padma'i rgyal tshab rigs kun khyab bdag 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyi zhabs rdul spyi bor reg pa'i skal bzang nyams su myong yang skyes sbyangs yon tan gyi nar ma son pa'i rgan bu byis pa'i ngang tshul can o rgyan gsang sngags bstan 'dzin nam rab btags sgo chen sprul ming du 'bod pas rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu lug lo dbo zla'i yar tshes thub pa'i grangs ldan nyin sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lho 'brong rdo shul gyi bande o rgyan gsang sngags 'gro 'dul gyis bgyis shing zhu dag gi mthun 'gyur byang 'brong lci yul gyi rnal 'byor pa gsang sngags ye shes rgya mtshos bgyis pa'i dge bas 'gro kun gsang sngags rim gnyis zab mo'i shul ring bsnyegs te rnam grol sku bzhi'i grong la 'jug pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

// e wam̐ sgrub sde zung gi lo gsum mtshams kyi bca' yig ma nor lam ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ rin chen gsum gyi thugs rje'i snang ba yis/ /srid gsum 'khrul pa'i mun pa bcom dang lhan/ /rang gnas ye shes rig khams yid bzhin nor/ /rnyed nas don gnyis 'grub pa'i thabs gyis shig /rang re rnams skye ba snyigs ma'i dus mthar skyes kyang bsags sbyangs ma dman pas dal 'byor gyi rten khyad par can thob/ mjal bar dka' ba snying po'i bstan pa rin po che dang nges don ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes dang mjal/ 'byor bar dka' ba'i gnas mchog khyad par can ma hā gu ru mchog gi dngos grub grub pa'i gnas chen yang le shod 'di lta bur gnas dus ston 'khor chos sogs phun sum tshogs pa'i mthun rkyen 'byor zhing 'gal rkyen dben pa'i dus 'di 'dra slar rnyed par dka' bas na/ yid bzhin nor bu'i gling du slebs pa'i dus lag stong du mi 'gro bar mi tshe gtan gyi 'dun ma dam pa'i lha chos gsha' ma zhig mdzad de rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa zhig ci nas kyang gal che/ de ltar ma byung yang tha ma 'chi khar blo lhag med par spro dga' ya le gdeng dang ldan pa zhig ni nges par du med na sgrub pa byas pa'i don go stong pa yin pas da res snying po lon pa zhig dgos/ de la thog ma nyid nas kun slong chos brgyad kyi dug dang ma 'dres pa dang bar du zhus lo thob lo tsam las rang rgyud chos kyis ma smin pa dred po chos rgyus can bdag lta bur ma song ba dang tha ma yang mtshams tha mal du grol nas rang rgyud spu nyag gcig gis bzang du ma song bar yar bla ma la dag snang bar mched grogs la brtse gdung mar sems can la snying rje/ nyams len la yid ches dang snying rus sogs spo tho mthur la 'gril ba bzhin je chung dang je zhan/ rgyud je gyong nga rgyal dang phrag dog je che ru phyin na ngal ba 'bras med du phyin pa yin pas de 'dras rang rgyud chud zos su btang ba ni phung tshab che/

des na rang re rnams rang don rang gces kyi blang dor ma 'dzol ba zhig gnang rgyu gal che ba ltar 'dir blang dor gyi byed phyogs cha shas gtan la dbab pa la/ dang po sgrub grwa la 'jug pa'i skabs nyid nas rmang gzhi brtan po yong ched/ gang 'jug 'dod yod pa rnams la'ang 'char zin zhig nges par dgos pa mthong ste de'ang chos dang bla ma la dad gus brtan pa/ dge 'dun gyi khrims la srung brtsi zhu nus min la brtag gzhig legs par bya rgyu las/ blo sna mi brtan pa'i chos dred dang gzhan nas 'thab 'khon can dang gnas dbyung btang ba dang*/ de bzhin du sgrub pa mtha' 'khyongs dka' ba'i nad gzhi lci ba snying rlung nad tshab che ba sogs ma brtags bab col du bzhag na rang gzhan zag pa bsog cing sgrub sde spyi yi bar chad du 'gyur nyen yod pas byung rgyal du mi 'jug rgyu dang*/ sgrub khang du dgos gal che ba'i rigs sman pa dang chu glog nyams skyob pa sogs dgos nges rnams thog mar nas dmigs 'og tu chud par byed rgyu las dus min du gsar 'jug sogs gtan nas mi bya/ sgrub pa'i sgor zhugs nas rang rgyud chos dang mthun phyir chos min gyi spyod pa dang 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi bya gzhag las rgyang bsrings te chos gsha' ma zhig byed dgos pa las/ lus mtshams khong du gnas kyang sems bag med du shor nas phyi rol gyi skye bo la phag lta nyan rna byed pa sogs sgrub par g.yel ba'i rgyu dang*/ de bzhin du nad par sngags 'debs dang srung ba'i 'khor lo ster ba/ gshin don bdun bcol len pa sogs nyams len la gnod rigs spang*/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba mo rtsis tshem drub dang*/ 'khel 'thag shing bzhogs lag bzo'i rigs dang*/ tshong bun khe bskyed sogs rang dang gzhan la bgyi bar bskul ba/ dngos grub phrogs pa'i rgyu chen por 'gyur ba'i nyes dmigs dran nas 'go ba'i nad bzhin du spang*/ de bzhin du sgrub khang du yod pa'i mtshams g.yog dang las byed yin yang thun gyi bar gseng kho na ma gtogs sgrub shag tu 'dzul ba dang ngag bsre ba skad cor brgyab pa sogs mi bya/

gung gseng gi skabs yin kyang don med kyi gtam chags sdang bsog pa'i ngag 'khyal lung tshan dang chos lugs sogs phyogs ris kyi gtams dang cal ka shag 'debs sogs mi byed/ sgrub khang nang du yul shog phyogs bsgrigs dang 'then 'khyer gyi rigs nam yang mi bya/ gzhan gyi thugs dam la gnod pa'i rol mo'i rigs dus min du 'bud dkrol brdung gsum dang 'jig rten gyi glu gzhas rnams ngag thog dang sgra thag 'khor lo sogs 'ur zing gi bya ba spangs nas kha khu sim po'i ngang dge sbyor gyi gnad la 'gro bar byed dgos/ thun bsdam dkrol thun dpon pas tshod 'dzin ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin sgrigs la phab dgos kyin so so'i rang snang gang dran mi bya/ khyad par du bla ma dang mched la 'gal na bsgrubs kyang 'bras bu med pas mtshams khang du kha rtsod dang lag 'dzing lta bu tshab chen bya ba'i mi su 'dra'i thad nas byung na yang*/ de nyin rang du gnas dbyung bya rgyu ma gtogs zhu bshags bya sa gtan nas med pa nges pas de bzhin nam yang mi 'byung bar thugs la nges gnang zhes zhu ba lags/ gnyis pa sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i snga snur du mtshams kyi sna sel du sgrub 'os rnams spyir mtshams kyi khog dbub mkhyen brtse'i dgongs rgyan ltar blta bar bya la bye brag bar chad sel ched rdo rje phur pa dang nyams chag bskang phyir rdo rje sems dpa' rnams thog mar bdun re las ma nyung bar bya bar gsungs pa bzhin yang phur phrin las 'bring po ltar dang rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan ltar grub par byas nas thog mar so so'i re 'dod dang sgrub khang gi byed phyogs dgongs don gcig tu bsgril na rang cag rnams la kun mkhyen yab sras kyi brgyud pa rin po che'i byin rlabs kyi drod tshad ma yal bar rtog ges tshig khrid dang chen po'i spom khrid ltar ma yin bar man ngag myong khrid zab mo'i srol rgyun zhig yod pa 'di shin tu gal che bas de ltar na/

lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi khog tu/ mdo phyogs skyes bu gsum dang*/ gsang sngags dbang bzhi'i nyams len bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen ste/ rim gnyis mthar thug snga 'gyur bla med yo ga gsum gyi nyams len bcas stan thog gcig tu gong 'og theg pa'i bab dang mi 'gal bar lam gyi lhu tshang zhing gnad lhongs pa dgos pas/ des na lo dang por sngon du zhal lung dang zhal lung zin bris sbrags ma dang*/ sa bcad mkhan po mun sel rin po ches khul bton rnams bsdebs la/ blo sbyong zhag brgya'i bka' khrid legs par thob par byas nas/ de dag re re bzhin sa mig mdzub gnon gyis dpyad 'jog spel ma'i sgo nas thun mong blo sbyong rang rgyud la bkal nas zhag dus thun tshad yan zhib phra rang nyams dang bstun te nyams su len dgos/ de yang thun gyi sum cha bgos pa'i cha gnyis blo sbyong dang cha gcig skyabs 'gro bsags pa sbrel nas thun mong blo sbyong grub pa dang*/ byang chub sems bskyed la/ kun rdzob sems bskyed smon sems tshad med bzhi dang*/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa/ bdag gzhan brje ba/ bdag pas gzhan gces rnams la'ang snga ma bzhin dpyad sgom dang*/ 'jog sgom spel mas nyams su len/ skabs su rlung phyi nang gi 'gro 'ong dang bstun nas gtong len bsgom/ de la 'jug pa sems bskyed phar phyin drug la'ang sngar ltar blo sbyang*/ thun tshad snga ma dang mtshungs par thun gyi cha bgos te sum cha gcig la sems bskyed grangs bsags bya/ grangs ka yang khri bzhi las mi nyung bar bya/ de la'ang bsam gtan dang shes rab gnyis las snga ma ni sems gnas kyi zhi gnas dang*/ phyi ma ni/ lhag mthong bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab gtso che la des na snga ma 'jog sgom dang*/ phyi ma ni dpyad shes kyis gtan las dbab cing dpyad 'jog spel mas nyams su myong bar byed dgos/ de nas zhag brgya grub nas sngon 'gro dngos ni grwa btsun sgrub sde gnyis so so'i rang lugs ltar byas pas chog

/de rjes sems sbyong bdun ma rgyab snon gyi tshul du zhus la sa bcad phal cher nyin shas re bsgoms pas chog ste blo sbyong zhag brgya sngar song zin pa'i phyir zhib par ma byas kyang chog /de nas sems sbyong bdun gyi tha ma bde stong gsal stong mi rtog pa gsum la sems sbyong ba 'di gal che bas re re la bdun phrag re las mi nyung bar bsgoms la myong ba thob pa ci nas kyang bya/ de dag gi skabs zur bltas dpe cha ni zhal lung dang*/ zhe chen rgyal tshab rin po che'i sngon 'gro'i khrid dang yon tan mdzod sogs dpe ltas tshun ci thub bya/ de nas bsags sbyong dngos rdor sems nas bzung bla ma'i rnal 'byor bar sku gsum mkha' 'gro gling du snying thig sngon 'gro ltar bya ba yin la/ phur pa gling sgrub sdes rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje'i rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol sngon 'gro'i zab khrid ltar nyams su len pa yin pas tshul de ltar bgyis na rung min 7skyabs rje bya bral rin po cher bka' 'dri zhus pas rje grub dbang thugs mchog rdo rje dang*/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa gnyis bla slob yin pa dang chos brgyud gcig pa yin pas de ltar man ngag rnams snying thig gis brgyan na ches 'brel che la don che ba yin zhes bka' stsal thob pa ma zad rigs kun khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po o rgyan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis kyang gnam lcags chos brgyud nyams len rang rkang la man ngag snying thig ltar gyis zhes rdo rje'i bka' stsal gnang byung bas rang re rjes 'jug kun gyis ma 'ongs par 'di ltar bya dgos pas thugs nges zhu/ de ltar na rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol ltar na skyabs phyag sbrags rgyu yin la/ snying thig phal cher bla rnal yan lag bdun pa dang sbrags nas phyag 'tshal ba mang bas de ltar bya/ khrid rim yang snying thig ltar na thun mong nang gi sngon 'gro'i khrid lag len 'debs srol ltar dang*/

gnam lcags ltar na rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje'i zab khrid ltar byed dgos/ bsags sbyong gyi grangs tshad ni/ rdor sems 'bum gcig dang maṇḍal 'bum gcig /7skyabs rje bya bral rin po ches bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'bum brgya kha skong dang bcas pa bsags pa'i phyag srol 'dug pas de ltar grub na shin tu legs/ 'on kyang sngon 'gro'i las rim de dag rnams lo gcig nang grub par bya dgos so/ ༈ lo rim gnyis pa dngos gzhi bskyed rim ma hā yo ga'i nyams len gtso bo yin la/ de la thog mar gsang sngags kyi 'jug sgo dbang thob dgos pas rtsa gsum gang sgrub rgyu'i smin byed kyi rim pa rnams dang po thob par byed dgos/ bla ma phal che ba'i phyag srol ltar na bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sngon du gu ru yi dam gang rung dbang gnang srol 'dug /dang po bskyed rim rnam bzhag 'og min bgrod pa'i them skas dang srog sdom gzer bzhi'i rtsa 'grel/ bskyed rim zung 'jug snye ma/ zhe chen rgyal tshab rin po che'i bskyed rim khrid rnam zhib khṛd zhus te/ bskyed rim spyi la go ba chags par byed dgos/ zur bltas yon tan mdzod 'grel nyi ma'i 'od zer dang*/ rtsa gsum gling pa'i bzlas pa sngags kyi pra khrid bsnyen sgrub spyi gces rnams dang gzhan yang so so'i rtsa gsum bye brag gi bsnyen yig rnams zhus te/ dngos gzhi btsun ma'i sgrub sde'i/ thog mar bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa zla ba gnyis bar du bsnyen pa thon nas tho rangs dngos grub blang zhing bsnyen sgrub kyi kha skong sbyin sreg nyin gsum tsam gyis grub pa dang*/ de nas yi dam thugs sgrub dpal chen 'dus pa'i bsnyen sgrub la zhugs nas zla ba gsum dang*/ de nas thugs rje chen po sdug bsngal rang grol zla ba gsum ste yi dam zhi drag grub pa dang*/ de nas mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo'i rtsa sgrub la 'jug par bya ste yun zla ba gsum/

gong gsal rnams re re bzhin kha skong sbyin sreg dang gtang rag tshogs 'khor bcas lo rim gnyis pa'i rtsa gsum bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa grub pa'o/ yang gnam lcags sgrub sde phur pa gling du cha mtshon na/ ༈ dang po rdor sems thar lam lnga ldan dus bsnyen zhag nyer gcig /gnyis pa bla ma'i thugs sgrub rtsa gsum bka' 'dus spyi dril bsam lhun las byang tshar re snga thun dang*/ thun gzhan la rtsa ba gcig dril byas pa'i bsnyen pa siddhi 'bru 'bum kha skong dang bcas pa/ sgrub pa thod phreng rtsal dang las sbyor hri ma ha ri ni sa bcas sgrub mtshams sbyin sreg nyin gsum tshogs skong bcas tshar bar bya ba grangs bsnyen la zla ba gcig dang zhag nyer lnga/ gsum pa 'khor 'das zil gnon sta gon byas la longs sku ltar sgrub dus bsnyen zhag bdun/ bzhi pa bla ma drag po padma khrag 'thung gsang sgrub bzhin bsnyen pa zhag nyer gcig /lnga pa bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po zhag nyer gcig ༈ yi dam gyi skor la/ dang po bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi las byang 'bring po ltar dang thun rjes ma rnams la rgyun khyer kho nas zhag nyer gcig /gnyis pa yang phur las byang rgyas pa dang phrin las rgyun khyer sbrags yang phur rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa kho na grangs bsnyen zla ba gnyis dang zhag po lnga/ gsum pa gshin rje dug ri me 'bar zhag bdun/ rta mgrin/ ༈ mkha' 'gro'i skor la/ dang po gsang ba ye shes zla ba gcig dang zhag nyer brgyad/ gnyis pa bdud 'dul drag mo zhag nyer gcig /gsum pa rlung zhags mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs zhag nyer gcig /tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud zhag nyer gcig /rig 'dzin 'dus par bsnyen 'brel zhag nyer gcig bcas kyis grub/ ༈ lo tha ma gsang sher gyi nyams len lung a nu yo ga dang 'brel ba'i mtshan bcas rdzogs rim skor la/ gnam lcags rlung zhags mkha' 'gro'i rtsa rlung dang*/ klong snying zung 'brel gyi rtsa rlung khrid zhus nas thog mar bde stong rlung gi rdzogs rim ltar rlung bum pa can bzung zhing de yi gegs sel yan lag lnga sbyong gyi 'khrul 'khor la bslab/

gtum mo'i nyams len 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa dang gegs sel gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor rig 'dzin brgyad/ thig le'i 'khrul 'khor rgyal ba rigs lnga/ gegs sel bogs 'don gyi 'khrul 'khor gsum ste yongs dril 'khrul 'khor nyer gcig bcas mdor na zhag brgya la tshar rgyu/ de nas bzung nyin re bzhin 'khrul 'khor tshar re ma chag par bya dgos so/ de nas tha ma rdzogs chen khyad par gyi sngon 'gro sgo gsum 'khor 'das ru shan sbyang ba nas dngos gzhi khregs chod dang thod rgal gyi nyams len/ nyin mtshan thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor khrigs rim la phab nas rtse gcig nyams su len tshul ni/ yon tan mdzod rdzogs chen skor dang tshig gsum gnad du brdeg pa'i man ngag dang gnam lcags rdzogs chen don khrid/ khrid ye shes bla ma zung 'brel byas nas 'khor 'das ru shan skabs phyi'i ru shan lus ngag yid gsum gcig tu zhag bcu bzhi/ nang gi ru shan rigs drug sa bon sbyong ba'i dmigs pa dang sbrags 'bru gsum bzlas pa 'bum bdun zhag bdun la tshar rgyu/ lus sbyong la zhag bdun/ ngag sbyong rgyas gdab la zhag bdun/ rtsal sbyang ba la zhag bdun/ gnyen btsal la zhag gsum/ lam gzhug la zhag gsum/ sems sbyong la byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag pa zhag bco lnga/ rnal dbab la zhag bcu bzhi/ sor zhugs la zhag gsum/ bcas bsdoms zhag brgyad cu tham pa/ khregs chod la zla ba gsum dang zhag po bcu la nyams len dang*/ de nas thod rgal la'ang zla ba gsum dang zhag po bcu bar nyams len byed dgos/ de dag gis lo gsum phyogs gsum dngos gzhi nyams len grub par byas nas mthar skong bshags dang chos skyong gi gtang rag sogs rgyas par bya/ mtshams grol nas kyang thog mar chos grogs sogs nye ba rnams dang 'phrad cing de yi rjes su rim bzhin gzhan du 'phrad/ 'di phyin thugs dam sngar grub pa'i rgyun khyer rnams ma chad par rgyun gyi nyams len bya/

de bzhin mkhan chen ngag gi dbang po'i thugs dam nar ma rgyun gyi nyams len ltar nyin re bzhin zhogs par sngon 'gro dang bum can nyin gung rdzogs chen srod du gtum mo'i nyams len nam phyed shes pa bum 'jug sogs mdor na rab tshe lhag chos kyis bsgril nas tshe dang sgrub pa mthar phyin par bya/ de ltar ma nus kyang sngar brtsams pa'i mjug 'khyol bar byas te rang nus ji yod bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du zhabs zhu sgrub pa'i dam bca' bcang zhing bsngo ba dang smon lam bzang pos las 'phro ma log pa zhig ci nas kyang gal che bas de lugs bzhin thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhes/ snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/ zhes pa'ang rang la rtogs pa med pa'i gzhan bskul gtam 'on pas rol mo 'khrol ba'i dper zad pa bden mod/ 'on kyang rdo rje 'chang dngos mi yi zol du bzhugs pa rigs bdag o rgyan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer sogs dam pa du ma'i zhal las legs par thos pa'i don rang ltos gzhan rnams la phan pa'i kun nas bslangs te dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin smras pa la nor ba med snyam mo/

zhes pa 'di yang sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i gling btsun ma'i sgrub sde dang*/ gsang sngags phur pa gling grwa pa'i sgrub sde ste e wam̐ sgrub sde zung gi sgrub brtson pa rnams kyi dgos mkho'i ched sprul ming gsang sngags bstan 'dzin nas smras rim bzhin rang slob dbyangs can chos sgron nas glog klad 'phrul gyi do ra ru sor mos 'du byed bsgyur ba dge bar gyur cig/ //
